import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { GATE_COOKIE, GATE_PATH, gateEnabled, isOpenPath, verifyGateToken } from '@/lib/gate'

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl

  if (gateEnabled() && !isOpenPath(pathname) && !(await verifyGateToken(request.cookies.get(GATE_COOKIE)?.value))) {
    const isNavigation = (request.method === 'GET' || request.method === 'HEAD') && !pathname.startsWith('/api/')
    if (!isNavigation) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Bu alan özel. Önce erişim kapısından geçmelisin.' }, { status: 401, headers: { 'X-Robots-Tag': 'noindex, nofollow' } })
    }
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone()
    url.pathname = GATE_PATH
    // Keep any existing query (e.g. preview tokens) so the redirect never drops host-level auth.
    url.search = search
    url.searchParams.set('next', `${pathname}${search}`)
    return NextResponse.redirect(url)
  }

  const headers = new Headers(request.headers)
  headers.set('x-pathname', pathname)
  const response = NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } })
  response.headers.set('X-Robots-Tag', 'noindex, nofollow, noarchive')
  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|svg|webp|avif|gif|ico|zip|woff2?|mp3|mp4|webm)$).*)'],
}

// SYTHERIS · /indir sayfasını tamamen kaldırır.
// Çalıştır: node indir-kaldir.mjs
// Sitenin geri kalanı bu dosyalara bağlı değildir; kaldırdıktan sonra proje sorunsuz derlenir.
import { promises as fs } from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const ROOT = process.cwd()
const PATHS = ['app/indir', 'app/api/indir', 'components/download', 'lib/project-archive.ts', 'public/sytheris-proje.zip']

for (const rel of PATHS) {
  try {
    await fs.rm(path.join(ROOT, rel), { recursive: true, force: true })
    console.log(`- ${rel}`)
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`! ${rel}: ${e.message}`)
  }
}

const cfgPath = path.join(ROOT, 'next.config.mjs')
const cfg = await fs.readFile(cfgPath, 'utf8')
const nextCfg = cfg.replace(/\n\s*outputFileTracingIncludes:\s*\{[\s\S]*?\n\s{2}\},/, '').replace(/\nconst ARCHIVE_FILES = \[[\s\S]*?\]\n/, '\n')
if (nextCfg !== cfg) {
  await fs.writeFile(cfgPath, nextCfg)
  console.log('~ next.config.mjs: /indir izleme ayarı kaldırıldı')
}

const gatePath = path.join(ROOT, 'lib', 'gate.ts')
try {
  const gate = await fs.readFile(gatePath, 'utf8')
  const nextGate = gate.replace(", '/indir', '/api/indir'", '')
  if (nextGate !== gate) {
    await fs.writeFile(gatePath, nextGate)
    console.log('~ lib/gate.ts: /indir açık yol listesinden çıkarıldı')
  }
} catch {}

await fs.rm(path.join(ROOT, 'indir-kaldir.mjs'), { force: true })
console.log('\n/indir kaldırıldı. Bu betik de kendini sildi.')

# SYTHERIS

Anime keşif platformu — Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4.

## Kurulum

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

## Ortam değişkenleri (.env.local)

| Değişken | Açıklama |
| --- | --- |
| ADMIN_PASSWORD | /admin paneli şifresi |
| SESSION_SECRET | Oturum imzalama anahtarı (openssl rand -base64 32) |
| DATABASE_URL | Neon / Postgres bağlantısı (kalıcı veri) |
| DISCORD_CLIENT_ID / DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET | Discord ile giriş |
| GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET | Google ile giriş |
| GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET | GitHub ile giriş |
| GEMINI_API_KEY | Gemini yapay zekâ (bulut yedek) |
| OLLAMA_URL / OLLAMA_MODEL | Sunucudan erişilebilir Ollama (opsiyonel) |

## Intro ve tanıtım

- İlk açılışta kısa bir yükleme sahnesi oynar (`components/shell/intro.tsx`); ilk kez gelen ziyaretçi `/hosgeldin` sayfasına alınır.
- `/hosgeldin` kaydırmayla oynayan 3D tanıtım filmidir (`components/welcome/prologue/`): pencere → kapak tüneli → kelime makarası → Syra. Ardından dergi tarzı tanıtım bölümleri gelir. `Esc` ya da "Geç" filmi atlar.

## Kontrol merkezi (gizli yönetim paneli)

Panel `/sy-core` adresindedir ve sitede hiçbir yerde bağlantısı yoktur. Açmak için:

- `Ctrl` / `Cmd` + `Shift` + `Y`
- Bir metin alanında değilken `sycore` yazmak
- Mobilde üst menüdeki SYTHERIS logosuna ~2,5 sn basılı tutmak

`ADMIN_PASSWORD` ile giriş tam yetki verir. Kullanıcılara panelden "Moderatör" rolü atanırsa kendi hesaplarıyla girip yalnızca topluluk/moderasyon sekmelerini görürler.

## Sytheris+ abonelik

Planlar kod ile etkinleşir: Kontrol merkezi › Abonelik kodları bölümünden kod üretip kullanıcılara dağıtın; kullanıcılar `/abonelik` sayfasından kodu girer.

## Çizim Atölyesi

- `/atolye` — herkese açık topluluk galerisi (haftanın eseri, beğeni, paylaşım).
- `/atolye/studyo` — Sytheris+ üyelerine özel tarayıcı stüdyosu: 16 katman, 11 karışım modu, basınca duyarlı fırçalar, sabitleyici, simetri, ayna görünüm, boya kovası, şekiller, görsel içe aktarma, buluta taslak kaydı (Ctrl+S) ve tek tıkla galeride sergileme.

## Link avcısı (mp4 / m3u8)

Kontrol merkezi › İçerik › **Link avcısı**. Bir bölüm sayfasının bağlantısını yapıştır; sayfa, içindeki gömülü oynatıcılar (iframe), oynatıcı betikleri, paketlenmiş (p,a,c,k,e,d) ve base64 ile gizlenmiş kaynaklar taranır, bulunan her mp4 / m3u8 sunucuda doğrulanır.

- **Önizle / İzle**: kaynak indirilmeden, imzalı `/api/medya` bağlantısıyla gömülü oynar.
- **Kaydet**: kaynak "Kayıtlı kaynaklar" listesine eklenir.
- **Bölüme ekle**: kaynağı bir animenin bölümüne bağlar; bölüm sayfası aynı imzalı bağlantıyla oynar.

Güvenlik: yalnızca yöneticiler kullanabilir, her yönlendirme adımında özel ağ (SSRF) koruması vardır, dakikada 12 tarama sınırı uygulanır, her işlem denetim kaydına yazılır. `/api/medya` yalnızca sunucunun HMAC ile imzaladığı adresleri aktarır, açık proxy olarak kullanılamaz. Giriş, captcha ya da DRM adımından sonra oluşan kaynaklar okunamaz.

## Projeyi indirme (gizli sayfa)

`/indir` sayfasındaki buton, projenin tamamını (node_modules, .next ve .env hariç) giriş istemeden ZIP olarak indirir. Dosyalar açık olan sayfanın kendi adresine giden sunucu eylemleriyle 2 MB'lık parçalar hâlinde çekilir ve ZIP tarayıcıda oluşturulur; bu yüzden 401 / Unauthorized hatası vermez. Olmazsa `/api/indir` akışı denenir.

Sayfayı tamamen kaldırmak için: `node indir-kaldir.mjs`. Geçici kapatmak için ortam değişkeni: `INDIR_DISABLED=1`.

OAuth callback adresi: `https://ALANADIN/api/auth/{discord|google|github}/callback`

Yerel Ollama'nın tarayıcıdan kullanılabilmesi için Ollama'yı `OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*` ile başlatın.

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode }>) {
  const [settings, admin, h] = await Promise.all([getSettings(), isAdmin(), headers()])
  const pathname = h.get('x-pathname') ?? '/'
  const bypass = admin || pathname.startsWith('/sy-core') || pathname.startsWith('/api') || pathname.startsWith('/indir') || pathname.startsWith('/kapi') || pathname.startsWith('/rehber')
  const showMaintenance = settings.maintenance && !bypass

  return (
    <html
      lang="tr"
      data-theme="green"
      data-scroll-behavior="smooth"
      suppressHydrationWarning
      className={`${bricolage.variable} ${instrument.variable} ${jetbrains.variable} ${notoJp.variable} bg-background`}
    >
      <head>
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://s4.anilist.co" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://graphql.anilist.co" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
        <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://i.ytimg.com" />
        <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com" />
        <Script id="sy-boot-script" strategy="beforeInteractive">
          {BOOT_SCRIPT}
        </Script>
      </head>
      {/* overflow-x-clip, not -hidden: "hidden" turns <body> into a scroll container and silently breaks every position:sticky stage. */}
      <body className="min-h-dvh overflow-x-clip" suppressHydrationWarning>
        <AppProviders introEnabled={settings.introEnabled}>
          {showMaintenance ? <MaintenanceScreen settings={settings} /> : children}
        </AppProviders>

        <FloatingInstall />

        <Script id="sw-register" strategy="afterInteractive">
          {`if('serviceWorker' in navigator){navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(function(){})}`}
        </Script>
        {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && <Analytics />}
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}

/*
 * Boot intro. The whole timeline (load → expand → exit) is CSS so it plays from first paint and never waits on
 * hydration; JS only unmounts it afterwards and handles skip. Unlayered so @property / @counter-style stay top-level.
 */
@property --intro-n {
  syntax: '<integer>';
  initial-value: 0;
  inherits: true;
}

@counter-style intro-pad {
  system: extends decimal;
  pad: 3 '0';
}

.intro {
  --intro-load: 1900ms;
  --intro-expand-at: 2170ms;
  --intro-exit-at: 3070ms;
  --intro-ease: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --intro-snap: cubic-bezier(0.83, 0, 0.17, 1);
  animation:
    intro-count var(--intro-load) var(--intro-ease) 150ms both,
    intro-exit 850ms var(--intro-snap) var(--intro-exit-at) forwards;
}
.intro[data-phase='exit'] {
  animation:
    intro-count var(--intro-load) var(--intro-ease) 150ms both,
    intro-exit 650ms var(--intro-snap) forwards;
}
@keyframes intro-count {
  to {
    --intro-n: 100;
  }
}
@keyframes intro-exit {
  from {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
  }
  to {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0);
    visibility: hidden;
  }
}

.intro-counter::after {
  counter-reset: intro var(--intro-n);
  content: counter(intro, intro-pad);
}

.intro-stage {
  animation: intro-stage-in 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes intro-stage-in {

    opacity: 0;

  }

import { StudioGate } from '@/components/studio/studio-gate'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Stüdyo — Çizim Atölyesi',
  description: 'Katmanlar, basınç duyarlı fırçalar, simetri ve karışım modlarıyla tarayıcıda çiz; eserini Sytheris galerisinde sergile.',
  robots: { index: false },
}

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: '#121212',
  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  maximumScale: 1,
  userScalable: false,
}

export default async function StudioPage() {
  const viewer = await getViewer().catch(() => null)
  if (!viewer) return <StudioGate reason="login" />
  if (viewer.header.tier === 'free') return <StudioGate reason="premium" />
  const draft = await getDraft(viewer.user.id).catch(() => null)
  return <StudioEditor draft={draft} artist={`@${viewer.user.username}`} />
}

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Giriş yap', description: 'Discord, Google, GitHub veya e-posta ile Sytheris hesabına giriş yap.' }

export default async function LoginPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string; provider?: string }> }) {

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { getChapterPages, getChapters, getManga, type ReadLang } from '@/lib/manga'
import { MangaReader } from '@/components/manga/manga-reader'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string; chapter: string }>; searchParams: Promise<{ hq?: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params
  const manga = await getManga(id)
  return { title: manga ? `${manga.title} oku` : 'Manga oku', robots: { index: false } }
}

export default async function ReaderPage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const [{ id, chapter }, { hq }] = await Promise.all([params, searchParams])
  const quality = hq === '1' ? 'data' : 'data-saver'
  const [manga, pages] = await Promise.all([getManga(id), getChapterPages(chapter, quality)])
  if (!manga || !pages || !pages.pages.length) notFound()

  const lang: ReadLang = pages.lang === 'tr' ? 'tr' : 'en'
  const chapters = await getChapters(id, lang)
  const index = chapters.findIndex((c) => c.id === chapter)
  const prev = index > 0 ? chapters[index - 1] : null
  const next = index >= 0 && index < chapters.length - 1 ? chapters[index + 1] : null

  return (
    <MangaReader
      manga={{ id: manga.id, title: manga.title }}
      chapter={{ id: chapter, number: pages.chapter, title: pages.title, lang }}
      pages={pages.pages}
      chapters={chapters.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, number: c.chapter, title: c.title }))}
      prevId={prev?.id ?? null}
      nextId={next?.id ?? null}
      hq={quality === 'data'}
    />
  )

'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'

import { LostScene } from '@/components/mascot/lost-scene'

export default function ErrorPage({ error, reset }: { error: Error & { digest?: string }; reset: () => void }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/log', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ message: error.message || 'Sayfa hatası', stack: `${error.stack ?? ''}\ndigest: ${error.digest ?? '-'}`, path: location.pathname }),
    }).catch(() => {})
  }, [error])

  return (
    <LostScene
      embedded
      code="500"
      word="TERS GİTTİ"
      mood="think"
      title="Bir şeyler"
      accent="ters gitti."
      message={`Hata kaydedildi ve yöneticiye iletildi. Syra bakıyor; sen de sayfayı yeniden deneyebilirsin.${error.digest ? ` (kod: ${error.digest})` : ''}`}
      primaryAction={
        <button type="button" onClick={reset} className="group flex flex-col gap-1.5 py-4 text-left outline-none sm:px-6 sm:py-0">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-on-scrim transition group-hover:text-ink">
            <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> Tekrar dene
          </span>

        </button>
      }
    />
  )
}

async function introArt(mode: 'anime' | 'film') {
  if (mode === 'anime') return { covers: await getIntroCovers(), keyart: '/intro/keyart.webp' }
  const films = (await getTopFilms(30)).filter((f) => f.poster)
  return { covers: films.slice(1, 8).map((f) => f.poster), keyart: films[0]?.posterLg ?? '/intro/keyart.webp' }
}

export default async function SiteLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {

    <>

      <AnnouncementBar text={settings.announcement} tone={settings.announcementTone} />
      <SiteHeader user={viewer?.header ?? null} mode={mode} />

        {children}

'use client'

import { motion, type TargetAndTransition } from 'motion/react'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

type Variant = { initial: TargetAndTransition; animate: TargetAndTransition; overlay?: 'curtain' | 'iris' | 'shutter' }

const EASE = [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] as const

function variantFor(pathname: string): Variant {
  if (pathname === '/') return { initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.985 }, animate: { opacity: 1, scale: 1 } }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/anime')) return { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, overlay: 'curtain' }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/rastgele')) return { initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 }, animate: { opacity: 1, scale: 1 }, overlay: 'iris' }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/kutuphane')) return { initial: { opacity: 0, x: -36 }, animate: { opacity: 1, x: 0 }, overlay: 'shutter' }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/ara')) return { initial: { opacity: 0, x: 36 }, animate: { opacity: 1, x: 0 } }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/takvim')) return { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 60 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/ayarlar') || pathname.startsWith('/abonelik')) return { initial: { opacity: 0, y: -18 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }
  return { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 14 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }
}

function Overlay({ kind }: { kind: NonNullable<Variant['overlay']> }) {
  if (kind === 'curtain') {
    return (
      <motion.div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[90] origin-top bg-primary"
        initial={{ scaleY: 1 }}
        animate={{ scaleY: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] }}
      />
    )
  }
  if (kind === 'iris') {
    return (
      <motion.div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[90] bg-scrim"
        initial={{ clipPath: 'circle(150% at 50% 50%)' }}
        animate={{ clipPath: 'circle(0% at 50% 50%)' }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] }}
      />
    )
  }
  return (
    <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex">
      {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => (
        <motion.span
          key={i}
          className="h-full flex-1 origin-left bg-primary"
          initial={{ scaleX: 1 }}
          animate={{ scaleX: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.45, delay: i * 0.05, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Opens the same shutters the welcome film closed, so leaving /hosgeldin reads as one continuous cut. */
function CurtainOpen() {
  const panels = 7
  return (
    <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[150] flex">
      {Array.from({ length: panels }, (_, i) => (
        <motion.span
          key={i}
          className="h-full flex-1 border-x border-scrim/30 bg-primary"
          initial={{ y: '0%' }}
          animate={{ y: i % 2 ? '101%' : '-101%' }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.85, delay: 0.15 + Math.abs(i - (panels - 1) / 2) * 0.05, ease: [0.83, 0, 0.17, 1] }}
        />
      ))}
      <motion.p
        lang="en"
        className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[clamp(56px,12vw,190px)] font-black uppercase tracking-[-0.06em] text-primary-foreground"
        initial={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.35 }}
      >
        Sytheris
      </motion.p>
    </div>
  )
}

function hasWelcomeHandoff() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false
  try {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('sy-from-welcome') === '1'
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

export default function Template({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const v = variantFor(pathname)
  const [handoff] = useState(hasWelcomeHandoff)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!handoff) return
    try {
      sessionStorage.removeItem('sy-from-welcome')
    } catch {}
  }, [handoff])
  return (
    <>
      {handoff ? <CurtainOpen /> : v.overlay && <Overlay kind={v.overlay} />}
      <motion.div initial={v.initial} animate={v.animate} transition={{ duration: 0.55, ease: EASE }}>
        {children}
      </motion.div>
    </>
  )
}

export const alt = 'Anime detayları — SYTHERIS'

export default async function OG({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const [media, bold, serif] = await Promise.all([getAnimeMeta(Number(id)), loadGoogleFont('Bricolage Grotesque', 700), loadGoogleFont('Instrument Serif', 400, 'italic')])
  const fonts = [
    ...(bold ? [{ name: 'Bricolage', data: bold, weight: 700 as const, style: 'normal' as const }] : []),
    ...(serif ? [{ name: 'Instrument', data: serif, weight: 400 as const, style: 'italic' as const }] : []),
  ]
  const title = media ? pickTitle(media.title) : 'SYTHERIS'
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)
  const bg = media?.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${media.trailer.id}/hqdefault.jpg` : media?.bannerImage || media?.coverImage.extraLarge
  const accent = media?.coverImage.color || '#10d27f'
  const fontSize = title.length > 40 ? 58 : title.length > 22 ? 72 : 92

  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', position: 'relative', background: '#07100c', fontFamily: 'Bricolage', color: '#f4f7f5' }}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        {bg && <img src={bg} alt="" width={1200} height={630} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', opacity: 0.5 }} />}
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, display: 'flex', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #07100c 0%, rgba(7,16,12,0.92) 50%, rgba(7,16,12,0.4) 100%)' }} />

          )}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, fontSize: 20, letterSpacing: 6, color: '#10d27f' }}>

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params
  const media = await getAnime(Number(id))
  if (!media) return { title: 'Anime bulunamadı' }
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const description = stripHtml(media.description).slice(0, 180)
  return {
    title,
    description,
    openGraph: { title: `${title} — SYTHERIS`, description, type: 'video.tv_show' },
    twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image', title: `${title} — SYTHERIS`, description },
  }
}

export default async function AnimePage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const animeId = Number(id)
  if (!Number.isInteger(animeId) || animeId <= 0) notFound()

  const [media, episodes, viewer, rawComments] = await Promise.all([
    getAnime(animeId).catch(() => null),
    listEpisodes(animeId).catch(() => []),
    getViewer().catch(() => null),
    listComments(animeId).catch(() => []),
  ])
  if (!media) notFound()

  const comments = await toCommentViews(rawComments, viewer?.user.id ?? null)
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const studio = media.studios?.nodes.find((s) => s.isAnimationStudio) ?? media.studios?.nodes[0]
  const recs = (media.recommendations?.nodes ?? []).map((n) => n.mediaRecommendation).filter((m): m is MediaCard => Boolean(m))
  const relations = (media.relations?.edges ?? []).filter((e) => e.node.type === 'ANIME')
  const characters = media.characters?.edges ?? []
  const tags = (media.tags ?? []).filter((t) => !t.isMediaSpoiler).slice(0, 12)
  const streaming = (media.externalLinks ?? []).filter((l) => l.type === 'STREAMING')
  const links = (media.externalLinks ?? []).filter((l) => l.type !== 'STREAMING').slice(0, 8)
  const synopsis = stripHtml(media.description)
  const synopsisTr = synopsis ? await Promise.race([translate(synopsis, 'tr'), new Promise<null>((r) => setTimeout(() => r(null), 1800))]) : null

  const info: [string, string | null | undefined][] = [
    ['Format', formatTr(media.format)],
    ['Durum', statusTr(media.status)],
    ['Başlangıç', fuzzyDate(media.startDate)],
    ['Bitiş', fuzzyDate(media.endDate)],
    ['Sezon', media.season ? `${seasonTr(media.season)} ${media.seasonYear ?? ''}` : null],
    ['Stüdyo', studio?.name],
    ['Kaynak', media.source ? media.source.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase() : null],
    ['Ülke', media.countryOfOrigin === 'JP' ? 'Japonya' : media.countryOfOrigin === 'CN' ? 'Çin' : media.countryOfOrigin === 'KR' ? 'Kore' : media.countryOfOrigin],
    ['Japonca', media.title.native],
    ['Diğer adlar', media.synonyms?.slice(0, 2).join(', ')],
  ]

  const sections = [
    { id: 'genel', label: 'Genel bakış' },
    ...(episodes.length ? [{ id: 'bolumler', label: 'Bölümler', count: episodes.length }] : []),
    ...(characters.length ? [{ id: 'karakterler', label: 'Karakterler', count: characters.length }] : []),
    ...(relations.length ? [{ id: 'iliskili', label: 'Evren', count: relations.length }] : []),
    { id: 'istatistik', label: 'İstatistik' },
    ...(recs.length ? [{ id: 'oneriler', label: 'Benzerleri' }] : []),
    { id: 'yorumlar', label: 'Yorumlar', count: comments.length },
  ]

  const customLists = (viewer?.lists ?? []).filter((l) => !l.system).map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name, hue: l.hue, has: l.items.some((i) => i.id === animeId) }))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-16 pb-10">
      <section className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground">
        <DetailBackdrop media={media} />
        <DetailHero
          media={media}
          firstEpisode={episodes[0]?.number ?? null}
          actions={

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string; ep: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id, ep } = await params
  const media = await getAnimeMeta(Number(id))
  return { title: media ? `${pickTitle(media.title)} ${ep}. Bölüm izle` : 'Bölüm izle' }
}

export default async function WatchPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id, ep } = await params
  const animeId = Number(id)
  const number = Number(ep)
  const [media, episodes] = await Promise.all([getAnimeMeta(animeId), listEpisodes(animeId).catch(() => [])])
  const index = episodes.findIndex((e) => e.number === number)
  const current = episodes[index]
  const title = media ? pickTitle(media.title) : 'Anime'

  if (!current) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-xl flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-32 text-center">
        <p className="label-mono text-ink">Bölüm yok</p>
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Bu bölüm henüz <span className="accent-serif">eklenmedi</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Yöneticiler bölümü eklediğinde burada izleyebileceksin.</p>
        <Link href={`/anime/${animeId}`} className="mt-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 py-3 font-medium text-primary-foreground">
          Anime sayfasına dön
        </Link>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const prev = episodes[index - 1]
  const next = episodes[index + 1]
  const subtitleSrc = current.subtitleText || current.subtitleUrl ? `/api/subtitle/${current.id}` : null

  const hasMagnet = Boolean(current.magnetUrl && current.magnetUrl.startsWith('magnet:'))
  const hasVideo = Boolean(current.videoUrl && current.videoUrl.trim().length > 5)

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] gap-8 px-4 pb-10 pt-6 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px] lg:px-10">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-5">
        <Link href={`/anime/${animeId}`} className="flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
          <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> {title}
        </Link>
        
        {hasMagnet ? (
          <TorrentPlayer 
            magnetURI={current.magnetUrl!} 
            subtitleSrc={subtitleSrc} 
            subtitleLang={current.subtitleLang} 
          />
        ) : hasVideo ? (
          <VideoPlayer
            key={current.id}
            src={current.videoUrl}
            subtitleSrc={subtitleSrc}
            subtitleLang={current.subtitleLang}
            poster={current.thumbnail || media?.bannerImage}
            title={current.title || `${current.number}. bölüm`}
            episodeLabel={`${title} · Bölüm ${current.number}`}
            storageKey={current.id}
            prevHref={prev ? `/anime/${animeId}/izle/${prev.number}` : null}
            nextHref={next ? `/anime/${animeId}/izle/${next.number}` : null}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex aspect-video w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-muted/30 text-center p-6">
            <AlertCircle className="size-10 text-muted-foreground" />
            <p className="text-lg font-semibold">Video Kaynağı Bulunamadı</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Bu bölüm için geçerli bir video veya magnet linki eklenmemiş.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="label-mono text-ink">Bölüm {current.number}</p>
          <h1 className="text-balance text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
            {title} <span className="accent-serif">{current.title || `${current.number}. bölüm`}</span>

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Keşfet', description: 'Tüm anime kataloğunda tür, yıl, sezon ve formata göre ara.' }

type SP = Promise<Record<string, string | undefined>>

export default async function SearchPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: SP }) {
  const sp = await searchParams
  const page = Math.max(1, Number(sp.page) || 1)
  const { season, year } = currentSeason()
  const result = await searchAnime({
    q: sp.q,
    genre: sp.genre,
    tag: sp.tag,
    year: sp.year ? Number(sp.year) : undefined,
    season: sp.season,
    format: sp.format,
    status: sp.status,
    sort: sp.sort,
    page,
  })
  const link = (p: number) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(sp).filter(([, v]) => v) as [string, string][])
    next.set('page', String(p))
    return `/ara?${next.toString()}`
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-10 pt-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 lg:pt-14">
      <div className="grid items-end gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_auto]">
        <SectionHeading
          as="h1"
          eyebrow="Katalog"
          title={sp.genre ? genreTr(sp.genre) : sp.tag ? sp.tag.split(',').map((t) => TROPE_LABEL[t] ?? t).join(' + ') : 'Tüm animeleri'}
          accent={sp.genre || sp.tag ? 'animeleri' : 'keşfet'}
          description="Binlerce anime arasında ara; türlere, klişelere ve sezonlara göre filtrele, yeni favorini bul."
        />
        <nav className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4" aria-label="Hızlı erişim">
          {[
            { href: `/ara?season=${season}&year=${year}`, label: 'Bu sezon', icon: Sparkles },
            { href: '/ara?status=RELEASING&sort=TRENDING_DESC', label: 'Yayında', icon: Radio },
            { href: '/takvim', label: 'Takvim', icon: CalendarDays },
            { href: '/rastgele', label: 'Rastgele öneri', icon: Dices },
          ].map((l) => (
            <Link key={l.label} href={l.href} className="group flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-primary">
              <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-accent text-ink transition group-hover:bg-primary group-hover:text-primary-foreground">
                <l.icon className="size-4" />
              </span>
              {l.label}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </div>
      <Suspense>
        <SearchFilters />
      </Suspense>
      <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
        {result.pageInfo.total > 0 ? `${result.pageInfo.total.toLocaleString('tr-TR')}+ sonuç · sayfa ${page}` : 'Sonuç yok'}
      </p>
      {result.media.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6">
          {result.media.map((m, i) => (
            <li key={m.id}>
              <AnimeCard media={m} priority={i < 6} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border py-24 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-semibold">
            Hiçbir şey <span className="accent-serif">bulunamadı</span>
          </p>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Filtreleri gevşetmeyi ya da farklı bir arama yapmayı dene.</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <nav className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3" aria-label="Sayfalama">

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { listArtworks } from '@/lib/artworks'
import { getUser } from '@/lib/users'
import { resolveFrame } from '@/lib/membership'
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/viewer'
import { GalleryView, type GalleryArtist, type GalleryItem } from '@/components/studio/gallery-view'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Çizim Atölyesi',
  description: 'Sytheris+ üyelerinin katmanlı çizim stüdyosunda yarattığı eserlerin sergilendiği topluluk galerisi.',
}

export default async function AtelierPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ eser?: string }> }) {
  const [{ eser }, viewer, works] = await Promise.all([searchParams, getViewer().catch(() => null), listArtworks(160).catch(() => [])])

  const uids = [...new Set(works.map((w) => w.uid))]
  const users = await Promise.all(uids.map((id) => getUser(id).catch(() => null)))
  const artists: Record<string, GalleryArtist> = {}
  for (const u of users) {
    if (!u || u.banned) continue
    artists[u.id] = { username: u.username, displayName: u.displayName, avatar: u.avatar ?? null, frame: resolveFrame(u.frame), nameStyle: u.nameStyle ?? 'default' }
  }

  const me = viewer?.user.id ?? null
  const items: GalleryItem[] = works
    .filter((w) => artists[w.uid])
    .map((w) => ({
      id: w.id,
      title: w.title,
      width: w.width,
      height: w.height,
      at: w.at,
      likes: w.likes.length,
      liked: me ? w.likes.includes(me) : false,
      mine: me === w.uid,
      uid: w.uid,
      effort: w.effort ?? 0,
      layers: w.layers ?? 1,
    }))

  const week = Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000
  const pool = items.filter((i) => i.at >= week)
  const featured = [...(pool.length ? pool : items)].sort((a, b) => b.likes - a.likes || b.at - a.at)[0] ?? null

  const viewerInfo = viewer ? { loggedIn: true, premium: viewer.header.tier !== 'free', staff: viewer.header.role !== 'user' } : { loggedIn: false, premium: false, staff: false }
  // The exhibition is a Sytheris+ space: everyone else only receives the featured work and a small teaser set.
  const unlocked = viewerInfo.premium || viewerInfo.staff
  const shown = unlocked ? items : items.filter((i) => i.id === featured?.id || i.mine).concat(items.filter((i) => i.id !== featured?.id && !i.mine).slice(0, 8))

  return (
    <GalleryView
      items={shown}
      total={items.length}
      artistTotal={Object.keys(artists).length}
      locked={!unlocked}
      artists={artists}
      featuredId={featured?.id ?? null}
      initialOpen={unlocked && eser && items.some((i) => i.id === eser) ? eser : null}
      viewer={viewerInfo}
    />
  )
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { SERIES_GENRES, getSeriesByGenre, getSeriesIndex, isSeriesGenre } from '@/lib/series'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Diziler',
  description: 'En sevilen yabancı diziler: dram, suç, bilim kurgu, fantastik, komedi, gerilim ve daha fazlası. Puanlar, sezonlar ve oyuncular.',
}

const SORTS = [
  { id: 'populer', label: 'Popüler' },
  { id: 'puan', label: 'En yüksek puan' },
  { id: 'yeni', label: 'En yeni' },
] as const

export default async function SeriesPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ tur?: string; sira?: string }> }) {
  const { tur, sira } = await searchParams
  const genre = isSeriesGenre(tur) ? SERIES_GENRES.find((g) => g.id === tur)! : null
  const sort = SORTS.find((s) => s.id === sira)?.id ?? 'populer'
  const base = genre ? await getSeriesByGenre(genre.id, 120) : (await getSeriesIndex()).slice(0, 120)
  const list = sort === 'puan' ? [...base].sort((a, b) => (b.rating ?? 0) - (a.rating ?? 0)) : sort === 'yeni' ? [...base].sort((a, b) => (b.premiered ?? '').localeCompare(a.premiered ?? '')) : base
  const href = (next: { tur?: string | null; sira?: string | null }) => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams()
    const t = next.tur === undefined ? genre?.id : next.tur
    const s = next.sira === undefined ? sort : next.sira
    if (t) p.set('tur', t)
    if (s && s !== 'populer') p.set('sira', s)
    const q = p.toString()
    return q ? `/diziler?${q}` : '/diziler'
  }

  return (
    <div className="cine dark min-h-dvh">
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-24 pt-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <header className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <p className="label-mono flex items-center gap-3 text-ink">
            <span className="h-px w-8 bg-primary" /> Sinema modu · Diziler
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-balance text-5xl font-bold tracking-[-0.04em] sm:text-6xl">
            {genre ? genre.label : 'Tüm'} <span className="accent-serif">diziler</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-xl text-pretty leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{genre ? genre.blurb : 'Dünyada en çok izlenen, en çok konuşulan diziler. Tür ve sıralama seçerek daralt.'}</p>
        </header>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <nav aria-label="Dizi türleri" className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0">
            <Link href={href({ tur: null })} aria-current={!genre ? 'page' : undefined} className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', !genre ? 'border-foreground bg-foreground text-background' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/40')}>
              Hepsi
            </Link>
            {SERIES_GENRES.map((g) => (
              <Link key={g.id} href={href({ tur: g.id })} aria-current={genre?.id === g.id ? 'page' : undefined} className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', genre?.id === g.id ? 'border-foreground bg-foreground text-background' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/40')}>
                {g.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </nav>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 self-start rounded-full bg-muted p-1" role="group" aria-label="Sıralama">
            {SORTS.map((s) => (
              <Link key={s.id} href={href({ sira: s.id })} aria-current={sort === s.id ? 'true' : undefined} className={cn('rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition', sort === s.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}>
                {s.label}

        />

      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

async function DirectorRow({ director, filmId }: { director: string; filmId: string }) {
  const films = await getFilmsByDirector(director, filmId)
  if (!films.length) return null
  return <FilmRow eyebrow="Yönetmen koltuğunda" title={director.split(/,|&/)[0].trim()} accent="filmografisi" href={`/sinema-ara?q=${encodeURIComponent(director)}&tur=film`} items={films} />
}

  const c = await getCharacter(Number(id))

  return { title: c.name.full, description: stripHtml(c.description).slice(0, 160), openGraph: { images: c.image.large ? [c.image.large] : [] } }

const GENDER: Record<string, string> = { Male: 'Erkek', Female: 'Kadın', 'Non-binary': 'Non-binary' }
const LANG: Record<string, string> = { Japanese: 'Japonca', English: 'İngilizce', Korean: 'Korece', Turkish: 'Türkçe', Spanish: 'İspanyolca', German: 'Almanca', French: 'Fransızca', Italian: 'İtalyanca', Portuguese: 'Portekizce' }
const MONTHS = ['Oca', 'Şub', 'Mar', 'Nis', 'May', 'Haz', 'Tem', 'Ağu', 'Eyl', 'Eki', 'Kas', 'Ara']

/** AniList descriptions often open with "__Height:__ 170cm" style fact lines; drop them since the hero shows facts. */
function cleanBio(raw?: string | null) {
  const body = (raw ?? '')
    // Spoiler blocks first, so a fact line inside one can't leave a dangling "~!" behind.
    .replace(/~![\s\S]*?!~/g, '')
    .replace(/~!|!~/g, '')
    .split('\n')
    .filter((l) => !/^\s*(__|\*\*)[^_*\n]{1,40}:?\s*(__|\*\*)\s*:?/.test(l))
    .join('\n')
    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1')
    .replace(/(\*\*|__)(.+?)\1/g, '$2')
    .replace(/(^|[\s(])[_*]([^_*\n]+)[_*](?=[\s.,;:!?)]|$)/g, '$1$2')
  return stripHtml(body).replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim()
}

]

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { getCompare } from '@/lib/anilist'
import type { MediaDetail } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { compact, formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, seasonTr, statusTr } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'
import { ComparePicker } from '@/components/compare/compare-picker'

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Karşılaştır', description: 'İki animeyi puan, popülerlik ve detaylarına göre yan yana karşılaştır.' }

type SP = Promise<{ a?: string; b?: string }>

function Bar({ a, b, label, fmt = (n: number) => String(n) }: { a?: number | null; b?: number | null; label: string; fmt?: (n: number) => string }) {
  const av = a ?? 0
  const bv = b ?? 0
  const max = Math.max(av, bv, 1)
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-center gap-3 sm:gap-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
        <span className={cn('font-mono text-sm tabular-nums', av >= bv && av > 0 && 'font-semibold text-ink')}>{a != null ? fmt(av) : '—'}</span>
        <div className="h-2.5 w-full max-w-60 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
          <div className="ml-auto h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${(av / max) * 100}%`, opacity: av >= bv ? 1 : 0.45 }} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <span className="label-mono w-24 text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground sm:w-32">{label}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="h-2.5 w-full max-w-60 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${(bv / max) * 100}%`, opacity: bv >= av ? 1 : 0.45 }} />
        </div>
        <span className={cn('font-mono text-sm tabular-nums', bv >= av && bv > 0 && 'font-semibold text-ink')}>{b != null ? fmt(bv) : '—'}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Side({ m, align }: { m?: MediaDetail; align: 'left' | 'right' }) {
  if (!m) return <div className="grid aspect-[2/3] w-full max-w-56 place-items-center rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border text-sm text-muted-foreground">Anime seç</div>
  return (
    <Link href={`/anime/${m.id}`} className={cn('group flex flex-col gap-3', align === 'right' ? 'items-start' : 'items-end text-right')}>
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={m.coverImage.extraLarge || m.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="aspect-[2/3] w-full max-w-56 rounded-3xl object-cover shadow-xl transition group-hover:-translate-y-1" />
      <p className="text-lg font-semibold leading-tight group-hover:text-ink sm:text-xl">{pickTitle(m.title)}</p>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{[m.seasonYear, formatTr(m.format), statusTr(m.status)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</p>
    </Link>
  )
}

export default async function ComparePage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: SP }) {
  const sp = await searchParams
  const ids = [sp.a, sp.b].map(Number).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0)
  const list = await getCompare(ids)
  const a = list.find((m) => m.id === Number(sp.a))
  const b = list.find((m) => m.id === Number(sp.b))
  const completed = (m?: MediaDetail) => m?.stats?.statusDistribution?.find((s) => s.status === 'COMPLETED')?.amount ?? null

  return (

        <Side m={a} align="left" />
        <span className="mt-24 font-serif text-4xl italic text-ink sm:text-6xl">vs</span>
        <Side m={b} align="right" />
      </div>
      {a && b && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-[2rem] border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-10">
          <Bar label="Ortalama puan" a={a.averageScore} b={b.averageScore} fmt={(n) => `${n}%`} />
          <Bar label="Popülerlik" a={a.popularity} b={b.popularity} fmt={compact} />
          <Bar label="Favori" a={a.favourites} b={b.favourites} fmt={compact} />

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { getAnimeBatch, getTrendingBanners } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { libraryStats } from '@/lib/library'
import { LIST_LIMIT } from '@/lib/membership'
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/viewer'
import { LibraryView } from '@/components/library/library-view'

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Kütüphanem', description: 'İzlediğin, izleyeceğin ve tamamladığın animeler; kendi koleksiyon listelerin.' }

export default async function LibraryPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ yeni?: string; liste?: string }> }) {
  const [viewer, sp] = await Promise.all([getViewer().catch(() => null), searchParams])

  if (!viewer) {
    const banners = await getTrendingBanners()
    return <LibraryView guest banners={banners} lists={[]} media={{}} stats={null} limit={0} openCreate={false} initialList={null} />
  }

  const ids = viewer.lists.flatMap((l) => l.items.map((i) => i.id))
  const map = await getAnimeBatch(ids)
  const owned = [...map.values()].filter((m) => m.bannerImage)
  const banners = owned.length >= 3 ? owned.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, 6) : await getTrendingBanners()

  return (
    <LibraryView
      guest={false}
      banners={banners}
      lists={viewer.lists}
      media={Object.fromEntries(map)}
      stats={libraryStats(viewer.lists)}
      limit={LIST_LIMIT[viewer.header.tier]}
      openCreate={sp.yeni === '1'}
      initialList={sp.liste ?? null}
    />
  )
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { GENRES, SORTS, getMangaHome, listManga, type SortKey } from '@/lib/manga'
import { MangaCard } from '@/components/manga/manga-card'
import { MangaFilters } from '@/components/manga/manga-filters'
import { MangaHero } from '@/components/manga/manga-hero'
import { MangaRow } from '@/components/manga/manga-row'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Manga',
  description: 'Binlerce manga serisi, Türkçe ve İngilizce bölümleriyle. Tür ve popülerliğe göre keşfet, tarayıcında oku.',
}

type SP = Promise<Record<string, string | undefined>>

export default async function MangaPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: SP }) {
  const sp = await searchParams
  const q = sp.q?.trim().slice(0, 80) || undefined
  const genre = GENRES.some((g) => g.slug === sp.genre) ? sp.genre : undefined
  const sort = sp.sort && sp.sort in SORTS ? (sp.sort as SortKey) : undefined
  const lang = sp.lang === 'tr' ? ('tr' as const) : undefined
  const page = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number(sp.page) || 1))
  const filtered = Boolean(q || genre || sort || lang || page > 1)

  if (!filtered) {
    const home = await getMangaHome()
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col pb-10">
        <MangaHero stack={home.popular} total={home.total} />
        <MangaFilters current={{}} />
        {home.popular.length === 0 ? (
          <Unavailable />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-20 pt-14 sm:gap-24">
            <MangaRow eyebrow="Türkçe" title="Türkçe" accent="okunabilenler" description="Çevirmen ekiplerin Türkçeye kazandırdığı seriler." href="/manga?lang=tr" items={home.turkish} />
            <TopShelf items={home.top} />
            <MangaRow eyebrow="Taze" title="Yeni bölüm" accent="gelenler" description="Son saatlerde yeni bölümü yüklenen seriler." href="/manga?sort=guncel" items={home.latest} />
            <MangaRow eyebrow="Popüler" title="Herkesin" accent="okudukları" href="/manga?sort=populer&page=1" items={home.popular} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  const result = await listManga({ q, genre, sort, lang, page })
  const genreLabel = GENRES.find((g) => g.slug === genre)?.label
  const heading = q ? `“${q}”` : genreLabel ?? (lang ? 'Türkçe seriler' : SORTS[sort ?? 'populer'].label)
  const pageHref = (n: number) => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams()
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries({ q, genre, sort, lang })) if (v) p.set(k, v)
    if (n > 1) p.set('page', String(n))
    return `/manga?${p.toString()}`
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col pb-10">
      <MangaHero stack={result.items} total={result.total} q={q} />
      <MangaFilters current={{ q, genre, sort, lang }} />
      <section className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-8 px-4 pt-12 sm:px-6 lg:px-10" aria-labelledby="mg-results">
        <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border pb-5">
          <h2 id="mg-results" className="text-balance text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.03em] sm:text-4xl">
            {heading}
          </h2>
          <p className="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{result.total.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} sonuç</p>
        </div>
        {result.items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-24 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Bu rafta bir şey yok</p>
            <p className="max-w-sm text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Başka bir isim dene ya da filtreleri gevşet.</p>
            <Link href="/manga" className="mt-2 rounded-full border border-border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition hover:bg-muted">
              Kataloğa dön
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6">
            {result.items.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={m.id}>
                <MangaCard manga={m} priority={i < 6} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {result.pages > 1 && (
          <nav className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 pt-6" aria-label="Sayfalar">
            {page > 1 && (
              <Link href={pageHref(page - 1)} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition hover:bg-muted">
                <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Önceki
              </Link>
            )}
            <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
              {page} / {Math.min(result.pages, 200)}
            </span>
            {page < Math.min(result.pages, 200) && (
              <Link href={pageHref(page + 1)} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground px-4 py-2 text-sm text-background transition hover:opacity-90">
                Sonraki <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </Link>
            )}
          </nav>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

function TopShelf({ items }: { items: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getMangaHome>>['top'] }) {
  if (!items.length) return null
  return (
    <section className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10" aria-labelledby="mg-top">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="label-mono flex items-center gap-3 text-ink">
          <span className="h-px w-8 bg-primary" />
          Zirve rafı
        </p>
        <h2 id="mg-top" className="text-balance text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.03em] sm:text-4xl lg:text-[44px] lg:leading-[1.05]">
          Okurların <span className="accent-serif">en sevdikleri</span>
        </h2>
      </div>
      <ol className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6">
        {items.map((m, i) => (
          <li key={m.id}>
            <MangaCard manga={m} rank={i + 1} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </section>
  )
}

      <p className="leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">MangaDex’e ulaşılamadı. Birkaç saniye sonra sayfayı yenilemeyi dene.</p>

export default async function MangaDetailPage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const [{ id }, { dil }] = await Promise.all([params, searchParams])
  const manga = await getManga(id)
  if (!manga) notFound()

  const preferred: ReadLang = dil === 'en' || dil === 'tr' ? dil : manga.languages.includes('tr') ? 'tr' : 'en'
  let lang = preferred
  let chapters = await getChapters(id, lang)
  if (!chapters.length && !dil) {
    lang = preferred === 'tr' ? 'en' : 'tr'
    chapters = await getChapters(id, lang)
  }
  const first = chapters[0]
  const last = chapters.at(-1)
  const official = chapters.length ? null : await getOfficialLink(id)

  const facts = [
    manga.status && { k: 'Durum', v: STATUS_TR[manga.status] },
    manga.year && { k: 'Yıl', v: String(manga.year) },
    manga.demographic && { k: 'Hedef kitle', v: DEMO_TR[manga.demographic] ?? manga.demographic },
    manga.authors.length && { k: 'Yazar', v: manga.authors.join(', ') },
    manga.artists.length && manga.artists.join() !== manga.authors.join() && { k: 'Çizer', v: manga.artists.join(', ') },
    manga.lastChapter && { k: 'Final', v: `${manga.lastChapter}. bölüm` },
  ].filter(Boolean) as { k: string; v: string }[]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col pb-16">
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden">
        {manga.coverHi && (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={manga.coverHi} alt="" aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 -z-20 size-full scale-125 object-cover opacity-40 blur-3xl" />
        )}
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-gradient-to-b from-background/40 via-background/85 to-background" />
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="halftone halftone-fade absolute inset-0 -z-10 text-foreground/[0.06]" />

        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1200px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-12 pt-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
          <Link href="/manga" className="flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Manga kataloğu
          </Link>

          <div className="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-[260px_minmax(0,1fr)] md:gap-12">
            <div className="mx-auto w-48 md:mx-0 md:w-full">
              <div className="mg-spine relative aspect-[5/7] overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-muted shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-border">
                {manga.coverHi ? (
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  <img src={manga.coverHi} alt={`${manga.title} kapağı`} className="size-full object-cover" />
                ) : (

const dateTr = (d: string | null) => (d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) : null)

function SignatureRole({ credit }: { credit: PersonCredit }) {
  const inner = (
    <>
      <span className="relative block aspect-[2/3] overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-muted ring-1 ring-border transition duration-500 group-hover:-translate-y-1 group-hover:ring-primary/60">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={credit.poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="size-full object-cover transition duration-700 group-hover:scale-[1.04]" />
        <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim via-scrim/50 to-transparent" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="cine-card-light pointer-events-none absolute inset-0" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex flex-col gap-1 p-4 text-on-scrim">
          <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-primary">Rolü</span>
          <span className="text-balance font-serif text-2xl italic leading-tight">{credit.character}</span>
        </span>
      </span>
      <span className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <span className="line-clamp-1 text-sm font-semibold transition group-hover:text-ink">{credit.title}</span>
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
          {credit.kind === 'film' ? 'Film' : 'Dizi'}
          {credit.year ? ` · ${credit.year}` : ''}
        </span>
      </span>
    </>
  )
  return credit.href ? (
    <Link href={credit.href} className="group flex flex-col gap-3 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary">
      {inner}
    </Link>
  ) : (
    <div className="group flex flex-col gap-3">{inner}</div>
  )
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/viewer'
import { getContentMode } from '@/lib/content-mode'
import { getFilmHome, runtimeTr } from '@/lib/films'
import { getSeriesIndex } from '@/lib/series'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'
import { FateDeck } from '@/components/random/fate-deck'
import { CineRoulette, type RouletteItem } from '@/components/random/cine-roulette'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Rastgele Öneri',
  description: 'Ruh haline göre bir kart çek ya da sinema modunda makarayı çevir; sıradaki anime, film ya da dizi seni bulsun.',
}

async function cinemaPool() {
  const [films, series] = await Promise.all([getFilmHome(), getSeriesIndex()])
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const filmItems: RouletteItem[] = [films.top, films.action, films.scifi, films.thriller, films.drama, films.comedy, films.horror, films.classics]
    .flat()
    .filter((f) => f.poster && !seen.has(f.id) && seen.add(f.id))
    .map((f) => ({ id: f.id, kind: 'film', title: f.title, poster: f.poster, posterLg: f.posterLg, genre: f.genreTr, year: f.year, summary: f.summary, rating: null, meta: f.director || null }))
  const seriesItems: RouletteItem[] = series.slice(0, 150).map((s) => ({
    id: s.id,
    kind: 'dizi',
    title: s.name,
    poster: s.poster,
    posterLg: s.posterLg,
    genre: s.genresTr[0] ?? 'Dizi',
    year: s.year,
    summary: s.summary,
    rating: s.rating,
    meta: s.network ?? (s.runtime ? runtimeTr(s.runtime) : null),
  }))
  const pool = [...filmItems, ...seriesItems]
  const counts = pool.reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, p) => ((acc[p.genre] = (acc[p.genre] ?? 0) + 1), acc), {})
  const genres = Object.entries(counts)
    .filter(([, n]) => n >= 4)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .map(([g]) => g)
    .slice(0, 12)
  return { pool, genres }
}

export default async function RandomPage() {
  const mode = await getContentMode()

  if (mode === 'film') {
    const { pool, genres } = await cinemaPool()
    return (
      <div className="cine dark min-h-dvh">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-24 pt-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 lg:pt-14">
          <SectionHeading as="h1" eyebrow="Rastgele seans" title="Bu gece ne" accent="izlesek?" description="Film mi dizi mi, hangi tür? Seçimini yap, makarayı çevir; bu gecenin seansını şans belirlesin." />
          <CineRoulette pool={pool} genres={genres} />
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const viewer = await getViewer().catch(() => null)
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-10 pt-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 lg:pt-14">
      <SectionHeading
        as="h1"
        eyebrow="Rastgele öneri"
        title="Sıradaki animeni"
        accent="kader seçsin"
        description="Ruh halini ya da sevdiğin klişeleri seç — isekai, harem, iyashikei, ölüm oyunu… Desteden bir kart çek; nadirliği puanına göre belirlenir."
      />
      <FateDeck loggedIn={Boolean(viewer)} />
    </div>
  )
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { getStaff } from '@/lib/anilist'

import { RoleGallery, type Role } from '@/components/person/role-gallery'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params
  const s = await getStaff(Number(id))
  if (!s) return { title: 'Kişi bulunamadı' }
  return { title: `${s.name.full} — Seslendirmen`, description: stripHtml(s.description).slice(0, 160), openGraph: { images: s.image.large ? [s.image.large] : [] } }
}

const LANG: Record<string, string> = { Japanese: 'Japonca', English: 'İngilizce', Korean: 'Korece', Turkish: 'Türkçe', Spanish: 'İspanyolca', German: 'Almanca', French: 'Fransızca', Italian: 'İtalyanca', Portuguese: 'Portekizce' }
const JOBS: Record<string, string> = { 'Voice Actor': 'Seslendirme sanatçısı', Actor: 'Oyuncu', Singer: 'Şarkıcı', Narrator: 'Anlatıcı' }

const SECTIONS = [
  { id: 'karakter-ust', label: 'Giriş' },
  { id: 'roller', label: 'Roller' },
  { id: 'biyografi', label: 'Biyografi' },
]

export default async function StaffPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const s = await getStaff(Number(id))
  if (!s) notFound()

  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const roles: Role[] = []
  for (const e of s.characterMedia.edges) {
    for (const c of e.characters) {
      const key = `${c.id}-${e.node.id}`
      if (seen.has(key)) continue
      seen.add(key)
      roles.push({
        characterId: c.id,
        characterName: c.name.full,
        characterImage: c.image.large,
        mediaId: e.node.id,
        mediaTitle: pickTitle(e.node.title),
        mediaCover: e.node.coverImage.large ?? e.node.coverImage.extraLarge,
        mediaColor: e.node.coverImage.color ?? null,
        series: [e.node.title.romaji, e.node.title.english].filter((t): t is string => Boolean(t)),
        year: e.node.seasonYear,
        role: e.characterRole,
      })
    }
  }
  roles.sort((a, b) => Number(b.role === 'MAIN') - Number(a.role === 'MAIN'))
  const mainCount = roles.filter((r) => r.role === 'MAIN').length
  const animeCount = new Set(roles.map((r) => r.mediaId)).size
  const signature = roles[0]
  const standeeArt = signature ? await getFullBody(signature.characterName, signature.series).catch(() => null) : null

  const facts: [string, string][] = (
    [
      ['Meslek', s.primaryOccupations?.map((o) => JOBS[o] ?? o).join(', ')],
      ['Dil', s.languageV2 ? (LANG[s.languageV2] ?? s.languageV2) : null],
      ['Doğum', fuzzyDate(s.dateOfBirth)],
      ['Yaş', s.age ? String(s.age) : null],
      ['Memleket', s.homeTown],
      ['Aktif', s.yearsActive?.length ? `${s.yearsActive[0]}–${s.yearsActive[1] ?? 'günümüz'}` : null],
      ['Rol', String(roles.length)],
      ['Başrol', String(mainCount)],
    ] as [string, string | null | undefined][]
  ).filter((f): f is [string, string] => Boolean(f[1]))

  const bio = stripHtml(s.description)
  const subtitle = [s.primaryOccupations?.[0] ? (JOBS[s.primaryOccupations[0]] ?? s.primaryOccupations[0]) : 'Seslendirmen', `${roles.length} rol`, `${animeCount} yapım`].join(' · ')

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-20 pb-20" style={signature?.mediaColor ? ({ ['--tone' as string]: signature.mediaColor } as React.CSSProperties) : undefined}>
      <CharacterShowcase
        name={s.name.full}
        native={s.name.native}
        subtitle={subtitle}
        bio={bio}
        favourites={s.favourites}
        art={s.image.large ? { src: s.image.large, transparent: false } : null}
        seriesTitle="Seslendirmen"
        seriesColor={signature?.mediaColor ?? null}
        primaryHref={signature ? `/karakter/${signature.characterId}` : undefined}
        primaryLabel={signature ? `${signature.characterName} rolü` : undefined}
        secondaryHref="#roller"
        secondaryLabel="Tüm roller"
        standee={signature ? { src: standeeArt ? artSrc(standeeArt) : (signature.characterImage ?? ''), transparent: Boolean(standeeArt?.transparent), label: `${signature.characterName} · ${signature.mediaTitle}` } : null}
        sections={SECTIONS}
      />

      {facts.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="mx-auto -mt-20 grid w-full max-w-[1440px] grid-cols-2 gap-px border-b border-border bg-border sm:grid-cols-4">
          {facts.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="flex flex-col gap-1 bg-background px-5 py-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
              <dt className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">{k}</dt>
              <dd className="truncate text-lg font-bold tracking-tight">{v}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}

      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-24 px-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
        {roles.length > 0 && (
          <section id="roller" aria-labelledby="roller-baslik" className="flex scroll-mt-24 flex-col gap-10">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
              <TaggedHeading id="roller-baslik" title="Hayat verdiği karakterler" tag="キャラクター" />
              <span className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
                {roles.length} rol · {animeCount} yapım
              </span>
            </div>
            <RoleGallery roles={roles} />
          </section>
        )}

        {bio && (
          <section id="biyografi" aria-labelledby="biyografi-baslik" className="grid scroll-mt-24 gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
            <TaggedHeading id="biyografi-baslik" title="Biyografi" tag="プロフィール" />
            <ExpandableText text={bio} lines={8} className="max-w-3xl text-lg leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground" />

type Kind = 'hepsi' | 'film' | 'dizi'
type SP = Promise<{ q?: string; tur?: string }>

const kindOf = (v?: string): Kind => (v === 'film' || v === 'dizi' ? v : 'hepsi')
const GRID = 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6'

function KindTabs({ q, kind }: { q: string; kind: Kind }) {
  const href = (k: Kind) => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams()
    if (q) sp.set('q', q)
    if (k !== 'hepsi') sp.set('tur', k)
    return `/sinema-ara${sp.size ? `?${sp}` : ''}`
  }
  const tabs: { k: Kind; label: string; icon?: typeof Tv }[] = [
    { k: 'hepsi', label: 'Hepsi' },
    { k: 'film', label: 'Filmler', icon: Clapperboard },
    { k: 'dizi', label: 'Diziler', icon: Tv },
  ]
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Arama türü" className="flex w-fit gap-1 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.06] p-1">
      {tabs.map((t) => (
        <Link
          key={t.k}
          href={href(t.k)}
          scroll={false}
          aria-current={kind === t.k ? 'page' : undefined}
          className={cn('flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', kind === t.k ? 'bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground' : 'text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground')}
        >
          {t.icon && <t.icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
          {t.label}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </nav>
  )
}

async function Results({ q, kind }: { q: string; kind: Kind }) {
  const [films, series] = await Promise.all([kind !== 'dizi' ? searchFilms(q) : Promise.resolve([] as Film[]), kind !== 'film' ? searchSeries(q) : Promise.resolve([] as Series[])])

  if (!films.length && !series.length) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border px-6 py-20 text-center">
        <p className="text-balance text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          {'"'}
          {q}
          {'"'} için <span className="accent-serif">perde kapalı</span>
        </p>
        <p className="max-w-md text-pretty text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Yazımı kontrol et ya da filmin orijinal (İngilizce) adını dene. Yönetmen adıyla da arayabilirsin.</p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const best = pickBest(q, films, series)

  return (
    <>
      <p className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
        {films.length} film · {series.length} dizi bulundu
      </p>

      {best && <BestMatch item={best} />}

      {films.length > 0 && (
        <section aria-labelledby="sonuc-film" className="flex flex-col gap-8">
          <CineHeading id="sonuc-film" eyebrow="Filmler" title="Perdede" accent={`${films.length} film`} />
          <ul className={GRID}>
            {films.map((f) => (
              <li key={f.id}>
                <FilmCard film={f} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      )}

      {series.length > 0 && (
        <section aria-labelledby="sonuc-dizi" className="flex flex-col gap-8">
          <CineHeading id="sonuc-dizi" eyebrow="Diziler" title="Ekranda" accent={`${series.length} dizi`} />
          <ul className={GRID}>
            {series.map((s) => (
              <li key={s.id}>
                <SeriesCard series={s} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

type Best = { kind: 'film'; film: Film } | { kind: 'dizi'; series: Series }

function pickBest(q: string, films: Film[], series: Series[]): Best | null {
  const n = q.toLocaleLowerCase('tr')
  const exactFilm = films.find((f) => f.title.toLocaleLowerCase('tr') === n)
  const exactSeries = series.find((s) => s.name.toLocaleLowerCase('tr') === n)
  if (exactFilm) return { kind: 'film', film: exactFilm }
  if (exactSeries) return { kind: 'dizi', series: exactSeries }
  if (films[0]) return { kind: 'film', film: films[0] }
  if (series[0]) return { kind: 'dizi', series: series[0] }
  return null
}

function BestMatch({ item }: { item: Best }) {
  const d =
    item.kind === 'film'
      ? { href: `/film/${item.film.id}`, title: item.film.title, poster: item.film.posterLg, meta: [item.film.genreTr, item.film.year, item.film.director].filter(Boolean).join(' · '), text: item.film.summary, label: 'Film', rating: null }
      : { href: `/dizi/${item.series.id}`, title: item.series.name, poster: item.series.posterLg, meta: [item.series.genresTr.slice(0, 2).join(', '), item.series.year, item.series.network].filter(Boolean).join(' · '), text: item.series.summary, label: 'Dizi', rating: item.series.rating }

  return (
    <Link href={d.href} className="dark group relative isolate flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-scrim text-foreground ring-1 ring-border outline-none transition focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary sm:flex-row">
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={d.poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 size-full scale-125 object-cover opacity-35 blur-3xl saturate-150" />
      <div className="grain absolute inset-0 -z-10" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="relative shrink-0 p-5 sm:p-7">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}

'use server'

import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { SESSION_COOKIE, cookieOptions, sessionToken } from '@/lib/session'
import { consumeCode, issueCode } from '@/lib/verify-code'
import {
  addPasswordLogin,
  commitEmailChange,
  changePassword,
  changeUsername,
  deleteAccount,
  getCurrentUser,
  passwordEmailOf,
  prepareEmailChange,
  revokeSessions,
  saveUser,
  type User,
} from '@/lib/users'

type Result = { ok: true; message?: string; step?: 'verify'; masked?: string; devCode?: string } | { ok: false; error: string }

const attempts = new Map<string, { n: number; at: number }>()
const WINDOW = 15 * 60_000

function throttle(uid: string) {
  const now = Date.now()
  const a = attempts.get(uid)
  if (a && now - a.at < WINDOW && a.n >= 6) return false
  attempts.set(uid, a && now - a.at < WINDOW ? { n: a.n + 1, at: a.at } : { n: 1, at: now })
  return true
}

async function reissue(user: User) {
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(SESSION_COOKIE, sessionToken(user), cookieOptions(30 * 86400))
}

async function withUser(fn: (u: User) => Promise<Result>): Promise<Result> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) return { ok: false, error: 'Oturumun sona ermiş. Lütfen tekrar giriş yap.' }
  try {
    return await fn(user)
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: (e as Error).message || 'Bir şeyler ters gitti.' }
  }
}

export async function updateIdentity(input: { displayName: string; username: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    const displayName = String(input.displayName ?? '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    if (displayName.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: 'Görünen ad en az 2 karakter olmalı.' }
    if (displayName.length > 40) return { ok: false, error: 'Görünen ad en fazla 40 karakter olabilir.' }
    const previous = u.username
    const username = String(input.username ?? '').trim()
    if (username && username !== u.username) await changeUsername(u, username)
    u.displayName = displayName
    await saveUser(u)
    revalidatePath(`/u/${previous}`)
    revalidatePath(`/u/${u.username}`)
    revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
    return { ok: true, message: u.username !== previous ? `Artık @${u.username} olarak görünüyorsun.` : 'Görünen ad güncellendi.' }
  })
}

/** Step 1 of an e-mail change: checks the password and sends a code to the new address. */
export async function updateEmail(input: { email: string; password: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    if (!throttle(u.id)) return { ok: false, error: 'Çok fazla deneme yaptın. 15 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }
    const next = await prepareEmailChange(u, String(input.email ?? ''), String(input.password ?? ''))
    const issued = await issueCode<{ uid: string }>('email-change', next, { uid: u.id })
    if (!issued.ok) return { ok: false, error: issued.error }
    if ('skipped' in issued) {
      await commitEmailChange(u, next)
      u.emailVerified = false
      await saveUser(u)
      revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
      return { ok: true, message: 'E-posta adresin güncellendi.' }
    }
    return { ok: true, step: 'verify', masked: issued.masked, devCode: 'devCode' in issued ? issued.devCode : undefined }
  })
}

/** Step 2: the code proves the new address belongs to the user; the change is applied and the account is marked verified. */
export async function confirmEmailChange(input: { email: string; code: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    const next = String(input.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
    const r = await consumeCode<{ uid: string }>('email-change', next, String(input.code ?? ''))
    if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: r.error }
    if (r.payload.uid !== u.id) return { ok: false, error: 'Bu kod bu hesaba ait değil.' }
    await commitEmailChange(u, next)
    revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
    revalidatePath(`/u/${u.username}`)
    return { ok: true, message: 'E-posta adresin doğrulandı ve güncellendi. Doğrulanmış rozeti profilinde.' }
  })
}

/** Lets accounts that signed up before codes existed verify their current address. */
export async function sendVerificationCode(): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    const email = passwordEmailOf(u) ?? u.email
    if (!email) return { ok: false, error: 'Hesabında doğrulanacak bir e-posta yok.' }
    if (u.emailVerified) return { ok: true, message: 'E-postan zaten doğrulanmış.' }
    if (!throttle(u.id)) return { ok: false, error: 'Çok fazla deneme yaptın. 15 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }
    const issued = await issueCode<{ uid: string }>('email-change', email, { uid: u.id })
    if (!issued.ok) return { ok: false, error: issued.error }
    if ('skipped' in issued) return { ok: false, error: 'E-posta servisi henüz yapılandırılmamış.' }
    return { ok: true, step: 'verify', masked: issued.masked, devCode: 'devCode' in issued ? issued.devCode : undefined }
  })
}

export async function confirmCurrentEmail(input: { code: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    const email = passwordEmailOf(u) ?? u.email
    if (!email) return { ok: false, error: 'Hesabında doğrulanacak bir e-posta yok.' }
    const r = await consumeCode<{ uid: string }>('email-change', email, String(input.code ?? ''))
    if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: r.error }
    if (r.payload.uid !== u.id) return { ok: false, error: 'Bu kod bu hesaba ait değil.' }
    u.emailVerified = true
    u.emailVerifiedAt = Date.now()
    await saveUser(u)
    revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
    revalidatePath(`/u/${u.username}`)
    return { ok: true, message: 'E-postan doğrulandı. Doğrulanmış rozeti profilinde.' }
  })
}

export async function updatePassword(input: { current: string; next: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    if (!throttle(u.id)) return { ok: false, error: 'Çok fazla deneme yaptın. 15 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }
    await changePassword(u, String(input.current ?? ''), String(input.next ?? ''))
    await reissue(u)
    revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
    return { ok: true, message: 'Şifren değişti. Diğer cihazlardaki oturumlar kapatıldı.' }
  })
}

export async function linkPasswordLogin(input: { email: string; password: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    await addPasswordLogin(u, String(input.email ?? ''), String(input.password ?? ''))
    revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
    return { ok: true, message: 'Artık e-posta ve şifreyle de giriş yapabilirsin.' }
  })
}

export async function signOutEverywhere(): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    await revokeSessions(u)
    await reissue(u)
    revalidatePath('/ayarlar')
    return { ok: true, message: 'Bu cihaz dışındaki tüm oturumlar kapatıldı.' }
  })
}

export async function removeAccount(input: { confirm: string; password?: string }): Promise<Result> {
  return withUser(async (u) => {
    if (String(input.confirm ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() !== u.username.toLowerCase()) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Onay için kullanıcı adını aynen yazmalısın.' }
    }
    if (passwordEmailOf(u)) {
      if (!throttle(u.id)) return { ok: false, error: 'Çok fazla deneme yaptın. 15 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }
      const { loginEmail } = await import('@/lib/users')
      await loginEmail(passwordEmailOf(u)!, String(input.password ?? '')).catch(() => {
        throw new Error('Şifre hatalı.')
      })
    }
    await deleteAccount(u)
    const store = await cookies()
    store.set(SESSION_COOKIE, '', cookieOptions(0))
    return { ok: true, message: 'Hesabın silindi.' }
  })
}
