import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

// Tarayıcıda (WebTorrent) çalışabilmesi için gerekli WSS Tracker'ları
const WSS_TRACKERS = [
  'wss://tracker.btorrent.xyz',
  'wss://tracker.openwebtorrent.com',
  'wss://tracker.webtorrent.dev',
]

function addWssTrackers(magnet: string) {
  let url = magnet
  for (const tr of WSS_TRACKERS) {
    if (!url.includes(encodeURIComponent(tr))) {
      url += `&tr=${encodeURIComponent(tr)}`
    }
  }
  return url
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const rawQuery = searchParams.get('q')

  if (!rawQuery) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Arama terimi gerekli' }, { status: 400 })

  // Gelen aramayı temizle (örneğin "One Piece 1" -> "One Piece")
  // Sadece bölüm numarasını ayırıp Nyaa'da daha iyi sonuç almak için kullanacağız.
  const parts = rawQuery.trim().split(/\s+/)
  const episodeNum = parts.length > 1 ? parts.pop() : ''
  const animeName = parts.join(' ') || rawQuery

  // Nyaa aramasını bölüm numarasıyla veya tek başına yap
  const searchTerm = episodeNum ? `${animeName} ${episodeNum}` : animeName
  // Nyaa sadece İngilizce çevirileri arasın (c=1_2)
  const nyaaUrl = `https://nyaa.si/?page=rss&q=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}&c=1_2&f=0`

  try {
    const res = await fetch(nyaaUrl, {
      headers: { 
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
        'Accept': 'application/rss+xml, application/xml, text/xml'
      },
      cache: 'no-store',
    })

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Nyaa HTTP Hatası: ${res.status}`)

    const xml = await res.text()
    const items = [...xml.matchAll(/<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/g)]

    if (items.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Bu arama için Nyaa üzerinde sonuç bulunamadı.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    const results: { title: string; magnet: string; seeders: number; size: string }[] = []

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const itemXml = item[1]
      
      const titleMatch = itemXml.match(/<title>(.*?)<\/title>/)
      const infoHashMatch = itemXml.match(/<nyaa:infoHash>(.*?)<\/nyaa:infoHash>/)
      const seedersMatch = itemXml.match(/<nyaa:seeders>(.*?)<\/nyaa:seeders>/)
      const sizeMatch = itemXml.match(/<nyaa:size>(.*?)<\/nyaa:size>/)

      if (titleMatch && infoHashMatch) {
        // CDATA etiketlerini temizle
        const title = decodeURIComponent(titleMatch[1].replace(/<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>/g, '').trim())
        const infoHash = infoHashMatch[1].trim()
        const seeders = seedersMatch ? parseInt(seedersMatch[1], 10) : 0
        const size = sizeMatch ? sizeMatch[1].trim() : 'Bilinmiyor'

        const magnet = `magnet:?xt=urn:btih:${infoHash}&dn=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`
        
        results.push({ title, magnet, seeders, size })
      }
    })

    // Seed sayısına göre en yüksekten en düşüğe sırala
    results.sort((a, b) => b.seeders - a.seeders)

    // En iyi sonucu seç
    const best = results[0]

    if (!best) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Uygun magnet linki oluşturulamadı.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    // WebTorrent için WSS tracker'larını ekle
    const finalMagnet = addWssTrackers(best.magnet)

    return NextResponse.json({
      magnet: finalMagnet,
      title: best.title,
      seeders: best.seeders,
      size: best.size,
    })

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Torrent arama hatası:', error)
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      error: 'Nyaa sunucusuna ulaşılamadı veya bir hata oluştu.',
      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from '@/lib/rate-limit'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const maxDuration = 30

const MAX = 2 * 1024 * 1024

/** The declared MIME type is client-controlled, so the file's magic bytes must agree with it. */
function sniff(b: Buffer): string | null {
  const hex = b.subarray(0, 12).toString('hex')
  if (hex.startsWith('89504e47')) return 'image/png'
  if (hex.startsWith('ffd8ff')) return 'image/jpeg'
  if (hex.startsWith('47494638')) return 'image/gif'
  if (hex.startsWith('52494646') && b.subarray(8, 12).toString('ascii') === 'WEBP') return 'image/webp'
  if (hex.startsWith('1a45dfa3')) return 'video/webm'
  if (b.subarray(4, 8).toString('ascii') === 'ftyp') {
    const brand = b.subarray(8, 12).toString('ascii')
    return brand.startsWith('avi') ? 'image/avif' : 'video/mp4'
  }
  return null
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const wait = rateLimit('upload', clientIp(req.headers), 20, 10 * 60_000)
  if (wait) return tooMany(wait, 'Çok fazla yükleme. Biraz sonra tekrar dene.')
  if (Number(req.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0) > MAX + 64 * 1024) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'Dosya 2MB sınırını aşıyor' }, { status: 413 })
  }

  try {
    const form = await req.formData()
    const file = form.get('file')
    if (!(file instanceof File)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'Dosya bulunamadı' }, { status: 400 })
    if (file.size > MAX) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'Dosya 2MB sınırını aşıyor' }, { status: 400 })
    const buf = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer())
    const type = sniff(buf)
    if (!type) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'Desteklenmeyen dosya türü (PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF, MP4, WEBM)' }, { status: 400 })
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, url: `data:${type};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`, size: file.size, type })
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'Dosya işlenemedi' }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

'use server'

import { ARCHIVE_NAME, CHUNK_BYTES, archiveFilename, downloadsEnabled, listProjectFiles, readChunks, type ArchiveEntry, type ChunkRequest } from '@/lib/project-archive'

/*
 * Why this never answers 401: Server Actions are POSTed to the URL of the page that is already open in the
 * browser, so they ride on whatever let that page load (preview share token, protection cookie, nothing at all
 * on production). No session, cookie or admin check is read here on purpose, and no second URL is involved.
 */

export type ArchiveManifest = { ok: true; name: string; filename: string; chunkBytes: number; files: ArchiveEntry[] } | { ok: false; error: string }

export async function getArchiveManifest(): Promise<ArchiveManifest> {
  if (!downloadsEnabled()) return { ok: false, error: 'İndirme kapalı' }
  try {
    const files = await listProjectFiles()
    if (files.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'Sunucuda proje dosyası bulunamadı' }
    return { ok: true, name: ARCHIVE_NAME, filename: archiveFilename(), chunkBytes: CHUNK_BYTES, files }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

export type ArchiveChunk = { ok: true; parts: { path: string; offset: number; data: string }[] } | { ok: false; error: string }

export async function getArchiveChunk(requests: ChunkRequest[]): Promise<ArchiveChunk> {
  if (!downloadsEnabled()) return { ok: false, error: 'İndirme kapalı' }
  try {
    return { ok: true, parts: await readChunks(requests) }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

'use server'

import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
import { GATE_COOKIE, gateEnabled, issueGateToken, keyMatches, safeNext } from '@/lib/gate'
import { logEvent } from '@/lib/site'

const WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60_000
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
const attempts = new Map<string, { n: number; at: number }>()

export type GateState = { error?: string; next?: string; retryIn?: number }

export async function unlockGate(_prev: GateState, formData: FormData): Promise<GateState> {
  const next = safeNext(formData.get('next'))
  if (!gateEnabled()) return { next }

  const h = await headers()
  const ip = h.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || h.get('x-real-ip') || 'local'
  const now = Date.now()
  const record = attempts.get(ip)
  const active = record && now - record.at < WINDOW_MS ? record : null

  if (active && active.n >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    return { error: 'Çok fazla hatalı deneme. Kapı bir süreliğine kilitlendi.', retryIn: Math.ceil((WINDOW_MS - (now - active.at)) / 60_000) }
  }

  const key = String(formData.get('key') ?? '').trim()
  if (!(await keyMatches(key))) {
    const n = (active?.n ?? 0) + 1
    attempts.set(ip, { n, at: active?.at ?? now })
    // Progressive delay makes scripted guessing slow even before the lockout kicks in.
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.min(400 * 2 ** (n - 1), 4000)))
    await logEvent({ level: 'warn', source: 'server', message: `Erişim kapısında hatalı anahtar (${ip}, deneme ${n})`, path: '/kapi' }).catch(() => {})
    const left = MAX_ATTEMPTS - n
    return { error: left > 0 ? `Anahtar geçersiz. ${left} deneme hakkın kaldı.` : 'Anahtar geçersiz. Kapı bir süreliğine kilitlendi.' }
  }

  attempts.delete(ip)
  const remember = formData.get('remember') === 'on'
  const ttl = remember ? 30 * 86400_000 : 12 * 3600_000
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(GATE_COOKIE, await issueGateToken(ttl), {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: true,
    // The v0 preview renders inside a cross-site iframe, so development needs a partitioned SameSite=None cookie.
    sameSite: isProd ? 'lax' : 'none',
    partitioned: !isProd,
    path: '/',
    maxAge: Math.floor(ttl / 1000),
  })
  return { next }
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { GateForm } from '@/components/gate/gate-form'
import { GATE_COOKIE, gateEnabled, safeNext, verifyGateToken } from '@/lib/gate'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Özel Erişim',
  robots: { index: false, follow: false },
}

export default async function GatePage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string }> }) {
  const { next } = await searchParams
  const target = safeNext(next)
  const store = await cookies()
  if (!gateEnabled() || (await verifyGateToken(store.get(GATE_COOKIE)?.value))) redirect(target)

  return <GateForm next={target} />

'use server'

import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { ADMIN_COOKIE, cookieOptions, isAdmin, safeEqual, sign } from '@/lib/session'
import { addEpisode, clearLogs, deleteEpisode, logEvent, saveSettings, type SiteSettings } from '@/lib/site'
import { storeHealth } from '@/lib/store'
import { getCurrentUser, getUser, saveUser } from '@/lib/users'
import { audit, createCodes, deleteCode, removeComment, setReportStatus, type Report } from '@/lib/community'
import { BADGE_IDS, type BadgeId, type Role } from '@/lib/membership'

const attempts = new Map<string, { n: number; at: number }>()

export type StaffLevel = 'admin' | 'moderator'

/** Password session = full admin. Logged-in users with role admin/moderator get their role's access. */
export async function getStaff(): Promise<{ level: StaffLevel; actor: string } | null> {
  if (await isAdmin()) return { level: 'admin', actor: 'yönetici' }
  const u = await getCurrentUser()
  if (u?.role === 'admin') return { level: 'admin', actor: `@${u.username}` }
  if (u?.role === 'moderator') return { level: 'moderator', actor: `@${u.username}` }
  return null
}

async function guard() {
  const s = await getStaff()
  if (s?.level !== 'admin') throw new Error('Yetkisiz işlem')
  return s
}

async function guardMod() {
  const s = await getStaff()
  if (!s) throw new Error('Yetkisiz işlem')
  return s
}

export async function adminLogin(_: unknown, formData: FormData) {
  const h = await headers()
  const ip = h.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || 'local'
  const now = Date.now()
  const a = attempts.get(ip)
  if (a && now - a.at < 15 * 60_000 && a.n >= 6) return { error: 'Çok fazla hatalı deneme. 15 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }
  const expected = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD
  if (!expected) return { error: 'ADMIN_PASSWORD ortam değişkeni tanımlı değil. Vercel proje ayarlarından (Vars) ekleyin.' }
  const password = String(formData.get('password') ?? '')
  if (!password || !safeEqual(password, expected)) {
    attempts.set(ip, a && now - a.at < 15 * 60_000 ? { n: a.n + 1, at: a.at } : { n: 1, at: now })
    await logEvent({ level: 'warn', source: 'server', message: `Hatalı admin girişi denemesi (${ip})`, path: '/sy-core' })
    return { error: 'Şifre hatalı.' }
  }
  attempts.delete(ip)
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(ADMIN_COOKIE, sign({ admin: true, exp: Date.now() + 12 * 3600_000 }), cookieOptions(12 * 3600))
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function adminLogout() {
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(ADMIN_COOKIE, '', cookieOptions(0))
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  redirect('/')
}

export async function saveSiteSettings(patch: Partial<SiteSettings>) {
  await guard()
  const next = await saveSettings(patch)
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
  return next
}

export async function addEpisodeAction(input: {
  animeId: number
  animeTitle: string
  animeCover?: string | null
  number: number
  title: string
  videoUrl: string
  magnetUrl?: string // <-- BURAYA EKLENDİ
  subtitleUrl?: string
  subtitleText?: string
  subtitleLang: string
  thumbnail?: string
}) {
  await guard()
  const isUrl = (u?: string) => {
    if (!u) return false
    try {
      const p = new URL(u).protocol
      return p === 'https:' || p === 'http:'
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  // Video veya Magnet'ten en az biri olmalı
  const hasVideo = isUrl(input.videoUrl)
  const hasMagnet = Boolean(input.magnetUrl && (input.magnetUrl.startsWith('magnet:?') || input.magnetUrl.endsWith('.torrent')))

  if (!Number.isInteger(input.animeId) || input.animeId <= 0) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Anime seçmelisin.' }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.number) || input.number <= 0 || input.number > 5000) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Geçerli bir bölüm numarası gir.' }
  if (!hasVideo && !hasMagnet) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Geçerli bir video bağlantısı veya Magnet linki gir.' }
  if (input.subtitleUrl && !isUrl(input.subtitleUrl)) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Altyazı bağlantısı geçersiz.' }

  const ep = await addEpisode({
    animeId: input.animeId,
    animeTitle: input.animeTitle.slice(0, 200),
    animeCover: input.animeCover ?? null,
    number: input.number,
    title: input.title.slice(0, 200),
    videoUrl: input.videoUrl || '', // Boş olabilir
    magnetUrl: input.magnetUrl || null, // Veritabanına kaydedildi
    subtitleUrl: input.subtitleUrl || null,
    subtitleText: input.subtitleText ? input.subtitleText.slice(0, 500_000) : null,
    subtitleLang: (input.subtitleLang || 'tr').slice(0, 5),
    thumbnail: isUrl(input.thumbnail) ? input.thumbnail : null,
  })
  revalidatePath(`/anime/${input.animeId}`)
  revalidatePath('/')
  return { ok: true as const, id: ep.id }
}

export async function deleteEpisodeAction(animeId: number, id: string) {
  await guard()
  await deleteEpisode(animeId, id)
  revalidatePath(`/anime/${animeId}`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

  await clearLogs()
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
}

export async function setUserBanned(id: string, banned: boolean, reason = '') {
  const s = await guardMod()
  const u = await getUser(id)
  if (!u) return { ok: false }
  if (s.level === 'moderator' && (u.role === 'admin' || u.role === 'moderator')) return { ok: false, error: 'Ekip üyelerini yalnızca yönetici askıya alabilir.' }
  u.banned = banned
  u.banReason = banned ? reason.slice(0, 200) || null : null
  await saveUser(u)
  await audit(s.actor, banned ? 'askıya aldı' : 'yasağı kaldırdı', `@${u.username}${reason ? ` — ${reason}` : ''}`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function resetUserContent(id: string, field: 'avatar' | 'bio' | 'background') {
  const s = await guardMod()
  const u = await getUser(id)
  if (!u) return { ok: false }
  if (field === 'avatar') u.avatar = null
  if (field === 'bio') u.bio = ''
  if (field === 'background') {
    u.background = null
    u.bannerPreset = 'none'
  }
  await saveUser(u)
  await audit(s.actor, `${field === 'avatar' ? 'avatarı' : field === 'bio' ? 'biyografiyi' : 'afişi'} sıfırladı`, `@${u.username}`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  revalidatePath(`/u/${u.username}`)
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function setUserRole(id: string, role: Role) {
  const s = await guard()
  if (!['user', 'moderator', 'admin'].includes(role)) return { ok: false }
  const u = await getUser(id)
  if (!u) return { ok: false }
  u.role = role
  await saveUser(u)
  await audit(s.actor, `rolü "${role}" yaptı`, `@${u.username}`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function grantPremium(id: string, tier: 'plus' | 'ultra' | null, days: number) {
  const s = await guard()
  const u = await getUser(id)
  if (!u) return { ok: false }
  if (!tier) u.premium = null
  else {
    const d = Math.min(3650, Math.max(1, Math.round(days)))
    u.premium = { tier, since: u.premium?.since ?? Date.now(), until: Date.now() + d * 86400_000 }
  }
  await saveUser(u)
  await audit(s.actor, tier ? `${tier} verdi (${days} gün)` : 'aboneliği kaldırdı', `@${u.username}`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function setUserBadges(id: string, badges: BadgeId[]) {
  const s = await guard()
  const u = await getUser(id)
  if (!u) return { ok: false }
  u.badges = badges.filter((b) => BADGE_IDS.includes(b))
  await saveUser(u)
  await audit(s.actor, `rozetleri güncelledi (${u.badges.length})`, `@${u.username}`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function moderateComment(animeId: number, commentId: string, reportId?: string) {
  const s = await guardMod()
  const removed = await removeComment(animeId, commentId)
  if (reportId) await setReportStatus(reportId, 'resolved')
  await audit(s.actor, 'yorumu sildi', `${removed?.animeTitle ?? animeId}: “${removed?.text.slice(0, 60) ?? ''}”`)
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  revalidatePath(`/anime/${animeId}`)
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function resolveReport(id: string, status: Report['status']) {
  const s = await guardMod()
  const r = await setReportStatus(id, status)
  if (r) await audit(s.actor, status === 'resolved' ? 'bildirimi çözdü' : status === 'dismissed' ? 'bildirimi reddetti' : 'bildirimi yeniden açtı', r.snapshot.slice(0, 60))
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: Boolean(r) }
}

export async function createPremiumCodes(tier: 'plus' | 'ultra', days: number, count: number, note: string) {
  const s = await guard()
  const n = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, Math.round(count)))
  const d = Math.min(3650, Math.max(1, Math.round(days)))
  const codes = await createCodes(tier, d, n, note.slice(0, 80))
  await audit(s.actor, `${n} adet ${tier} kodu üretti (${d} gün)`, note || '—')
  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true, codes: codes.map((c) => c.code) }
}

  revalidatePath('/sy-core')
  return { ok: true }
}

}

export async function testIntegration(name: 'anilist' | 'gemini' | 'store' | 'ollama' | 'animethemes') {
  await guard()
  const started = Date.now()
  try {
    if (name === 'store') {
      const h = await storeHealth()
      return { ok: h.ok, ms: h.ms, detail: h.ok ? (process.env.DATABASE_URL ? 'Postgres bağlantısı başarılı' : 'Geçici bellek deposu (kalıcı değil)') : h.error }
    }
    if (name === 'anilist') {
      const res = await fetch('https://graphql.anilist.co', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: '{ SiteStatistics { anime(perPage:1) { nodes { count } } } }' }), cache: 'no-store' })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: `HTTP ${res.status} · limit ${res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining') ?? '?'} kaldı` }
    }
    if (name === 'animethemes') {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.animethemes.moe/anime?page[size]=1', { cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Sytheris/1.0 (+https://sytheris.vercel.app)', Accept: 'application/json' } })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: `HTTP ${res.status}` }
    }
    if (name === 'gemini') {
      const key = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY
      if (!key) return { ok: false, ms: 0, detail: 'GEMINI_API_KEY tanımlı değil' }
      const res = await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?pageSize=1', { headers: { 'x-goog-api-key': key }, cache: 'no-store' })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: res.ok ? 'API anahtarı geçerli' : `HTTP ${res.status}` }
    }
    if (name === 'ollama') {
      if (!process.env.OLLAMA_URL) return { ok: false, ms: 0, detail: 'OLLAMA_URL tanımlı değil (yerel Ollama tarayıcıdan denenir)' }
      const res = await fetch(`${process.env.OLLAMA_URL.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/tags`, { cache: 'no-store' })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: `HTTP ${res.status}` }
    }
    return { ok: false, ms: 0, detail: 'Bilinmeyen entegrasyon' }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { adminActor } from '@/lib/admin-guard'
import { audit } from '@/lib/community'
import { huntMedia, type HuntCandidate, type HuntResult } from '@/lib/media-hunter'
import { deleteVaultItem, getVaultItem, isHttpUrl, saveVaultItem, signedMediaPath, type MediaKind } from '@/lib/media-vault'
import { rateLimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
import { addEpisode } from '@/lib/site'

type Fail = { ok: false; error: string }
export type HuntCandidateView = HuntCandidate & { preview: string }
export type HuntResponse = (Omit<Extract<HuntResult, { ok: true }>, 'candidates'> & { candidates: HuntCandidateView[] }) | (Fail & { pages?: Extract<HuntResult, { ok: false }>['pages'] })

async function requireAdmin() {
  const actor = await adminActor()
  if (!actor) throw new Error('Yetkisiz işlem')
  return actor
}

export async function huntAction(rawUrl: string): Promise<HuntResponse> {
  try {
    const actor = await requireAdmin()
    const wait = rateLimit('media-hunt', actor, 12, 60_000)
    if (wait) return { ok: false, error: `Çok sık tarama yapıldı. ${wait} sn sonra tekrar dene.` }
    const url = String(rawUrl ?? '').trim()
    if (!isHttpUrl(url)) return { ok: false, error: 'http(s) ile başlayan geçerli bir bağlantı yapıştır.' }

    const result = await huntMedia(url)
    await audit(actor, 'kaynak taradı', new URL(url).hostname).catch(() => {})
    if (!result.ok) return result
    return { ...result, candidates: result.candidates.map((c) => ({ ...c, preview: signedMediaPath(c.url, c.referer, c.kind) })) }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

export async function saveVaultAction(input: { label: string; pageUrl: string; url: string; referer: string; kind: MediaKind; quality: string | null }) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireAdmin()
    if (!isHttpUrl(input.url) || !isHttpUrl(input.referer) || !isHttpUrl(input.pageUrl)) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Bağlantılar geçersiz.' }
    if (input.kind !== 'hls' && input.kind !== 'mp4') return { ok: false as const, error: 'Bilinmeyen kaynak türü.' }
    const item = await saveVaultItem({
      label: String(input.label ?? '').trim().slice(0, 160) || new URL(input.pageUrl).hostname,
      pageUrl: input.pageUrl,
      url: input.url,
      referer: input.referer,
      kind: input.kind,
      quality: typeof input.quality === 'string' ? input.quality.slice(0, 12) : null,
      by: actor,
    })
    await audit(actor, 'kaynak kaydetti', item.label).catch(() => {})
    revalidatePath('/sy-core')
    return { ok: true as const, id: item.id }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

export async function deleteVaultAction(id: string) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireAdmin()
    const item = await getVaultItem(String(id))
    await deleteVaultItem(String(id))
    if (item) await audit(actor, 'kaynak sildi', item.label).catch(() => {})
    revalidatePath('/sy-core')
    return { ok: true as const }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

export async function attachVaultAction(input: { id: string; animeId: number; animeTitle: string; animeCover: string | null; number: number; title: string }) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireAdmin()
    const item = await getVaultItem(String(input.id))
    if (!item) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Kaynak bulunamadı.' }
    if (!Number.isInteger(input.animeId) || input.animeId <= 0) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Anime seçmelisin.' }
    if (!Number.isInteger(input.number) || input.number <= 0 || input.number > 5000) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Geçerli bir bölüm numarası gir.' }

    await addEpisode({
      animeId: input.animeId,
      animeTitle: String(input.animeTitle).slice(0, 200),
      animeCover: isHttpUrl(input.animeCover) ? input.animeCover : null,
      number: input.number,
      title: String(input.title ?? '').slice(0, 200),
      videoUrl: signedMediaPath(item.url, item.referer, item.kind),
      magnetUrl: null,
      subtitleUrl: null,
      subtitleText: null,
      subtitleLang: 'tr',
      thumbnail: null,
    })
    await audit(actor, 'bölüme bağladı', `${input.animeTitle} #${input.number}`).catch(() => {})
    revalidatePath(`/anime/${input.animeId}`)
    revalidatePath('/sy-core')
    return { ok: true as const }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

function Stat({ label, value, hint, tone }: { label: string; value: string | number; hint?: string; tone?: 'ok' | 'warn' }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5">
      <p className="label-mono text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className={cn('mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums', tone === 'warn' && 'text-destructive', tone === 'ok' && 'text-ink')}>{value}</p>
      {hint && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export type AnalyticsInput = {
  signups: number[]
  comments: number[]
  active7: number
  active30: number
  total: number
  verified: number
  banned: number
  tiers: { label: string; value: number }[]
  providers: { label: string; value: number }[]
  topAnime: { title: string; value: number }[]
  topUsers: { name: string; value: number }[]
}

const DAY = 86_400_000

/** Buckets timestamps into the last `days` calendar days (oldest first) in Turkey time. */
export function dailyBuckets(stamps: number[], days = 14) {
  const tz = 3 * 3_600_000
  const today = Math.floor((Date.now() + tz) / DAY)
  const out = new Array<number>(days).fill(0)
  for (const t of stamps) {
    const idx = days - 1 - (today - Math.floor((t + tz) / DAY))
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < days) out[idx]++
  }
  return out
}

function dayLabel(offsetFromToday: number) {
  return new Date(Date.now() - offsetFromToday * DAY).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: 'Europe/Istanbul' })
}

function Bars({ values, label }: { values: number[]; label: string }) {
  const max = Math.max(1, ...values)
  const sum = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
  return (
    <figure className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">
      <figcaption className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
        <span className="font-semibold">{label}</span>
        <span className="text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">Son 14 gün · {sum}</span>
      </figcaption>
      <div className="flex h-36 items-end gap-1" role="img" aria-label={`${label}: son 14 günde toplam ${sum}`}>
        {values.map((v, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="group relative flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col justify-end">
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-background opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100">
              {v}
            </span>
            <span className={cn('w-full rounded-t-md transition-colors', v ? 'bg-primary group-hover:brightness-110' : 'bg-muted')} style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, (v / max) * 100)}%` }} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
        <span>{dayLabel(values.length - 1)}</span>
        <span>Bugün</span>
      </div>
    </figure>
  )
}

function Breakdown({ title, rows, empty }: { title: string; rows: { label: string; value: number }[]; empty: string }) {
  const total = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.value, 0) || 1
  return (
    <section className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">
      <h3 className="font-semibold">{title}</h3>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{empty}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.label} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <span className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{r.label}</span>
                <span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                  {r.value} · {Math.round((r.value / total) * 100)}%
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                <span className="block h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${(r.value / total) * 100}%` }} />
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  )
}

export function AnalyticsPanel({ data }: { data: AnalyticsInput }) {
  const pct = (n: number) => (data.total ? Math.round((n / data.total) * 100) : 0)
  const kpis = [
    { label: 'Aktif (7 gün)', value: data.active7, hint: `Üyelerin %${pct(data.active7)}'i` },
    { label: 'Aktif (30 gün)', value: data.active30, hint: `Üyelerin %${pct(data.active30)}'i` },
    { label: 'Doğrulanmış e-posta', value: data.verified, hint: `%${pct(data.verified)}` },
    { label: 'Askıdaki hesap', value: data.banned, hint: data.banned ? 'Kullanıcılar sekmesinden yönet' : 'Yok' },
  ]
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {kpis.map((k) => (
          <div key={k.label} className="rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{k.label}</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums tracking-tight">{k.value}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{k.hint}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Bars values={data.signups} label="Yeni kayıtlar" />
        <Bars values={data.comments} label="Yorumlar" />
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <Breakdown title="Üyelik planları" rows={data.tiers} empty="Henüz üye yok." />
        <Breakdown title="Giriş yöntemleri" rows={data.providers} empty="Henüz üye yok." />
        <Breakdown title="En çok konuşulan animeler" rows={data.topAnime.map((a) => ({ label: a.title, value: a.value }))} empty="Henüz yorum yok." />
        <Breakdown title="En aktif yorumcular" rows={data.topUsers.map((u) => ({ label: u.name, value: u.value }))} empty="Henüz yorum yok." />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'

import { createPremiumCodes, deletePremiumCode } from '@/app/sy-core/actions'

export type CodeRow = { code: string; tier: 'plus' | 'ultra'; days: number; createdAt: number; usedBy?: string | null; usedAt?: number | null; note?: string }

export function CodesPanel({ codes }: { codes: CodeRow[] }) {
  const [tier, setTier] = useState<'plus' | 'ultra'>('plus')
  const [days, setDays] = useState(30)
  const [count, setCount] = useState(5)
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const [fresh, setFresh] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const router = useRouter()
  const unused = codes.filter((c) => !c.usedBy).length

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          start(async () => {
            try {
              const res = await createPremiumCodes(tier, days, count, note)
              setFresh(res.codes)
              toast.success(`${res.codes.length} kod üretildi`)
              router.refresh()
            } catch (err) {
              toast.error((err as Error).message)
            }
          })
        }}
        className="grid gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-6 md:grid-cols-[auto_auto_auto_1fr_auto] md:items-end"
      >
        <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <legend className="mb-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Plan</legend>
          <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-xl bg-muted p-1">
            {(['plus', 'ultra'] as const).map((t) => (
              <button key={t} type="button" aria-pressed={tier === t} onClick={() => setTier(t)} className={cn('rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium capitalize transition', tier === t ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                {t}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">

          <input type="number" min={1} max={3650} value={days} onChange={(e) => setDays(Number(e.target.value))} className="h-10 w-24 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground outline-none focus:border-primary" />
        </label>
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Adet
          <input type="number" min={1} max={50} value={count} onChange={(e) => setCount(Number(e.target.value))} className="h-10 w-20 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground outline-none focus:border-primary" />
        </label>
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Not
          <input value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Örn. Discord çekilişi" className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground outline-none focus:border-primary" />
        </label>
        <button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-primary px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-70">

            <p className="font-semibold">Yeni kodlar</p>

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { ExternalLink, Loader2, Search, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { moderateComment } from '@/app/sy-core/actions'

export type CommentRow = { id: string; animeId: number; animeTitle: string; text: string; spoiler: boolean; at: number; likes: number; author: string }

export function CommentsPanel({ comments }: { comments: CommentRow[] }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [, start] = useTransition()
  const router = useRouter()
  const list = comments.filter((c) => `${c.text} ${c.author} ${c.animeTitle}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Yorumlarda, yazarlarda veya animelerde ara…" aria-label="Yorum ara" className="h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card pl-11 pr-4 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary" />
      </div>
      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz yorum yok.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card">
          {list.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.id} className="flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:gap-4">
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{c.author}</span>
                  <span>·</span>
                  <Link href={`/anime/${c.animeId}#yorumlar`} target="_blank" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-ink">
                    {c.animeTitle} <ExternalLink className="size-3" />
                  </Link>
                  <span>· {new Date(c.at).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
                  {c.spoiler && <span className="rounded-full bg-destructive/10 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase text-destructive">spoiler</span>}
                  <span>· {c.likes} beğeni</span>
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1.5 line-clamp-3 text-sm leading-relaxed">{c.text}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setBusy(c.id)
                  start(async () => {
                    try {
                      await moderateComment(c.animeId, c.id)
                      toast.success('Yorum silindi')
                      router.refresh()
                    } catch (e) {
                      toast.error((e as Error).message)
                    } finally {
                      setBusy(null)
                    }
                  })
                }}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { ExternalLink, Eye, Loader2, Plus, Trash2, Wand2, Tv } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { addEpisodeAction, deleteEpisodeAction } from '@/app/sy-core/actions'
import type { Episode } from '@/lib/site'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Card } from '@/components/settings/settings-panel'
import { AnimePicker } from '@/components/compare/compare-picker'

const field = 'h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary'

type CatalogItem = { animeId: number; title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; episodes: Episode[] }

export function EpisodeManager({ catalog }: { catalog: CatalogItem[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [anime, setAnime] = useState<{ id: number; title: string; cover: string | null } | null>(null)
  const [subMode, setSubMode] = useState<'url' | 'text'>('url')
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(false)
  const [searchingTorrent, setSearchingTorrent] = useState(false)
  const [searchingStream, setSearchingStream] = useState(false)
  
  const [f, setF] = useState({ number: 1, title: '', videoUrl: '', magnetUrl: '', thumbnail: '', subtitleUrl: '', subtitleText: '', subtitleLang: 'tr' })

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!anime) {
      toast.error('Önce bir anime seç')
      return
    }
    start(async () => {
      const res = await addEpisodeAction({
        animeId: anime.id,
        animeTitle: anime.title,
        animeCover: anime.cover,
        number: Number(f.number),
        title: f.title,
        videoUrl: f.videoUrl.trim(),
        magnetUrl: f.magnetUrl.trim(),
        thumbnail: f.thumbnail.trim(),
        subtitleUrl: subMode === 'url' ? f.subtitleUrl.trim() : '',
        subtitleText: subMode === 'text' ? f.subtitleText : '',
        subtitleLang: f.subtitleLang,
      })
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(res.error)
        return
      }
      toast.success(`${anime.title} · ${f.number}. bölüm eklendi`)
      setF((x) => ({ ...x, number: x.number + 1, title: '', videoUrl: '', magnetUrl: '', thumbnail: '', subtitleUrl: '', subtitleText: '' }))
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  const handleFindStream = async () => {
    if (!anime || !f.number) {
      toast.error('Anime ve bölüm numarası gerekli')
      return
    }
    setSearchingStream(true)
    toast.loading('HLS/MP4 Akış linki aranıyor...', { id: 'stream' })
    
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/stream?title=${encodeURIComponent(anime.title)}&ep=${f.number}`)
      
      const text = await res.text()
      let data
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(text)
      } catch {
        throw new Error('Sunucu geçersiz yanıt döndürdü (HTML veya boş sayfa). Vercel loglarına bakın.')
      }
      
      if (data.streamUrl) {
        setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, videoUrl: data.streamUrl }))
        toast.success('Akış linki bulundu ve eklendi!', { id: 'stream' })
      } else {
        toast.error(data.error || 'Bulunamadı', { id: 'stream', duration: 6000 })
        console.log('Detaylı Hata:', data)
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || 'Bağlantı hatası', { id: 'stream', duration: 8000 })
      console.error(error)
    } finally {
      setSearchingStream(false)
    }
  }

  const handleFindTorrent = async () => {
    if (!anime || !f.number) {
      toast.error('Anime ve bölüm numarası gerekli')
      return
    }
    setSearchingTorrent(true)
    toast.loading('Torrent aranıyor...', { id: 'torrent' })
    
    try {
      const q = `${anime.title} ${f.number < 10 ? '0'+f.number : f.number}`
      const res = await fetch(`/api/torrents?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`)
      const data = await res.json()
      
      if (data.magnet) {
        setF((prev) => ({ 
          ...prev, 
          magnetUrl: data.magnet,
          title: prev.title || data.title || `${prev.number}. bölüm`,
          thumbnail: prev.thumbnail || anime.cover || ''
        }))
        toast.success(`Torrent bulundu! (${data.seeders} seed)`, { id: 'torrent' })
      } else {
        toast.error(data.error || 'Bulunamadı', { id: 'torrent' })
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Arama hatası', { id: 'torrent' })
    } finally {
      setSearchingTorrent(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card title="Yeni bölüm" accent="ekle">
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">Anime</span>
            <AnimePicker label="Anime adı yaz ve seç" value={anime} onPick={(m) => setAnime(m ? { id: m.id, title: pickTitle(m.title), cover: m.coverImage.large ?? null } : null)} />
          </div>
          
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[140px_1fr]">
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Bölüm no</span>
              <input type="number" min={1} required className={field} value={f.number} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, number: Number(e.target.value) })} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Bölüm başlığı</span>
              <input className={field} value={f.title} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, title: e.target.value })} />
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">HLS / MP4 Linki</span>
                <button 
                  type="button" 
                  onClick={handleFindStream}
                  disabled={searchingStream}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {searchingStream ? <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Tv className="size-3.5" />}
                  Akış Bul
                </button>
              </div>
              <input type="text" className={field} placeholder="https://.../master.m3u8" value={f.videoUrl} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, videoUrl: e.target.value })} />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">Magnet Linki</span>
                <button 
                  type="button" 
                  onClick={handleFindTorrent}
                  disabled={searchingTorrent}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-secondary px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {searchingTorrent ? <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Wand2 className="size-3.5" />}
                  Torrent Bul
                </button>
              </div>
              <input type="text" className={field} placeholder="magnet:?xt=urn:btih:..." value={f.magnetUrl} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, magnetUrl: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
          </div>

type Group = { title: string; vars: { key: string; note: string; required?: boolean; set: boolean }[] }
type Result = { ok: boolean; ms: number; detail?: string }

const SERVICES = [
  { id: 'anilist', label: 'AniList API', note: 'Anime verileri' },
  { id: 'animethemes', label: 'AnimeThemes', note: 'OP / ED müzikleri' },

  { id: 'ollama', label: 'Ollama (sunucu)', note: 'Yerel yapay zekâ' },
] as const

export function IntegrationPanel({ groups, providers, origin }: { groups: Group[]; providers: { id: string; label: string; configured: boolean }[]; origin: string }) {
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Record<string, Result>>({})
  const [running, setRunning] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [, start] = useTransition()

  const run = (id: (typeof SERVICES)[number]['id']) => {
    setRunning(id)
    start(async () => {
      const r = await testIntegration(id)
      setResults((x) => ({ ...x, [id]: r }))
      setRunning(null)
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card title="Servis" accent="durumu">
        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => SERVICES.forEach((s, i) => window.setTimeout(() => run(s.id), i * 300))} className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-4 text-sm transition hover:border-primary">
            <PlayCircle className="size-4" /> Tümünü test et
          </button>
        </div>
        <ul className="mt-3 flex flex-col divide-y divide-border">
          {SERVICES.map((s) => {
            const r = results[s.id]
            return (
              <li key={s.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 py-3">
                <span className={cn('size-2.5 rounded-full', !r ? 'bg-muted-foreground/40' : r.ok ? 'bg-primary shadow-[0_0_10px_var(--primary)]' : 'bg-destructive')} />
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">

                  <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r?.detail ?? s.note}</span>

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Loader2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

import { clearLogsAction } from '@/app/sy-core/actions'
import type { LogEntry } from '@/lib/site'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function LogsPanel({ logs }: { logs: LogEntry[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'error' | 'warn'>('all')
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const list = logs.filter((l) => filter === 'all' || l.level === filter)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {(['all', 'error', 'warn'] as const).map((f) => (
          <button key={f} type="button" aria-pressed={filter === f} onClick={() => setFilter(f)} className={cn('rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', filter === f ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary')}>
            {f === 'all' ? `Tümü (${logs.length})` : f === 'error' ? `Hatalar (${logs.filter((l) => l.level === 'error').length})` : `Uyarılar (${logs.filter((l) => l.level === 'warn').length})`}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={pending || logs.length === 0}
          onClick={() =>
            start(async () => {
              await clearLogsAction()
              toast.success('Kayıtlar temizlendi')
              router.refresh()
            })
          }
          className="ml-auto flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm text-destructive transition hover:bg-destructive/10 disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 className="size-4" />} Temizle
        </button>
      </div>
      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Kayıt yok. Sistem sorunsuz çalışıyor.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {list.map((l) => (
            <li key={l.id}>
              <details className="group rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 open:border-primary/40">
                <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-start gap-3">
                  <span className={cn('mt-0.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase', l.level === 'error' ? 'bg-destructive text-on-scrim' : 'bg-accent text-ink')}>{l.level}</span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block text-sm">{l.message}</span>
                    <span className="mt-1 block font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {new Date(l.at).toLocaleString('tr-TR')} · {l.source} {l.path ? `· ${l.path}` : ''}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </summary>
                {(l.stack || l.userAgent) && (
                  <pre className="mt-3 max-h-64 overflow-auto rounded-xl bg-muted p-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                    {l.stack}
                    {l.userAgent ? `\n\nUA: ${l.userAgent}` : ''}
                  </pre>
                )}
              </details>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Bookmark, BookmarkCheck, ChevronDown, Link2, Loader2, Play, Plus, Radar, ShieldCheck, Trash2, Tv } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { attachVaultAction, deleteVaultAction, huntAction, saveVaultAction, type HuntCandidateView, type HuntResponse } from '@/app/sy-core/hunter-actions'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Card } from '@/components/settings/settings-panel'
import { AnimePicker } from '@/components/compare/compare-picker'
import { VaultPlayer } from './vault-player'

export type VaultView = { id: string; label: string; host: string; pageUrl: string; kind: 'hls' | 'mp4'; quality: string | null; by: string; createdAt: number; preview: string }

const field = 'h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary'

function formatBytes(n: number | null) {
  if (!n) return null
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.round(n / 1024)} KB`
  if (n < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`
  return `${(n / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB`
}

function shortPath(url: string) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url)
    const file = u.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).slice(-2).join('/')
    return `${u.hostname}/…/${file}`
  } catch {
    return url
  }
}

function KindBadge({ kind }: { kind: 'hls' | 'mp4' }) {
  return (
    <span className={cn('rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider', kind === 'hls' ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-foreground text-background')}>
      {kind === 'hls' ? 'm3u8' : 'mp4'}
    </span>
  )
}

function Elapsed({ running }: { running: boolean }) {
  const [s, setS] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return
    setS(0)
    const t = window.setInterval(() => setS((x) => x + 1), 1000)
    return () => clearInterval(t)
  }, [running])
  return <span className="tabular-nums">{s} sn</span>
}

export function MediaHunter({ vault }: { vault: VaultView[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('')
  const [hunting, startHunt] = useTransition()
  const [busy, startBusy] = useTransition()
  const [result, setResult] = useState<HuntResponse | null>(null)
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<{ key: string; src: string; kind: 'hls' | 'mp4'; title: string } | null>(null)
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const [attachFor, setAttachFor] = useState<string | null>(null)

  function hunt(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!url.trim()) return
    setPreview(null)
    startHunt(async () => {
      const res = await huntAction(url.trim())
      setResult(res)
      if (!res.ok) toast.error(res.error)
      else if (!res.candidates.length) toast.message('Sayfada mp4 / m3u8 bulunamadı', { description: 'Ayrıntılar için taranan sayfalara bak.' })
      else toast.success(`${res.candidates.length} kaynak bulundu`)
    })
  }

  function save(c: HuntCandidateView) {
    if (!result?.ok) return
    startBusy(async () => {
      const res = await saveVaultAction({ label: result.title ?? new URL(result.pageUrl).hostname, pageUrl: result.pageUrl, url: c.url, referer: c.referer, kind: c.kind, quality: c.quality })
      if (!res.ok) return void toast.error(res.error)
      setSaved((s) => new Set(s).add(c.url))
      toast.success('Kayıtlı kaynaklara eklendi')
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  function remove(item: VaultView) {
    if (!confirm(`"${item.label}" kaynağı silinsin mi? Bu kaynağa bağlı bölümler oynamayı sürdürür.`)) return
    startBusy(async () => {
      const res = await deleteVaultAction(item.id)
      if (!res.ok) return void toast.error(res.error)
      if (preview?.key === item.id) setPreview(null)
      toast.success('Kaynak silindi')
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card title="Link avcısı" accent="mp4 · m3u8">
        <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          Bölüm sayfasının bağlantısını yapıştır. Sayfa, içindeki oynatıcılar (iframe), oynatıcı betikleri, paketlenmiş ve base64 ile gizlenmiş kaynaklar taranır; bulunan her
          bağlantı sunucuda doğrulanır. Kaydettiğin kaynaklar indirilmeden, imzalı bağlantıyla burada gömülü oynar.
        </p>

        <form onSubmit={hunt} className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
          <label className="relative flex-1">
            <span className="sr-only">Bölüm sayfasının bağlantısı</span>
            <Link2 className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <input
              type="url"
              required
              inputMode="url"
              autoComplete="off"
              spellCheck={false}
              placeholder="https://site.com/anime/bolum-1"
              value={url}
              onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
              className={cn(field, 'pl-11 font-mono')}
            />
          </label>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={hunting}
            className="flex h-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-foreground px-6 text-sm font-semibold text-background transition hover:opacity-90 disabled:cursor-progress disabled:opacity-80"
          >
            {hunting ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Radar className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
            {hunting ? 'Taranıyor' : 'Kaynakları çek'}
          </button>
        </form>

        <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <ShieldCheck className="size-3.5 text-ink" aria-hidden="true" />
          Yalnızca yöneticiler · özel ağ adresleri engellenir · dakikada 12 tarama · tüm işlemler denetim kaydına yazılır
        </p>

        {hunting && (
          <div role="status" className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border">
            <div className="relative h-1 bg-muted">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/3 animate-[hunt-scan_1.4s_ease-in-out_infinite] bg-primary" />
            </div>
            <p className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Sayfa ve gömülü oynatıcılar taranıyor… <Elapsed running={hunting} />
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {result && !hunting && (
          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-4">
            {result.ok && (
              <p className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                <span className="font-semibold">{result.title ?? new URL(result.pageUrl).hostname}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {result.candidates.length} kaynak · {result.pages.length} sayfa · {(result.tookMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} sn
                </span>
              </p>
            )}

            {preview && !vault.some((v) => v.id === preview.key) && <VaultPlayer src={preview.src} kind={preview.kind} title={preview.title} onClose={() => setPreview(null)} />}

            {result.ok && result.candidates.length > 0 && (
              <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border">
                {result.candidates.map((c) => {
                  const isSaved = saved.has(c.url) || vault.some((v) => v.preview === c.preview)
                  return (
                    <li key={c.url} className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <KindBadge kind={c.kind} />
                          {c.quality && <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{c.quality}</span>}
                          <span className={cn('flex items-center gap-1 text-xs', c.probe?.ok ? 'text-ink' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                            <span className={cn('size-1.5 rounded-full', c.probe?.ok ? 'bg-primary' : c.probe ? 'bg-destructive' : 'bg-muted-foreground/40')} aria-hidden="true" />
                            {c.probe ? c.probe.note : 'Doğrulanmadı'}
                            {formatBytes(c.probe?.bytes ?? null) && ` · ${formatBytes(c.probe?.bytes ?? null)}`}
                          </span>
                          <span className="rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{c.via}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground" title={c.url}>
                          {shortPath(c.url)}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setPreview({ key: c.url, src: c.preview, kind: c.kind, title: `${c.quality ?? ''} ${shortPath(c.url)}`.trim() })}
                          className="flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition hover:border-primary"
                        >
                          <Play className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> Önizle
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => save(c)}
                          disabled={busy || isSaved}
                          className="flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-60"
                        >
                          {isSaved ? <BookmarkCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Bookmark className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />}
                          {isSaved ? 'Kayıtlı' : 'Kaydet'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  )
                })}
              </ul>
            )}

            {result.ok && result.candidates.length === 0 && (
              <p className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                Bu sayfanın kodunda oynatılabilir bir mp4 / m3u8 bağlantısı yok. Kaynak, sitenin kendi giriş, captcha ya da DRM adımından sonra oluşuyor olabilir. Oynatıcının açıldığı
                gömülü sayfanın (iframe) bağlantısını doğrudan yapıştırmayı dene.
              </p>
            )}

            {(result.ok ? result.pages : (result.pages ?? [])).length > 0 && (
              <details className="group rounded-2xl border border-border">
                <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                  Taranan sayfalar
                  <ChevronDown className="size-4 text-muted-foreground transition group-open:rotate-180" aria-hidden="true" />
                </summary>
                <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border border-t border-border font-mono text-xs">
                  {(result.ok ? result.pages : (result.pages ?? [])).map((p, i) => (
                    <li key={`${p.url}-${i}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2" style={{ paddingLeft: `${1 + p.depth * 1.25}rem` }}>
                      <span className={cn('w-9 shrink-0', p.status >= 200 && p.status < 400 ? 'text-ink' : 'text-destructive')}>{p.status || '—'}</span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate" title={p.url}>
                        {p.url}
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">{p.note}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </details>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Kayıtlı" accent="kaynaklar">
        {vault.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz kaydedilmiş kaynak yok. Yukarıdan bir bölüm sayfası tarayıp bulduklarını kaydet.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
            {vault.map((item) => (
              <li key={item.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border p-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
                    <p className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <KindBadge kind={item.kind} />
                      {item.quality && <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{item.quality}</span>}
                      <span className="truncate font-medium">{item.label}</span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {item.host} · {item.by} · {new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setPreview(preview?.key === item.id ? null : { key: item.id, src: item.preview, kind: item.kind, title: item.label })}
                      className={cn('flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition', preview?.key === item.id ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10' : 'border-border hover:border-primary')}
                    >
                      <Tv className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> {preview?.key === item.id ? 'Kapat' : 'İzle'}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setAttachFor(attachFor === item.id ? null : item.id)}
                      className="flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition hover:border-primary"
                    >
                      <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> Bölüme ekle
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => remove(item)}
                      disabled={busy}
                      className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"
                      aria-label={`${item.label} kaynağını sil`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {preview?.key === item.id && <VaultPlayer src={item.preview} kind={item.kind} title={item.label} />}
                {attachFor === item.id && <AttachForm item={item} onDone={() => setAttachFor(null)} />}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}

function AttachForm({ item, onDone }: { item: VaultView; onDone: () => void }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [anime, setAnime] = useState<{ id: number; title: string; cover: string | null } | null>(null)
  const [number, setNumber] = useState(1)
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!anime) return void toast.error('Önce bir anime seç')
    start(async () => {
      const res = await attachVaultAction({ id: item.id, animeId: anime.id, animeTitle: anime.title, animeCover: anime.cover, number, title })
      if (!res.ok) return void toast.error(res.error)
      toast.success(`${anime.title} · ${number}. bölüme bağlandı`)
      router.refresh()
      onDone()
    })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-muted/40 p-4">
      <AnimePicker label="Anime adı yaz ve seç" value={anime} onPick={(m) => setAnime(m ? { id: m.id, title: pickTitle(m.title), cover: m.coverImage.large ?? null } : null)} />
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[120px_1fr_auto]">
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Bölüm no
          <input type="number" min={1} max={5000} required value={number} onChange={(e) => setNumber(Number(e.target.value))} className={field} />
        </label>
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Bölüm başlığı (opsiyonel)
          <input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} className={field} />
        </label>
        <button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="mt-auto flex h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-foreground px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-background transition hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-70">
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
          Bağla
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

export type ReportRow = {
  id: string
  kind: 'comment' | 'user'
  targetId: string
  animeId?: number
  reason: string
  at: number
  status: 'open' | 'resolved' | 'dismissed'

export function ReportsPanel({ reports }: { reports: ReportRow[] }) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'open' | 'all'>('open')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [, start] = useTransition()
  const router = useRouter()
  const list = reports.filter((r) => filter === 'all' || r.status === 'open')

  const run = (id: string, fn: () => Promise<unknown>, msg: string) => {

      try {
        await fn()
        toast.success(msg)
        router.refresh()

        toast.error((e as Error).message)

        setBusy(null)

                      >

                    )}
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => run(r.id, () => resolveReport(r.id, 'resolved'), 'Çözüldü olarak işaretlendi')} className="flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition hover:border-primary">
                      <Check className="size-3.5" /> Çözüldü

                  </>
                ) : (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => run(r.id, () => resolveReport(r.id, 'open'), 'Yeniden açıldı')} className="flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted">
                    <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" /> Yeniden aç
                  </button>
                )}
                {busy === r.id && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function UsersTable({ users, isAdmin = true }: { users: PublicUser[]; isAdmin?: boolean }) {

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle, Loader2, X } from 'lucide-react'

/**
 * Embedded preview for hunted sources. Plays through the signed /api/medya relay, so the upstream
 * referer/CORS rules are satisfied and the original link never reaches the browser. No download control.
 */
export function VaultPlayer({ src, kind, title, onClose }: { src: string; kind: 'hls' | 'mp4'; title: string; onClose?: () => void }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const [state, setState] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading')
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = ref.current
    if (!video) return
    setState('loading')
    let destroy: (() => void) | undefined
    let cancelled = false

    const fail = (msg: string) => {
      if (cancelled) return
      setMessage(msg)
      setState('error')
    }

    if (kind === 'hls' && !video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
      import('hls.js').then(({ default: Hls }) => {
        if (cancelled) return
        if (!Hls.isSupported()) return fail('Bu tarayıcı HLS oynatmayı desteklemiyor.')
        const hls = new Hls({ enableWorker: true, lowLatencyMode: false, maxBufferLength: 30 })
        hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, () => !cancelled && setState('ready'))
        hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, (_e, data) => {
          if (!data.fatal) return
          if (data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR) return hls.recoverMediaError()
          fail(data.response?.code ? `Kaynak ${data.response.code} döndürdü.` : 'Akış yüklenemedi. Kaynak süresi dolmuş ya da erişime kapalı olabilir.')
        })
        hls.loadSource(src)
        hls.attachMedia(video)
        destroy = () => hls.destroy()
      })
    } else {
      video.src = src
      const onReady = () => setState('ready')
      const onError = () => fail('Video yüklenemedi. Kaynak süresi dolmuş ya da erişime kapalı olabilir.')
      video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onReady)
      video.addEventListener('error', onError)
      destroy = () => {
        video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onReady)
        video.removeEventListener('error', onError)
        video.removeAttribute('src')
        video.load()
      }
    }
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      destroy?.()
    }
  }, [src, kind])

  return (
    <figure className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-scrim">
      <video
        ref={ref}
        controls
        playsInline
        preload="metadata"
        controlsList="nodownload noplaybackrate"
        onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className="aspect-video w-full bg-scrim"
        aria-label={`${title} önizleme`}
      />
      {state === 'loading' && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-on-scrim/80">
          <Loader2 className="size-6 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="sr-only">Yükleniyor</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {state === 'error' && (
        <div role="alert" className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-scrim/90 p-6 text-center text-sm text-on-scrim">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-6 text-destructive" aria-hidden="true" />
          {message}
        </div>
      )}
      <figcaption className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-on-scrim/10 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-on-scrim/70">
        <span className="truncate">{title}</span>
        <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">
          <span className="font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">{kind === 'hls' ? 'HLS' : 'MP4'} · gömülü</span>
          {onClose && (
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full text-on-scrim/70 transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 hover:text-on-scrim" aria-label="Önizlemeyi kapat">
              <X className="size-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  )
}
