const SYSTEM = `Sen "Syra"sın: Sytheris anime keşif platformunun neşeli, Türkçe konuşan anime kızı maskotu ve asistanısın. Her zaman Türkçe yanıt ver, emoji kullanma. Anime önerirken 3-5 başlık ver, başlıkları **kalın** yaz, her biri için tek cümlelik neden ekle. Spoiler verme.`

let ollamaStatus: { url: string; ok: boolean; at: number } | null = null

async function ollamaAvailable(url: string) {
  if (ollamaStatus && ollamaStatus.url === url && Date.now() - ollamaStatus.at < 60_000) return ollamaStatus.ok
  try {
    const ctrl = new AbortController()
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 1200)
    const res = await fetch(`${url.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/tags`, { signal: ctrl.signal })
    window.clearTimeout(t)
    ollamaStatus = { url, ok: res.ok, at: Date.now() }
  } catch {
    ollamaStatus = { url, ok: false, at: Date.now() }
  }
  return ollamaStatus.ok
}

function renderInline(text: string) {
  const parts = text.split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)/g)
  return parts.map((p, i) => (p.startsWith('**') && p.endsWith('**') ? <strong key={i} className="font-semibold text-foreground">{p.slice(2, -2)}</strong> : <span key={i}>{p}</span>))
}

export function RichText({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = []
  let list: string[] = []
  const flush = () => {
    if (!list.length) return
    out.push(
      <ul key={`l${out.length}`} className="my-1 flex flex-col gap-1.5 pl-1">
        {list.map((l, i) => (
          <li key={i} className="flex gap-2">
            <span className="mt-2 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-primary" />
            <span>{renderInline(l)}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>,
    )
    list = []
  }
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    const m = line.match(/^\s*(?:[-*•]|\d+[.)])\s+(.*)$/)
    if (m) list.push(m[1])
    else {
      flush()
      if (line.trim()) out.push(<p key={i}>{renderInline(line.replace(/^#+\s*/, ''))}</p>)
    }
  })
  flush()
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">{out}</div>
}

export function AiAssistant() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Msg[]>([])
  const [input, setInput] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const abort = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
  const scroller = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    scroller.current?.scrollTo({ top: scroller.current.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }, [messages])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Escape' && setOpen(false)
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [open])

  async function send(text: string) {
    const content = text.trim()
    if (!content || busy) return
    const history: Msg[] = [...messages, { role: 'user', content }]
    setMessages([...history, { role: 'assistant', content: '' }])
    setInput('')
    setBusy(true)
    const ctrl = new AbortController()
    abort.current = ctrl
    const prefs = getPrefs()
    const append = (chunk: string, provider?: string) =>
      setMessages((list) => {
        const next = [...list]
        const last = next[next.length - 1]
        next[next.length - 1] = { ...last, content: last.content + chunk, provider: provider ?? last.provider }
        return next
      })

    try {
      let usedLocal = false
      if (prefs.aiProvider !== 'gemini' && (await ollamaAvailable(prefs.ollamaUrl))) {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${prefs.ollamaUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/chat`, {
            method: 'POST',
            signal: ctrl.signal,
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ model: prefs.ollamaModel, stream: true, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYSTEM }, ...history.map(({ role, content }) => ({ role, content }))] }),
          })
          if (res.ok && res.body) {
            usedLocal = true
            const reader = res.body.getReader()
            const dec = new TextDecoder()
            let buf = ''
            append('', `Ollama · ${prefs.ollamaModel}`)
            while (true) {
              const { value, done } = await reader.read()
              if (done) break
              buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true })
              const lines = buf.split('\n')
              buf = lines.pop() ?? ''
              for (const l of lines) {
                if (!l.trim()) continue
                try {
                  const t = JSON.parse(l).message?.content
                  if (t) append(t)
                } catch {}
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          if ((e as Error).name === 'AbortError') throw e
        }
      }
      if (!usedLocal) {
        if (prefs.aiProvider === 'ollama') append('', 'Ollama erişilemedi → bulut')
        const res = await fetch('/api/ai', {
          method: 'POST',
          signal: ctrl.signal,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ messages: history.map(({ role, content }) => ({ role, content })), provider: prefs.aiProvider }),
        })
        const provider = res.headers.get('X-AI-Provider')
        append('', provider === 'gemini' ? 'Gemini' : provider === 'ollama' ? 'Ollama (sunucu)' : 'Hata')
        if (!res.body) throw new Error(await res.text())
        const reader = res.body.getReader()
        const dec = new TextDecoder()
        while (true) {
          const { value, done } = await reader.read()
          if (done) break
          append(dec.decode(value, { stream: true }))
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as Error).name !== 'AbortError') append('\nBir hata oluştu, lütfen tekrar dene.')
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
      abort.current = null
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <motion.button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        aria-label={open ? 'Asistanı kapat' : `${MASCOT_NAME} ile konuş`}
        aria-expanded={open}
        whileHover={{ scale: 1.06 }}
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.94 }}
        className="group fixed bottom-[calc(6.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] right-3 z-[60] grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-popover p-0.5 shadow-[0_10px_40px_-8px_var(--primary)] ring-2 ring-primary transition md:bottom-6 md:left-auto md:right-6 md:size-15"
      >
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.span
            key={open ? 'x' : 's'}
            initial={{ scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="grid size-full place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-full"
          >
            {open ? <X className="size-5" /> : <Mascot pose="bust" className="size-full" />}
          </motion.span>
        </AnimatePresence>
        {!open && (
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-1 right-0 grid size-4 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground ring-2 ring-background">
            <Sparkles className="size-2.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
        )}
      </motion.button>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.section
            role="dialog"
            aria-label="Sytheris AI"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.97 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 28, stiffness: 320 }}
            className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-40 top-20 z-[60] flex origin-bottom-left flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-white/40 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-3xl dark:bg-black/40 md:inset-x-auto md:bottom-24 md:right-6 md:top-auto md:h-[min(640px,75vh)] md:w-[420px] md:origin-bottom-right"
          >
            <header className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-4 bg-white/10 dark:bg-black/20">
              <Mascot pose="bust" className="size-11 shrink-0 ring-2 ring-primary" />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {MASCOT_NAME} <span className="accent-serif">asistan</span>
                </p>
                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <span className="size-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-primary" /> Anime önerileri ve sorular için buradayım
                </p>
              </div>
              {messages.length > 0 && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setMessages([])} aria-label="Sohbeti temizle" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-black/10 hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-white/10">
                  <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </header>

            <div ref={scroller} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4" aria-live="polite">
              {messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex h-full flex-col justify-end gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                      Ne izlesem <span className="accent-serif">bugün?</span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Ruh haline, sevdiğin animelere ya da türlere göre öneri iste.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    {SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
                      <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => send(s)} className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/20 px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm backdrop-blur-sm transition hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-white/40 dark:bg-black/20 dark:hover:bg-black/40">
                        {s}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                  {messages.map((m, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className={cn('flex flex-col gap-1', m.role === 'user' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start')}>
                      {m.role === 'assistant' && m.provider && <span className="label-mono text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{m.provider}</span>}
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          'max-w-[88%] rounded-3xl px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-sm',
                          m.role === 'user' ? 'rounded-br-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'rounded-bl-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/30 text-foreground/90 backdrop-blur-md dark:bg-black/40',
                        )}
                      >
                        {m.role === 'assistant' ? m.content ? <RichText text={m.content} /> : <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /> : m.content}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                send(input)
              }}
              className="border-t border-white/10 p-3 bg-white/10 dark:bg-black/20"
            >
              <div className="flex items-end gap-2 rounded-3xl border border-white/20 bg-white/20 p-1.5 pl-4 backdrop-blur-md transition focus-within:border-primary/50 focus-within:bg-white/30 dark:bg-black/20 dark:focus-within:bg-black/40">
                <textarea
                  value={input}
                  onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                      if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return
                      e.preventDefault()
                      send(input)
                    }
                  }}
                  rows={1}
                  placeholder="Bir şey sor…"
                  aria-label="Mesaj"
                  className="max-h-32 min-h-10 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent py-2.5 text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
                />
                {busy ? (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()} aria-label="Durdur" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground text-background">
                    <Square className="size-3.5" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button type="submit" disabled={!input.trim()} aria-label="Gönder" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground transition disabled:opacity-40">
                    <ArrowUp className="size-4" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.section>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { BackdropImage } from '@/components/media/backdrop-image'
import { YTTrailer, isTrailerBroken, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'

export function DetailBackdrop({ media }: { media: MediaCard }) {
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)
  const id = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setOn(true), 3000)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return
    if (prefs.trailerSound) yt.current?.unMute()
    else yt.current?.mute()
  }, [prefs.trailerSound, playing])

  const show = Boolean(id) && on && prefs.autoplayTrailers && !prefs.dataSaver && !failed && !isTrailerBroken(id)

  return (
    <>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        <BackdropImage media={media} priority />
        {show && id && <YTTrailer ref={yt} videoId={id} start={5} onPlaying={() => setPlaying(true)} onError={() => setFailed(true)} />}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim via-scrim/75 to-scrim/20" />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-page to-transparent" />
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      </div>
      {playing && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPrefs({ trailerSound: !prefs.trailerSound })}
          aria-label={prefs.trailerSound ? 'Fragman sesini kapat' : 'Fragman sesini aç'}
          className="absolute right-4 top-6 z-10 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-foreground/25 bg-scrim/30 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-scrim/60 sm:right-10"
        >
          {prefs.trailerSound ? <Volume2 className="size-5" /> : <VolumeX className="size-5" />}
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { ChevronDown, Play, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { YTTrailer, isTrailerBroken, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'

type Active = { media: MediaCard; rect: DOMRect }
type Ctx = { show: (media: MediaCard, el: HTMLElement) => void; hide: () => void; cancelShow: () => void }

const PreviewCtx = createContext<Ctx | null>(null)

export function PreviewProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<Active | null>(null)
  const showTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const pathname = usePathname()

  const clear = () => {
    if (showTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(showTimer.current)
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
  }

  const show = useCallback((media: MediaCard, el: HTMLElement) => {
    if (window.innerWidth < 768) return
    clear()
    showTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setActive({ media, rect: el.getBoundingClientRect() }), 520)
  }, [])

  const cancelShow = useCallback(() => {
    if (showTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(showTimer.current)
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setActive(null), 140)
  }, [])

  const hide = useCallback(() => {
    clear()
    setActive(null)
  }, [])

  const keep = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    setActive(null)
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return
    const onScroll = () => setActive(null)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true, once: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [active])

  return (
    <PreviewCtx.Provider value={{ show, hide, cancelShow }}>
      {children}
      <PreviewLayer active={active} onEnter={keep} onLeave={hide} />
    </PreviewCtx.Provider>
  )
}

export function usePreview() {
  return useContext(PreviewCtx)
}

function PreviewLayer({ active, onEnter, onLeave }: { active: Active | null; onEnter: () => void; onLeave: () => void }) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), [])
  if (!mounted) return null
  return createPortal(
    <AnimatePresence>{active && <PreviewCard key={active.media.id} active={active} onEnter={onEnter} onLeave={onLeave} />}</AnimatePresence>,
    document.body,
  )
}

function PreviewCard({ active, onEnter, onLeave }: { active: Active; onEnter: () => void; onLeave: () => void }) {
  const { media, rect } = active
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)
  const [startTrailer, setStartTrailer] = useState(false)
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const canTrailer = Boolean(trailerId) && prefs.autoplayTrailers && !prefs.dataSaver && !failed && !isTrailerBroken(trailerId)

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setStartTrailer(true), 350)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return
    if (prefs.trailerSound) yt.current?.unMute()
    else yt.current?.mute()
  }, [prefs.trailerSound, playing])

  const width = Math.min(Math.max(rect.width * 1.75, 340), 420)
  const vw = window.innerWidth
  const left = Math.min(Math.max(rect.left + rect.width / 2 - width / 2, 16), vw - width - 16)
  const mediaH = (width * 9) / 16
  const top = Math.max(rect.top + rect.height * 0.32 - mediaH / 2, 76)
  const originX = ((rect.left + rect.width / 2 - left) / width) * 100

  const image = media.bannerImage || media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.72 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, transition: { duration: 0.16 } }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 360, damping: 30 }}
      onMouseEnter={onEnter}
      onMouseLeave={onLeave}
      style={{ position: 'fixed', left, top, width, transformOrigin: `${originX}% 30%` }}
      className="z-[80] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-[0_30px_80px_-20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)]"
    >
      <Link href={`/anime/${media.id}`} className="relative block aspect-video overflow-hidden bg-scrim" aria-label={`${title} detayları`} onClick={onLeave}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={image || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
        {canTrailer && startTrailer && trailerId && (
          <YTTrailer ref={yt} videoId={trailerId} start={4} onPlaying={() => setPlaying(true)} onError={() => setFailed(true)} />
        )}
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-2/3 bg-gradient-to-t from-popover via-popover/40 to-transparent" />
        <p className="absolute bottom-3 left-4 right-14 line-clamp-2 text-lg font-semibold leading-tight text-foreground drop-shadow">{title}</p>
      </Link>
      {playing && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPrefs({ trailerSound: !prefs.trailerSound })}
          aria-label={prefs.trailerSound ? 'Sesi kapat' : 'Sesi aç'}
          className="absolute right-3 top-[calc(var(--h)-3rem)] grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-on-scrim/30 bg-scrim/40 text-on-scrim backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-scrim/70"
          style={{ ['--h' as string]: `${mediaH}px` }}
        >
          {prefs.trailerSound ? <Volume2 className="size-4" /> : <VolumeX className="size-4" />}
        </button>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/anime/${media.id}`}
            onClick={onLeave}
            className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground text-background transition hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"
            aria-label={`${title} izle`}
          >
            <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4 fill-current" />
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/anime/${media.id}`}
            onClick={onLeave}
            className="ml-auto grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border transition hover:border-foreground"

          {media.averageScore ? <span className="font-semibold text-ink">%{media.averageScore} eşleşme</span> : null}
          {media.seasonYear && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{media.seasonYear}</span>}
          {media.format && <span className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{formatTr(media.format)}</span>}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function ScrollRow({ children, className, label }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; label: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [edges, setEdges] = useState({ start: true, end: false })

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const update = () => setEdges({ start: el.scrollLeft < 8, end: el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth >= el.scrollWidth - 8 })
    update()
    el.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true })
    window.addEventListener('resize', update)
    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', update)
      window.removeEventListener('resize', update)
    }
  }, [])

  const scroll = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (el) el.scrollBy({ left: dir * el.clientWidth * 0.85, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  return (
    <div className="group/row relative">
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="region"
        aria-label={label}
        tabIndex={0}
        className={cn(
          'scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-px-4 gap-4 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-4 pt-2 sm:-mx-6 sm:scroll-px-6 sm:px-6 lg:-mx-10 lg:scroll-px-10 lg:px-10',
          className,
        )}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
      {(['start', 'end'] as const).map((side) => (
        <button
          key={side}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => scroll(side === 'start' ? -1 : 1)}
          aria-label={side === 'start' ? 'Geri kaydır' : 'İleri kaydır'}
          className={cn(
            'absolute top-[38%] z-10 hidden size-12 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-popover/90 shadow-xl backdrop-blur transition md:grid',
            side === 'start' ? '-left-2 lg:left-2' : '-right-2 lg:right-2',
            edges[side] ? 'pointer-events-none opacity-0' : 'opacity-0 group-hover/row:opacity-100 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:opacity-100',
          )}
        >
          {side === 'start' ? <ChevronLeft className="size-5" /> : <ChevronRight className="size-5" />}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { TITLE_STYLES, titleStyleFor, type TitleStyle } from '@/lib/title-fonts'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type Props = {
  title: string
  genres?: string[]
  tags?: string[]
  style?: TitleStyle
  as?: 'h1' | 'h2' | 'p'
  className?: string
  animate?: boolean
}

const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
/** Effects that paint text through `background-clip: text` cannot run on individually transformed letters. */
const CLIP_STYLES = new Set<TitleStyle>(['fantasy', 'supernatural', 'romance'])

/**
 * Renders an anime title in a typeface + effect that matches its genre.
 * Letters rise in one by one, then the title settles into a single static node carrying the full effect.
 */
export function StyledTitle({ title, genres, tags, style, as = 'h1', className, animate = true }: Props) {
  const s = style ?? titleStyleFor(genres, tags)
  const def = TITLE_STYLES[s]
  const Tag = as
  const words = title.split(/\s+/)
  const long = title.length > 34
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(!animate)
  const duration = 700 + Math.min(900, title.length * 30)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!animate) return
    setSettled(false)
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setSettled(true), duration + 80)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [title, animate, duration])

  const clip = CLIP_STYLES.has(s)
  const sizeStyle = long ? { fontSize: '0.74em' } : undefined

  if (settled) {
    return (
      <Tag data-title-style={s} className={cn('text-balance leading-[0.98]', def.font, def.effect, className)}>
        <span style={sizeStyle}>{title}</span>
      </Tag>
    )
  }

  let index = 0
  const step = Math.min(0.035, 0.9 / Math.max(1, title.length))
  return (
    <Tag aria-label={title} data-title-style={s} className={cn('text-balance leading-[0.98]', def.font, clip ? 'text-[var(--fx-gold)]' : def.effect, s === 'romance' && 'text-foreground', className)}>
      {words.map((word, wi) => (
        <span key={wi} className="inline-block whitespace-nowrap" style={sizeStyle} aria-hidden="true">
          {word.split('').map((ch) => {
            const i = index++
            return (
              <motion.span
                key={i}
                className="inline-block"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: '0.45em', rotateX: -70 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, rotateX: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.7, delay: i * step, ease: OUT }}
              >
                {ch}
              </motion.span>
            )
          })}
          {wi < words.length - 1 && <span className="inline-block">&nbsp;</span>}
        </span>
      ))}
    </Tag>
  )
}

function TrailerStage({ videoId, poster }: { videoId: string; poster?: string | null }) {
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const [state, setState] = useState<'loading' | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'error'>('loading')
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState({ t: 0, d: 0 })

  return (
    <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-on-scrim">
      {poster && (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img src={poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full scale-105 object-cover opacity-40 blur-[2px]" />
      )}
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      {state !== 'error' && (
        <YTTrailer
          ref={yt}
          videoId={videoId}
          muted={false}
          loop={false}
          onPlaying={() => {
            setState('playing')
            yt.current?.unMute()
          }}
          onEnded={() => setState('paused')}
          onProgress={(t, d) => setProgress({ t, d })}
          onError={() => setState('error')}
        />
      )}
      {state === 'loading' && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
          <Loader2 className="size-8 animate-spin text-primary" aria-hidden="true" />
          <p className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-on-scrim/60">Fragman hazırlanıyor</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {state === 'paused' && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
          <span className="grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary/90 text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_60px_var(--primary)]">
            <Play className="ml-1 size-8 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      {state === 'error' && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold">Bu fragman gömülü oynatmaya izin vermiyor</p>
          <a
            href={`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground"
          >
            YouTube&apos;da aç <ExternalLink className="size-4" />
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
      {(state === 'playing' || state === 'paused') && (
        <>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={state === 'playing' ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
            className="absolute inset-0"
            onClick={() => {
              if (state === 'playing') {
                yt.current?.pause()
                setState('paused')
              } else {
                yt.current?.play()
                setState('playing')
              }
            }}
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex items-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim/90 to-transparent p-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={state === 'playing' ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
              onClick={() => {
                if (state === 'playing') {
                  yt.current?.pause()
                  setState('paused')
                } else {
                  yt.current?.play()
                  setState('playing')
                }
              }}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
            >
              {state === 'playing' ? <Pause className="size-5" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-5" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Baştan başlat"
              onClick={() => {
                yt.current?.restart()
                setState('playing')
              }}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={muted ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'}
              onClick={() => {
                if (muted) yt.current?.unMute()
                else yt.current?.mute()
                setMuted(!muted)
              }}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20"
            >
              {muted ? <VolumeX className="size-4" /> : <Volume2 className="size-4" />}

            </span>
          </div>

  )

function ago(ts: number) {
  const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 1000)
  if (s < 60) return 'az önce'
  if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)} dk önce`
  if (s < 86400) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)} sa önce`
  return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })
}

      {c.author ? (

          <AvatarFrame src={c.author.avatar} name={c.author.displayName} frame={c.author.frame} className="size-11" />

      ) : (

            {ink && <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-y-1 left-0 w-[3px] rounded-full bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ink-a),var(--ink-b))]" />}

            </button>

        </div>
        <AnimatePresence>
          {reporting && (
            <motion.div initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }} exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 overflow-hidden">
              {REASONS.map((r) => (
                <button
                  key={r}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    start(async () => {

                      setReporting(false)
                      if (res.ok) toast.success('Bildirimin ekibe iletildi. Teşekkürler!')
                      else toast.error(res.error)
                    })
                  }
                  className="rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition hover:border-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                >
                  {r}
                </button>
              ))}
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </motion.li>

export function Comments({
  animeId,
  animeTitle,
  comments,
  viewer,
}: {
  animeId: number
  animeTitle: string
  comments: CommentView[]
  viewer: { displayName: string; avatar?: string | null; frame?: string | null; nameStyle?: string | null; commentColor?: CommentColor } | null
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [gif, setGif] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [gifOpen, setGifOpen] = useState(false)
  const [spoiler, setSpoiler] = useState(false)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<'new' | 'top'>('new')
  const router = useRouter()
  const sorted = [...comments].sort((a, b) => (sort === 'new' ? b.at - a.at : b.likes - a.likes))

  const submit = () => {
    if (!text.trim() && !gif) return
    start(async () => {
      const res = await postComment(animeId, animeTitle, text, spoiler, gif)
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(res.error)
        return
      }
      setText('')
      setGif(null)
      setGifOpen(false)
      setSpoiler(false)
      toast.success('Yorumun yayında')
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {viewer ? (
        <form
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault()
            submit()
          }}
          className="flex gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5"
        >
          <AvatarFrame src={viewer.avatar} name={viewer.displayName} frame={viewer.frame} className="hidden size-11 sm:inline-grid" />
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-3">
            <label htmlFor="comment" className="sr-only">
              Yorumun
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="comment"
              value={text}
              onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing && e.keyCode !== 229) submit()
              }}
              maxLength={1200}
              rows={3}
              placeholder={`${animeTitle} hakkında ne düşünüyorsun?`}
              className="w-full resize-none rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed outline-none transition focus:border-primary"
            />
            {gif && (
              <div className="relative w-fit">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={gif} alt="Seçilen GIF" className="max-h-40 rounded-xl" />
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setGif(null)} aria-label="GIF’i kaldır" className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full bg-scrim/80 text-on-scrim">
                  <X className="size-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {gifOpen && (
              <GifPicker
                onPick={(url) => {
                  setGif(url)
                  setGifOpen(false)
                }}
              />
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGifOpen((v) => !v)}
                  aria-expanded={gifOpen}
                  className={cn('flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 text-xs font-semibold transition', gifOpen ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary')}
                >
                  <ImagePlay className="size-3.5" /> GIF
                </button>
                <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={spoiler} onChange={(e) => setSpoiler(e.target.checked)} className="size-4 accent-[var(--primary)]" />
                  Spoiler içeriyor
                </label>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{text.length}/1200</span>
                <button type="submit" disabled={pending || (text.trim().length < 2 && !gif)} className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50">
                  {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="size-4" />}
                  Gönder
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border p-5">
          <Mascot pose="bust" className="size-14 shrink-0" />
          <p className="flex-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Sohbete katılmak ister misin? Giriş yap ve düşüncelerini paylaş.</p>
          <Link href="/giris" className="rounded-full bg-foreground px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-background transition hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground">
            Giriş yap
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}

      {comments.length > 1 && (
        <div className="flex gap-1 self-start rounded-full bg-muted p-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Sırala">
          {(
            [
              ['new', 'En yeni'],
              ['top', 'En beğenilen'],
            ] as const
          ).map(([v, l]) => (
            <button key={v} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={sort === v} onClick={() => setSort(v)} className={cn('rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition', sort === v ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
              {l}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {comments.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz yorum yok. İlk yorumu sen yaz!</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {sorted.map((c) => (
              <CommentItem key={c.id} c={c} animeId={animeId} />
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

function parts(sec: number) {
  const s = Math.max(0, sec)
  return [
    { label: 'gün', value: Math.floor(s / 86400) },
    { label: 'saat', value: Math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600) },
    { label: 'dk', value: Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60) },
    { label: 'sn', value: Math.floor(s % 60) },
  ]
}

export function Countdown({ episode, airingAt }: { episode: number; airingAt: number }) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState<number | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    setNow(Date.now())
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [])
  const remaining = now === null ? null : airingAt - Math.floor(now / 1000)
  const date = new Date(airingAt * 1000).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { weekday: 'long', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })

  return (
    <div className="flex w-fit flex-wrap items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/[0.05] p-3 pr-5 backdrop-blur-md">
      <span className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 pl-1">
        <span className="label-mono text-[9px] text-primary">Sıradaki bölüm</span>
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
          {episode}. bölüm · <span className="text-foreground/60">{date}</span>
        </span>
      </span>
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5" aria-live="off">
        {(remaining === null ? parts(0) : parts(remaining)).map((p) => (
          <span key={p.label} className="flex min-w-11 flex-col items-center rounded-xl bg-scrim/50 px-2 py-1.5">
            <span className="font-mono text-base font-semibold tabular-nums leading-none">{remaining === null ? '--' : String(p.value).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
            <span className="mt-1 text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground/50">{p.label}</span>
          </span>
        ))}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}

import { Countdown } from './countdown'

const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

function TiltPoster({ src, alt, color }: { src: string; alt: string; color?: string | null }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const mx = useMotionValue(0.5)
  const my = useMotionValue(0.5)
  const rx = useSpring(useTransform(my, [0, 1], [10, -10]), { stiffness: 200, damping: 20 })
  const ry = useSpring(useTransform(mx, [0, 1], [-12, 12]), { stiffness: 200, damping: 20 })
  const glareX = useTransform(mx, [0, 1], ['0%', '100%'])
  const glareY = useTransform(my, [0, 1], ['0%', '100%'])

  return (
    <motion.div
      ref={ref}
      onPointerMove={(e) => {
        const r = ref.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!r || e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return
        mx.set((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width)
        my.set((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height)
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        mx.set(0.5)
        my.set(0.5)
      }}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40, rotateY: -20 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, rotateY: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 1, ease: OUT, delay: 0.15 }}
      style={{ rotateX: rx, rotateY: ry, transformPerspective: 900 }}
      className="relative mx-auto w-48 sm:w-60 md:mx-0 md:w-full"
    >
      <div className="absolute -inset-3 -z-10 rounded-[2rem] opacity-50 blur-2xl" style={{ background: color ?? 'var(--primary)' }} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-foreground/15">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={alt} className="aspect-[2/3] w-full object-cover" fetchPriority="high" />
        <motion.div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 mix-blend-overlay"
          style={{ background: useTransform([glareX, glareY], ([x, y]) => `radial-gradient(circle at ${x} ${y}, rgba(255,255,255,0.45), transparent 55%)`) }}
        />
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

export function DetailHero({ media, firstEpisode, actions }: { media: MediaDetail; firstEpisode: number | null; actions: React.ReactNode }) {
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const alt = media.title.romaji && media.title.romaji !== title ? media.title.romaji : media.title.english && media.title.english !== title ? media.title.english : null
  const tagNames = (media.tags ?? []).filter((t) => !t.isMediaSpoiler).sort((a, b) => b.rank - a.rank).map((t) => t.name)
  const style = titleStyleFor(media.genres, tagNames)
  const rankTop = media.rankings?.find((r) => r.allTime && r.type === 'RATED')
  const rankPop = media.rankings?.find((r) => r.allTime && r.type === 'POPULAR')
  const cover = media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'

  const share = async () => {
    const url = window.location.href
    try {
      if (navigator.share) await navigator.share({ title, url })
      else {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url)
        toast.success('Bağlantı kopyalandı')
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] items-end gap-10 px-4 pb-16 pt-14 sm:px-6 md:grid-cols-[240px_1fr] lg:grid-cols-[300px_1fr] lg:gap-14 lg:px-10 lg:pb-24 lg:pt-24">
      <TiltPoster src={cover} alt={title} color={media.coverImage.color} />

      <div className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-6">
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: OUT }} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span className="label-mono flex items-center gap-3 text-ink">
            <span className="h-px w-10 bg-primary" />
            {[formatTr(media.format), media.seasonYear].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
          </span>
          {media.status && (
            <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider ${media.status === 'RELEASING' ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border border-foreground/20 text-foreground/70'}`}>
              {statusTr(media.status)}
            </span>
          )}
        </motion.div>

        <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-3" style={{ ['--cover-color' as string]: media.coverImage.color ?? 'var(--primary)' }}>
          <StyledTitle title={title} style={style} className="relative text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-8xl" />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
            {alt && <p className="text-lg text-foreground/55">{alt}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.7, delay: 0.35, ease: OUT }}
          className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-4"
        >
          {media.averageScore ? <ScoreRing score={media.averageScore} /> : null}
          <dl className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-3 text-sm">
            {[
              { icon: Tv, label: 'Bölüm', value: media.episodes ?? (media.nextAiringEpisode ? `${media.nextAiringEpisode.episode - 1}+` : '—') },
              { icon: Clock, label: 'Süre', value: media.duration ? `${media.duration} dk` : '—' },
              { icon: Flame, label: 'Popülerlik', value: compact(media.popularity) },
              { icon: Heart, label: 'Favori', value: compact(media.favourites) },
            ].map((s) => (
              <div key={s.label} className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <dt className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-foreground/50">

          </dl>

export function GifPicker({ onPick }: { onPick: (url: string) => void }) {

          placeholder="GIF ara (İngilizce: happy, cry, hug…)"
          aria-label="GIF ara"
          className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-card pl-9 pr-9 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary"
        />
        {isLoading && <Loader2 className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />}
      </div>
      {dq.length < 2 && (
        <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-1 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto px-1" role="tablist" aria-label="GIF kategorileri">
          {CATS.map(([id, label]) => (

              role="tab"

            >
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* The scroll box and the grid are separate elements: a grid that is itself height-capped squeezes its
          auto rows, and aspect-ratio tiles then overlap each other and become clickable through one another. */}
      <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-lg">
        {results.length === 0 && !isLoading ? (
          <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">GIF bulunamadı.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid auto-rows-max grid-cols-3 content-start gap-1.5 p-0.5 sm:grid-cols-4">
            {results.map((g) => (
              <li key={g.id} className="relative h-0 pb-[56.25%]">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPick(g.url)}
                  className="group absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-muted outline-none ring-primary transition hover:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-2"
                  aria-label={`GIF ekle${g.source ? `: ${g.source}` : ''}`}
                >
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={g.preview} alt="" loading="lazy" className="size-full object-cover" />
                  {g.source && <span className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 truncate bg-scrim/70 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-left text-[10px] text-on-scrim opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100">{g.source}</span>}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="text-right font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">Anime GIF’leri · nekos.best</p>
    </div>
  )

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { BookmarkPlus, Check, ChevronDown, Loader2, Plus } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { setAnimeStatus, toggleInList } from '@/app/actions/library'
import { STATUS_LABEL, type ListStatus } from '@/lib/library-types'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Popover } from '@/components/ui-kit/popover'

type CustomList = { id: string; name: string; hue: number; has: boolean }

export function LibraryButton({ animeId, loggedIn, initialStatus, customLists }: { animeId: number; loggedIn: boolean; initialStatus: ListStatus | null; customLists: CustomList[] }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ListStatus | null>(initialStatus)
  const [lists, setLists] = useState(customLists)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const router = useRouter()

  if (!loggedIn) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => toast('Kütüphanene eklemek için giriş yap', { action: { label: 'Giriş yap', onClick: () => router.push('/giris') } })}
        className="flex h-13 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-foreground/25 px-5 font-medium backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-foreground/10"
      >
        <BookmarkPlus className="size-4" />
        Listeye ekle
      </button>
    )
  }

  const pick = (s: ListStatus | null) => {
    const prev = status
    setStatus(s)
    start(async () => {
      const res = await setAnimeStatus(animeId, s)
      if (!res.ok) {
        setStatus(prev)
        toast.error(res.error)
      } else toast.success(s ? `“${STATUS_LABEL[s]}” listesine eklendi` : 'Kütüphaneden çıkarıldı')
    })
  }

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setLists((ls) => ls.map((l) => (l.id === id ? { ...l, has: !l.has } : l)))
    start(async () => {
      const res = await toggleInList(id, animeId)
      if (!res.ok) {
        setLists((ls) => ls.map((l) => (l.id === id ? { ...l, has: !l.has } : l)))
        toast.error(res.error)
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <Popover
      label="Kütüphane"
      align="start"
      className="w-72 p-2"
      trigger={({ open, toggle: t, ref }) => (
        <button
          ref={ref}
          type="button"
          onClick={t}
          aria-expanded={open}
          className={cn(
            'flex h-13 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-5 font-medium backdrop-blur transition',
            status ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15 text-primary' : 'border-foreground/25 hover:bg-foreground/10',
          )}
        >
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : status ? <Check className="size-4" /> : <BookmarkPlus className="size-4" />}
          {status ? STATUS_LABEL[status] : 'Listeye ekle'}
          <ChevronDown className={cn('size-4 transition', open && 'rotate-180')} />
        </button>
      )}
    >
      {(close) => (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <p className="label-mono px-3 pb-1 pt-2 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Durum</p>
          {(Object.keys(STATUS_LABEL) as ListStatus[]).map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                pick(status === s ? null : s)
                close()
              }}
              className={cn('flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition hover:bg-muted', status === s && 'bg-accent font-medium')}
            >
              {STATUS_LABEL[s]}
              {status === s && <Check className="size-4 text-ink" />}
            </button>
          ))}
          <div className="my-1 h-px bg-border" />
          <p className="label-mono px-3 pb-1 pt-1 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Koleksiyonlarım</p>
          {lists.length === 0 && <p className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz özel listen yok.</p>}
          {lists.map((l) => (
            <button key={l.id} type="button" onClick={() => toggle(l.id)} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition hover:bg-muted">
              <span className="size-3 rounded-full" style={{ background: `oklch(0.72 0.16 ${l.hue})` }} />
              <span className="flex-1 truncate">{l.name}</span>
              <span className={cn('grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-md border transition', l.has ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border')}>
                {l.has && <Check className="size-3" />}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
          <Link href="/kutuphane?yeni=1" onClick={close} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-ink transition hover:bg-muted">
            <Plus className="size-4" /> Yeni liste oluştur
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
    </Popover>
  )
}

'use client'

import { animate, motion, useMotionValue, useTransform } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect } from 'react'

export function ScoreRing({ score, size = 72 }: { score: number; size?: number }) {
  const r = 30
  const c = 2 * Math.PI * r
  const value = useMotionValue(0)
  const rounded = useTransform(value, (v) => Math.round(v))
  const offset = useTransform(value, (v) => c - (v / 100) * c)

  useEffect(() => {
    const controls = animate(value, score, { duration: 1.4, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: 0.4 })
    return () => controls.stop()
  }, [score, value])

  return (
    <div className="relative grid place-items-center" style={{ width: size, height: size }} role="img" aria-label={`Ortalama puan ${score} / 100`}>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 72 72" className="absolute inset-0 -rotate-90" aria-hidden="true">
        <circle cx="36" cy="36" r={r} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity="0.15" strokeWidth="5" />
        <motion.circle cx="36" cy="36" r={r} fill="none" stroke="var(--primary)" strokeWidth="5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={c} style={{ strokeDashoffset: offset }} />
      </svg>
      <span className="flex flex-col items-center leading-none">
        <motion.span className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums">{rounded}</motion.span>
        <span className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[8px] uppercase tracking-widest opacity-60">puan</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function SectionNav({ sections, title }: { sections: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]; title: string }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(sections[0]?.id)
  const [stuck, setStuck] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const els = sections.map((s) => document.getElementById(s.id)).filter(Boolean) as HTMLElement[]
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visible = entries.filter((e) => e.isIntersecting).sort((a, b) => a.boundingClientRect.top - b.boundingClientRect.top)
        if (visible[0]) setActive(visible[0].target.id)
      },
      { rootMargin: '-30% 0px -60% 0px' },
    )
    els.forEach((el) => io.observe(el))
    const onScroll = () => setStuck(window.scrollY > 520)
    onScroll()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => {
      io.disconnect()
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
    }
  }, [sections])

  return (
    <div className="sticky top-[4.5rem] z-30 -mt-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
      <nav
        aria-label="Sayfa bölümleri"
        className={cn(
          'scrollbar-none mx-auto flex max-w-[1440px] items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-full border p-1.5 transition-all duration-500',
          stuck ? 'border-border bg-popover/90 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl' : 'border-transparent bg-transparent',
        )}
      >
        <span className={cn('hidden shrink-0 truncate pl-3 pr-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-all duration-500 md:block', stuck ? 'max-w-56 opacity-100' : 'max-w-0 overflow-hidden pl-0 pr-0 opacity-0')}>
          {title}
        </span>
        {sections.map((s) => (
          <a
            key={s.id}
            href={`#${s.id}`}
            aria-current={active === s.id ? 'location' : undefined}
            className={cn('relative isolate shrink-0 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors', active === s.id ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
          >
            {active === s.id && <motion.span layoutId="detail-tab" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-full bg-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 34 }} />}
            {s.label}
            {typeof s.count === 'number' && s.count > 0 && <span className="ml-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] opacity-70">{s.count}</span>}
          </a>
        ))}
      </nav>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import type { MediaDetail } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { compact, seasonTr } from '@/lib/format'

const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; tone: string }> = {
  CURRENT: { label: 'İzliyor', tone: 'var(--primary)' },
  PLANNING: { label: 'Planlıyor', tone: 'color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 55%, var(--muted-foreground))' },
  COMPLETED: { label: 'Tamamladı', tone: 'var(--foreground)' },
  PAUSED: { label: 'Ara verdi', tone: 'var(--muted-foreground)' },
  DROPPED: { label: 'Bıraktı', tone: 'var(--destructive)' },
}

export function StatsPanel({ media }: { media: MediaDetail }) {
  const scores = media.stats?.scoreDistribution ?? []
  const maxScore = Math.max(1, ...scores.map((s) => s.amount))
  const statuses = (media.stats?.statusDistribution ?? []).filter((s) => STATUS[s.status])
  const totalStatus = statuses.reduce((n, s) => n + s.amount, 0) || 1
  const rankings = (media.rankings ?? []).slice(0, 6)

  return (
    <div className="grid min-w-0 grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr]">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-5 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-4 sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="font-semibold">Puan dağılımı</p>
          {media.meanScore ? <p className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">Ortalama {media.meanScore}/100</p> : null}
        </div>
        {scores.length ? (
          <div className="flex h-48 items-end gap-1 sm:gap-2.5" role="img" aria-label="Puan dağılımı grafiği">
            {scores.map((s, i) => (
              <div key={s.score} className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100">{compact(s.amount)}</span>
                <motion.span
                  className="w-full rounded-t-lg"
                  style={{ background: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) ${30 + (s.score / 100) * 70}%, var(--muted))` }}
                  initial={{ height: 0 }}
                  whileInView={{ height: `${Math.max(3, (s.amount / maxScore) * 100)}%` }}
                  viewport={{ once: true }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.8, delay: i * 0.05, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
                />
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{s.score}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz yeterli puan verisi yok.</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-6">
          <p className="font-semibold">Topluluk durumu</p>

                style={{ background: STATUS[s.status].tone }}
                initial={{ width: 0 }}
                whileInView={{ width: `${(s.amount / totalStatus) * 100}%` }}
                viewport={{ once: true }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.9, delay: i * 0.08, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
              />
            ))}

                <span className="size-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ background: STATUS[s.status].tone }} />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{STATUS[s.status].label}</span>
                <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{compact(s.amount)}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
        {rankings.length > 0 && (

            {rankings.map((r) => (
              <li key={r.id} className="flex items-center gap-4 py-3 text-sm">

                </span>

            ))}

}

'use client'

import useSWR from 'swr'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Check, ChevronDown, Languages, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Popover } from '@/components/ui-kit/popover'

export const LANGS = [
  { id: 'tr', label: 'Türkçe', short: 'TR' },
  { id: 'en', label: 'English', short: 'EN' },
  { id: 'ja', label: '日本語', short: 'JA' },
  { id: 'de', label: 'Deutsch', short: 'DE' },
  { id: 'fr', label: 'Français', short: 'FR' },
  { id: 'es', label: 'Español', short: 'ES' },
  { id: 'ru', label: 'Русский', short: 'RU' },
  { id: 'ar', label: 'العربية', short: 'AR' },
  { id: 'ko', label: '한국어', short: 'KO' },
  { id: 'az', label: 'Azərbaycanca', short: 'AZ' },
] as const

type Res = { ok: boolean; text: string; translated: boolean; fallback?: boolean }

const fetcher = (url: string) =>
  fetch(url).then((r) => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status))
    return r.json() as Promise<Res>
  })

export function Synopsis({ id, original, initialTr }: { id: number; original: string; initialTr?: string | null }) {
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const lang = prefs.synopsisLang
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false)
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR(original && lang !== 'en' ? `/api/synopsis?id=${id}&lang=${lang}` : null, fetcher, {
    revalidateOnFocus: false,
    keepPreviousData: true,
    fallbackData: lang === 'tr' && initialTr ? { ok: true, text: initialTr, translated: true } : undefined,
  })

  const text = lang === 'en' ? original : (data?.text ?? original)
  const current = LANGS.find((l) => l.id === lang) ?? LANGS[0]
  const long = text.length > 420
  const rtl = lang === 'ar'

  if (!original) return <p className="text-muted-foreground">Açıklama bulunmuyor.</p>

  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Popover
          align="start"
          label="Özet dili"
          trigger={({ open, toggle, ref }) => (
            <button
              ref={ref}
              type="button"
              aria-haspopup="listbox"
              aria-expanded={open}
              onClick={toggle}
              className="flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-3.5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary"
            >
              <Languages className="size-4 text-ink" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="sr-only">Özet dili:</span>
              {current.label}
              <ChevronDown className={cn('size-3.5 opacity-60 transition', open && 'rotate-180')} aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
          )}
        >
          {(close) => (
            <ul role="listbox" aria-label="Özet dili" className="grid w-60 grid-cols-2 gap-1 p-1.5">
              {LANGS.map((l) => (
                <li key={l.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={l.id === lang}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPrefs({ synopsisLang: l.id })
                      close()
                    }}
                    className={cn(
                      'flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-sm transition',
                      l.id === lang ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-muted',
                    )}
                  >
                    <span className="truncate">{l.label}</span>
                    {l.id === lang ? <Check className="size-3.5 shrink-0" /> : <span className="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-50">{l.short}</span>}
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Popover>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
          {isLoading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="size-3 animate-spin" /> Çevriliyor
            </>
          ) : lang === 'en' ? (
            'Orijinal metin · AniList'
          ) : data?.fallback ? (
            'Çeviri şu an alınamadı · orijinal gösteriliyor'
          ) : (
            'Otomatik çeviri · kaynak AniList'
          )}
        </span>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        <motion.div
          key={`${lang}-${data?.translated ? 't' : 'o'}`}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8, filter: 'blur(6px)' }}
          animate={{ opacity: isLoading ? 0.5 : 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)' }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.35 }}
          lang={lang}
          dir={rtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
          className={cn('whitespace-pre-line text-pretty text-lg leading-relaxed text-foreground/80', !expanded && long && 'line-clamp-6')}
        >
          {text}
        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>
      {long && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)} className="w-fit font-mono text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-ink hover:underline">
          {expanded ? 'Daha az göster' : 'Devamını oku'}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRef } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** Six single-digit boxes that behave like one field: typing advances, Backspace steps back, pasting fills all. */
export function CodeInput({ value, onChange, onComplete, disabled, tone = 'dark' }: { value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; onComplete?: (v: string) => void; disabled?: boolean; tone?: 'dark' | 'light' }) {
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([])
  const digits = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => value[i] ?? '')

  const set = (next: string) => {
    const clean = next.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6)
    onChange(clean)
    if (clean.length === 6) onComplete?.(clean)
    return clean
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-2" role="group" aria-label="6 haneli doğrulama kodu">
      {digits.map((d, i) => (
        <input
          key={i}
          ref={(el) => {
            refs.current[i] = el
          }}
          value={d}
          disabled={disabled}
          inputMode="numeric"
          autoComplete={i === 0 ? 'one-time-code' : 'off'}
          maxLength={6}
          aria-label={`${i + 1}. hane`}
          autoFocus={i === 0}
          onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()}
          onChange={(e) => {
            const typed = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '')
            if (!typed) return
            const next = set((value.slice(0, i) + typed + value.slice(i + typed.length)).slice(0, 6))
            refs.current[Math.min(next.length, 5)]?.focus()
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
              e.preventDefault()
              if (d) set(value.slice(0, i) + value.slice(i + 1))
              else if (i > 0) {
                set(value.slice(0, i - 1) + value.slice(i))
                refs.current[i - 1]?.focus()
              }
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && i > 0) refs.current[i - 1]?.focus()
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && i < 5) refs.current[i + 1]?.focus()
          }}
          onPaste={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault()
            const next = set(e.clipboardData.getData('text'))
            refs.current[Math.min(next.length, 5)]?.focus()
          }}
          className={cn(
            'h-14 w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl border text-center font-mono text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums outline-none transition focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/20 disabled:opacity-60',
            tone === 'dark' ? 'border-foreground/15 bg-foreground/5' : 'border-border bg-background',
            d && 'border-primary/60',
          )}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Mail, MailCheck, RotateCw } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useTheme } from '@/components/providers/theme-provider'
import { BrandIcon } from '@/components/ui-kit/brand-icon'
import { ScrambleText } from '@/components/shell/scramble-text'
import { CodeInput } from './code-input'

type P = { id: 'discord' | 'google' | 'github'; label: string; configured: boolean }

const ERRORS: Record<string, string> = {
  not_configured: 'Bu giriş yöntemi çok yakında aktif olacak.',
  denied: 'Giriş iptal edildi.',
  state: 'Oturum doğrulanamadı, lütfen tekrar dene.',
  oauth: 'Sağlayıcıdan yanıt alınamadı. Tekrar dene.',
  banned: 'Bu hesap askıya alınmış.',
  provider: 'Geçersiz giriş yöntemi.',
}

export function LoginPanel({ providers, error, errorProvider, registrationsOpen }: { providers: P[]; error?: string; errorProvider?: string; registrationsOpen: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { themeLabel } = useTheme()
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'login' | 'register'>('login')
  const [showEmail, setShowEmail] = useState(false)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false)
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', email: '', password: '' })
  const [err, setErr] = useState(error ? (ERRORS[error] ?? 'Bir hata oluştu.') : '')
  const [verify, setVerify] = useState<{ masked: string; devCode?: string } | null>(null)
  const [code, setCode] = useState('')
  const [cooldown, setCooldown] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cooldown <= 0) return
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setCooldown((c) => c - 1), 1000)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [cooldown])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMsg = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (e.origin !== location.origin || e.data?.type !== 'sy-auth') return
      if (e.data.ok) {
        toast.success('Giriş yapıldı')
        router.replace('/')
        router.refresh()
      } else setErr(ERRORS[e.data.message] ?? 'Giriş başarısız oldu.')
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', onMsg)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg)
  }, [router])

  function oauth(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>, p: P) {
    if (!p.configured) {
      e.preventDefault()
      setErr(`${p.label} ile giriş çok yakında aktif olacak. Şimdilik e-posta ile devam edebilirsin.`)
      return
    }
    if (window.self !== window.top) {
      e.preventDefault()
      const w = 520
      const h = 720
      window.open(`/api/auth/${p.id}?popup=1`, 'sy-auth', `width=${w},height=${h},left=${(screen.width - w) / 2},top=${(screen.height - h) / 2}`)
    }
  }

  async function call(payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/email', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) })
    const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error || 'Bir hata oluştu')
    return json as { ok: true; step?: 'verify'; masked?: string; devCode?: string; verified?: boolean }
  }

  function finish(verified?: boolean) {
    toast.success(mode === 'register' ? 'Hesabın oluşturuldu' : 'Tekrar hoş geldin', verified ? { description: 'E-postan doğrulandı — Doğrulanmış rozeti profilinde.' } : undefined)
    router.replace('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setBusy(true)
    setErr('')
    try {
      const json = await call({ step: 'start', mode, ...form })
      if (json.step === 'verify') {
        setVerify({ masked: json.masked ?? form.email, devCode: json.devCode })
        setCode('')
        setCooldown(60)
        return
      }
      finish(json.verified)
    } catch (e) {
      setErr((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  async function confirm(value = code) {
    if (value.length !== 6 || busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    setErr('')
    try {
      const json = await call({ step: 'verify', mode, email: form.email, code: value })
      finish(json.verified)
    } catch (e) {
      setErr((e as Error).message)
      setCode('')
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  async function resend() {
    if (cooldown > 0) return
    setErr('')
    try {
      const json = await call({ step: 'resend', mode, email: form.email })
      setVerify({ masked: json.masked ?? form.email, devCode: json.devCode })
      setCooldown(60)
      toast.success('Yeni kod gönderildi')
    } catch (e) {
      setErr((e as Error).message)
    }
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30, scale: 0.97 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200, damping: 24, delay: 0.1 }}
      className="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-foreground/10 bg-scrim/60 p-7 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl sm:p-9"
    >
      <div className="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between">
        <Link href="/" className="flex flex-col leading-none" aria-label="Ana sayfa">
          <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">SYTHERIS</span>
          <span className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="h-px w-5 bg-primary" />
            <ScrambleText text={themeLabel} className="font-mono text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary" />
          </span>
        </Link>
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground">
          <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Siteye dön
        </Link>
      </div>

      <h1 className="text-balance text-4xl font-semibold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight">
        {mode === 'login' ? 'Tekrar' : 'Aramıza'} <span className="font-serif font-normal italic text-primary">{mode === 'login' ? 'hoş geldin' : 'katıl'}</span>
      </h1>
      <p className="mt-3 text-pretty leading-relaxed text-foreground/60">Favorilerini kaydet, profilini kişiselleştir ve kendi müziğini ekle.</p>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {err && (
          <motion.p initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} role="alert" className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/15 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-foreground">
            {err}
            {errorProvider && error === 'not_configured' ? ` (${errorProvider})` : ''}
          </motion.p>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        {verify ? (
          <motion.form
            key="verify"
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault()
              confirm()
            }}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            className="mt-7 flex flex-col gap-5"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 p-4">
              <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                <MailCheck className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
              </span>
              <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground/70">
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{verify.masked}</span> adresine 6 haneli bir kod gönderdik. Kod 10 dakika geçerli.
              </p>
            </div>
            {verify.devCode && (
              <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-primary/50 px-4 py-2.5 font-mono text-xs text-foreground/70">
                Önizleme modu (e-posta servisi bağlı değil) · kod: <span className="font-semibold tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">{verify.devCode}</span>
              </p>
            )}
            <CodeInput value={code} onChange={setCode} onComplete={(v) => confirm(v)} disabled={busy} />
            <button type="submit" disabled={busy || code.length !== 6} className="flex h-14 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-60">
              {busy && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
              Doğrula ve devam et
            </button>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setVerify(null)
                  setErr('')
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> E-postayı düzelt

                {cooldown > 0 ? `Tekrar gönder (${cooldown})` : 'Kodu tekrar gönder'}

        ) : !showEmail ? (
