                className={cn(
                  'group flex h-14 items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-5 font-medium transition hover:border-primary/60 hover:bg-foreground/10',
                  !p.configured && 'opacity-60',
                )}

function MemberCard() {
  const mx = useMotionValue(0.5)
  const my = useMotionValue(0.5)
  const rx = useSpring(useTransform(my, [0, 1], [12, -12]), { stiffness: 160, damping: 18 })
  const ry = useSpring(useTransform(mx, [0, 1], [-16, 16]), { stiffness: 160, damping: 18 })
  const shine = useTransform([mx, my], ([x, y]: number[]) => `radial-gradient(circle at ${x * 100}% ${y * 100}%, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.35), transparent 50%)`)

  return (
    <motion.div
      onPointerMove={(e) => {
        const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
        mx.set((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width)
        my.set((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height)
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        mx.set(0.5)
        my.set(0.5)
      }}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 60, rotateZ: -8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, rotateZ: -4 }}
      transition={{ duration: 1.1, delay: 0.2, ease: OUT }}
      style={{ rotateX: rx, rotateY: ry, transformPerspective: 1000 }}
      className="sy-holo relative aspect-[1.586] w-[min(440px,100%)] overflow-hidden rounded-[1.6rem] border border-foreground/20 bg-gradient-to-br from-card via-scrim to-card shadow-[0_40px_90px_-30px_rgb(0_0_0/0.8)]"
    >
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="halftone absolute inset-0 text-primary/25 [mask-image:linear-gradient(120deg,black,transparent_60%)]" />

function starsFor(favourites: number) {
  if (favourites >= 60000) return 5
  if (favourites >= 25000) return 4.5
  if (favourites >= 10000) return 4
  if (favourites >= 4000) return 3.5
  if (favourites >= 1000) return 3
  return 2.5
}

function Stars({ value }: { value: number }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5" role="img" aria-label={`${value} / 5 yıldız`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) =>
        value >= n ? (
          <Star key={n} className="size-3.5 fill-foreground text-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : value >= n - 0.5 ? (
          <StarHalf key={n} className="size-3.5 fill-foreground text-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : null,
      )}
    </span>
  )
}

                  </Link>
                </li>
              )
            })}

        </nav>
      )}

export type ShowcaseArt = { src: string; transparent: boolean }

/**
 * Character key visual, modelled on an official character page:
 * outlined name echo across the top, name + signature on the left, the full-body artwork
 * standing in (and breaking out of) a slanted panel on the right, the series mark in the corner.
 */
export function CharacterShowcase({
  name,
  native,
  subtitle,
  bio,
  favourites,
  art,
  seriesTitle,
  seriesColor,
  primaryHref,
  primaryLabel = 'Animeyi izle',
  secondaryHref = '#kadro',
  secondaryLabel = 'Kadroyu gör',
  standee,
  sections,
}: {
  name: string
  native?: string | null
  subtitle: string
  bio: string
  favourites?: number | null
  art: ShowcaseArt | null
  seriesTitle?: string | null
  seriesColor?: string | null
  primaryHref?: string
  primaryLabel?: string
  secondaryHref?: string
  secondaryLabel?: string
  /** Optional cut-out that stands in front of a photographic panel (e.g. a voice actor's best-known role). */
  standee?: (ShowcaseArt & { label: string }) | null
  sections: { id: string; label: string }[]
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  const scrollYProgress = useSectionProgress(ref, ['start start', 'end start'])
  const echoX = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], ['0%', '-12%'])
  const artY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], ['0%', '10%'])
  const panelY = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], ['0%', '4%'])

  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/)
  const first = words[0]
  const echo = (words.length > 1 ? words[words.length - 1] : first).toUpperCase()
  const tone = seriesColor || 'var(--primary)'
  const seriesWords = (seriesTitle ?? '').split(':')[0].toUpperCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
  const seriesLines = seriesWords.length > 2 ? [seriesWords.slice(0, Math.ceil(seriesWords.length / 2)).join(' '), seriesWords.slice(Math.ceil(seriesWords.length / 2)).join(' ')] : seriesWords

  return (
    <section
      ref={ref}
      id="karakter-ust"
      aria-labelledby="character-name"
      className="relative isolate overflow-clip border-b border-border bg-background"

        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}

        className="char-echo pointer-events-none absolute -left-[2vw] top-[4%] -z-10 select-none whitespace-nowrap text-[clamp(120px,24vw,400px)] font-black leading-none tracking-[-0.05em]"
      >
        {echo}

          <motion.div initial="hidden" animate="show" variants={{ show: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.08, delayChildren: 0.15 } } }} className="flex flex-col gap-6">

              {subtitle}
            </motion.p>

              <motion.p variants={rise} className="line-clamp-4 max-w-md text-pretty text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">

                {compact(favourites ?? 0)} favori
              </span>
              {native && (
                <>

'use client'

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function GalleryGrid({ images, name }: { images: string[]; name: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open === null) return
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(null)
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') setOpen((i) => (i === null ? i : (i + 1) % images.length))
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') setOpen((i) => (i === null ? i : (i - 1 + images.length) % images.length))
    }
    const prev = document.documentElement.style.overflow
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => {
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = prev
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    }
  }, [open, images.length])

  if (!images.length) return null

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}
        aria-expanded={expanded}
        className="flex h-8 w-fit items-center gap-2 border-2 border-foreground px-3 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] transition hover:bg-foreground hover:text-background"
      >
        Galeri
        <ChevronDown className={cn('size-3.5 transition-transform', expanded && 'rotate-180')} aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {expanded && (
          <motion.ul
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.45, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
            className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 overflow-hidden"
          >
            {images.map((src, i) => (
              <li key={src}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOpen(i)}
                  aria-label={`${name} galerisi, ${i + 1}. görseli büyüt`}
                  className="group relative block aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden bg-muted outline-none ring-foreground focus-visible:ring-2"
                >
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="size-full object-cover object-top grayscale transition duration-700 group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:grayscale-0" />
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-foreground/10 transition group-hover:bg-transparent">
                    <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-background/90 text-foreground shadow-lg transition group-hover:scale-110">
                      <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </motion.ul>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open !== null && (
          <motion.div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label={`${name} galerisi`}
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center bg-scrim/92 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
            onClick={() => setOpen(null)}
          >
            <motion.img
              key={images[open]}
              src={images[open]}
              alt={`${name} — hayran çizimi ${open + 1}`}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
              className="max-h-[86dvh] max-w-full rounded-lg object-contain shadow-2xl"
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} aria-label="Kapat" className="absolute right-4 top-4 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 text-on-scrim transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20">
              <X className="size-5" />
            </button>
            {images.length > 1 && (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => (e.stopPropagation(), setOpen((open - 1 + images.length) % images.length))}
                  aria-label="Önceki görsel"
                  className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 grid size-11 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 text-on-scrim transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20"
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="size-5" />
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => (e.stopPropagation(), setOpen((open + 1) % images.length))}
                  aria-label="Sonraki görsel"
                  className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 grid size-11 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 text-on-scrim transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20"
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="size-5" />
                </button>
              </>
            )}
            <p className="absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-on-scrim/70">
              {String(open + 1).padStart(2, '0')} / {String(images.length).padStart(2, '0')}
            </p>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

export type CreditPerson = { href: string; name: string; character: string | null; image: string | null }

function Portrait({ src, className }: { src: string | null; className?: string }) {
  return src ? (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img src={src} alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" className={cn('cine-portrait size-full object-cover object-top', className)} />
  ) : (
    <span className={cn('grid size-full place-items-center bg-muted text-muted-foreground', className)}>
      <UserRound className="size-8" aria-hidden="true" />
    </span>
  )
}

/** Opening-titles cast list: three billed leads as tall portraits, the ensemble as a compact roll. */

'use client'

import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Loader2, Search, X } from 'lucide-react'

/** Marquee-framed search field. Typing updates the URL (debounced) so results stream in from the server. */
export function CineSearchBox({ initial, kind }: { initial: string; kind: string }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const last = useRef(initial)

  useEffect(() => {
    const term = value.trim()
    if (term === last.current) return
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
      last.current = term
      const sp = new URLSearchParams()
      if (term) sp.set('q', term)
      if (kind !== 'hepsi') sp.set('tur', kind)
      start(() => router.replace(`${pathname}${sp.size ? `?${sp}` : ''}`, { scroll: false }))
    }, 380)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [value, kind, pathname, router])

  return (
    <form
      role="search"
      action={pathname}
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        inputRef.current?.blur()
      }}
      className="relative"
    >
      <span className="cine-bulbs absolute inset-x-6 -top-2 h-4 -translate-y-1/2" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="cine-bulbs absolute inset-x-6 -bottom-2 h-4 translate-y-1/2" aria-hidden="true" />
      <label className="relative flex h-20 items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-primary/40 bg-scrim/80 px-5 shadow-[0_0_80px_-30px_var(--primary)] backdrop-blur-md transition focus-within:border-primary sm:h-24 sm:px-7">
        <span className="sr-only">Film veya dizi ara</span>
        {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-6 shrink-0 animate-spin text-primary" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Search className="size-6 shrink-0 text-primary" aria-hidden="true" />}
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          name="q"
          type="search"
          autoFocus={!initial}
          autoComplete="off"
          spellCheck={false}
          enterKeyHint="search"
          placeholder="Film, dizi ya da yönetmen…"
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229)) e.preventDefault()
          }}
          className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground outline-none placeholder:text-foreground/30 sm:text-4xl [&::-webkit-search-cancel-button]:hidden"
        />
        {value && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setValue('')
              inputRef.current?.focus()
            }}
            className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 transition hover:bg-foreground/10 hover:text-foreground"
            aria-label="Aramayı temizle"
          >
            <X className="size-5" />
          </button>
        )}
      </label>
    </form>
  )
}

/** First sentence of a synopsis, used as the poster-style tagline. */
export function taglineOf(text: string | null | undefined, max = 180) {
  if (!text) return null
  const first = text.split(/(?<=[a-zçğıöşüé]{2}[.!?…])\s+(?=[A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ"“'])/)[0]?.trim()
  if (!first) return null
  return first.length > max ? `${first.slice(0, max).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '')}…` : first
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Pause, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/**
 * Muted, looping trailer projected behind the detail hero. Only mounts on wide screens, when the visitor
 * hasn't asked for reduced motion or data saving, and fades in once frames are actually playing.
 */
export function HeroProjection({ src, title }: { src: string; title: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(false)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const conn = (navigator as Navigator & { connection?: { saveData?: boolean } }).connection
    const ok = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)').matches && !conn?.saveData
    setEnabled(ok)
  }, [])

  if (!enabled) return null

  return (
    <>
      <video
        ref={ref}
        src={`${src}#t=8`}
        muted
        autoPlay
        loop
        playsInline
        preload="auto"
        aria-hidden="true"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onPlaying={() => setPlaying(true)}
        className={cn('absolute inset-0 -z-20 size-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-[1600ms]', playing && !paused ? 'opacity-55' : 'opacity-0')}
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          const v = ref.current
          if (!v) return
          if (v.paused) {
            void v.play()
            setPaused(false)
          } else {
            v.pause()
            setPaused(true)
          }
        }}
        className={cn(
          'absolute right-6 top-7 z-10 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-foreground/20 bg-scrim/60 px-3.5 py-2 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-foreground/70 backdrop-blur transition hover:border-foreground/50 hover:text-foreground xl:right-10',
          !playing && 'pointer-events-none opacity-0',
        )}
        aria-label={paused ? `${title} arka plan fragmanını oynat` : `${title} arka plan fragmanını durdur`}
      >
        {paused ? <Play className="size-3 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Pause className="size-3 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />}
        {paused ? 'Projeksiyon' : 'Projeksiyonu durdur'}
      </button>
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState } from 'react'
import useSWR from 'swr'
import { Loader2, Search, X } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { useDebounced } from '@/components/shell/command-palette'

const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json())

export function AnimePicker({ label, value, onPick }: { label: string; value: { id: number; title: string } | null; onPick: (m: MediaCard | null) => void }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const dq = useDebounced(q.trim(), 250)
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR<{ results: MediaCard[] }>(dq.length > 1 ? `/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(dq)}` : null, fetcher)
  if (value) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-12 items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-full border border-primary/50 bg-accent pl-5 pr-2">
        <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{value.title}</span>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onPick(null)} aria-label={`${label} temizle`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full hover:bg-background">
          <X className="size-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
      <input
        value={q}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setQ(e.target.value)
          setOpen(true)
        }}
        onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
        onBlur={() => window.setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 150)}
        placeholder={label}
        aria-label={label}
        className="h-12 w-full rounded-full border border-border bg-card pl-11 pr-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary"
      />
      {isLoading && <Loader2 className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin" />}
      {open && data?.results && data.results.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="absolute inset-x-0 top-full z-30 mt-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-border bg-popover p-1.5 shadow-2xl">
          {data.results.map((m) => (
            <li key={m.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onClick={() => {
                  onPick(m)
                  setQ('')
                  setOpen(false)
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-2 text-left transition hover:bg-muted"
              >
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={m.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="h-12 w-9 rounded-md object-cover" />
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{pickTitle(m.title)}</span>
                  <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{m.seasonYear}</span>
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function ComparePicker({ a, b }: { a: { id: number; title: string } | null; b: { id: number; title: string } | null }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const params = useSearchParams()
  const set = (key: 'a' | 'b', m: MediaCard | null) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString())
    if (m) next.set(key, String(m.id))
    else next.delete(key)
    router.push(`/karsilastir?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false })
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <AnimePicker label="Birinci anime" value={a} onPick={(m) => set('a', m)} />
      <AnimePicker label="İkinci anime" value={b} onPick={(m) => set('b', m)} />
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import useSWR from 'swr'
import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowDown, Check, FileArchive, Loader2, RotateCcw, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react'
import { getArchiveChunk, getArchiveManifest, type ArchiveManifest } from '@/app/indir/actions'

type Manifest = Extract<ArchiveManifest, { ok: true }>
type State =
  | { kind: 'idle' }
  | { kind: 'loading'; received: number; total: number; step: string }
  | { kind: 'done'; size: number; count: number; via: string; href: string; filename: string }
  | { kind: 'error'; message: string }

const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const STORED = /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif|woff2?|mp4|webm|mp3|zip)$/i
const FIXED_MTIME = new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')

/**
 * Triggers the save and returns the object URL. It stays alive for 10 minutes so the manual
 * "click here" link keeps working when a sandboxed preview frame swallows the automatic download.
 */
function saveBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string) {
  const href = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = href
  a.download = filename
  a.rel = 'noopener'
  document.body.appendChild(a)
  a.click()
  a.remove()
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(href), 10 * 60_000)
  return href
}

function base64ToBytes(b64: string) {
  const bin = atob(b64)
  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length)
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i)
  return out
}

function formatBytes(n: number) {
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
  return `${(n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`
}

async function manifestFetcher(): Promise<Manifest> {
  const res = await getArchiveManifest()
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.error)
  return res
}

type Progress = (received: number, total: number, step: string) => void
type Request = { path: string; offset: number; length: number }

/** Groups files into requests of ~chunkBytes; large files are split into ranges. */
function plan(files: Manifest['files'], chunkBytes: number) {
  const batches: Request[][] = []
  let current: Request[] = []
  let size = 0
  const flush = () => {
    if (current.length) batches.push(current)
    current = []
    size = 0
  }
  for (const f of files) {
    if (f.size > chunkBytes) {
      flush()
      for (let offset = 0; offset < f.size; offset += chunkBytes) batches.push([{ path: f.path, offset, length: Math.min(chunkBytes, f.size - offset) }])
      continue
    }
    if (size + f.size > chunkBytes || current.length >= 300) flush()
    current.push({ path: f.path, offset: 0, length: f.size })
    size += f.size
  }
  flush()
  return batches
}

/**
 * 1) Server Actions — POSTed to the URL of this already-open page, so whatever let the page load also lets these
 * through. Files arrive in ~2 MB batches and are zipped in the browser; nothing is ever served from a second URL.
 */
async function viaActions(manifest: Manifest, onProgress: Progress) {
  const total = manifest.files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.size, 0)
  const buffers = new Map<string, Uint8Array>(manifest.files.map((f) => [f.path, new Uint8Array(f.size)]))
  let received = 0
  for (const batch of plan(manifest.files, manifest.chunkBytes)) {
    let res = await getArchiveChunk(batch).catch(() => null)
    if (!res?.ok) res = await getArchiveChunk(batch).catch(() => null)
    if (!res?.ok) throw new Error(res?.error ?? 'Sunucuya ulaşılamadı')
    for (const part of res.parts) {
      const bytes = base64ToBytes(part.data)
      buffers.get(part.path)?.set(bytes, part.offset)
      received += bytes.byteLength
    }
    onProgress(received, total, 'Dosyalar alınıyor')
  }
  if (received !== total) throw new Error('Bazı dosyalar eksik geldi')

  onProgress(total, total, 'ZIP oluşturuluyor')
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30))
  const { zipSync } = await import('fflate')
  const tree: Record<string, [Uint8Array, { level: 0 | 6; mtime: Date }]> = {}
  for (const [p, data] of buffers) tree[`${manifest.name}/${p}`] = [data, { level: STORED.test(p) ? 0 : 6, mtime: FIXED_MTIME }]
  const zip = zipSync(tree)
  return new Blob([zip as BlobPart], { type: 'application/zip' })
}

/** 2) Streamed ZIP from the route handler, with the page's query string forwarded (preview share tokens). */
async function viaApi(_: Manifest | undefined, onProgress: Progress) {
  const url = new URL('/api/indir', window.location.origin)
  new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).forEach((v, k) => url.searchParams.set(k, v))
  const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'include' })
  if (!res.ok || !res.body || !(res.headers.get('content-type') ?? '').includes('zip')) throw new Error(`Sunucu ${res.status} döndürdü`)
  const reader = res.body.getReader()
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
  let received = 0
  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
    if (done) break
    chunks.push(value)
    received += value.byteLength
    onProgress(received, 0, 'Arşiv akıyor')
  }
  return new Blob(chunks as BlobPart[], { type: 'application/zip' })
}

export function DownloadPanel() {
  const { data, error, isLoading } = useSWR('indir-manifest', manifestFetcher, { revalidateOnFocus: false, shouldRetryOnError: false })
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>({ kind: 'idle' })

  const totalBytes = useMemo(() => data?.files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.size, 0) ?? 0, [data])
  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const f of data?.files ?? []) {
      const top = f.path.includes('/') ? `${f.path.split('/')[0]}/` : 'kök dosyalar'
      map.set(top, (map.get(top) ?? 0) + 1)
    }
    return [...map.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
  }, [data])

  async function download() {
    const errors: string[] = []
    const strategies = [
      { id: 'Sunucu eylemi', run: async (p: Progress) => viaActions(data ?? (await manifestFetcher()), p) },
      { id: 'API akışı', run: (p: Progress) => viaApi(data, p) },
    ]
    for (const s of strategies) {
      setState({ kind: 'loading', received: 0, total: 0, step: 'Hazırlanıyor' })
      try {
        const blob = await s.run((received, total, step) => setState({ kind: 'loading', received, total, step }))
        if (!blob.size) throw new Error('Boş arşiv')
        const filename = data?.filename ?? `sytheris-proje-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.zip`
        const href = saveBlob(blob, filename)
        setState({ kind: 'done', size: blob.size, count: data?.files.length ?? 0, via: s.id, href, filename })
        return
      } catch (e) {
        errors.push(`${s.id}: ${(e as Error).message}`)
      }
    }
    setState({ kind: 'error', message: errors.join(' · ') })
  }

  const progress = state.kind === 'loading' && state.total ? state.received / state.total : state.kind === 'done' ? 1 : 0
  const label =
    state.kind === 'loading' ? (state.total ? `%${Math.round(progress * 100)}` : state.step) : state.kind === 'done' ? 'İndirildi — tekrar indir' : state.kind === 'error' ? 'Tekrar dene' : 'ZIP olarak indir'

  const icon =
    state.kind === 'loading' ? (
      <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
    ) : state.kind === 'done' ? (
      <Check className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
    ) : state.kind === 'error' ? (
      <RotateCcw className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
    ) : (
      <ArrowDown className="size-5 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-y-0.5" aria-hidden="true" />
    )

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.8, delay: 0.2, ease: OUT }}
      className="flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-foreground/12 bg-foreground/[0.03]"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-foreground/10 p-5">
        <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
          <FileArchive className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <span className="truncate font-mono text-sm">{data?.filename ?? 'sytheris-proje.zip'}</span>
          <span className="text-xs text-foreground/55">
            {isLoading ? 'Dosyalar sayılıyor…' : error ? 'Liste alınamadı — buton yine de dener' : `${data?.files.length ?? 0} dosya · ${formatBytes(totalBytes)} (sıkıştırmadan önce)`}
          </span>
        </span>
        <span className="hidden items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-foreground/15 px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-foreground/55 sm:flex">
          <ShieldCheck className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" /> Yetki gerekmez
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-5">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={download}
          disabled={state.kind === 'loading'}
          aria-describedby="indir-status"
          className="group relative flex h-14 w-full items-center justify-center gap-3 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-foreground font-semibold text-background outline-none transition hover:opacity-90 focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-primary/40 disabled:cursor-progress"
        >
          <motion.span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-primary"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ width: `${(state.kind === 'loading' && !state.total ? 0.12 : progress) * 100}%` }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
          />
          <span className="relative flex items-center gap-3">
            {icon}
            {label}
          </span>
        </button>

        <div id="indir-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" className="min-h-5 text-sm text-foreground/60">
          {state.kind === 'error' && <span className="text-destructive">İndirme başarısız. {state.message}</span>}
          {state.kind === 'done' && (
            <span className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span>
                {state.count ? `${state.count} dosya, ` : ''}
                {formatBytes(state.size)} ZIP indirildi ({state.via}). Arşivi açıp içeriğini eski projenin üzerine kopyalayabilirsin.
              </span>
              <a href={state.href} download={state.filename} className="w-fit font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
                İndirme başlamadıysa buraya tıkla
              </a>
            </span>
          )}
          {state.kind === 'loading' && (
            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
              {state.step}
              {state.total > 0 ? ` · ${formatBytes(state.received)} / ${formatBytes(state.total)}` : state.received > 0 ? ` · ${formatBytes(state.received)}` : '…'}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {groups.length > 0 && (
        <div className="border-t border-foreground/10 p-5">
          <p className="mb-3 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-foreground/45">Arşiv içeriği</p>
          <ul className="flex flex-col font-mono text-xs" aria-label="Arşiv içeriği">
            {groups.map(([name, n], i) => (
              <li key={name} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-1 text-foreground/75">
                <span className="text-foreground/30" aria-hidden="true">
                  {i === groups.length - 1 ? '└─' : '├─'}
                </span>
                <span className="flex-1 truncate">{name}</span>
                <span className="tabular-nums text-foreground/45">{n}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowRight, Pause, Play, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { Film } from '@/lib/films'
import { usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const SLIDE_MS = 11000
const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

/**
 * Cinema-mode hero. Each slide shows the poster as a blurred projection, the sharp one-sheet on the right,
 * and after a beat starts the official trailer muted behind the title (respecting the autoplay preference).
 */
export function FilmHero({ items }: { items: Film[] }) {
  const slides = items.filter((f) => f.poster).slice(0, 5)
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false)
  const [rolling, setRolling] = useState(false)
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(true)
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const film = slides[index]

  const go = useCallback((i: number) => {
    setRolling(false)
    setIndex(((i % slides.length) + slides.length) % slides.length)
  }, [slides.length])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (paused || rolling) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => go(index + 1), SLIDE_MS)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [index, paused, rolling, go])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!film?.trailer || !prefs.autoplayTrailers || prefs.dataSaver) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setRolling(true), 2600)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [film?.trailer, prefs.autoplayTrailers, prefs.dataSaver, index])

  if (!film) return null

  return (
    <section className="dark relative isolate flex min-h-[88svh] flex-col overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground" aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Öne çıkan filmler" onPointerEnter={() => setPaused(true)} onPointerLeave={() => setPaused(false)}>
      <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
        <motion.div key={film.id} className="absolute inset-0 -z-20" initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.08 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 1.4, ease: OUT }} aria-hidden="true">
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { Clapperboard } from 'lucide-react'
import { getFilmHome, type Film } from '@/lib/films'
import { getSeries, getSeriesHome, type SeriesDetail } from '@/lib/series'
import { translate } from '@/lib/translate'
import { HorrorTeaser } from '@/components/home/horror-teaser'
import { SeriesRow } from '@/components/series/series-card'
import { SeriesSpotlight } from '@/components/series/series-spotlight'
import { CinemaMarquee } from './cinema-marquee'
import { StarFaces } from './star-faces'
import { FilmRow } from './film-card'
import { FilmGenres } from './film-genres'
import { FilmHero } from './film-hero'
import { FilmTopTen } from './film-top-ten'

async function heroSlides(top: Film[]) {
  const head = top.filter((f) => f.poster).slice(0, 5)
  const translated = await Promise.all(head.map((f) => (f.summary ? translate(f.summary, 'tr').catch(() => null) : null)))
  return head.map((f, i) => ({ ...f, summary: translated[i] || f.summary }))
}

export async function FilmHome() {
  const [data, series] = await Promise.all([getFilmHome(), getSeriesHome()])
  const [slides, spotlight] = await Promise.all([
    heroSlides(data.top),
    Promise.all(series.popular.slice(0, 4).map((s) => getSeries(s.id))).then((list) => list.filter((s): s is SeriesDetail => Boolean(s))),
  ])

  if (!data.top.length) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-xl flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-32 text-center">
        <Clapperboard className="size-8 text-ink" aria-hidden="true" />
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Film listesi <span className="accent-serif">yüklenemedi</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Film kataloğuna şu an ulaşılamıyor. Birkaç saniye sonra yenile ya da anime moduna dön.</p>
        <Link href="/ayarlar?tab=icerik" className="rounded-full bg-foreground px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-background">
          İçerik modunu değiştir
        </Link>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const used = new Set<string>()
  const pick = (...lists: (Film | undefined)[][]) => {
    for (const list of lists) {
      const hit = list.find((f) => f && (f.posterLg || f.poster) && !used.has(f.id))
      if (hit) {
        used.add(hit.id)
        return hit
      }
    }
    return undefined
  }
  const covers = {
    aksiyon: pick(data.action),
    bilimkurgu: pick(data.scifi),
    gerilim: pick(data.thriller),
    dram: pick(data.drama),
    komedi: pick(data.comedy),
    korku: pick(data.horror, data.thriller),
    romantik: pick(data.top.filter((f) => f.genre === 'Romance'), data.drama),
    aile: pick(data.top.filter((f) => f.genre === 'Kids & Family'), data.comedy, data.classics),
  }

  return (
    <div className="cine dark flex flex-col gap-20 pb-24 sm:gap-24">
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <FilmHero items={slides} />
        <CinemaMarquee items={data.top.slice(5)} />
      </div>
      <FilmTopTen items={data.top} />
      <SeriesSpotlight items={spotlight} />
      <StarFaces series={spotlight} />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Aksiyon & Macera" title="Nabzı" accent="yükseltenler" href="/filmler?tur=aksiyon" items={data.action} />
      <SeriesRow eyebrow="Diziler · Popüler" title="Herkesin" accent="izlediği diziler" href="/diziler" items={series.popular.slice(4)} />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Bilim Kurgu & Fantastik" title="Başka" accent="dünyalar" href="/filmler?tur=bilimkurgu" items={data.scifi} />
      <FilmGenres covers={covers} />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Gerilim" title="Nefesini" accent="tut" href="/filmler?tur=gerilim" items={data.thriller} />
      <SeriesRow eyebrow="Diziler · Suç" title="Dosyası" accent="kapanmayanlar" href="/diziler?tur=suc" items={series.crime} />
      <HorrorTeaser />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Dram" title="İnsanı anlatan" accent="hikâyeler" href="/filmler?tur=dram" items={data.drama} />
      <SeriesRow eyebrow="Diziler · En yüksek puan" title="Puanı" accent="tavan yapanlar" href="/diziler?sira=puan" items={series.topRated} />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Komedi" title="Kötü günlere" accent="ilaç" href="/filmler?tur=komedi" items={data.comedy} />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Korku" title="Işıkları" accent="kapatma" href="/filmler?tur=korku" items={data.horror} />
      <FilmRow eyebrow="Klasikler" title="Sinemanın" accent="taşları" description="Zamana direnen, her izleyişte yeniden keşfedilen filmler." href="/filmler?tur=klasik" items={data.classics} />
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function FilmSynopsis({ original, translated, kind = 'film' }: { original: string; translated: string | null; kind?: 'film' | 'dizi' }) {
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<'tr' | 'en'>(translated ? 'tr' : 'en')
  const text = lang === 'tr' && translated ? translated : original

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Konu <span className="accent-serif">özeti</span>
        </h2>
        {translated && (
          <div className="flex rounded-full bg-muted p-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Özet dili">
            {(['tr', 'en'] as const).map((l) => (
              <button key={l} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={lang === l} onClick={() => setLang(l)} className={cn('rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase transition', lang === l ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                {l}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {text ? (
        <p className="text-pretty text-lg leading-relaxed text-foreground/85 first-letter:float-left first-letter:mr-3 first-letter:mt-1 first-letter:font-serif first-letter:text-7xl first-letter:italic first-letter:leading-[0.8] first-letter:text-primary">
          {text}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">Bu {kind} için özet bulunmuyor.</p>
      )}
      {lang === 'tr' && translated && <p className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">Otomatik çeviri</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

/** A literal strip of 35mm film: perforated rails, one frame per title, giant outlined rank numerals. */
export function FilmTopTen({ items }: { items: Film[] }) {
  const top = items.slice(0, 10)
  if (!top.length) return null
  const week = new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long' })

  return (
    <section className="flex w-full flex-col gap-8" aria-labelledby="film-top10">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1440px] px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">

      </div>

        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1440px] px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">

            {top.map((f, i) => (

'use client'

import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Play } from 'lucide-react'

/** Poster-first trailer: nothing downloads until the visitor presses play, then native controls take over. */
export function FilmTrailer({ src, poster, title }: { src: string; poster: string; title: string }) {
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false)
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)

  return (
    <div className="dark relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-scrim text-foreground ring-1 ring-border">
      {started ? (
        <video ref={ref} src={src} controls autoPlay playsInline className="size-full bg-scrim object-contain" aria-label={`${title} fragmanı`} />
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
            setStarted(true)
          }}
          className="group absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"
          aria-label={`${title} fragmanını oynat`}
        >
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full scale-110 object-cover opacity-50 blur-2xl" />
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="relative h-[86%] rounded-xl object-contain shadow-2xl transition duration-700 group-hover:scale-[1.02]" />
          <span className="absolute grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_20px_50px_-10px_var(--primary)] transition duration-300 group-hover:scale-110">
            <Play className="ml-1 size-8 fill-current" />
          </span>
          <span className="absolute bottom-4 left-5 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-foreground/70">Resmî fragman</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import type { SeriesDetail } from '@/lib/series'
import { ScrollRow } from '@/components/anime/scroll-row'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'

/** "Yıldızlar geçidi" — the faces behind this week's series, each opening its actor page. */
export function StarFaces({ series }: { series: SeriesDetail[] }) {
  const seen = new Set<number>()
  const faces: { id: number; name: string; character: string; show: string; image: string }[] = []
  const maxPerShow = 5
  for (const s of series) {
    let taken = 0
    for (const c of s.cast) {
      if (taken >= maxPerShow || seen.has(c.personId) || !c.personImage) continue
      seen.add(c.personId)
      faces.push({ id: c.personId, name: c.name, character: c.character, show: s.name, image: c.personImage })
      taken++
    }
  }
  if (faces.length < 4) return null

  return (
    <section className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10" id="star-faces" aria-label="Ekranın yüzleri">
      <SectionHeading eyebrow="Yıldızlar geçidi" title="Ekranın" accent="yüzleri" description="Bu haftanın dizilerinde rol alan oyuncular. Bir yüze dokun, tüm filmografisini aç." />
      <ScrollRow label="Oyuncular">
        {faces.map((f) => (
          <Link key={f.id} href={`/oyuncu/tv-${f.id}`} className="group flex w-[38vw] shrink-0 snap-start flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center outline-none sm:w-[168px]">
            <span className="relative block aspect-[3/4] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-t-full rounded-b-lg bg-muted ring-1 ring-border transition duration-500 group-hover:-translate-y-1 group-hover:shadow-[0_0_60px_-18px_var(--primary)] group-hover:ring-primary/70 group-focus-visible:ring-2 group-focus-visible:ring-primary">
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img src={f.image} alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" className="cine-portrait size-full object-cover object-top" />
            </span>
            <span className="flex w-full flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="truncate font-semibold transition group-hover:text-ink">{f.name}</span>
              <span className="truncate font-serif text-sm italic text-muted-foreground">{f.character}</span>
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-[10px] tracking-[0.08em] text-foreground/45">{f.show}</span>
            </span>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </ScrollRow>
    </section>
  )
}

'use client'

import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Lock } from 'lucide-react'
import { useActionState, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { unlockGate, type GateState } from '@/app/kapi/actions'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MistBackdrop, MistBrand, MistRule } from './mist-scene'

const d = (ms: number) => ({ '--d': `${ms}ms` }) as React.CSSProperties

export function GateForm({ next }: { next: string }) {
  const [state, action, pending] = useActionState<GateState, FormData>(unlockGate, {})
  const [reveal, setReveal] = useState(false)
  const [opening, setOpening] = useState(false)
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const ids = { key: useId(), remember: useId(), status: useId() }
  const locked = Boolean(state.retryIn)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state.next) return
    setOpening(true)
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => window.location.assign(state.next!), reduce ? 0 : 1100)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [state])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.error) inputRef.current?.select()
  }, [state])

  return (

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { Check, Copy } from 'lucide-react'

export function CodeBlock({ code, file }: { code: string; file?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
  return (
    <figure className="dark overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-scrim text-foreground">
      <figcaption className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-foreground/10 px-4 py-2.5">
        <span className="truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{file ?? 'kod'}</span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).catch(() => {})
            setCopied(true)
            window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1400)
          }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] text-foreground/70 transition hover:bg-foreground/10 hover:text-foreground"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="size-3.5 text-primary" /> : <Copy className="size-3.5" />}
          {copied ? 'Kopyalandı' : 'Kopyala'}
        </button>
      </figcaption>
      <pre className="overflow-x-auto p-4 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-foreground/85">
        <code>{code}</code>
      </pre>
    </figure>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ImageUp, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MASCOT, type MascotMood } from '@/components/mascot/mascot-config'
import { AvatarFrame } from '@/components/membership/avatar-frame'

const SLOTS: { id: MascotMood; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'wave', label: 'El sallayan' },
  { id: 'lost', label: 'Kaybolmuş' },
  { id: 'secret', label: 'Sır veren' },
  { id: 'think', label: 'Düşünen' },
  { id: 'portrait', label: 'Portre' },
  { id: 'avatar', label: 'Avatar (kare)' },
]

/** Local-only preview: the chosen file never leaves the browser (object URL). */
export function MascotTester() {
  const [src, setSrc] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [slot, setSlot] = useState<MascotMood>('wave')
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState<{ name: string; w: number; h: number } | null>(null)
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => () => void (src && URL.revokeObjectURL(src)), [src])

  const pick = (file: File) => {
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    const img = new Image()
    img.onload = () => setMeta({ name: file.name, w: img.naturalWidth, h: img.naturalHeight })
    img.src = url
    setSrc(url)
  }

  const shown = src ?? MASCOT.images[slot]
  const target = MASCOT.images[slot]
  const ratio = meta ? meta.w / meta.h : null
  const ratioHint = !meta ? null : slot === 'avatar' ? (Math.abs((ratio ?? 1) - 1) < 0.08 ? 'Kare — tam uygun.' : 'Avatar için kare (1:1) bir görsel önerilir.') : (ratio ?? 1) < 0.95 ? 'Dikey — tam uygun.' : 'Dikey (yaklaşık 3:4) bir görsel daha iyi oturur.'

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Hangi hâli deniyorsun?">
        {SLOTS.map((s) => (
          <button key={s.id} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={slot === s.id} onClick={() => setSlot(s.id)} className={cn('rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition', slot === s.id ? 'border-foreground bg-foreground text-background' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/40')}>
            {s.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-[1.2fr_1fr_1fr]">
        <div className="dark relative grid h-72 place-items-end overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_50%_70%,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_40%,var(--scrim)),var(--scrim)_70%)]">
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={shown || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="Tam boy önizleme" className="h-full w-full object-contain object-bottom drop-shadow-[0_24px_30px_rgb(0_0_0/0.4)]" />
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-scrim/70 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-on-scrim">Tam boy</span>
        </div>
        <div className="relative h-72 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-muted">
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={shown || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="Portre kırpımı önizleme" className="size-full object-cover object-top" />
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-scrim/70 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-on-scrim">Portre</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex h-72 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-8 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background">
          <AvatarFrame src={shown} name={MASCOT.name} frame="ribbon" className="size-24" />
          <AvatarFrame src={shown} name={MASCOT.name} frame="none" className="size-10" />
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Avatar boyutları</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => input.current?.click()} className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110">
            <ImageUp className="size-4" /> Görsel seç ve dene
          </button>
          {src && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSrc(null)
                setMeta(null)
              }}
              className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm transition hover:border-foreground/40"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="size-4" /> Mevcut maskota dön
            </button>
          )}
          <input
            ref={input}
            type="file"
            accept="image/png,image/webp,image/jpeg,image/gif"
            className="sr-only"
            tabIndex={-1}
            aria-hidden="true"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0]
              if (f) pick(f)
              e.target.value = ''
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {meta ? (
            <>
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{meta.name}</span> · {meta.w}×{meta.h}px · {ratioHint}
            </>
          ) : (
            'Görsel yalnızca tarayıcında gösterilir, hiçbir yere yüklenmez.'
          )}
        </p>
      </div>

      <p className="rounded-2xl bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed">
        Beğendiysen bu dosyayı projede <code className="rounded bg-background px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs">public{target}</code> adıyla kaydet (eskisinin üzerine yaz). Farklı bir isim kullanacaksan <code className="rounded bg-background px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs">components/mascot/mascot-config.ts</code> içindeki <code className="rounded bg-background px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs">{slot}</code> satırını değiştir.
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

DOSYA: C:\Users\mumya\Desktop\SYTHERİS_SON\components\home\hero.tsx

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowRight, Pause, Play, Star, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, stripHtml } from '@/lib/format'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BackdropImage } from '@/components/media/backdrop-image'
import { YTTrailer, isTrailerBroken, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'
import { StyledTitle } from '@/components/anime/styled-title'

const SLIDE_MS = 9000
const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function Hero({ items }: { items: MediaCard[] }) {
  const slides = items.slice(0, 5)
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [dir, setDir] = useState(1)
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false)
  const [trailerOn, setTrailerOn] = useState(false)
  const [trailerPlaying, setTrailerPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({})
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const media = slides[index]

  const go = useCallback(
    (i: number) => {
      setDir(i >= index ? 1 : -1)
      setIndex((i + slides.length) % slides.length)
      setTrailerOn(false)
      setTrailerPlaying(false)
    },
    [index, slides.length],
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion') || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) setPaused(true)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!media) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setTrailerOn(true), 2600)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [media])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trailerPlaying) return
    if (prefs.trailerSound) yt.current?.unMute()
    else yt.current?.mute()
  }, [prefs.trailerSound, trailerPlaying])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement
      if (t.closest('input, textarea, [role="dialog"]')) return
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(index + 1)
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(index - 1)
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [go, index])

  if (!media) return null
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const showTrailer = Boolean(trailerId) && trailerOn && prefs.autoplayTrailers && !prefs.dataSaver && !failed[media.id] && !isTrailerBroken(trailerId)
  const barStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    animation: `hero-progress ${SLIDE_MS}ms linear forwards`,
    animationPlayState: paused || trailerPlaying ? 'paused' : 'running',
  }

  return (
    <section className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground" aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Öne çıkan animeler">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false} custom={dir}>
          <motion.div
            key={media.id}
            custom={dir}
            className="absolute inset-0"
            variants={{
              enter: (d: number) => ({ clipPath: d > 0 ? 'inset(0% 0% 0% 100%)' : 'inset(0% 100% 0% 0%)' }),
              center: { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)' },
              exit: { opacity: 0.6 },
            }}
            initial="enter"
            animate="center"
            exit="exit"
            transition={{ clipPath: { duration: 1, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] }, opacity: { duration: 1 } }}
          >
            <motion.div className="absolute inset-0" initial={{ scale: 1.12 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }} transition={{ duration: 9, ease: 'linear' }}>
              <BackdropImage media={media} priority={index === 0} />
            </motion.div>
            {showTrailer && trailerId && (
              <YTTrailer
                ref={yt}
                videoId={trailerId}
                start={6}
                loop={false}
                onPlaying={() => setTrailerPlaying(true)}
                onEnded={() => go(index + 1)}
                onError={() => {
                  setFailed((f) => ({ ...f, [media.id]: true }))
                  setTrailerPlaying(false)
                }}
              />
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim via-scrim/70 to-transparent lg:via-scrim/35" />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-56 bg-gradient-to-t from-page via-page/40 to-transparent" />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-28 bg-gradient-to-b from-scrim/70 to-transparent" />
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      </div>

      <span
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute right-4 top-28 hidden select-none font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-foreground/40 [writing-mode:vertical-rl] 2xl:block"
      >
        Trend · {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} / {String(slides.length).padStart(2, '0')}
      </span>

      <div className="mx-auto grid min-h-[min(94svh,920px)] max-w-[1440px] grid-cols-1 content-end gap-10 px-4 pb-8 pt-24 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] lg:items-end lg:gap-16 lg:px-10 lg:pb-10">
        {/* Outgoing and incoming slides share one grid cell, so the block never collapses to zero height mid-swap.
            A collapse here shifted everything below the hero and made the page jump while scrolling. */}
        <div className="grid min-h-[30rem] items-end sm:min-h-[28rem] [&>*]:[grid-area:1/1]">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          <motion.div
            key={media.id}
            initial="hidden"
            animate="show"
            exit="exit"
            variants={{ show: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.08 } }, exit: { opacity: 0, y: -10, transition: { duration: 0.25 } } }}
            className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6"
          >
            <motion.div variants={fade} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground">
                #{String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} Trend
              </span>
              {[media.seasonYear, formatTr(media.format), media.episodes ? `${media.episodes} bölüm` : null].filter(Boolean).map((t) => (
                <span key={String(t)} className="rounded-full border border-foreground/20 px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground/80 backdrop-blur">
                  {t}
                </span>
              ))}
              {media.averageScore ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-primary/50 bg-primary/10 px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-primary backdrop-blur">
                  <Star className="size-3 fill-current" />
                  {media.averageScore}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </motion.div>

            <div style={{ ['--cover-color' as string]: media.coverImage.color ?? 'var(--primary)' }}>
              <StyledTitle title={title} genres={media.genres} className="text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-[88px]" />
            </div>

            <motion.p variants={fade} className="line-clamp-3 max-w-xl text-pretty leading-relaxed text-foreground/75 sm:text-lg">
              {stripHtml(media.description)}
            </motion.p>
            <motion.div variants={fade} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm text-foreground/60">
              {media.genres?.slice(0, 4).map((g, i) => (
                <span key={g} className="flex items-center gap-2">

                className="grid size-13 place-items-center rounded-full border border-foreground/25 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-foreground/10"

              </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPrefs({ trailerSound: !prefs.trailerSound })}
                  aria-label={prefs.trailerSound ? 'Fragman sesini kapat' : 'Fragman sesini aç'}
                  className="grid size-13 place-items-center rounded-full border border-foreground/25 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-foreground/10"
                >
                  {prefs.trailerSound ? <Volume2 className="size-5" /> : <VolumeX className="size-5" />}
                </button>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
        </div>

        <PosterCard media={media} index={index} total={slides.length} />

        <ol className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex snap-x gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:-mx-6 sm:px-6 lg:col-span-2 lg:mx-0 lg:grid lg:grid-cols-5 lg:overflow-visible lg:px-0" aria-label="Slaytlar">

                  <span className={cn('relative block aspect-[2/3] w-12 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg ring-1 transition', active ? 'ring-primary' : 'ring-foreground/10')}>

                    <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{pickTitle(s.title)}</span>
                    <span className="relative h-0.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-foreground/15">
                      {i < index && <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-foreground/50" />}
                      {active && <span key={index} className="absolute inset-0 origin-left bg-primary" style={barStyle} onAnimationEnd={() => go(index + 1)} />}

                  </span>
                </button>

function PosterCard({ media, index, total }: { media: MediaCard; index: number; total: number }) {
  const [tilt, setTilt] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 })
  const cover = media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large
  if (!cover) return null
  return (
    <div className="relative hidden lg:block" style={{ perspective: '1200px' }}>
      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        <motion.div
          key={media.id}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, rotateY: -35, x: 60 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, rotateY: -10 + tilt.x, rotateX: tilt.y, x: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, rotateY: 25, x: -40, transition: { duration: 0.35 } }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 120, damping: 18 }}
          onPointerMove={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            setTilt({ x: ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * 16, y: -((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5) * 12 })
          }}
          onPointerLeave={() => setTilt({ x: 0, y: 0 })}
          className="sy-holo relative aspect-[2/3] w-[260px] overflow-hidden rounded-[1.4rem] shadow-[0_40px_80px_-20px_rgb(0_0_0/0.7)] ring-1 ring-foreground/20 xl:w-[300px]"
          style={{ transformStyle: 'preserve-3d' }}
        >
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={cover} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim/80 via-transparent to-transparent" />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-4 bottom-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
            <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-on-scrim/80">Vol. {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-on-scrim/60">
              {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(total).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

const fade = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 24, filter: 'blur(8px)' },
  show: { opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)', transition: { duration: 0.7, ease: OUT } },
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { HORROR_FILMS, horrorRuntime, type HorrorFilm } from '@/lib/horror'

const STRIP = 16

/** A different slice of the programme every day, stable for the whole day so SSR and cache agree. */
function tonightsProgramme(): HorrorFilm[] {
  const day = Math.floor(Date.now() / 86_400_000)
  const start = (day * 7) % HORROR_FILMS.length
  return Array.from({ length: Math.min(STRIP, HORROR_FILMS.length) }, (_, i) => HORROR_FILMS[(start + i * 5) % HORROR_FILMS.length])
}

function Poster({ film, hidden }: { film: HorrorFilm; hidden?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <li className="shrink-0" aria-hidden={hidden || undefined}>
      <Link
        href="/korku"
        tabIndex={hidden ? -1 : undefined}
        className="gs-poster group/p relative block aspect-[16/9] w-[78vw] max-w-[420px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-scrim outline-none ring-1 ring-on-scrim/10 transition duration-500 hover:ring-[var(--hx)] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--hx)] sm:w-[420px]"
        aria-label={`${film.title} — ${film.director}. Gece Sineması'nda izle`}
      >
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={`/api/korku/still/${film.slug}`}
          alt=""
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          className="absolute inset-0 size-full scale-[1.06] object-cover grayscale-[0.6] transition duration-[900ms] ease-out group-hover/p:scale-100 group-hover/p:grayscale-0"

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Clapperboard, Loader2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'
import { setContentMode } from '@/app/actions/content-mode'
import type { ContentMode } from '@/lib/content-mode-shared'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const MODES: { id: ContentMode; label: string; hint: string; icon: typeof Sparkles }[] = [
  { id: 'anime', label: 'Anime', hint: 'AniList kataloğu, sezonlar, karakterler', icon: Sparkles },
  { id: 'film', label: 'Sinema', hint: 'Anime olmayan filmler, resmî fragmanlar', icon: Clapperboard },
]

/** Segmented switch between the anime and live-action catalogues. Persists in a cookie and refreshes server data. */
export function ModeSwitcher({ mode, className, size = 'md' }: { mode: ContentMode; className?: string; size?: 'sm' | 'md' }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(mode)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()

  const choose = (next: ContentMode) => {
    if (next === current || pending) return
    setCurrent(next)
    start(async () => {
      await setContentMode(next)
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  return (
    <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="İçerik modu" className={cn('relative grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-full border border-border bg-card p-1', className)}>
      {MODES.map((m) => {
        const on = current === m.id
        return (
          <button
            key={m.id}
            type="button"
            role="radio"
            aria-checked={on}
            onClick={() => choose(m.id)}
            title={m.hint}
            className={cn('relative flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full font-medium transition-colors', size === 'sm' ? 'h-9 px-3 text-xs' : 'h-11 px-5 text-sm', on ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
          >
            {on && <motion.span layoutId="mode-pill" className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 34 }} />}
            <span className="relative flex items-center gap-2">
              {pending && on ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <m.icon className="size-4" />}
              {m.label}
            </span>
          </button>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

export function TopTen({ items }: { items: MediaCard[] }) {
  const list = items.slice(0, 10)
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0)
  const [hovering, setHovering] = useState(false)
  const [manualPause, setManualPause] = useState(false)
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const paused = hovering || manualPause || !visible

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => setVisible(entry.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.35 })
    io.observe(el)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (paused || list.length < 2) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setActive((a) => (a + 1) % list.length), CYCLE_MS)
    return () => clearTimeout(id)
  }, [active, paused, list.length])

  const select = useCallback((i: number) => setActive(i), [])

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key !== 'ArrowRight' && e.key !== 'ArrowLeft') return
    e.preventDefault()
    setActive((a) => (a + (e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + list.length) % list.length)
  }

  if (!list.length) return null
  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', weekday: 'long' })

  return (
    <section className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10" aria-labelledby="top10">
      <div id="top10" className="flex items-end justify-between gap-6">
        <SectionHeading eyebrow={`Top 10 · ${today}`} title="Bugün Türkiye'de" accent="Top 10" description="Bir dilimin üzerine gel ya da ok tuşlarını kullan; sahne o seriye açılsın." href="/ara?sort=TRENDING_DESC" />
        <div className="hidden shrink-0 items-center gap-3 pb-1 lg:flex">
          <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="text-foreground">{String(active + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span> / {String(list.length).padStart(2, '0')}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setManualPause((p) => !p)}
            aria-label={manualPause ? 'Otomatik geçişi başlat' : 'Otomatik geçişi durdur'}
            className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border transition hover:border-primary hover:text-ink"
          >
            {manualPause ? <Play className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Pause className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div ref={ref} className="dark hidden lg:block" onPointerEnter={() => setHovering(true)} onPointerLeave={() => setHovering(false)}>
        <ol className="flex h-[520px] gap-2 xl:h-[560px]" aria-label="Bugün Türkiye'de Top 10" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
          {list.map((m, i) => (
            <Slice key={m.id} media={m} rank={i + 1} active={i === active} paused={paused} onSelect={() => select(i)} />
          ))}
        </ol>
      </div>

      <ol className="scrollbar-none dark -mx-4 flex snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-px-4 gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-2 sm:-mx-6 sm:scroll-px-6 sm:px-6 lg:hidden" aria-label="Bugün Türkiye'de Top 10">
        {list.map((m, i) => (
          <MobileCard key={m.id} media={m} rank={i + 1} />
        ))}
      </ol>
    </section>
  )
}
