'use client'

import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { Float, Image } from '@react-three/drei'
import { Suspense, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { MathUtils, type Color, type Group } from 'three'
import { cssVarColor, textureUrl } from '@/components/three/css-color'
import { QuietBoundary } from '@/components/three/quiet-boundary'

function seeded(i: number) {
  const x = Math.sin(i * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453
  return x - Math.floor(x)
}

function Drift({ covers, reduced }: { covers: string[]; reduced: boolean }) {
  const group = useRef<Group>(null)
  const cards = useMemo(
    () =>
      covers.map((url, i) => {
        const a = seeded(i) * Math.PI * 2
        const r = 2.6 + seeded(i + 40) * 4.5
        return {
          url,
          position: [Math.cos(a) * r * 1.4, (seeded(i + 80) - 0.5) * 6, -seeded(i + 120) * 9 - 1] as [number, number, number],
          rotation: [(seeded(i + 160) - 0.5) * 1.2, (seeded(i + 200) - 0.5) * 1.6, (seeded(i + 240) - 0.5) * 1.2] as [number, number, number],
          speed: 0.6 + seeded(i + 280) * 1.2,
        }
      }),
    [covers],
  )

  useFrame((state, dt) => {
    const g = group.current
    if (!g) return
    if (!reduced) g.rotation.z += dt * 0.012
    state.camera.position.x = MathUtils.damp(state.camera.position.x, reduced ? 0 : state.pointer.x * 0.8, 2.5, dt)
    state.camera.position.y = MathUtils.damp(state.camera.position.y, reduced ? 0 : state.pointer.y * 0.5, 2.5, dt)
    state.camera.lookAt(0, 0, -4)
  })

  return (
    <group ref={group}>
      {cards.map((c, i) => (
        <QuietBoundary key={c.url + i}>
          <Suspense fallback={null}>
            <Float speed={reduced ? 0 : c.speed} rotationIntensity={reduced ? 0 : 0.8} floatIntensity={reduced ? 0 : 1.2}>
              <Image url={textureUrl(c.url)} transparent radius={0.06} grayscale={0.85} scale={[1.2, 1.8]} position={c.position} rotation={c.rotation} side={2} />
            </Float>
          </Suspense>
        </QuietBoundary>
      ))}
    </group>
  )
}

function Background({ onColor }: { onColor: (c: Color) => void }) {
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const host = document.querySelector('[data-lost-stage]') ?? document.documentElement
    onColor(cssVarColor('--scrim', '#0b0b0d', host))
  }, [onColor])
  return null
}

export default function LostVoidScene({ covers, reduced }: { covers: string[]; reduced: boolean }) {
  const [bg, setBg] = useState<Color | null>(null)
  return (
    <Canvas dpr={[1, 1.5]} camera={{ fov: 50, position: [0, 0, 6] }} gl={{ antialias: true, alpha: false }} aria-hidden="true">
      <Background onColor={setBg} />
      {bg && <color attach="background" args={[bg]} />}
      {bg && <fog attach="fog" args={[bg, 5, 16]} />}
      <Drift covers={covers.slice(0, 18)} reduced={reduced} />
    </Canvas>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowDownUp, Search } from 'lucide-react'
import type { ChapterItem } from '@/lib/manga'

const PAGE = 60

export function ChapterList({ mangaId, chapters }: { mangaId: string; chapters: ChapterItem[] }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState(false)
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE)

  const list = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase()
    const filtered = q ? chapters.filter((c) => (c.chapter ?? '').includes(q) || (c.title ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q)) : chapters
    return desc ? [...filtered].reverse() : filtered
  }, [chapters, query, desc])

  if (!chapters.length) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-6 py-16 text-center">
        <p className="font-semibold">Bu dilde okunabilir bölüm yok</p>
        <p className="max-w-sm text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Lisanslı seriler yalnızca resmî platformlarda yayınlanır. Diğer dili denemek için yukarıdaki seçiciyi kullan.</p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <label className="flex h-10 flex-1 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-4 transition focus-within:border-primary">
          <Search className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="sr-only">Bölüm ara</span>
          <input
            type="search"
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setQuery(e.target.value)
              setLimit(PAGE)
            }}
            placeholder="Bölüm numarası ya da adı"
            className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70"
          />
        </label>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setDesc((v) => !v)}
          aria-pressed={desc}
          className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-4 text-sm transition hover:bg-muted"
        >
          <ArrowDownUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          {desc ? 'Yeniden eskiye' : 'Eskiden yeniye'}
        </button>
      </div>

      <ol className="grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-border sm:grid-cols-2">
        {list.slice(0, limit).map((c) => (
          <li key={c.id} className="bg-background">
            <Link href={`/manga/${mangaId}/oku/${c.id}`} className="group flex items-center gap-4 px-4 py-3.5 transition hover:bg-muted/60 focus-visible:bg-muted/60">
              <span className="w-14 shrink-0 font-mono text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-foreground/90 transition group-hover:text-ink">{c.chapter ?? '—'}</span>
              <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{c.title || (c.chapter ? `${c.chapter}. bölüm` : 'Tek bölüm')}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {[c.volume && `Cilt ${c.volume}`, c.group, `${c.pages} sayfa`].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                </span>
              </span>
              <time dateTime={c.publishedAt} className="hidden shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground sm:block">
                {new Date(c.publishedAt).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}
              </time>
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      {list.length > limit && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setLimit((l) => l + PAGE)} className="mx-auto rounded-full border border-border px-5 py-2 text-sm transition hover:bg-muted">
          {list.length - limit} bölüm daha göster
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function MangaCard({ manga, className, rank, priority }: { manga: Manga; className?: string; rank?: number; priority?: boolean }) {

          </span>
        )}
      </span>
      <span className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <span className="line-clamp-2 text-sm font-semibold leading-snug tracking-tight transition group-hover/mg:text-ink">{manga.title}</span>
        <span className="line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{[manga.year, manga.tags[0]].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Manga'}</span>
      </span>
    </Link>
  )

import Link from 'next/link'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { GENRES, SORTS, type SortKey } from '@/lib/manga'

type Current = { q?: string; genre?: string; sort?: SortKey; lang?: 'tr' }

function href(current: Current, patch: Partial<Current>) {
  const next = { ...current, ...patch }
  const p = new URLSearchParams()
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(next)) if (v) p.set(k, String(v))
  const s = p.toString()
  return s ? `/manga?${s}` : '/manga'
}

export function MangaFilters({ current }: { current: Current }) {
  return (
    <div className="sticky top-16 z-20 border-b border-border bg-background/85 backdrop-blur-xl">
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:gap-6 lg:px-10">
        <nav aria-label="Türler" className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex flex-1 gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
          <Link
            href={href(current, { genre: undefined })}
            aria-current={!current.genre ? 'true' : undefined}
            className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition', !current.genre ? 'bg-foreground text-background' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground')}
          >
            Tümü
          </Link>
          {GENRES.map((g) => {
            const active = current.genre === g.slug
            return (
              <Link
                key={g.slug}
                href={href(current, { genre: active ? undefined : g.slug })}
                aria-current={active ? 'true' : undefined}
                className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition', active ? 'bg-foreground text-background' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground')}
              >
                {g.label}
              </Link>
            )
          })}
        </nav>
        <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
          <div className="flex shrink-0 rounded-full border border-border p-0.5" role="group" aria-label="Sıralama">
            {(Object.keys(SORTS) as SortKey[]).map((k) => {
              const active = (current.sort ?? 'populer') === k
              return (
                <Link
                  key={k}
                  href={href(current, { sort: k === 'populer' ? undefined : k })}
                  aria-current={active ? 'true' : undefined}
                  className={cn('whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition', active ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
                >
                  {SORTS[k].label}
                </Link>
              )
            })}
          </div>
          <Link
            href={href(current, { lang: current.lang === 'tr' ? undefined : 'tr' })}
            aria-pressed={current.lang === 'tr'}
            className={cn(
              'flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition',
              current.lang === 'tr' ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-ink' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
            )}
          >
            <span className={cn('size-1.5 rounded-full', current.lang === 'tr' ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-muted-foreground/40')} aria-hidden="true" />
            Türkçe
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

DOSYA: C:\Users\mumya\Desktop\SYTHERİS_SON\components\manga\manga-reader.tsx

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Columns2, Rows3, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type Props = {
  manga: { id: string; title: string }
  chapter: { id: string; number: string | null; title: string | null; lang: string }
  pages: string[]
  chapters: { id: string; number: string | null; title: string | null }[]
  prevId: string | null
  nextId: string | null
  hq: boolean
}

type Mode = 'strip' | 'page'
const MODE_KEY = 'sy-manga-mode'

export function MangaReader({ manga, chapter, pages, chapters, prevId, nextId, hq }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('strip')
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [chrome, setChrome] = useState(true)
  const lastY = useRef(0)

  const base = `/manga/${manga.id}/oku`
  const hqQuery = hq ? '?hq=1' : ''
  const label = chapter.number ? `${chapter.number}. bölüm` : 'Tek bölüm'

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY)
    if (saved === 'page' || saved === 'strip') setMode(saved)
  }, [])

  const changeMode = (m: Mode) => {
    setMode(m)
    setPage(0)
    window.localStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY, m)
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'strip') return
    const onScroll = () => {
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight
      setProgress(max > 0 ? Math.min(1, window.scrollY / max) : 0)
      const y = window.scrollY
      setChrome(y < 80 || y < lastY.current)
      lastY.current = y
    }
    onScroll()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [mode])

  const go = useCallback(
    (dir: 1 | -1) => {
      if (mode === 'page') {
        const nextPage = page + dir
        if (nextPage >= 0 && nextPage < pages.length) {
          setPage(nextPage)
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0 })
          return
        }
      }
      const target = dir === 1 ? nextId : prevId
      if (target) router.push(`${base}/${target}${hqQuery}`)
    },
    [mode, page, pages.length, nextId, prevId, router, base, hqQuery],
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.target instanceof HTMLInputElement || e.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || (mode === 'page' && e.key === ' ')) {
        e.preventDefault()
        go(1)
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        go(-1)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [go, mode])

  const shownProgress = mode === 'page' ? (page + 1) / pages.length : progress

  return (
    <div className="dark min-h-dvh bg-scrim text-foreground">
      <header
        className={cn(
          'fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-40 border-b border-on-scrim/10 bg-scrim/85 backdrop-blur-xl transition-transform duration-500',
          !chrome && mode === 'strip' && '-translate-y-full',
        )}
      >
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-5xl items-center gap-3 px-3 sm:px-5">
          <Link href={`/manga/${manga.id}`} className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10" aria-label={`${manga.title} sayfasına dön`}>
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </Link>
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
            <span className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{manga.title}</span>
            <span className="truncate font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-foreground/50">
              {label}
              {chapter.title ? ` · ${chapter.title}` : ''} · {chapter.lang.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
          </div>

          <label className="hidden sm:block">
            <span className="sr-only">Bölüm seç</span>
            <select
              value={chapter.id}
              onChange={(e) => router.push(`${base}/${e.target.value}${hqQuery}`)}
              className="h-9 max-w-44 rounded-full border border-on-scrim/15 bg-scrim px-3 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:border-primary"
            >
              {chapters.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.number ? `Bölüm ${c.number}` : 'Tek bölüm'}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>

          <div className="flex rounded-full border border-on-scrim/15 p-0.5" role="group" aria-label="Okuma modu">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => changeMode('strip')} aria-pressed={mode === 'strip'} className={cn('grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full transition', mode === 'strip' ? 'bg-on-scrim text-scrim' : 'text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground')} aria-label="Dikey şerit">
              <Rows3 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => changeMode('page')} aria-pressed={mode === 'page'} className={cn('grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full transition', mode === 'page' ? 'bg-on-scrim text-scrim' : 'text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground')} aria-label="Sayfa sayfa">
              <Columns2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <Link
            href={`${base}/${chapter.id}${hq ? '' : '?hq=1'}`}
            aria-pressed={hq}
            className={cn('hidden h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition sm:flex', hq ? 'border-primary text-ink' : 'border-on-scrim/15 text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground')}
          >
            <Sparkles className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> HD
          </Link>
        </div>
        <div className="h-0.5 bg-on-scrim/10" role="progressbar" aria-label="Okuma ilerlemesi" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={Math.round(shownProgress * 100)}>
          <div className="h-full origin-left bg-primary transition-transform duration-200" style={{ transform: `scaleX(${shownProgress})` }} />
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="pt-14">
        {mode === 'strip' ? (
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-3xl flex-col">
            {pages.map((src, i) => (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img key={src} src={src} alt={`${label}, sayfa ${i + 1} / ${pages.length}`} loading={i < 3 ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} decoding="async" className="mg-page block w-full select-none bg-on-scrim/[0.03]" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="relative mx-auto flex min-h-[calc(100dvh-3.5rem)] max-w-4xl items-center justify-center px-2 py-4">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => go(-1)} className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-10 w-1/3 cursor-w-resize" aria-label="Önceki sayfa" />
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img key={pages[page]} src={pages[page]} alt={`${label}, sayfa ${page + 1} / ${pages.length}`} className="mg-page-in max-h-[calc(100dvh-5.5rem)] w-auto max-w-full select-none object-contain" />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => go(1)} className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 z-10 w-1/3 cursor-e-resize" aria-label="Sonraki sayfa" />
            {/* Warm the next page so turning feels instant. */}
            {pages[page + 1] && <link rel="prefetch" as="image" href={pages[page + 1]} />}
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-scrim/80 px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-foreground/70 backdrop-blur">
              {page + 1} / {pages.length}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        <nav className={cn('mx-auto flex max-w-3xl flex-col items-center gap-6 px-4 py-16 text-center', mode === 'page' && page < pages.length - 1 && 'hidden')} aria-label="Bölüm gezintisi">
          <p className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-foreground/45">{label} bitti</p>
          <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
            {prevId ? (
              <Link href={`${base}/${prevId}${hqQuery}`} className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-on-scrim/15 px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:bg-on-scrim/5">
                <ChevronLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Önceki bölüm
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex-1" />
            )}
            {nextId ? (
              <Link href={`${base}/${nextId}${hqQuery}`} className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110">
                Sonraki bölüm <ChevronRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <Link href={`/manga/${manga.id}`} className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-scrim transition hover:opacity-90">
                Son bölüme ulaştın — seriye dön
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-foreground/40">Klavye: ← → ile bölümler arasında geç</p>
        </nav>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

 * En kolay yol: public/mascot/ klasöründeki görselleri AYNI İSİMLERLE kendi görsellerinle değiştir.

 * Adım adım anlatım ve canlı deneme: sitede /rehber sayfası.
 */

export const MASCOT = {
  /** Sitenin her yerinde geçen maskot adı. */
  name: 'Syra',
  /** Ruh hâline göre görseller. Şeffaf arka planlı, dikey (yaklaşık 3:4) görseller en iyi sonucu verir. */
  images: {
    /** El sallayan, karşılayan hâl — ana sayfa, giriş, tanıtım. */
    wave: '/mascot/syra-wave.webp',
    /** Kaybolmuş / şaşkın — 404 ve hata sayfaları. */
    lost: '/mascot/syra-lost.webp',

    secret: '/mascot/syra-secret.webp',

    portrait: '/mascot/syra-portrait.webp',
    /** Kare yüz kırpımı — avatarlar, yuvarlak rozetler. Kare (1:1) olmalı. */
    avatar: '/mascot/syra-avatar.webp',
  },
  /** Tema renklerine göre giydirilmiş versiyonlar (tanıtım sayfasındaki tema seçici). */
  themes: {
    green: '/mascot/syra-green.webp',

    mono: '/mascot/syra-mono.webp',
  } as Record<string, string>,

'use client'

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MASCOT, mascotImage, type MascotMood } from './mascot-config'

export const MASCOT_NAME = MASCOT.name

export type { MascotMood }

/** Resolves a mood to its image path; all paths live in mascot-config.ts. */
export function mascotSrc(mood: MascotMood | string = 'wave') {
  return mascotImage(mood)
}

type Props = {
  className?: string
  pose?: 'full' | 'bust' | 'portrait'
  mood?: MascotMood
  float?: boolean
  say?: string | null
  bubbleSide?: 'left' | 'right'
  priority?: boolean
  glow?: boolean
}

/**
 * Syra — the Sytheris mascot. `mood` picks the artwork, `pose` picks the crop:
 * `full` shows the waist-up artwork, `portrait` crops to the upper body, `bust` is a circular face crop.
 */
export function Mascot({ className, pose = 'full', mood = 'wave', float = false, say, bubbleSide = 'left', priority, glow }: Props) {
  const src = mascotSrc(pose === 'bust' ? 'avatar' : mood)

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'relative',
        pose === 'bust' && 'overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_50%_35%,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_45%,var(--scrim))_0%,var(--scrim)_75%)]',
        className,
      )}
    >
      {glow && pose !== 'bust' && (
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-[12%] bottom-[6%] top-[18%] rounded-full bg-primary/25 blur-3xl"
        />
      )}
      <motion.div
        className="relative size-full"
        animate={float ? { y: [0, -8, 0] } : undefined}
        transition={float ? { duration: 5, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' } : undefined}
      >
        <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
          <motion.img
            key={src}
            src={src}
            alt={pose === 'bust' ? '' : `${MASCOT_NAME}, Sytheris maskotu`}
            aria-hidden={pose === 'bust' ? true : undefined}
            draggable={false}
            fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : undefined}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(8px)' }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] }}
            className={cn(
              'absolute inset-0 size-full select-none',
              pose === 'full' && 'object-contain object-bottom drop-shadow-[0_30px_40px_rgb(0_0_0/0.35)]',
              pose === 'portrait' && 'object-cover object-top',
              pose === 'bust' && 'origin-[50%_40%] scale-[1.18] object-cover object-[50%_30%]',
            )}
          />
        </AnimatePresence>
      </motion.div>
      <AnimatePresence>
        {say && (
          <motion.div
            key={say}
            role="status"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.9 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6, scale: 0.95 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 26 }}
            className={cn(
              'absolute top-[8%] z-10 w-max max-w-[min(240px,60vw)] rounded-2xl border border-border bg-popover px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-popover-foreground shadow-xl',
              bubbleSide === 'left' ? 'right-[78%] rounded-br-sm' : 'left-[78%] rounded-bl-sm',
            )}
          >
            {say}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/**
 * Picks the sharpest landscape artwork available: the trailer's 1280x720 YouTube
 * thumbnail first, then the AniList banner, then a blurred cover as a last resort.
 */
export function backdropCandidates(media: MediaCard) {
  const list: { src: string; kind: 'yt' | 'banner' | 'cover' }[] = []
  if (media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' && media.trailer.id) list.push({ src: `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${media.trailer.id}/maxresdefault.jpg`, kind: 'yt' })
  if (media.bannerImage) list.push({ src: media.bannerImage, kind: 'banner' })
  const cover = media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large
  if (cover) list.push({ src: cover, kind: 'cover' })
  return list
}

export function BackdropImage({ media, className, priority }: { media: MediaCard; className?: string; priority?: boolean }) {
  const candidates = backdropCandidates(media)
  const [i, setI] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => setI(0), [media.id])
  const current = candidates[i]
  if (!current) return <div className={cn('absolute inset-0 bg-scrim', className)} />
  const isCover = current.kind === 'cover'
  return (
    <>
      {isCover && (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img src={current.src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" aria-hidden="true" className={cn('absolute inset-0 size-full scale-110 object-cover blur-2xl', className)} />
      )}
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img
        key={current.src}
        src={current.src || '/placeholder.svg'}
        alt=""
        aria-hidden="true"
        fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'}
        decoding="async"
        onLoad={(e) => {
          if (current.kind === 'yt' && e.currentTarget.naturalWidth <= 320) setI((n) => n + 1)
        }}
        onError={() => setI((n) => n + 1)}
        className={cn('absolute inset-0 size-full', isCover ? 'object-contain object-right py-10' : 'object-cover', className)}
      />
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const broken = new Set<string>()
function loadBroken() {
  try {
    for (const id of JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sy-yt-broken') || '[]')) broken.add(id)
  } catch {}
}
function markBroken(id: string) {
  broken.add(id)
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem('sy-yt-broken', JSON.stringify([...broken]))
  } catch {}
}
export function isTrailerBroken(id?: string | null) {
  if (!id) return true
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && broken.size === 0) loadBroken()
  return broken.has(id)
}

export type YTHandle = {
  mute: () => void
  unMute: () => void
  play: () => void
  pause: () => void
  restart: () => void
}

type Props = {
  videoId: string
  muted?: boolean
  start?: number
  fit?: 'cover' | 'crop'
  className?: string
  onPlaying?: () => void
  onError?: () => void
  onEnded?: () => void
  onProgress?: (time: number, duration: number) => void
  loop?: boolean
}

/**
 * Chrome-less YouTube trailer. Uses the IFrame postMessage protocol directly so we can
 * hide the iframe until the video is actually playing (no YouTube UI flashes) and detect
 * embed-blocked videos to fall back gracefully.
 */
export const YTTrailer = forwardRef<YTHandle, Props>(function YTTrailer(
  { videoId, muted = true, start = 0, fit = 'cover', className, onPlaying, onError, onEnded, onProgress, loop = true },
  ref,
) {
  const frame = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null)
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState('')
  const visibleRef = useRef(false)
  const cbs = useRef({ onPlaying, onError, onEnded, onProgress })
  cbs.current = { onPlaying, onError, onEnded, onProgress }

  useEffect(() => setOrigin(window.location.origin), [])

  const command = (func: string, args: unknown[] = []) => {
    frame.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'command', func, args }), '*')
  }

  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    mute: () => command('mute'),
    unMute: () => {
      command('unMute')
      command('setVolume', [70])
    },
    play: () => command('playVideo'),
    pause: () => {
      visibleRef.current = false
      setVisible(false)
      command('pauseVideo')
    },
    restart: () => {
      visibleRef.current = false
      setVisible(false)
      command('seekTo', [start, true])
      command('playVideo')
    },
  }))

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!origin) return
    let alive = true
    let listening = 0
    let revealedOnce = false
    let lastTime = 0
    let duration = 0
    let state = -1
    let revealTimer = 0
    // YouTube paints its title bar / channel avatar for ~3s whenever playback (re)starts,
    // and an end screen in the last second. Keep the frame invisible across those windows.
    const REVEAL_AFTER = 2.6

    const show = () => {
      if (!alive || visibleRef.current) return
      visibleRef.current = true
      setVisible(true)
      if (!revealedOnce) {
        revealedOnce = true
        cbs.current.onPlaying?.()
      }
    }
    const hide = () => {
      window.clearTimeout(revealTimer)
      revealTimer = 0
      if (!visibleRef.current) return
      visibleRef.current = false
      setVisible(false)
    }
    const scheduleReveal = (ms: number) => {
      if (revealTimer || visibleRef.current) return
      revealTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        revealTimer = 0
        if (state === 1) show()
      }, ms)
    }

    const ping = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (!frame.current?.contentWindow || listening > 40) return
      listening++
      frame.current.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'listening', id: videoId, channel: 'widget' }), '*')
    }, 250)
    const giveUp = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (alive && !revealedOnce && state !== 1) cbs.current.onError?.()
    }, 9000)

    const onMessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (e.source !== frame.current?.contentWindow) return
      if (typeof e.data !== 'string') return
      let data: { event?: string; info?: { playerState?: number; currentTime?: number; duration?: number } | number }
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(e.data)
      } catch {
        return
      }
      listening = 99
      if (data.event === 'onReady') {
        if (muted) command('mute')
        command('playVideo')
      }
      if (data.event === 'onError') {
        markBroken(videoId)
        hide()
        cbs.current.onError?.()
        return
      }

      const info = typeof data.info === 'object' && data.info ? data.info : null
      const nextState = data.event === 'onStateChange' ? (data.info as number) : info?.playerState
      if (typeof info?.duration === 'number' && info.duration > 0) duration = info.duration

      if (typeof nextState === 'number' && nextState !== state) {
        state = nextState
        if (state === 2 || state === 0 || state === 5) hide()
        if (state === 0) cbs.current.onEnded?.()
        if (state === 1) {
          // fresh start waits for the clock; a resume after pause only needs a short beat
          scheduleReveal(revealedOnce ? 1100 : 3200)
        }
      }

      if (typeof info?.currentTime === 'number') {
        const t = info.currentTime
        if (t + 2 < lastTime) {
          hide()
          scheduleReveal(3000)
        }
        lastTime = t
        if (duration && t > duration - 1.4) hide()
        else if (state === 1 && !revealedOnce && t >= start + REVEAL_AFTER) show()
        cbs.current.onProgress?.(t, duration)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', onMessage)
    return () => {
      alive = false
      window.clearInterval(ping)
      window.clearTimeout(giveUp)
      window.clearTimeout(revealTimer)
      window.removeEventListener('message', onMessage)
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [origin, videoId])

  if (!origin) return null

  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    autoplay: '1',
    mute: '1',
    controls: '0',
    disablekb: '1',
    fs: '0',
    iv_load_policy: '3',
    modestbranding: '1',
    playsinline: '1',
    rel: '0',
    showinfo: '0',
    enablejsapi: '1',
    cc_load_policy: '0',
    start: String(start),
    origin,
    widget_referrer: origin,
  })
  if (loop) {
    params.set('loop', '1')
    params.set('playlist', videoId)
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn('yt-wrap pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden', className)} aria-hidden="true">
      <iframe
        ref={frame}
        src={`https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${videoId}?${params.toString()}`}
        title="Fragman"
        allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"
        referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
        tabIndex={-1}
        className={cn(fit === 'cover' ? 'yt-cover' : 'yt-crop', 'transition-opacity duration-700', visible ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}
      />
    </div>
  )
})

import { isVideoMedia, resolveFrame } from '@/lib/membership'

import { Blossom, Bow, Pendant, RibbonDefs, Sparkle, StarGem, useRibbonPaint } from './ribbon-ornaments'

type Props = {
  src?: string | null
  name: string
  /** Accepts any stored value; anything other than `ribbon` renders unframed. */
  frame?: string | null

  ringWidth?: number

/**
 * The avatar box (0–120 in SVG units) is the photo; ornaments overflow it by 25% on every side.
 * Below ~52px the bow, blossom and pendant hide via a container query so header-sized avatars stay crisp.
 */
function RibbonRing() {
  const p = useRibbonPaint()
  return (
    <svg className="rb-avatar" viewBox="-30 -30 180 180" aria-hidden="true">
      <RibbonDefs p={p} />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="67.4" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${p.gold})`} strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray="0.01 8.82" className="rb-detail" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="65" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${p.gold})`} strokeWidth="1" opacity="0.9" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="61.6" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${p.gold})`} strokeWidth="4.4" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="61.6" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeOpacity="0.32" strokeWidth="0.6" strokeDasharray="0.5 7.5" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="58.4" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${p.gold})`} strokeWidth="0.9" />
      <StarGem p={p} x={60} y={-3.5} scale={1.05} />
      <g className="rb-detail">
        <Sparkle p={p} x={10} y={14} scale={0.75} />
        <Sparkle p={p} x={128} y={96} scale={0.6} />
        <Blossom p={p} x={112} y={20} rotate={18} scale={1.05} />
        <Pendant p={p} x={60} y={125.5} pearls={2} />
        <Pendant p={p} x={28} y={118} pearls={1} scale={0.85} />
        <Bow p={p} x={14} y={102} rotate={-24} scale={1.08} />
      </g>
    </svg>
  )
}

export function AvatarFrame({ src, name, frame, className = 'size-10' }: Props) {
  const f = resolveFrame(frame)
  return (
    <span className={cn('rb-frame', f === 'ribbon' && 'rb-frame-on', className)}>
      {src ? (
        isVideoMedia(src) ? (
          <video src={src} autoPlay muted loop playsInline className="rb-media" aria-label={name} />
        ) : (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={name} className="rb-media" loading="lazy" decoding="async" />
        )
      ) : (
        <span
          className="rb-media grid place-items-center bg-[linear-gradient(150deg,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_80%,white),var(--primary)_55%,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_60%,black))] font-bold uppercase text-primary-foreground [container-type:size]"
          aria-label={name}
          role="img"
        >
          <span className="leading-none" style={{ fontSize: '44cqw' }}>
            {name.slice(0, 1)}
          </span>
        </span>
      )}
      {f === 'ribbon' && <RibbonRing />}
    </span>
  )
}

const SIZE = { xs: '1.125rem', sm: '1.625rem', md: '2.5rem', lg: '3.5rem', xl: '4.5rem' } as const
type Size = keyof typeof SIZE

export function BadgeIcon({
  id,
  size = 'sm',
  showLabel = false,
  locked = false,
  tip = true,
  className,
}: {
  id: BadgeId
  size?: Size
  showLabel?: boolean
  locked?: boolean
  tip?: boolean
  className?: string
}) {
  const def = BADGES[id]
  if (!def) return null
  const Icon = ICONS[id]
  const rarity = RARITY[def.rarity]
  return (
    <span
      className={cn('group/badge relative inline-flex items-center gap-2 outline-none', className)}
      tabIndex={tip ? 0 : undefined}
      aria-label={`${def.name} rozeti, ${rarity.label}: ${def.description}`}
      role="img"
    >
      <span className={cn('bx', `bx-${def.rarity}`, locked && 'bx-locked')} style={{ '--bh': def.hue, '--bx-size': SIZE[size] } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <span className="bx-shape">
          <span className="bx-core">
            <Icon aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
        </span>
        {def.rarity === 'mythic' && size !== 'xs' && !locked && (
          <>
            <span className="bx-spark" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span className="bx-spark" aria-hidden="true" />
          </>
        )}
      </span>
      {showLabel && <span className="text-sm font-medium">{def.name}</span>}
      {tip && (
        <span className="bx-tip" style={{ '--bh': def.hue } as React.CSSProperties} aria-hidden="true">
          <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em]" style={{ color: `oklch(0.82 0.14 ${def.hue})` }}>
            {rarity.label}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold leading-tight">{def.name}</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] leading-snug opacity-70">{def.description}</span>
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  )
}

export function BadgeRow({ ids, size = 'sm', max = 8, className }: { ids: BadgeId[]; size?: Size; max?: number; className?: string }) {
  const sorted = sortBadges(ids)
  if (!sorted.length) return null
  const shown = sorted.slice(0, max)
  return (
    <span className={cn('flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5', className)}>
      {shown.map((b) => (
        <BadgeIcon key={b} id={b} size={size} />
      ))}
      {sorted.length > max && <span className="rounded-full bg-foreground/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">+{sorted.length - max}</span>}
    </span>
  )
}

'use client'

import { Popover } from '@/components/ui-kit/popover'
import { BADGES, RARITY, sortBadges, type BadgeId } from '@/lib/membership'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BadgeIcon } from './badge-icon'

/**
 * A single tidy row of a user's rarest badges. Everything beyond `max` folds into a "+N" chip
 * that opens the full, scrollable collection — so twenty badges never push the profile apart.
 */
export function BadgeTray({ ids, max = 5, className, tone = 'dark' }: { ids: BadgeId[]; max?: number; className?: string; tone?: 'dark' | 'light' }) {
  const sorted = sortBadges(ids)
  if (!sorted.length) return null
  const shown = sorted.slice(0, max)
  const hidden = sorted.length - shown.length

  return (
    <div className={cn('flex items-center justify-center gap-1', className)}>
      <ul className="flex items-center gap-1" aria-label={`Rozetler, toplam ${sorted.length}`}>
        {shown.map((b) => (
          <li key={b}>
            <BadgeIcon id={b} size="sm" />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {hidden > 0 && (
        <Popover
          label="Tüm rozetler"
          align="end"
          className="w-[min(92vw,22rem)]"
          trigger={({ open, toggle, ref }) => (
            <button
              ref={ref}
              type="button"
              onClick={toggle}
              aria-expanded={open}
              aria-label={`${hidden} rozet daha göster`}
              className={cn(
                'grid h-[1.625rem] min-w-[1.625rem] place-items-center rounded-full px-2 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums transition',
                tone === 'dark' ? 'bg-on-scrim/10 text-on-scrim/80 hover:bg-on-scrim/20' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
                open && 'ring-2 ring-primary',
              )}
            >
              +{hidden}
            </button>
          )}
        >
          {() => (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-3">
              <p className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-muted-foreground">
                Rozet koleksiyonu <span className="tabular-nums">{sorted.length}</span>
              </p>
              <ul className="grid max-h-80 grid-cols-1 gap-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {sorted.map((b) => (
                  <li key={b} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 transition hover:bg-muted/60">
                    <BadgeIcon id={b} size="sm" tip={false} />
                    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                      <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{BADGES[b].name}</span>
                      <span className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{BADGES[b].description}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em]" style={{ color: `oklch(0.72 0.14 ${BADGES[b].hue})` }}>
                      {RARITY[BADGES[b].rarity].label}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </Popover>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Frame layer drawn on top of the user's own banner image or video. */
export function BannerOverlayLayer({ overlay, className }: { overlay?: BannerOverlay | string | null; className?: string }) {
  if (resolveBannerOverlay({ bannerOverlay: overlay ?? null }) !== 'ribbon') return null
  return <RibbonBannerFrame className={className} />
}

/** Banner surface used by profile cards. The user's image or video is always the base; the frame sits on top. */
export function ProfileBanner({
  src,
  dim = 40,
  overlay,
  className,
}: {
  preset?: string | null
  src?: string | null
  dim?: number
  overlay?: BannerOverlay | string | null
  className?: string
}) {
  return (
    <div className={cn('relative overflow-hidden bg-scrim', className)}>
      {src ? (
        isVideoMedia(src) ? (
          <video src={src} autoPlay muted loop playsInline className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
        )
      ) : (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(120%_120%_at_0%_0%,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_45%,transparent),transparent_60%)]" />
      )}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-scrim" style={{ opacity: Math.min(0.9, dim / 100) * 0.6 }} />
      <BannerOverlayLayer overlay={overlay} />
    </div>
  )
}

function StateMark({ busy, on, open }: { busy: boolean; on: boolean; open: boolean }) {
  if (busy) return <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
  if (on)
    return (
      <span className="grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
        <Check className="size-3" strokeWidth={3} />
      </span>
    )
  if (!open) return <Lock className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
  return null
}

export function CosmeticsStudio({ look: initial, interactive = true }: { look: CosmeticLook; interactive?: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [, start] = useTransition()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>('frame')
  const [look, setLook] = useState<CosmeticLook>({
    ...initial,
    frame: resolveFrame(initial.frame),
    overlay: resolveBannerOverlay({ bannerOverlay: initial.overlay }),
    nameplate: resolveNameplate(initial.nameplate),
  })
  const [peek, setPeek] = useState<Partial<CosmeticLook>>({})
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const unlocked = (need: Tier) => TIER_RANK[look.tier] >= TIER_RANK[need]
  const shown = { ...look, ...peek }

  function apply<K extends ApplyKey>(key: K, value: string, need: Tier, label: string) {
    if (!interactive) {
      toast('Kozmetikleri kullanmak için giriş yap', { action: { label: 'Giriş', onClick: () => router.push('/giris') } })
      return
    }
    if (!unlocked(need)) {
      toast(`${label} ${TIER_LABEL[need]} gerektirir`, { action: { label: 'Planları gör', onClick: () => router.push('/abonelik') } })
      return
    }
    if (look[key] === value) return
    const prev = look[key]
    setLook((l) => ({ ...l, [key]: value }))
    setBusy(`${key}:${value}`)
    start(async () => {
      const res =
        key === 'frame'
          ? await setFrame(value as FrameId)
          : key === 'overlay'
            ? await setBannerOverlay(value as BannerOverlay)
            : key === 'nameplate'
              ? await setNameplate(value as Nameplate)
              : await setCommentColor(value as CommentColor)
      setBusy(null)
      if (!res.ok) {
        setLook((l) => ({ ...l, [key]: prev }))
        toast.error(res.error)
      } else {
        toast.success(`${label} uygulandı`)
        router.refresh()
      }
    })
  }

  const hover = (key: keyof CosmeticLook, value: string) => ({
    onPointerEnter: () => setPeek({ [key]: value } as Partial<CosmeticLook>),
    onPointerLeave: () => setPeek({}),
    onFocus: () => setPeek({ [key]: value } as Partial<CosmeticLook>),
    onBlur: () => setPeek({}),
  })

  const tile = (on: boolean) =>
    cn(
      'group relative flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border text-left outline-none transition duration-300 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary',
      on ? 'border-primary bg-accent/60 shadow-[0_10px_30px_-15px_var(--primary)]' : 'border-border bg-card hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-foreground/25',
    )

  const earned = new Set(look.badges)
  const banner = shown.background || SAMPLE_BANNER

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[360px_1fr] lg:items-start">
      <aside className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:sticky lg:top-24">
        <div className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[1.75rem] border border-border bg-scrim text-foreground shadow-[0_30px_80px_-30px_rgb(0_0_0/0.6)]">
          <ProfileBanner src={banner} overlay={shown.overlay} dim={25} className="h-40" />
          <div className="relative -mt-12 flex flex-col items-center gap-3 px-5 pb-7 text-center">
            <AvatarFrame src={shown.avatar} name={shown.name} frame={shown.frame} className="size-24" />
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">
                <NamePlate plate={shown.nameplate}>{shown.name}</NamePlate>
              </p>
              {shown.username && <p className="mt-3 font-mono text-xs text-foreground/50">@{shown.username}</p>}
            </div>
            {look.badges.length > 0 && <BadgeTray ids={look.badges} max={6} />}
            <p className="w-full border-l-2 border-foreground/15 pl-3 text-left text-sm leading-relaxed">
              <span className={commentInkClass(shown.commentColor)} style={commentInkStyle(shown.commentColor)}>
                {SAMPLE_COMMENT}
              </span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span>{Object.keys(peek).length ? 'Önizleme — uygulamak için tıkla' : 'Canlı önizleme'}</span>
          {interactive && (
            <Link href="/ayarlar?tab=profil" className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-ink hover:underline">
              <ImageIcon className="size-3.5" /> Afiş görselini değiştir
            </Link>
          )}
        </p>
      </aside>

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <p className="label-mono text-ink">Koleksiyon</p>
          <h3 className="text-balance text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            Kızıl Kurdele <span className="accent-serif">seti</span>
          </h3>
          <p className="max-w-xl text-pretty text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Gül altını pervaz, kızıl saten kurdeleler, yakut taşlar ve inci sarkıtlar. Avatarın, afişin ve ismin aynı takımı giyer.</p>
        </div>

        <div role="tablist" aria-label="Kozmetik kategorileri" className="scrollbar-none flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-full border border-border bg-card p-1">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={tab === t.id}
              onClick={() => {
                setTab(t.id)
                setPeek({})
              }}
              className={cn('relative flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition', tab === t.id ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
            >
              {tab === t.id && <motion.span layoutId="cx-tab" className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 34 }} />}
              <span className="relative">{t.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div key={tab} role="tabpanel" initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}>
            {tab === 'frame' && (
              <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {FRAMES.map((f) => {
                  const on = look.frame === f.id
                  return (
                    <li key={f.id}>
                      <button type="button" aria-pressed={on} onClick={() => apply('frame', f.id, f.tier, `${f.name} çerçevesi`)} {...hover('frame', f.id)} className={cn(tile(on), 'items-center gap-5 px-4 pb-6 pt-10 text-center')}>
                        <AvatarFrame src={look.avatar} name={look.name} frame={f.id} className="size-24 transition duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.04]" />
                        <span className="mt-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-base font-semibold">{f.name}</span>
                          <span className="max-w-[16rem] text-pretty text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{f.description}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="absolute right-3 top-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <TierChip tier={f.tier} />
                          <StateMark busy={busy === `frame:${f.id}`} on={on} open={unlocked(f.tier)} />

          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { resolveNameplate } from '@/lib/membership'

import { Pendant, RibbonDefs, useRibbonPaint } from './ribbon-ornaments'

function Cap({ side }: { side: 'left' | 'right' }) {
  const p = useRibbonPaint()
  return (
    <svg className={cn('rb-plate-cap', side === 'left' ? 'rb-plate-cap-l' : 'rb-plate-cap-r')} viewBox="-14 -14 28 28" aria-hidden="true">
      <RibbonDefs p={p} />
      <path d="M0 -13 L2 -2 L13 0 L2 2 L0 13 L-2 2 L-13 0 L-2 -2 Z" fill={`url(#${p.gold})`} />
      <path d="M0 -8 L5.2 0 L0 8 L-5.2 0 Z" fill={`url(#${p.ruby})`} stroke={`url(#${p.gold})`} strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      <path d="M-5.2 0 H5.2 M0 -8 V8" stroke="#fff" strokeOpacity="0.35" strokeWidth="0.45" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function Drop() {
  const p = useRibbonPaint()
  return (
    <svg className="rb-plate-drop" viewBox="-6 0 12 28" aria-hidden="true">
      <RibbonDefs p={p} />
      <Pendant p={p} x={0} y={0} pearls={1} scale={1.1} />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** Wraps a display name in the Kızıl Kurdele plate; any other stored value renders the name untouched. */
export function NamePlate({ plate, children, className }: { plate?: string | null; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  if (resolveNameplate(plate) !== 'ribbon') return <>{children}</>
  return (
    <span className={cn('rb-plate', className)}>
      <Cap side="left" />
      <span className="rb-plate-text">{children}</span>
      <Cap side="right" />
      <Drop />
    </span>
  )
}

import { useId } from 'react'

/*
 * "Kızıl Kurdele" ornament kit — rose-gold filigree, crimson satin bows, ruby drops and pearls.
 * Every cosmetic in the set (avatar frame, banner frame, nameplate) is assembled from these parts,
 * so they read as one family at any size. All paint comes from per-instance gradient ids.
 */

export type RibbonPaint = { gold: string; goldSoft: string; satin: string; satinDeep: string; ruby: string; pearl: string; cream: string }

export function useRibbonPaint(): RibbonPaint {
  const base = `rb${useId().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`
  return {
    gold: `${base}-gold`,
    goldSoft: `${base}-goldsoft`,
    satin: `${base}-satin`,
    satinDeep: `${base}-satindeep`,
    ruby: `${base}-ruby`,
    pearl: `${base}-pearl`,
    cream: `${base}-cream`,
  }
}

export function RibbonDefs({ p }: { p: RibbonPaint }) {
  return (
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id={p.gold} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#fff3dc" />
        <stop offset="0.22" stopColor="#efc597" />
        <stop offset="0.48" stopColor="#b9814f" />
        <stop offset="0.7" stopColor="#f6d9b0" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#94592f" />
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id={p.goldSoft} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#fff6e6" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#d8a876" />
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id={p.satin} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.4" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#f0535e" />
        <stop offset="0.45" stopColor="#c3172a" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#7c0918" />
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id={p.satinDeep} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#9e0f20" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#560510" />
      </linearGradient>
      <radialGradient id={p.ruby} cx="0.36" cy="0.3" r="0.8">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#ffb3b8" />
        <stop offset="0.35" stopColor="#e3213a" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#5e0410" />
      </radialGradient>
      <radialGradient id={p.pearl} cx="0.35" cy="0.3" r="0.75">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#ffffff" />
        <stop offset="0.55" stopColor="#f5e9df" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#c7a993" />
      </radialGradient>
      <linearGradient id={p.cream} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stopColor="#fffaf3" />
        <stop offset="1" stopColor="#f0d6bd" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
  )
}

const url = (id: string) => `url(#${id})`

      <path d="M2 2 C4 9.5 8 17.5 12.5 26 L7.5 25.2 L5.2 31 C3 22 1 12.5 -1 3 Z" fill={url(p.satinDeep)} stroke={url(p.gold)} strokeWidth="0.55" strokeLinejoin="round" />

      <path d="M-1 0 C-5 -5.5 -11.5 -9 -16.5 -7.5 C-12 -5 -6.5 -2 -1 0.8 Z" fill={url(p.satinDeep)} opacity="0.85" />

/** Faceted ruby set on a four-point gold star. */
export function StarGem({ p, x = 0, y = 0, scale = 1, className }: { p: RibbonPaint; x?: number; y?: number; scale?: number; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${scale})`} className={className}>
      <path d="M0 -12 L1.7 -1.7 L12 0 L1.7 1.7 L0 12 L-1.7 1.7 L-12 0 L-1.7 -1.7 Z" fill={url(p.gold)} />
      <path d="M0 -7.2 L4.6 0 L0 7.2 L-4.6 0 Z" fill={url(p.ruby)} stroke={url(p.gold)} strokeWidth="1" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      <path d="M-4.6 0 H4.6 M0 -7.2 L-1.4 0 L0 7.2 M0 -7.2 L1.4 0 L0 7.2" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeOpacity="0.38" strokeWidth="0.4" />
    </g>
  )
}

/** Small free-standing sparkle in gold. */
export function Sparkle({ p, x = 0, y = 0, scale = 1, className }: { p: RibbonPaint; x?: number; y?: number; scale?: number; className?: string }) {
  return <path transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${scale})`} d="M0 -6 C0.6 -1.2 1.2 -0.6 6 0 C1.2 0.6 0.6 1.2 0 6 C-0.6 1.2 -1.2 0.6 -6 0 C-1.2 -0.6 -0.6 -1.2 0 -6 Z" fill={url(p.goldSoft)} className={className} />
}

/** A strand of pearls ending in a long ruby drop. Hangs downwards from (x, y). */
export function Pendant({ p, x = 0, y = 0, pearls = 2, scale = 1, className }: { p: RibbonPaint; x?: number; y?: number; pearls?: number; scale?: number; className?: string }) {
  const gemTop = pearls * 4.6 + 1.5
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${scale})`} className={className}>
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2={gemTop} stroke={url(p.gold)} strokeWidth="0.6" />
      {Array.from({ length: pearls }, (_, i) => (
        <circle key={i} cx="0" cy={2.4 + i * 4.6} r="1.85" fill={url(p.pearl)} stroke="#b89176" strokeWidth="0.25" />
      ))}
      <circle cx="0" cy={gemTop + 0.6} r="1.2" fill={url(p.gold)} />
      <path d={`M0 ${gemTop + 1.2} L2.7 ${gemTop + 5.6} L0 ${gemTop + 14.5} L-2.7 ${gemTop + 5.6} Z`} fill={url(p.ruby)} stroke={url(p.gold)} strokeWidth="0.55" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      <path d={`M-2.7 ${gemTop + 5.6} H2.7 M0 ${gemTop + 1.2} V${gemTop + 14.5}`} stroke="#fff" strokeOpacity="0.35" strokeWidth="0.35" />
    </g>
  )
}

/** Five-petal cream blossom with gold leaves, used as a counterweight to the bow. */
export function Blossom({ p, x = 0, y = 0, rotate = 0, scale = 1, className }: { p: RibbonPaint; x?: number; y?: number; rotate?: number; scale?: number; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${rotate}) scale(${scale})`} className={className}>
      <path d="M2 2 C6 -1 11 0 14 4 C10 5.5 5.5 5 2 2 Z" fill={url(p.gold)} />
      <path d="M-2 2 C-5 6 -5 11 -2 14 C-0.5 10 -0.6 5.5 -2 2 Z" fill={url(p.gold)} />
      {[0, 72, 144, 216, 288].map((a) => (
        <ellipse key={a} cx="0" cy="-4" rx="2.7" ry="4.3" transform={`rotate(${a})`} fill={url(p.cream)} stroke={url(p.gold)} strokeWidth="0.45" />
      ))}
      <circle r="2" fill={url(p.gold)} />
      <circle r="0.8" cx="-0.5" cy="-0.5" fill="#fff6e6" />
    </g>
  )
}

/** Gold scroll for frame corners; drawn for the top-left corner, rotate for the others. */
export function Filigree({ p, x = 0, y = 0, rotate = 0, scale = 1, className }: { p: RibbonPaint; x?: number; y?: number; rotate?: number; scale?: number; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${rotate}) scale(${scale})`} className={className} fill="none" stroke={url(p.gold)} strokeLinecap="round">
      <path d="M0 22 C0 9 9 0 22 0" strokeWidth="1.6" />

      <circle cx="3.2" cy="3.2" r="2.2" fill={url(p.pearl)} stroke="none" />
    </g>
  )
}

/** Long satin ribbon that falls in soft waves from a bow and ends in a swallow-tail cut. Drawn in a 24 × 104 box. */

'use client'

import { Music2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useMusic } from './music-provider'

export function Equalizer({ playing, className }: { playing: boolean; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={cn('flex h-3.5 items-end gap-[2px]', className)} aria-hidden="true">
      {[0.2, 0.5, 0.1, 0.35].map((d, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className={cn('w-[3px] rounded-full bg-current', playing ? 'eq-bar' : '')}
          style={{ height: playing ? '100%' : `${[40, 70, 55, 30][i]}%`, animationDelay: `${d}s` }}
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  )
}

export function MusicButton() {
  const { playing, setPanelOpen, current } = useMusic()
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setPanelOpen(true)}
      aria-label={playing ? `Çalıyor: ${current?.title ?? ''}. Müzik panelini aç` : 'Müzik panelini aç'}
      className={cn(
        'flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 transition',
        playing ? 'border-primary/40 bg-accent text-ink' : 'border-border bg-card/60 text-muted-foreground hover:border-primary/50 hover:text-foreground',
      )}
    >
      {playing ? <Equalizer playing /> : <Music2 className="size-4" />}
      <span className="hidden font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] xl:inline">{playing ? 'Çalıyor' : 'Müzik'}</span>
    </button>
  )
}

'use client'

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { Music2, Pause, Play, SkipBack, SkipForward } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useMusic } from './music-provider'

export function MusicMiniPlayer({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const m = useMusic()
  const visible = Boolean(m.current) && (m.playing || m.progress > 0) && !m.panelOpen

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {visible && m.current && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.96 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.96 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 26, stiffness: 300 }}
          className={cn(
            'fixed z-50 flex w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] max-w-xs items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-popover/80 p-2 shadow-2xl shadow-scrim/20 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150',
            className,
          )}
          role="region"
          aria-label="Müzik çalar"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => m.setPanelOpen(true)}
            className="relative size-11 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-muted"
            aria-label="Müzik panelini aç"
          >
            {m.current.cover ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img
                src={m.current.cover}
                alt=""
                className={cn('size-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700', m.playing && 'scale-110')}
              />
            ) : (
              <Music2 className="absolute inset-0 m-auto size-5 text-muted-foreground" />
            )}
          </button>

          <button type="button" onClick={() => m.setPanelOpen(true)} className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium leading-tight text-foreground">{m.current.title}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-xs leading-tight text-muted-foreground">{m.current.artist}</p>
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={m.prev}
              aria-label="Önceki parça"
              className="hidden size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground sm:grid"
            >
              <SkipBack className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={m.toggle}
              aria-label={m.playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
              className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-md transition hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95"
            >
              {m.playing ? <Pause className="size-4" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={m.next}
              aria-label="Sonraki parça"
              className="hidden size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground sm:grid"
            >
              <SkipForward className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-0.5 bg-foreground/10">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-primary transition-[width] duration-300"
              style={{ width: m.duration ? `${Math.min(100, (m.progress / m.duration) * 100)}%` : '0%' }}
            />
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
