const SUGGESTIONS = ['Unravel', 'Gurenge', 'Blue Bird', 'Idol', 'Kick Back', 'Again', 'Silhouette', 'Shinzou wo Sasageyo', 'Yuusha', 'Specialz']

type Source = 'anime' | 'song'
const SOURCES: { id: Source; label: string; note: string }[] = [
  { id: 'anime', label: 'Anime OP / ED', note: 'AnimeThemes · tam sürüm' },
  { id: 'song', label: 'Tüm şarkılar', note: 'YouTube · tam sürüm' },
]

export function fmtTime(s: number) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(s) || s < 0) return '0:00'
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
  return `${m}:${String(Math.floor(s % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

export function useMusicSearch(q: string, source: Source, strict = false) {
  const dq = useDebounced(q.trim(), 300)
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR<{ results: Track[] }>(dq.length > 1 ? `/api/music/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(dq)}&source=${source}${strict ? '&strict=1' : ''}` : null, fetcher, {
    keepPreviousData: true,
  })
  return { results: dq.length > 1 ? (data?.results ?? []) : [], isLoading: isLoading && dq.length > 1 }
}

export function MusicSearch({
  onPick,
  onQueueNext,
  pickLabel = 'Ekle',
  pickedIds = [],
  sources = ['anime', 'song'],
}: {
  onPick: (t: Track) => void
  onQueueNext?: (t: Track) => void
  pickLabel?: string
  pickedIds?: string[]
  sources?: Source[]
}) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [source, setSource] = useState<Source>(sources[0])
  const { results, isLoading } = useMusicSearch(q, source, sources.length === 1 && sources[0] === 'anime')
  const player = useMusic()
  const available = SOURCES.filter((s) => sources.includes(s.id))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
        <input
          type="search"
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Şarkı, sanatçı veya anime adı…"
          aria-label="Müzik ara"
          className="h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background pl-11 pr-10 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary"
        />
        {isLoading && <Loader2 className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />}
      </div>
      {available.length > 1 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-2xl bg-muted p-1" role="tablist" aria-label="Kaynak">
          {available.map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s.id}
              role="tab"
              type="button"
              aria-selected={source === s.id}
              onClick={() => setSource(s.id)}
              className={cn('flex flex-col items-center rounded-xl py-2 transition', source === s.id ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
            >
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold">{s.label}</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider opacity-60">{s.note}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {q.trim().length < 2 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
            <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => setQ(s)} className="rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition hover:border-primary hover:text-ink">
              {s}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : results.length === 0 && !isLoading ? (
        <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Sonuç bulunamadı. {available.length > 1 ? 'Diğer kaynağı dene.' : 'Farklı bir ad dene.'}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          {results.map((t) => {
            const picked = pickedIds.includes(t.id)
            const isCurrent = player.current?.id === t.id && player.playing
            return (
              <li key={t.id} className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-2 transition hover:bg-muted">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => (isCurrent ? player.pause() : player.play(t))}
                  className={cn('relative shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-muted', t.source === 'youtube' ? 'aspect-video h-12' : 'size-12')}
                  aria-label={isCurrent ? `${t.title} duraklat` : `${t.title} şimdi çal`}
                >
                  {t.cover ? (
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                    <img src={t.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
                  ) : (
                    <Music2 className="m-auto size-5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
                  )}
                  <span className={cn('absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-scrim/55 text-on-scrim transition', isCurrent ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100')}>
                    {isCurrent ? <Equalizer playing className="h-3.5" /> : <Play className="size-4 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />}
                  </span>
                </button>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="line-clamp-1 text-sm font-medium">{t.title}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {t.artist}
                    {t.anime ? ` · ${t.anime}` : ''}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {t.kind && <span className="hidden rounded-full bg-accent px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase text-ink sm:inline">{t.kind}</span>}
                {onQueueNext && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onQueueNext(t)}
                    aria-label={`${t.title} sıradaki olarak çal`}
                    title="Sıradaki olarak çal"
                    className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border text-muted-foreground transition hover:border-primary hover:text-ink"
                  >
                    <ListPlus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPick(t)}
                  disabled={picked}
                  aria-label={picked ? `${t.title} listede` : `${t.title} ${pickLabel}`}
                  title={picked ? 'Listede' : 'Sona ekle'}
                  className={cn(
                    'grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border transition',
                    picked ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink',
                  )}
                >
                  {picked ? <Check className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
                </button>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function ArtStack({ cover, playing }: { cover?: string | null; playing: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="relative mx-auto h-56 w-full max-w-[19rem]">
      <motion.div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute left-[18%] top-1/2 aspect-square h-[88%] -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-scrim shadow-[0_24px_60px_-18px_rgb(0_0_0/0.7)]"
        style={{ backgroundImage: 'repeating-radial-gradient(circle at center, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.07) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px)' }}
        animate={{ x: playing ? '42%' : '8%', rotate: playing ? 360 : 0 }}
        transition={{
          x: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 90, damping: 16 },
          rotate: playing ? { duration: 5, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' } : { duration: 0.6 },
        }}
      >
        <span className="absolute inset-[32%] overflow-hidden rounded-full ring-4 ring-scrim">
          {cover ? (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img src={cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <span className="block size-full bg-primary" />
          )}
        </span>
        <span className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 size-2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-on-scrim/80" />
        <span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-[conic-gradient(from_200deg,transparent_0deg,oklch(1_0_0/0.14)_30deg,transparent_70deg,transparent_180deg,oklch(1_0_0/0.08)_210deg,transparent_250deg)]" />
      </motion.div>
      <motion.div
        className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 aspect-square h-full -translate-y-1/2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-muted shadow-[0_30px_60px_-20px_rgb(0_0_0/0.65)] ring-1 ring-foreground/10"
        animate={{ scale: playing ? 1 : 0.96 }}
        transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 160, damping: 18 }}
      >
        {cover ? (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
        ) : (
          <span className="grid size-full place-items-center bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Music2 className="size-10" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
        )}
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr from-transparent via-transparent to-on-scrim/15" />
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Scrubber({ value, max, onChange, disabled, label, showTip }: { value: number; max: number; onChange: (v: number) => void; disabled?: boolean; label: string; showTip?: boolean }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const pct = max ? Math.min(100, (value / max) * 100) : 0
  return (
    <div
      className="group relative flex h-5 items-center"
      onPointerMove={(e) => {
        if (!showTip || !max) return
        const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
        setHover(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width)))
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
    >
      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-foreground/10 transition-[height] group-hover:h-1.5">
        {hover !== null && <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-foreground/15" style={{ width: `${hover * 100}%` }} />}
        <div className="relative h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
      </div>
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-primary opacity-0 shadow ring-4 ring-primary/25 transition group-hover:opacity-100" style={{ left: `${pct}%` }} />
      {hover !== null && showTip && (
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-7 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] tabular-nums text-background" style={{ left: `${hover * 100}%` }}>
          {fmtTime(hover * max)}
        </span>
      )}
      <input
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={max || 0}
        step={0.1}
        value={Math.min(value, max || 0)}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-valuetext={showTip ? `${fmtTime(value)} / ${fmtTime(max)}` : `${Math.round(pct)}%`}
        disabled={disabled}
        className="absolute inset-0 w-full cursor-pointer opacity-0 disabled:cursor-default"
      />
    </div>
  )
}

function Visualizer({ playing }: { playing: boolean }) {
  const bars = [0.5, 0.8, 0.35, 0.9, 0.6, 0.4, 0.75, 0.3, 0.85, 0.55, 0.45, 0.7, 0.25, 0.65, 0.5, 0.8, 0.4, 0.6]
  return (
    <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-6 items-end justify-center gap-[3px]">
      {bars.map((h, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className={cn('w-[3px] rounded-full bg-primary/70', playing && 'eq-bar')}
          style={{ height: playing ? `${h * 100}%` : '12%', animationDelay: `${(i % 6) * 0.11}s`, animationDuration: `${0.7 + (i % 4) * 0.15}s` }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function QueueRow({ t, index, total, active }: { t: Track; index: number; total: number; active: boolean }) {
  const m = useMusic()
  return (
    <motion.li
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 24 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 34 }}
      className={cn('group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-2 transition-colors', active ? 'bg-accent' : 'hover:bg-muted')}
    >
      <button type="button" onClick={() => (active ? m.toggle() : m.play(t))} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-left" aria-label={active ? `${t.title} ${m.playing ? 'duraklat' : 'oynat'}` : `${t.title} çal`}>
        <span className="w-5 text-center font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{active && m.playing ? <Equalizer playing className="mx-auto h-3 text-ink" /> : index + 1}</span>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={t.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
        <span className="min-w-0">
          <span className={cn('block truncate text-sm font-medium', active && 'text-ink')}>{t.title}</span>
          <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {t.artist} · {t.source === 'youtube' ? 'YouTube' : 'AnimeThemes'}
          </span>
        </span>
      </button>
      <div className="flex items-center opacity-100 transition sm:opacity-0 sm:group-focus-within:opacity-100 sm:group-hover:opacity-100">
        {!active && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => m.playNext(t)} aria-label={`${t.title} sıradaki yap`} title="Sıradaki yap" className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground">
            <ListEnd className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        )}
        <button type="button" disabled={index === 0} onClick={() => m.move(t.id, -1)} aria-label={`${t.title} yukarı taşı`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30">
          <ArrowUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
        <button type="button" disabled={index === total - 1} onClick={() => m.move(t.id, 1)} aria-label={`${t.title} aşağı taşı`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30">
          <ArrowDown className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => m.remove(t.id)} aria-label={`${t.title} kaldır`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
          <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.li>
  )
}

export function MusicPanel() {
  const m = useMusic()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'queue' | 'search'>('queue')
  const VolIcon = m.volume === 0 ? VolumeX : m.volume < 0.5 ? Volume1 : Volume2
  const currentIndex = m.playlist.findIndex((t) => t.id === m.current?.id)
  const upNext = currentIndex >= 0 ? m.playlist[currentIndex + 1] : m.playlist[0]

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const typing = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input, textarea')
    if (typing && (e.target as HTMLInputElement).type !== 'range') return
    if (e.key === ' ' && !(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) {
      e.preventDefault()
      m.toggle()
    }
  }

  const add = (t: Track) => {
    m.add(t)
    toast.success('Listeye eklendi', { description: t.title, id: `add-${t.id}` })
  }
  const queueNext = (t: Track) => {
    m.playNext(t)
    toast.success('Sıradaki parça ayarlandı', { description: t.title, id: `next-${t.id}` })
  }

  return (
    <Modal open={m.panelOpen} onClose={() => m.setPanelOpen(false)} title="Müzik" side="right" className="sm:max-w-md">
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-5 overflow-y-auto px-5 pb-8 pt-4 sm:px-6 [&>*]:shrink-0" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
        <section aria-label="Şimdi çalan" className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[1.75rem] bg-scrim px-5 pb-5 pt-6 text-on-scrim ring-1 ring-on-scrim/10">
          <AnimatePresence>
            {m.current?.cover && (
              <motion.img
                key={m.current.cover}
                src={m.current.cover}
                alt=""
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 0.45 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.8 }}
                className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 size-full scale-150 object-cover blur-3xl saturate-150"
              />
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
          <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-scrim/40 to-scrim" />
          <div aria-hidden="true" className="grain absolute inset-0 -z-10" />

          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="label-mono flex items-center gap-2 text-[9px] text-primary">
              {m.buffering ? <Loader2 className="size-3 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <span className={cn('size-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary', m.playing && 'animate-pulse')} />}
              {m.buffering ? 'Yükleniyor' : m.playing ? 'Şimdi çalıyor' : m.current ? 'Duraklatıldı' : 'Sessizlik'}
            </p>
            {m.current && (
              <span className="rounded-full border border-on-scrim/15 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-widest text-on-scrim/70">
                {m.current.kind ?? (m.current.source === 'youtube' ? 'YouTube' : 'AnimeThemes')}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <ArtStack cover={m.current?.cover} playing={m.playing} />

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-1">
            <p className="line-clamp-2 text-balance text-xl font-bold leading-tight tracking-tight">{m.current?.title ?? 'Bir parça seç'}</p>
            <p className="line-clamp-1 text-sm text-on-scrim/65">{m.current ? `${m.current.artist}${m.current.anime ? ` · ${m.current.anime}` : ''}` : 'Keşfet sekmesinden ara, sıraya ekle, tam sürümünü dinle.'}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4">
            <Visualizer playing={m.playing && !m.buffering} />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-1">
            <Scrubber value={m.progress} max={m.duration} onChange={m.seek} disabled={!m.current} label="İlerleme" showTip />
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono text-[10px] tabular-nums text-on-scrim/55">
              <span>{fmtTime(m.progress)}</span>
              <span>-{fmtTime(Math.max(0, m.duration - m.progress))}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => m.setShuffle(!m.shuffle)} aria-pressed={m.shuffle} aria-label="Karışık çal" className={cn('grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition', m.shuffle ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary' : 'text-on-scrim/60 hover:text-on-scrim')}>
              <Shuffle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={m.prev} aria-label="Önceki" className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <SkipBack className="size-5 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
              <motion.button
                type="button"
                onClick={m.toggle}
                aria-label={m.playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.92 }}
                className="grid size-16 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim text-scrim shadow-[0_12px_40px_-10px_var(--primary)] transition hover:scale-105"
              >
                {m.playing ? <Pause className="size-6 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Play className="ml-1 size-6 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />}
              </motion.button>
              <button type="button" onClick={m.next} aria-label="Sonraki" className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <SkipForward className="size-5 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => m.setRepeat(!m.repeat)} aria-pressed={m.repeat} aria-label="Bu parçayı tekrarla" className={cn('grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition', m.repeat ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary' : 'text-on-scrim/60 hover:text-on-scrim')}>
              {m.repeat ? <Repeat1 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Repeat className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => m.setVolume(m.volume === 0 ? 0.6 : 0)} aria-label={m.volume === 0 ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'} className="text-on-scrim/60 hover:text-on-scrim">
              <VolIcon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
            <div className="flex-1">
              <Scrubber value={m.volume} max={1} onChange={m.setVolume} label="Ses düzeyi" />
            </div>
            <span className="w-8 text-right font-mono text-[10px] tabular-nums text-on-scrim/55">{Math.round(m.volume * 100)}</span>
          </div>

          {upNext && upNext.id !== m.current?.id && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-on-scrim/[0.06] p-2.5">
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img src={upNext.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-9 rounded-lg object-cover" />
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="label-mono block text-[8px] text-on-scrim/50">Sıradaki</span>
                <span className="block truncate text-[13px] font-medium">{upNext.title}</span>
              </span>
              <button type="button" onClick={m.next} aria-label="Sıradakine geç" className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-on-scrim/70 transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 hover:text-on-scrim">
                <SkipForward className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-2xl bg-muted p-1" role="tablist" aria-label="Müzik bölümleri">
          <button role="tab" type="button" aria-selected={tab === 'queue'} onClick={() => setTab('queue')} className={cn('flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition', tab === 'queue' ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
            <ListMusic className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Sıra ({m.playlist.length})
          </button>
          <button role="tab" type="button" aria-selected={tab === 'search'} onClick={() => setTab('search')} className={cn('flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition', tab === 'search' ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
            <Search className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Keşfet
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === 'search' ? (
          <MusicSearch onPick={add} onQueueNext={queueNext} pickedIds={m.playlist.map((t) => t.id)} />
        ) : m.playlist.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border p-8 text-center">
            <Music2 className="size-8 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Sıran boş. Bir anime açılışı ya da sevdiğin bir şarkıyı bul; tam sürümü burada çalar.</p>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab('search')} className="rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
              Şarkı ara
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
              <p className="label-mono text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Çalma sırası</p>
              {m.playlist.length > 1 && (
                <button type="button" onClick={m.clear} className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-destructive">
                  Sırayı temizle
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                {m.playlist.map((t, i) => (
                  <QueueRow key={t.id} t={t} index={i} total={m.playlist.length} active={m.current?.id === t.id} />
                ))}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}
        <p className="text-center font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">AnimeThemes · YouTube — tam sürüm, site içinde · Boşluk: oynat/duraklat</p>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

'use client'

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'

export type Track = {
  id: string
  title: string
  artist: string
  url: string
  cover?: string | null
  source: 'animethemes' | 'itunes' | 'youtube'
  anime?: string | null
  kind?: string | null
}

type Ctx = {
  playlist: Track[]
  current: Track | null
  playing: boolean
  buffering: boolean
  progress: number
  duration: number
  volume: number
  shuffle: boolean
  repeat: boolean
  panelOpen: boolean
  setPanelOpen: (v: boolean) => void
  play: (t?: Track) => void
  pause: () => void
  toggle: () => void
  next: () => void
  prev: () => void
  seek: (t: number) => void
  setVolume: (v: number) => void
  add: (t: Track) => void
  playNext: (t: Track) => void
  move: (id: string, dir: -1 | 1) => void
  clear: () => void
  remove: (id: string) => void
  setShuffle: (v: boolean) => void
  setRepeat: (v: boolean) => void
}

type YTPlayer = {
  loadVideoById: (id: string) => void
  playVideo: () => void
  pauseVideo: () => void
  stopVideo: () => void
  seekTo: (s: number, allow: boolean) => void
  setVolume: (v: number) => void
  getCurrentTime: () => number
  getDuration: () => number
  getPlayerState: () => number
}

type YTNamespace = {
  Player: new (
    el: HTMLElement,
    opts: {
      width: number
      height: number
      playerVars: Record<string, number | string>
      events: { onReady: () => void; onStateChange: (e: { data: number }) => void; onError: (e: { data: number }) => void }
    },
  ) => YTPlayer
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    YT?: YTNamespace
    onYouTubeIframeAPIReady?: () => void
  }
}

let ytReady: Promise<YTNamespace> | null = null
function loadYT() {
  if (ytReady) return ytReady
  ytReady = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (window.YT?.Player) return resolve(window.YT)
    const prev = window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady
    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = () => {
      prev?.()
      if (window.YT) resolve(window.YT)
    }
    const s = document.createElement('script')
    s.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api'
    s.async = true
    s.onerror = () => {
      ytReady = null
      reject(new Error('YouTube yüklenemedi'))
    }
    document.head.appendChild(s)
  })
  return ytReady
}

const isYT = (t: Track) => t.source === 'youtube' || t.url.startsWith('yt:')
const ytId = (t: Track) => t.url.replace(/^yt:/, '')

const MusicCtx = createContext<Ctx | null>(null)

export function MusicProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null)
  const ytRef = useRef<YTPlayer | null>(null)
  const ytHost = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const engine = useRef<'audio' | 'yt'>('audio')
  const [playlist, setPlaylist] = useState<Track[]>([])
  const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [buffering, setBuffering] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [volume, setVolumeState] = useState(0.6)
  const [shuffle, setShuffle] = useState(false)
  const [repeat, setRepeat] = useState(false)
  const [panelOpen, setPanelOpen] = useState(false)
  const stateRef = useRef({ playlist, currentId, shuffle, repeat, volume })
  stateRef.current = { playlist, currentId, shuffle, repeat, volume }
  const nextRef = useRef(() => {})
  const failures = useRef(0)

  const onEnded = useCallback(() => {
    if (stateRef.current.repeat) {
      if (engine.current === 'yt') {
        ytRef.current?.seekTo(0, true)
        ytRef.current?.playVideo()
      } else if (audioRef.current) {
        audioRef.current.currentTime = 0
        audioRef.current.play().catch(() => {})
      }
    } else nextRef.current()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sy-playlist') || '[]') as Track[]
      setPlaylist(saved.filter((t) => t.source !== 'itunes'))
      const v = Number(localStorage.getItem('sy-volume'))
      if (!Number.isNaN(v) && v > 0) setVolumeState(v)
    } catch {}
    const audio = new Audio()
    audio.preload = 'metadata'
    audioRef.current = audio
    const onTime = () => engine.current === 'audio' && setProgress(audio.currentTime)
    const onMeta = () => engine.current === 'audio' && setDuration(audio.duration || 0)
    const onPlay = () => engine.current === 'audio' && setPlaying(true)
    const onPause = () => engine.current === 'audio' && setPlaying(false)
    const onWaiting = () => setBuffering(true)
    const onPlaying = () => setBuffering(false)
    const onEnd = () => engine.current === 'audio' && onEnded()
    const onError = () => {
      if (engine.current !== 'audio' || !audio.src) return
      setPlaying(false)
      setBuffering(false)
      toast.error('Bu parça çalınamadı', { description: 'Kaynak şu an yanıt vermiyor, sıradakine geçebilirsin.' })
    }
    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    audio.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    audio.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    audio.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
    audio.addEventListener('playing', onPlaying)
    audio.addEventListener('ended', onEnd)
    audio.addEventListener('error', onError)

    const host = document.createElement('div')
    host.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
    host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-10000px;bottom:0;width:200px;height:200px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;'
    const inner = document.createElement('div')
    host.appendChild(inner)
    document.body.appendChild(host)
    ytHost.current = inner

    const onExternal = () => {
      audio.pause()
      ytRef.current?.pauseVideo()
    }
    window.addEventListener('sy:pause-music', onExternal)
    return () => {
      audio.pause()
      audio.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      audio.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      audio.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      audio.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
      audio.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
      audio.removeEventListener('playing', onPlaying)
      audio.removeEventListener('ended', onEnd)
      audio.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      window.removeEventListener('sy:pause-music', onExternal)
      host.remove()
    }
  }, [onEnded])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (panelOpen) loadYT().catch(() => {})
  }, [panelOpen])

  // YouTube has no timeupdate event, so poll while it plays.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing || engine.current !== 'yt') return
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      const p = ytRef.current
      if (!p) return
      setProgress(p.getCurrentTime() || 0)
      setDuration(p.getDuration() || 0)
    }, 400)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [playing, currentId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (audioRef.current) audioRef.current.volume = volume
    ytRef.current?.setVolume(Math.round(volume * 100))
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('sy-volume', String(volume))
    } catch {}
  }, [volume])

  const persist = (list: Track[]) => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('sy-playlist', JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, 100)))
    } catch {}
  }

  const ensureYT = useCallback(async () => {
    if (ytRef.current) return ytRef.current
    const YT = await loadYT()
    const host = ytHost.current
    if (!host) throw new Error('host yok')
    return new Promise<YTPlayer>((resolve) => {
      const player = new YT.Player(host, {
        width: 200,
        height: 200,
        playerVars: { autoplay: 0, controls: 0, disablekb: 1, playsinline: 1, rel: 0, origin: window.location.origin },
        events: {
          onReady: () => {
            ytRef.current = player
            player.setVolume(Math.round(stateRef.current.volume * 100))
            resolve(player)
          },
          onStateChange: (e) => {
            if (engine.current !== 'yt') return
            // 1 playing, 2 paused, 0 ended, 3 buffering
            if (e.data === 1) {
              failures.current = 0
              setPlaying(true)
              setBuffering(false)
              setDuration(player.getDuration() || 0)
            } else if (e.data === 2) setPlaying(false)
            else if (e.data === 3) setBuffering(true)
            else if (e.data === 0) {
              setPlaying(false)
              onEnded()
            }
          },
          onError: () => {
            setPlaying(false)
            setBuffering(false)
            failures.current += 1
            const canSkip = stateRef.current.playlist.length > 1 && failures.current < 3
            toast.error('Bu video sitede oynatılamıyor', {
              id: 'yt-error',
              description: canSkip ? 'Sanatçı gömülü oynatmayı kapatmış olabilir. Sıradakine geçiliyor.' : 'Sanatçı gömülü oynatmayı kapatmış olabilir. Başka bir sürüm dene.',
            })
            if (canSkip) window.setTimeout(() => nextRef.current(), 1200)
          },
        },
      })
    })
  }, [onEnded])

  const load = useCallback(
    async (t: Track) => {
      const audio = audioRef.current
      if (!audio) return
      setCurrentId(t.id)
      setProgress(0)
      setDuration(0)
      if (isYT(t)) {
        engine.current = 'yt'
        audio.pause()
        setBuffering(true)
        try {
          const p = await ensureYT()
          p.loadVideoById(ytId(t))
          p.playVideo()
        } catch {
          setBuffering(false)
          toast.error('YouTube oynatıcısı yüklenemedi', { description: 'Reklam engelleyici YouTube’u engelliyor olabilir.' })
        }
        return
      }
      engine.current = 'audio'
      ytRef.current?.pauseVideo()
      if (audio.src !== t.url) audio.src = t.url
      audio.play().catch(() => setPlaying(false))
    },
    [ensureYT],
  )

  const add = useCallback((t: Track) => {
    setPlaylist((list) => {
      if (list.some((x) => x.id === t.id)) return list
      const next = [...list, t]
      persist(next)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const playNext = useCallback((t: Track) => {
    setPlaylist((list) => {
      const without = list.filter((x) => x.id !== t.id)
      const at = without.findIndex((x) => x.id === stateRef.current.currentId)
      const next = [...without.slice(0, at + 1), t, ...without.slice(at + 1)]
      persist(next)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const move = useCallback((id: string, dir: -1 | 1) => {
    setPlaylist((list) => {
      const i = list.findIndex((x) => x.id === id)
      const j = i + dir
      if (i < 0 || j < 0 || j >= list.length) return list
      const next = [...list]
      ;[next[i], next[j]] = [next[j], next[i]]
      persist(next)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const play = useCallback(
    (t?: Track) => {
      if (t) {
        add(t)
        void load(t)
        return
      }
      const { playlist: list, currentId: cid } = stateRef.current
      const cur = list.find((x) => x.id === cid)
      if (cur && cid) {
        if (engine.current === 'yt') ytRef.current?.playVideo()
        else audioRef.current?.play().catch(() => {})
        return
      }
      if (list[0]) void load(list[0])
      else setPanelOpen(true)
    },
    [add, load],
  )

  const pause = useCallback(() => {
    if (engine.current === 'yt') ytRef.current?.pauseVideo()
    else audioRef.current?.pause()
  }, [])

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    if (playing) pause()
    else play()
  }, [playing, pause, play])

  const step = useCallback(
    (dir: 1 | -1) => {
      const { playlist: list, currentId: cid, shuffle: sh } = stateRef.current
      if (!list.length) return
      const i = list.findIndex((x) => x.id === cid)
      let n = sh && list.length > 1 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length) : i + dir
      if (sh && n === i) n = (n + 1) % list.length
      n = (n + list.length) % list.length
      void load(list[n])
    },
    [load],
  )
  nextRef.current = () => step(1)

  const remove = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      setPlaylist((list) => {
        const next = list.filter((x) => x.id !== id)
        persist(next)
        return next
      })
      if (stateRef.current.currentId === id) {
        pause()
        setCurrentId(null)
      }
    },
    [pause],
  )

  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    const cid = stateRef.current.currentId
    setPlaylist((list) => {
      const next = list.filter((x) => x.id === cid)
      persist(next)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const seek = useCallback((s: number) => {
    setProgress(s)
    if (engine.current === 'yt') ytRef.current?.seekTo(s, true)
    else if (audioRef.current) audioRef.current.currentTime = s
  }, [])

  const value = useMemo<Ctx>(
    () => ({
      playlist,
      current: playlist.find((x) => x.id === currentId) ?? null,
      playing,
      buffering,
      progress,
      duration,
      volume,
      shuffle,
      repeat,
      panelOpen,
      setPanelOpen,
      play,
      pause,
      toggle,
      next: () => step(1),
      prev: () => {
        if (progress > 4) seek(0)
        else step(-1)
      },
      seek,
      setVolume: setVolumeState,
      add,
      playNext,
      move,
      clear,
      remove,
      setShuffle,
      setRepeat,
    }),
    [playlist, currentId, playing, buffering, progress, duration, volume, shuffle, repeat, panelOpen, play, pause, toggle, step, seek, add, playNext, move, clear, remove],
  )

  const current = value.current
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!('mediaSession' in navigator)) return
    const ms = navigator.mediaSession
    if (!current) {
      ms.metadata = null
      return
    }
    try {
      ms.metadata = new MediaMetadata({
        title: current.title,
        artist: current.artist,
        album: current.anime ?? 'Sytheris',
        artwork: current.cover ? [{ src: current.cover, sizes: '512x512' }] : [],
      })
      ms.setActionHandler('play', () => play())
      ms.setActionHandler('pause', () => pause())
      ms.setActionHandler('nexttrack', () => step(1))
      ms.setActionHandler('previoustrack', () => step(-1))
    } catch {}
  }, [current, play, pause, step])

  useEffect(() => {
    if ('mediaSession' in navigator) navigator.mediaSession.playbackState = playing ? 'playing' : current ? 'paused' : 'none'
  }, [playing, current])

  return <MusicCtx.Provider value={value}>{children}</MusicCtx.Provider>
}

export function useMusic() {
  const ctx = useContext(MusicCtx)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useMusic must be used within MusicProvider')
  return ctx
}

            onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
            className={cn('flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm capitalize transition disabled:opacity-40', filter === f ? 'bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}

/** Full-body art is resolved lazily per card by /api/fullbody, falling back to the AniList portrait. */
export function fullBodySrc(r: Pick<Role, 'characterName' | 'series' | 'characterImage'>) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams({ n: r.characterName, s: r.series.join('|') })
  if (r.characterImage) p.set('f', r.characterImage)
  return `/api/fullbody?${p.toString()}`
}

        })}
      </div>

      <motion.ul layout className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-3 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6">
        <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
          {shown.map((r, i) => (
            <motion.li
              key={`${r.characterId}-${r.mediaId}`}
              layout
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.55, delay: Math.min(i % PAGE, 12) * 0.035, ease: OUT }}
              className="group flex flex-col gap-3"
              style={r.mediaColor ? ({ ['--card-tone' as string]: r.mediaColor } as React.CSSProperties) : undefined}
            >
              <div className="relative">
                <Link href={`/karakter/${r.characterId}`} className="role-card relative block aspect-[3/5] overflow-hidden outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-foreground">
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="role-card-num absolute -left-1 top-1 select-none text-7xl font-black leading-none tracking-[-0.06em]">
                    {String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img
                    src={fullBodySrc(r)}
                    alt={`${r.characterName}, tam boy`}
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      const img = e.currentTarget
                      const next = r.characterImage && img.dataset.fallback !== '1' ? r.characterImage : '/placeholder-user.jpg'
                      if (img.dataset.fallback === '2') return
                      img.dataset.fallback = img.dataset.fallback === '1' ? '2' : '1'
                      img.src = next
                    }}
                    className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover object-top transition duration-700 ease-out group-hover:scale-[1.05]"
                  />
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-1/3 bg-gradient-to-t from-foreground/55 to-transparent opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100" />
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'absolute left-2 top-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em]',
                      r.role === 'MAIN' ? 'bg-foreground text-background' : 'bg-background/85 text-foreground backdrop-blur',
                    )}
                  >
                    {ROLE_LABEL[r.role] ?? r.role}
                  </span>
                </Link>
                <Link
                  href={`/anime/${r.mediaId}`}
                  aria-label={`${r.mediaTitle} animesine git`}
                  className="absolute -bottom-3 -right-1.5 block w-[34%] origin-bottom-right rotate-[5deg] overflow-hidden shadow-xl ring-2 ring-background transition duration-500 group-hover:rotate-0 group-hover:scale-105"
                >
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={r.mediaCover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="aspect-[2/3] w-full object-cover" />
                </Link>
              </div>
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5 pr-[30%]">
                <Link href={`/karakter/${r.characterId}`} lang="en" className="truncate text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-tight transition hover:underline">
                  {r.characterName}
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/anime/${r.mediaId}`} className="line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
                  {r.mediaTitle}
                  {r.year ? ` · ${r.year}` : ''}
                </Link>
              </div>
            </motion.li>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </motion.ul>

      {filtered.length > limit && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setLimit((l) => l + PAGE)}
          className="mx-auto flex h-11 items-center gap-2 border-2 border-foreground px-6 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] transition hover:bg-foreground hover:text-background"
        >
          Daha fazla göster <span className="tabular-nums opacity-60">{filtered.length - limit}</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Loader2, Users, HardDrive, Wifi, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'

export function TorrentPlayer({ magnetURI, subtitleSrc, subtitleLang }: { magnetURI: string, subtitleSrc?: string | null, subtitleLang?: string }) {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ progress: 0, peers: 0, downloadSpeed: 0 })
  const clientRef = useRef<any>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true
    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout

    async function initTorrent() {
      try {
        // @ts-ignore - TypeScript tip tanımı olmadığı için bu satırı yoksay
        const WebTorrent = (await import('webtorrent/dist/webtorrent.min.js')).default
        
        if (!isMounted) return
        
        const client = new WebTorrent()
        clientRef.current = client

        client.on('error', (err: string | Error) => {
          if (isMounted) {
            const msg = typeof err === 'string' ? err : err.message
            setError(`Torrent Hatası: ${msg}`)
          }
        })

        const trackerList = '&tr=wss://tracker.btorrent.xyz&tr=wss://tracker.openwebtorrent.com&tr=wss://tracker.webtorrent.dev'
        const finalMagnet = magnetURI.includes('&tr=') ? magnetURI : magnetURI + trackerList

        client.add(finalMagnet, (torrent: any) => {
          if (!isMounted) return

          timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.readyState === 0) {
              setError('Yeterli "Seed" (dağıtıcı) bulunamadı. Bu torrent şu an tarayıcıdan izlenemiyor. Lütfen başka bir magnet linki veya doğrudan MP4 linki deneyin.')
            }
          }, 15000)

          const file = torrent.files.find((f: any) => f.name.endsWith('.mp4') || f.name.endsWith('.mkv') || f.name.endsWith('.webm'))

          if (!file) {
            setError('Torrent içinde oynatılabilir bir video dosyası (.mp4, .mkv, .webm) bulunamadı.')
            return
          }

          setLoading(false)

          if (videoRef.current) {
            file.renderTo(videoRef.current, { autoplay: true, muted: false }, (err: any) => {
              if (err) setError('Video oynatılamadı: ' + (err.message || err))
            })
          }

          const interval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!isMounted) return clearInterval(interval)
            setStats({
              progress: Math.round(torrent.progress * 100),
              peers: torrent.numPeers,
              downloadSpeed: torrent.downloadSpeed,
            })

            if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.currentTime > 0 && timeoutId) {
              clearTimeout(timeoutId)
            }
          }, 1000)
        })
      } catch (err) {
        if (isMounted) setError('WebTorrent başlatılamadı. Tarayıcınız desteklemiyor olabilir.')
      }
    }

    initTorrent()

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId)
      if (clientRef.current) {
        clientRef.current.destroy()
      }
    }
  }, [magnetURI])

  return (
    <div className="relative flex aspect-video w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-black">
      {loading && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/80">
          <Loader2 className="mb-4 size-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
          <p className="font-mono text-sm text-white/70">Torrent ağına bağlanılıyor...</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/90 p-6 text-center">
          <AlertTriangle className="mb-3 size-8 text-yellow-500" />
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-destructive">{error}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-white/60">
            WebTorrent sadece diğer tarayıcılardan (WebRTC) indirebilir. Eğer bu anime popüler değilse veya kimse tarayıcıdan seed etmiyorsa video başlamaz. Alternatif olarak direkt MP4 linki ekleyin.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <video ref={videoRef} className="size-full" controls playsInline crossOrigin="anonymous">
        {subtitleSrc && (
          <track kind="subtitles" src={subtitleSrc} srcLang={subtitleLang || 'tr'} label="Altyazı" default />
        )}
      </video>

      {!loading && !error && (
        <div className="absolute right-4 top-4 flex items-center gap-4 rounded-full bg-black/60 px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs text-white backdrop-blur-md">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Users className="size-3.5 text-primary" /> {stats.peers} Peer</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Wifi className="size-3.5 text-primary" /> {(stats.downloadSpeed / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB/s</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><HardDrive className="size-3.5 text-primary" /> %{stats.progress}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

DOSYA: C:\Users\mumya\Desktop\SYTHERİS_SON\components\player\video-player.tsx

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Captions,
  CaptionsOff,
  Check,
  Loader2,
  Maximize,
  Minimize,
  Pause,
  PictureInPicture2,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  RotateCw,
  Settings,
  SkipBack,
  SkipForward,
  Volume1,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { getPrefs, setPrefs, usePrefs, type Prefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { fmtTime } from '@/components/music/music-panel'

type Props = {
  src: string
  subtitleSrc?: string | null
  subtitleLang: string
  poster?: string | null
  title: string
  episodeLabel: string
  storageKey: string
  nextHref?: string | null
  prevHref?: string | null
}

/** Plain playlist URLs, legacy proxied ones and signed /api/medya?k=hls links from the admin link hunter. */
function isHlsSource(src: string) {
  return src.includes('.m3u8') || /[?&]k=hls(&|$)/.test(src)
}

const SPEEDS = [0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2]
const SUB_SIZES: Record<Prefs['subtitleSize'], string> = { sm: '1.9cqw', md: '2.4cqw', lg: '3cqw', xl: '3.7cqw' }

export function VideoPlayer({ src, subtitleSrc, subtitleLang, poster, title, episodeLabel, storageKey, nextHref, prevHref }: Props) {
  // SRC KONTROLÜ (ÇÖKMEYİ ENGELLER)
  if (!src || src.trim() === '') {
    return (
      <div className="flex aspect-video w-full items-center justify-center rounded-3xl bg-black text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Geçerli bir video kaynağı bulunamadı.
      </div>
    )
  }

  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const trackEl = useRef<HTMLTrackElement>(null)
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const prefs = usePrefs()

  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [time, setTime] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [buffered, setBuffered] = useState(0)
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(1)
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [controls, setControls] = useState(true)
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState(false)
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1)
  const [subsOn, setSubsOn] = useState(true)
  const [cue, setCue] = useState('')
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<{ x: number; t: number } | null>(null)
  const [ended, setEnded] = useState(false)
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pipSupported, setPipSupported] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => setPipSupported(Boolean(document.pictureInPictureEnabled)), [])

  // HLS (m3u8) DESTEĞİ
  useEffect(() => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return

    let hls: any = null
    const isHls = isHlsSource(src)

    if (isHls) {
      import('hls.js').then(({ default: Hls }) => {
        if (Hls.isSupported()) {
          hls = new Hls({
            maxMaxBufferLength: 30, // Tarayıcının önbelleğe alacağı maksimum saniye (hızı etkiler)
          })
          hls.loadSource(src)
          hls.attachMedia(v)
          hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, () => {
            v.play().catch(() => setPlaying(false))
          })
          hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, (event: any, data: any) => {
            if (data.fatal) {
              switch (data.type) {
                case Hls.ErrorTypes.NETWORK_ERROR:
                  hls.startLoad()
                  break
                case Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR:
                  hls.recoverMediaError()
                  break
                default:
                  setError('HLS Yayını oynatılamadı veya bağlantı kesildi.')
                  hls.destroy()
                  break
              }
            }
          })
        } else if (v.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
          // Safari (Native HLS Desteği)
          v.src = src
        } else {
          setError('Tarayıcınız HLS (m3u8) formatını desteklemiyor.')
        }
      })
    } else {
      // Normal MP4 / WebM
      v.src = src
    }

    return () => {
      if (hls) hls.destroy()
    }
  }, [src])

  const poke = useCallback(() => {
    setControls(true)
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!video.current?.paused) setControls(false)
    }, 2600)
  }, [])

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    if (v.paused) v.play().catch(() => {})
    else v.pause()
  }, [])

  const seekBy = useCallback((s: number) => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    v.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(v.duration || 0, v.currentTime + s))
    setFlash(s > 0 ? `+${s}s` : `${s}s`)
    window.setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 500)
  }, [])

  const toggleFullscreen = useCallback(() => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) wrap.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {})
    else document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    const saved = Number(localStorage.getItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`))

    const onMeta = () => {
      setDuration(v.duration)
      if (getPrefs().resumePlayback && saved && saved < v.duration - 15) v.currentTime = saved
      const rate = getPrefs().defaultSpeed
      if (rate && rate !== 1) {
        v.playbackRate = rate
        setSpeed(rate)
      }
      const tt = v.textTracks[0]
      if (tt) tt.mode = 'hidden'
    }
    let lastSave = 0
    const onTime = () => {
      setTime(v.currentTime)
      if (v.buffered.length) setBuffered(v.buffered.end(v.buffered.length - 1))
      if (Date.now() - lastSave > 4000) {
        lastSave = Date.now()
        localStorage.setItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`, String(Math.floor(v.currentTime)))
      }
    }
    const onPlay = () => {
      setPlaying(true)
      setEnded(false)
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    }
    const onPause = () => setPlaying(false)
    const onWaiting = () => setWaiting(true)
    const onCanPlay = () => setWaiting(false)
    const onVolume = () => {
      setVolume(v.volume)
      setMuted(v.muted)
    }
    const onEnded = () => {
      setEnded(true)
      localStorage.removeItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`)
    }
    const onError = () => {
      setWaiting(false)
      // HLS eklentisi kendi hata mesajını göstereceği için MP4 hatasını susturabiliriz (isteğe bağlı)
      if (!isHlsSource(src)) {
        setError('Video yüklenemedi. Bağlantı geçersiz olabilir ya da kaynak erişime kapalı.')
      }
    }

    v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    v.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('progress', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    v.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    v.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
    v.addEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay)
    v.addEventListener('playing', onCanPlay)
    v.addEventListener('volumechange', onVolume)
    v.addEventListener('ended', onEnded)
    v.addEventListener('error', onError)

    const onFs = () => setFullscreen(Boolean(document.fullscreenElement))
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFs)

    return () => {
      v.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      v.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('progress', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
      v.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
      v.removeEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('playing', onCanPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('volumechange', onVolume)
      v.removeEventListener('ended', onEnded)
      v.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFs)
    }
  }, [storageKey, src])

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = trackEl.current
    if (!t) return
    const onCue = () => {
      const active = t.track.activeCues
      if (!active || active.length === 0) return setCue('')
      setCue(
        Array.from(active)
          .map((c) => (c as VTTCue).text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ''))
          .join('\n'),
      )
    }
    const onLoad = () => {
      t.track.mode = 'hidden'
    }
    t.addEventListener('cuechange', onCue)
    t.addEventListener('load', onLoad)
    t.track.mode = 'hidden'
    return () => {
      t.removeEventListener('cuechange', onCue)
      t.removeEventListener('load', onLoad)
    }
  }, [subtitleSrc])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return
      const v = video.current
      if (!v) return
      const k = e.key.toLowerCase()
      if (k === ' ' || k === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault()
        toggle()
      } else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'l') seekBy(k === 'l' ? 10 : 5)
      else if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'j') seekBy(k === 'j' ? -10 : -5)
      else if (k === 'arrowup') {
        e.preventDefault()
        v.volume = Math.min(1, v.volume + 0.1)
      } else if (k === 'arrowdown') {
        e.preventDefault()
        v.volume = Math.max(0, v.volume - 0.1)
      } else if (k === 'm') v.muted = !v.muted
      else if (k === 'f') toggleFullscreen()
      else if (k === 'c') setSubsOn((s) => !s)
      else return
      poke()
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [toggle, seekBy, toggleFullscreen, poke])

  const VolIcon = muted || volume === 0 ? VolumeX : volume < 0.5 ? Volume1 : Volume2
  const pct = duration ? (time / duration) * 100 : 0
  const bufPct = duration ? (buffered / duration) * 100 : 0
  const showUi = controls || !playing || menu

  return (
    <div
      ref={wrap}
      onMouseMove={poke}
      onTouchStart={poke}
      onMouseLeave={() => playing && setControls(false)}
      className={cn('dark group/player relative aspect-video w-full select-none overflow-hidden bg-black text-foreground [container-type:inline-size]', fullscreen ? 'rounded-none' : 'rounded-3xl', !showUi && 'cursor-none')}
    >
      {/* src prop'u buradan kaldırıldı (useEffect içinde atanıyor) */}
      <video
        ref={video}
        poster={poster ?? undefined}
        playsInline
        preload="metadata"
        className="absolute inset-0 size-full"
        onClick={toggle}
        onDoubleClick={toggleFullscreen}
      >
        {subtitleSrc && <track ref={trackEl} kind="subtitles" src={subtitleSrc} srcLang={subtitleLang} label={subtitleLang.toUpperCase()} default />}
      </video>

      {subsOn && cue && (
        <div className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 flex justify-center px-[6%] transition-all duration-300', showUi ? 'bottom-[18%]' : 'bottom-[7%]')}>
          <p
            className={cn('whitespace-pre-line text-center font-semibold leading-snug text-on-scrim', prefs.subtitleBg ? 'rounded-lg bg-black/70 px-[0.6em] py-[0.25em]' : '[text-shadow:0_2px_4px_#000,0_0_2px_#000,0_0_8px_#000]')}
            style={{ fontSize: `max(13px, ${SUB_SIZES[prefs.subtitleSize]})` }}
          >
            {cue}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {waiting && !error && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
          <Loader2 className="size-12 animate-spin text-primary" />
        </div>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence>
        {flash && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-black/60 px-5 py-3 font-mono text-lg text-on-scrim backdrop-blur">{flash}</span>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {!playing && !waiting && !error && !ended && (
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label="Oynat" className="absolute inset-0 m-auto grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_60px_var(--primary)] transition hover:scale-105">
          <Play className="ml-1 size-8 fill-current" />
        </button>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-black/80 p-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-on-scrim">Oynatma hatası</p>
          <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-on-scrim/70">{error}</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => location.reload()} className="mt-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
            Tekrar dene
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {ended && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-black/75 p-6 text-center backdrop-blur-sm">
          <p className="label-mono text-primary">Bölüm bitti</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => video.current?.play()} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-on-scrim/30 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm text-on-scrim">
              <RotateCcw className="size-4" /> Tekrar izle
            </button>
            {nextHref && (
              <Link href={nextHref} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
                Sonraki bölüm <SkipForward className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/70 to-transparent p-4 transition-opacity duration-300 sm:p-6', showUi ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}>
        <p className="label-mono text-[10px] text-primary">{episodeLabel}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-on-scrim sm:text-lg">{title}</p>
      </div>

      <div className={cn('absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/40 to-transparent px-3 pb-3 pt-14 transition-opacity duration-300 sm:px-5 sm:pb-4', showUi ? 'opacity-100' : 'pointer-events-none opacity-0')}>
        <div
          className="group/seek relative mb-2 flex h-5 cursor-pointer items-center"
          onMouseMove={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            const x = Math.min(Math.max(e.clientX - r.left, 0), r.width)
            setHover({ x, t: (x / r.width) * duration })
          }}
          onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
          onClick={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            if (video.current) video.current.currentTime = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * duration
          }}
          role="slider"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label="İlerleme"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={Math.round(duration)}
          aria-valuenow={Math.round(time)}
          aria-valuetext={`${fmtTime(time)} / ${fmtTime(duration)}`}
        >
          <div className="relative h-1 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-on-scrim/20 transition-all group-hover/seek:h-1.5">
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-on-scrim/35" style={{ width: `${bufPct}%` }} />
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-primary" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="absolute size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 scale-0 rounded-full bg-primary shadow transition group-hover/seek:scale-100" style={{ left: `${pct}%` }} />
          {hover && (
            <span className="absolute -top-8 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-md bg-black/80 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-on-scrim" style={{ left: hover.x }}>
              {fmtTime(hover.t)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-on-scrim sm:gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label={playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
            {playing ? <Pause className="size-5 fill-current" /> : <Play className="size-5 fill-current" />}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => seekBy(-10)} aria-label="10 saniye geri" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
            <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => seekBy(10)} aria-label="10 saniye ileri" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
            <RotateCw className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <div className="group/vol flex items-center">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => video.current && (video.current.muted = !video.current.muted)} aria-label={muted ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
              <VolIcon className="size-5" />
            </button>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={1}
              step={0.02}
              value={muted ? 0 : volume}
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (!video.current) return
                video.current.volume = Number(e.target.value)
                video.current.muted = Number(e.target.value) === 0
              }}
              aria-label="Ses seviyesi"
              className="w-0 accent-[var(--primary)] opacity-0 transition-all duration-300 group-hover/vol:w-20 group-hover/vol:opacity-100 focus:w-20 focus:opacity-100"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="ml-1 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums text-on-scrim/80 sm:text-xs">
            {fmtTime(time)} / {fmtTime(duration)}
          </span>

          <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1">
            {prevHref && (
              <Link href={prevHref} aria-label="Önceki bölüm" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
                <SkipBack className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
            {nextHref && (
              <Link href={nextHref} aria-label="Sonraki bölüm" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <SkipForward className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
            {subtitleSrc && (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setSubsOn((s) => !s)} aria-pressed={subsOn} aria-label="Altyazı" className={cn('grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10', subsOn && 'text-primary')}>
                {subsOn ? <Captions className="size-5" /> : <CaptionsOff className="size-5" />}
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="relative">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)} aria-expanded={menu} aria-label="Oynatıcı ayarları" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <Settings className={cn('size-5 transition-transform duration-500', menu && 'rotate-90')} />
              </button>
              <AnimatePresence>
                {menu && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    className="absolute bottom-12 right-0 w-64 rounded-2xl border border-on-scrim/10 bg-black/90 p-3 text-sm text-on-scrim backdrop-blur-xl"
                  >
                    <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[9px] text-on-scrim/50">Hız</p>
                    <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
                      {SPEEDS.map((s) => (
                        <button
                          key={s}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSpeed(s)
                            if (video.current) video.current.playbackRate = s
                          }}
                          className={cn('rounded-lg py-1.5 font-mono text-xs transition', speed === s ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-on-scrim/10')}
                        >
                          {s}x
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    {subtitleSrc && (
                      <>
                        <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[9px] text-on-scrim/50">Altyazı boyutu</p>
                        <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-1">
                          {(['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((s) => (
                            <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => setPrefs({ subtitleSize: s })} className={cn('rounded-lg py-1.5 font-mono text-xs uppercase transition', prefs.subtitleSize === s ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-on-scrim/10')}>
                              {s}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setPrefs({ subtitleBg: !prefs.subtitleBg })} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2 py-2 transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                          Altyazı arka planı
                          {prefs.subtitleBg && <Check className="size-4 text-primary" />}
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
            {pipSupported && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (document.pictureInPictureElement) document.exitPictureInPicture().catch(() => {})
                  else video.current?.requestPictureInPicture().catch(() => {})
                }}
                aria-label="Resim içinde resim"
                className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid"
              >
                <PictureInPicture2 className="size-4" />
              </button>
            )}
            <button type="button" onClick={toggleFullscreen} aria-label={fullscreen ? 'Tam ekrandan çık' : 'Tam ekran'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
              {fullscreen ? <Minimize className="size-5" /> : <Maximize className="size-5" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/* Hand-drawn marks for the portfolio: deliberately wobbly strokes, round caps, no fills unless noted. */

const stroke = { fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round' } as const

export function Scribble({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 220" className={cn('fo-draw', className)} aria-hidden="true">
      <path {...stroke} strokeWidth="5" pathLength={1} d="M150 20 C120 60 30 70 40 120 C48 160 120 130 118 168 C116 200 60 205 30 190 M60 90 C90 98 140 80 170 100 C190 114 168 150 140 150" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Crown({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 60 64" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M30 4 C22 16 12 18 12 32 C12 46 20 58 30 60 C40 58 48 46 48 32 C48 24 44 20 40 14 C38 22 34 24 32 24 C34 16 33 10 30 4 Z" fill="currentColor" />
      <text x="30" y="47" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="18" fontWeight="900" fill="var(--fo-bg)" fontFamily="var(--font-anton), sans-serif">
        1
      </text>
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Burst({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const pts = Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => {
    const a = (i / 22) * Math.PI * 2
    const r = i % 2 ? 22 : 48
    return `${50 + Math.cos(a) * r},${50 + Math.sin(a) * r}`
  }).join(' ')
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
      <polygon points={pts} fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Kisses({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 120 60" className={cn('fo-draw', className)} aria-hidden="true">
      <path {...stroke} strokeWidth="6" pathLength={1} d="M10 14 L34 38 M34 14 L10 38 M56 8 L80 32 M80 8 L56 32 M18 50 C40 58 70 58 100 44" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Corner({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 60 60" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M4 4 V56 H56" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="9" strokeLinecap="square" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Cursor({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M11 4 V18 L8.5 15.5 C7.5 14.5 5.8 14.6 5 15.8 C4.3 16.8 4.6 18 5.4 18.8 L11.5 26 C12.6 27.3 14.2 28 16 28 H20 C23.3 28 26 25.3 26 22 V14 C26 12.9 25.1 12 24 12 C22.9 12 22 12.9 22 14 V13 C22 11.9 21.1 11 20 11 C18.9 11 18 11.9 18 13 V12 C18 10.9 17.1 10 16 10 C14.9 10 14 10.9 14 12 V4 C14 3.2 13.3 2.5 12.5 2.5 C11.7 2.5 11 3.2 11 4 Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="var(--fo-bg)" strokeWidth="1.4" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** Circular rotating label, words separated by dots. */
export function TextRing({ words, className }: { words: string[]; className?: string }) {
  const text = `${words.join(' • ')} • `
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" className={cn('fo-spin', className)} aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <path id="fo-ring" d="M100 100 m-78 0 a78 78 0 1 1 156 0 a78 78 0 1 1 -156 0" />
      </defs>
      <text fill="currentColor" fontSize="19" fontWeight="800" letterSpacing="4" fontFamily="var(--font-sans), sans-serif">
        <textPath href="#fo-ring" textLength="486" lengthAdjust="spacing">
          {text.repeat(Math.max(1, Math.round(40 / text.length)))}
        </textPath>
      </text>
    </svg>
  )
}
