'use client'

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useId, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ImageUp, Link2, Loader2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type Kind = 'avatar' | 'banner'

const LIMITS: Record<Kind, { raw: number; label: string; accept: string; seconds: number }> = {
  avatar: { raw: 2 * 1024 * 1024, label: '2 MB', accept: 'image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,image/avif,video/mp4,video/webm', seconds: 15 },
  banner: { raw: 4 * 1024 * 1024, label: '4 MB', accept: 'image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,image/avif,video/mp4,video/webm', seconds: 30 },
}

/** Reads a clip's length without uploading it, so overly long loops are caught on the device. */
function videoDuration(file: File) {
  return new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    const v = document.createElement('video')
    v.preload = 'metadata'
    v.muted = true
    const done = (d: number) => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
      resolve(d)
    }
    v.onloadedmetadata = () => done(Number.isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration : 0)
    v.onerror = () => done(0)
    v.src = url
  })
}

function readAsDataUrl(file: Blob) {
  return new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader()
    r.onload = () => resolve(String(r.result))
    r.onerror = () => reject(r.error ?? new Error('Dosya okunamadı'))
    r.readAsDataURL(file)
  })
}

/** Re-encodes still images on the device so uploads stay small: square 512px avatars, 1920px-wide banners. */
async function compress(file: File, kind: Kind) {
  const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file)
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('Tarayıcı görseli işleyemedi')
  if (kind === 'avatar') {
    const side = Math.min(bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
    const out = Math.min(512, side)
    canvas.width = out
    canvas.height = out
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, (bitmap.width - side) / 2, (bitmap.height - side) / 2, side, side, 0, 0, out, out)
  } else {
    const scale = Math.min(1, 1920 / bitmap.width)
    canvas.width = Math.round(bitmap.width * scale)
    canvas.height = Math.round(bitmap.height * scale)
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
  }
  bitmap.close()
  const webp = canvas.toDataURL('image/webp', 0.86)
  return webp.startsWith('data:image/webp') ? webp : canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.88)
}

export function MediaPicker({ kind, value, onChange, label, hint }: { kind: Kind; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; label: string; hint?: string }) {
  const id = useId()
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState(false)
  const [urlMode, setUrlMode] = useState(Boolean(value) && !value.startsWith('data:'))
  const limit = LIMITS[kind]
  const isVideo = /^data:video\//.test(value) || /\.(mp4|webm)(\?|$)/i.test(value)

  async function handle(file?: File | null) {
    if (!file) return
    if (!limit.accept.split(',').includes(file.type)) {
      toast.error('Bu dosya türü desteklenmiyor')
      return
    }
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const animated = file.type === 'image/gif' || file.type.startsWith('video/')
      if (animated && file.size > limit.raw) throw new Error(`Hareketli dosyalar en fazla ${limit.label} olabilir`)
      if (file.type.startsWith('video/')) {
        const seconds = await videoDuration(file)
        if (seconds > limit.seconds) throw new Error(`Video en fazla ${limit.seconds} saniye olabilir (seçilen: ${Math.round(seconds)} sn)`)
      }
      const url = animated ? await readAsDataUrl(file) : await compress(file, kind)
      onChange(url)
      setUrlMode(false)
      toast.success(kind === 'avatar' ? 'Profil fotoğrafı hazır — kaydetmeyi unutma' : 'Afiş hazır — kaydetmeyi unutma')
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
      if (fileRef.current) fileRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <label htmlFor={`${id}-file`} className="font-medium">
          {label}
        </label>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setUrlMode((v) => !v)} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-ink">
          <Link2 className="size-3.5" />
          {urlMode ? 'Dosya seç' : 'Bağlantı yapıştır'}
        </button>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        {urlMode ? (
          <motion.input
            key="url"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
            type="url"
            inputMode="url"
            aria-label={`${label} bağlantısı`}
            className="h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary"
            value={value.startsWith('data:') ? '' : value}
            placeholder="https://…"
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          />
        ) : (
          <motion.div
            key="file"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
            onDragOver={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault()
              setDrag(true)
            }}
            onDragLeave={() => setDrag(false)}
            onDrop={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault()
              setDrag(false)
              handle(e.dataTransfer.files?.[0])
            }}
            className={cn(
              'group relative flex items-center gap-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-dashed p-3 transition',
              drag ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10' : 'border-border bg-background hover:border-primary/60',
            )}
          >
            <span className={cn('relative grid shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden bg-muted', kind === 'avatar' ? 'size-16 rounded-full' : 'h-16 w-28 rounded-xl')}>
              {value ? (
                isVideo ? (
                  <video src={value} muted loop autoPlay playsInline className="size-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  <img src={value || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
                )
              ) : (
                <ImageUp className="size-5 text-muted-foreground" />
              )}
              {busy && (
                <span className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-scrim/60">
                  <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin text-on-scrim" />
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
            <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
              <span className="font-medium">{drag ? 'Bırak, yükleyelim' : 'Bilgisayarından seç'}</span>
              <span className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{hint ?? `PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, MP4 · en fazla ${limit.label}, video ${limit.seconds} sn`}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">
              {value && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => onChange('')} aria-label={`${label} kaldır`} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
                disabled={busy}
                className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <ImageUp className="size-3.5" />
                Gözat
              </button>
            </span>
            <input ref={fileRef} id={`${id}-file`} type="file" accept={limit.accept} className="sr-only" onChange={(e) => handle(e.target.files?.[0])} />
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

                  <p className="truncate font-medium">{form.song.title}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">{form.song.artist}</p>
                </div>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => set('song', null)} aria-label="Şarkıyı kaldır" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" />

            )}

                  {l.type === 'website' ? <ExternalLink className="size-4" /> : <BrandIcon name={l.type} />}
                </span>
                <select
                  value={l.type}
                  onChange={(e) => set('links', form.links.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, type: e.target.value } : x)))}
                  className="h-12 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary"
                  aria-label="Bağlantı türü"
                >
                  {LINK_TYPES.map(([v, label]) => (
                    <option key={v} value={v}>
                      {label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <input className={input} value={l.url} placeholder={l.type === 'discord' ? 'kullanıcı adı veya davet linki' : 'https://…'} onChange={(e) => set('links', form.links.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, url: e.target.value } : x)))} aria-label="Bağlantı adresi" />
                <button type="button" onClick={() => set('links', form.links.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} aria-label="Bağlantıyı sil" className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-2xl text-muted-foreground hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {form.links.length < 8 && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => set('links', [...form.links, { type: 'instagram', url: '' }])} className="mt-3 flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-dashed border-border px-5 text-sm transition hover:border-primary hover:text-ink">
              <Plus className="size-4" /> Bağlantı ekle
            </button>
          )}
        </Card>

        <Card title="Favori" accent="animeler">
          {favs.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Anime sayfalarındaki “Favorilere ekle” butonuyla buraya ekleyebilirsin.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-6">
              {favs.map((f) => (
                <li key={f.id} className="group relative">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}

                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setFavs(favs.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id))} aria-label={`${f.title} favorilerden çıkar`} className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full bg-scrim/70 text-on-scrim opacity-100 transition sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100">
                    <X className="size-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      <aside className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:sticky xl:top-24 xl:self-start">
        <div data-theme={form.accent} className="flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-border bg-card">
          <div className="dark">
            <ProfileBanner src={form.background || null} dim={form.background ? form.backgroundDim : 30} overlay={resolveBannerOverlay(user)} className="h-32" />
          </div>
          <div className="-mt-10 flex flex-col gap-3 px-5 pb-6">
            <span className="w-fit rounded-full bg-card p-1">
              <AvatarFrame src={form.avatar || null} name={form.displayName} frame={user.frame} className="size-20" />
            </span>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <p className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
                <NamePlate plate={user.nameplate}>{form.displayName}</NamePlate>
              </p>
              <p className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">@{form.username}</p>
            </div>
            {form.bio && <p className="line-clamp-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{form.bio}</p>}
            {form.links.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {form.links.slice(0, 6).map((l, i) => (
                  <span key={i} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-muted">
                    {l.type === 'website' ? <ExternalLink className="size-3.5" /> : <BrandIcon name={l.type} className="size-4" />}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            <p className="label-mono pt-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Canlı önizleme</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={pending} className="flex h-14 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-70">
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="size-4" />}

          Profilimi görüntüle <ExternalLink className="size-4" />
        </Link>
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Pause, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { fmtTime } from '@/components/music/music-panel'

export type ProfileSongData = { url: string; title: string; artist: string; cover?: string | null }

/** Opt-in player: nothing plays until the visitor presses play. */
export function ProfileSong({ song }: { song: ProfileSongData }) {
  const audio = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [time, setTime] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    const a = new Audio(song.url)
    a.preload = 'metadata'
    a.volume = 0.6
    audio.current = a
    const onTime = () => setTime(a.currentTime)
    const onMeta = () => setDuration(a.duration || 0)
    const onPlay = () => setPlaying(true)
    const onPause = () => setPlaying(false)
    a.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    a.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    a.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    a.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    a.addEventListener('ended', onPause)
    return () => {
      a.pause()
      a.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      a.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      a.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      a.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
      a.removeEventListener('ended', onPause)
    }
  }, [song.url])

  const toggle = () => {
    const a = audio.current
    if (!a) return
    if (a.paused) {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
      a.play().catch(() => {})
    } else a.pause()
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={song.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className={cn('size-14 shrink-0 rounded-xl object-cover ring-1 ring-border transition-[border-radius] duration-700', playing && 'animate-[spin_14s_linear_infinite] rounded-full')} />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{song.title}</p>
        <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{song.artist}</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="h-1 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
            <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary transition-[width] duration-300" style={{ width: duration ? `${(time / duration) * 100}%` : '0%' }} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px] tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{fmtTime(time)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label={playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'} className="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110">
        {playing ? <Pause className="size-4" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4" />}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

            </h1>

'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { Toaster } from 'sonner'
import { MusicProvider } from '@/components/music/music-provider'
import { PreviewProvider } from '@/components/anime/preview-provider'
import { ThemeProvider, useTheme } from './theme-provider'
import { applyPrefClasses, getPrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'

function PrefsSync() {
  useEffect(() => applyPrefClasses(getPrefs()), [])
  return null
}

function ErrorReporter() {
  useEffect(() => {
    let sent = 0
    const report = (message: string, stack?: string) => {
      if (sent > 5) return
      if (/ResizeObserver|Script error|youtube|chrome-extension/i.test(message + (stack ?? ''))) return
      sent++
      fetch('/api/log', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message, stack, path: location.pathname }),
        keepalive: true,
      }).catch(() => {})
    }
    const onError = (e: ErrorEvent) => report(e.message, e.error?.stack)
    const onRejection = (e: PromiseRejectionEvent) => report(String(e.reason?.message ?? e.reason), e.reason?.stack)
    window.addEventListener('error', onError)
    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', onRejection)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      window.removeEventListener('unhandledrejection', onRejection)
    }
  }, [])
  return null
}

function ThemedToaster() {
  const { dark } = useTheme()
  return (
    <Toaster
      theme={dark ? 'dark' : 'light'}
      position="top-center"
      toastOptions={{
        classNames: {

        },

  )
}

'use client'

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom'
import { THEME_IDS, themeHex, themeName, type ThemeId, type ThemeMode } from '@/lib/themes'
import { CUSTOM_THEME_KEY, CUSTOM_VAR_NAMES, customThemeVars, type CustomTheme } from '@/lib/custom-theme'

type Ctx = {
  theme: ThemeId
  mode: ThemeMode
  dark: boolean
  setTheme: (id: ThemeId, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => void
  setMode: (m: ThemeMode, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => void
  /** Active user-made theme (Sytheris+), or null when a preset is active. */
  custom: CustomTheme | null
  applyCustom: (t: CustomTheme, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => void
  themeLabel: string
}

function clearCustomVars() {
  const style = document.documentElement.style
  CUSTOM_VAR_NAMES.forEach((k) => style.removeProperty(k))
}

const ThemeCtx = createContext<Ctx | null>(null)

function systemDark() {
  return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
}

function withTransition(apply: () => void, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const doc = document as Document & { startViewTransition?: (cb: () => void) => { ready: Promise<void> } }
  const reduce = document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion') || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  if (!doc.startViewTransition || reduce) {
    apply()
    return
  }
  const x = origin?.x ?? window.innerWidth / 2
  const y = origin?.y ?? 0
  const r = Math.hypot(Math.max(x, window.innerWidth - x), Math.max(y, window.innerHeight - y))
  const t = doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(apply))
  t.ready
    .then(() => {
      document.documentElement.animate(
        { clipPath: [`circle(0px at ${x}px ${y}px)`, `circle(${r}px at ${x}px ${y}px)`] },
        { duration: 650, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)', pseudoElement: '::view-transition-new(root)' },
      )
    })
    .catch(() => {})
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<ThemeId>('green')
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState<ThemeMode>('system')
  const [dark, setDark] = useState(false)
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState<CustomTheme | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = (localStorage.getItem('sy-theme') as ThemeId) || 'green'
    const m = (localStorage.getItem('sy-mode') as ThemeMode) || 'system'
    setThemeState(THEME_IDS.includes(t) ? t : 'green')
    if ((t as string) === 'custom') {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CUSTOM_THEME_KEY) || 'null') as (CustomTheme & { base?: ThemeId }) | null
        if (saved?.hex) {
          setCustom({ id: saved.id, name: saved.name, hex: saved.hex })
          if (saved.base && THEME_IDS.includes(saved.base)) setThemeState(saved.base)
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    setModeState(m)
    setDark(document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'))
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
    const onChange = () => {
      if ((localStorage.getItem('sy-mode') || 'system') === 'system') {
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', mq.matches)
        setDark(mq.matches)
      }
    }
    mq.addEventListener('change', onChange)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]')
    if (meta) meta.setAttribute('content', custom?.hex ?? themeHex(theme))
  }, [theme, custom])

  const setTheme = useCallback((id: ThemeId, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => {
    withTransition(() => {
      clearCustomVars()
      document.documentElement.dataset.theme = id
      localStorage.setItem('sy-theme', id)
      setThemeState(id)
      setCustom(null)
    }, origin)
  }, [])

  const applyCustom = useCallback(
    (t: CustomTheme, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => {
      withTransition(() => {
        const vars = customThemeVars(t.hex)
        const root = document.documentElement
        Object.entries(vars).forEach(([k, v]) => root.style.setProperty(k, v))
        root.dataset.theme = 'custom'
        localStorage.setItem('sy-theme', 'custom')
        localStorage.setItem(CUSTOM_THEME_KEY, JSON.stringify({ ...t, vars, base: theme }))
        setCustom({ id: t.id, name: t.name, hex: t.hex })
      }, origin)
    },
    [theme],
  )

  const setMode = useCallback((m: ThemeMode, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => {
    withTransition(() => {
      const d = m === 'dark' || (m === 'system' && systemDark())
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', d)
      localStorage.setItem('sy-mode', m)
      setModeState(m)
      setDark(d)
    }, origin)
  }, [])

  const themeLabel = custom?.name ?? themeName(theme)
  return <ThemeCtx.Provider value={{ theme, mode, dark, setTheme, setMode, custom, applyCustom, themeLabel }}>{children}</ThemeCtx.Provider>
}

export function useTheme() {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeCtx)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider')
  return ctx
}

type KindFilter = 'hepsi' | 'film' | 'dizi'
const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

/** Cinema-mode randomiser: a ticket-reel of posters spins and lands on tonight's pick. */
export function CineRoulette({ pool, genres }: { pool: RouletteItem[]; genres: string[] }) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<KindFilter>('hepsi')
  const [genre, setGenre] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [reel, setReel] = useState<RouletteItem[]>([])
  const [pick, setPick] = useState<RouletteItem | null>(null)
  const [spinning, setSpinning] = useState(false)
  const timer = useRef<number | null>(null)

  const candidates = pool.filter((p) => (kind === 'hepsi' || p.kind === kind) && (!genre || p.genre === genre))

  function spin() {
    if (!candidates.length || spinning) return
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
    const chosen = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)]
    if (reduce) {
      setPick(chosen)
      return
    }
    const filler = Array.from({ length: 14 }, () => candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)])
    setReel([...filler, chosen])
    setPick(null)
    setSpinning(true)
    if (timer.current) window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setSpinning(false)
      setPick(chosen)
    }, 2400)
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="flex w-fit rounded-full bg-muted p-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Ne izlemek istiyorsun?">
          {(
            [
              { id: 'hepsi', label: 'Hepsi' },
              { id: 'film', label: 'Film' },
              { id: 'dizi', label: 'Dizi' },
            ] as const
          ).map((k) => (
            <button key={k.id} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={kind === k.id} onClick={() => setKind(k.id)} className={cn('rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition', kind === k.id ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}>
              {k.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0" role="group" aria-label="Tür">
          <button type="button" aria-pressed={!genre} onClick={() => setGenre(null)} className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition', !genre ? 'border-foreground bg-foreground text-background' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/40')}>
            Her tür
          </button>
          {genres.map((g) => (
            <button key={g} type="button" aria-pressed={genre === g} onClick={() => setGenre(g)} className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition', genre === g ? 'border-foreground bg-foreground text-background' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/40')}>
              {g}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-scrim text-foreground ring-1 ring-border">
        <span className="cine-bulbs absolute inset-x-0 top-2 h-3" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="cine-bulbs absolute inset-x-0 bottom-2 h-3" aria-hidden="true" />
        {pick && (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={pick.posterLg || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 size-full scale-125 object-cover opacity-30 blur-3xl" />
        )}
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0 -z-10" aria-hidden="true" />

        <div className="flex min-h-[26rem] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-8 px-5 py-14 sm:px-10">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {spinning ? (
              <motion.div key="reel" className="relative h-56 w-36 overflow-hidden rounded-xl ring-2 ring-primary sm:h-72 sm:w-48" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>
                <motion.div className="flex flex-col" initial={{ y: 0 }} animate={{ y: `-${((reel.length - 1) / reel.length) * 100}%` }} transition={{ duration: 2.3, ease: [0.15, 0.6, 0.1, 1] }}>
                  {reel.map((r, i) => (
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                    <img key={`${r.id}-${i}`} src={r.poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="h-56 w-36 shrink-0 object-cover sm:h-72 sm:w-48" />
                  ))}
                </motion.div>
              </motion.div>
            ) : pick ? (
              <motion.div key={pick.id} className="grid w-full max-w-3xl items-center gap-8 sm:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)]" initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: OUT }}>
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={pick.posterLg || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={`${pick.title} afişi`} className="mx-auto aspect-[2/3] w-40 rounded-xl object-cover shadow-[0_40px_80px_-30px_rgb(0_0_0/0.9)] ring-1 ring-foreground/10 sm:w-52" />
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 text-center sm:text-left">

type Drawn = MediaCard & { description?: string | null }
type Phase = 'idle' | 'shuffling' | 'revealed' | 'empty'

function rarity(score?: number | null) {
  if ((score ?? 0) >= 85) return { id: 'SSR', label: 'Efsanevi', ring: 'var(--fx-gold)' }
  if ((score ?? 0) >= 75) return { id: 'SR', label: 'Nadir', ring: 'var(--primary)' }
  return { id: 'R', label: 'Sıradan', ring: 'color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 35%, transparent)' }
}

function Chip({ active, onClick, children }: { active: boolean; onClick: () => void; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition', active ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink')}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}

                className="rounded-2xl rounded-bl-sm border border-border bg-popover px-4 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed"

                {syraLine}

              </Link>

          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { Fragment, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { Clock, LayoutGrid, List, Moon, Sun, Sunrise, Sunset } from 'lucide-react'
import type { ScheduleItem } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, timeUntil } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const TZ = 'Europe/Istanbul'
const dayKey = (ts: number) => new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TZ })
const hourOf = (ts: number) => Number(new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', hour12: false, timeZone: TZ }))
const timeOf = (ts: number) => new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleTimeString('tr-TR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: TZ })

const BUCKETS = [
  { id: 'morning', label: 'Sabah', range: [5, 12], icon: Sunrise },
  { id: 'noon', label: 'Öğleden sonra', range: [12, 17], icon: Sun },
  { id: 'evening', label: 'Akşam', range: [17, 22], icon: Sunset },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Gece', range: [22, 29], icon: Moon },
] as const

function bucketOf(ts: number) {
  const h = hourOf(ts)
  const hh = h < 5 ? h + 24 : h
  return BUCKETS.find((b) => hh >= b.range[0] && hh < b.range[1])?.id ?? 'night'
}

function Spotlight({ item, now }: { item: ScheduleItem; now: number }) {
  const left = Math.max(0, item.airingAt - now)
  return (
    <Link href={`/anime/${item.media.id}`} className="group dark relative isolate flex min-h-56 overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] bg-scrim text-foreground">
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={item.media.bannerImage || item.media.coverImage.extraLarge || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 size-full object-cover opacity-60 transition duration-700 group-hover:scale-105" />
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim via-scrim/80 to-transparent" />
      <div className="flex w-full flex-col justify-between gap-6 p-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:p-8">
        <div className="flex max-w-xl flex-col gap-3">
          <span className="label-mono flex items-center gap-2 text-primary">
            <span className="size-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-primary" /> Sıradaki yayın
          </span>
          <p className="text-balance text-3xl font-bold leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">{pickTitle(item.media.title)}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-foreground/70">
            {item.episode}. bölüm · {timeOf(item.airingAt)} · {item.media.genres?.slice(0, 2).map(genreTr).join(', ')}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1 sm:items-end">
          <span className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-foreground/60">Kalan süre</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-4xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-primary sm:text-5xl">{now ? timeUntil(left) : '—'}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Link>
  )
}

function Row({ it, now, index }: { it: ScheduleItem; now: number; index: number }) {
  const aired = now > 0 && it.airingAt <= now
  return (
    <motion.li initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.03, 0.4), duration: 0.4 }}>
      <Link
        href={`/anime/${it.media.id}`}
        className={cn('group relative flex items-center gap-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-3 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-primary sm:gap-5', aired && 'opacity-60 hover:opacity-100')}
      >
        <span className="flex w-16 shrink-0 flex-col items-center">
          <span className="font-mono text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums">{timeOf(it.airingAt)}</span>
          <span className={cn('mt-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider', aired ? 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' : 'bg-primary/15 text-ink')}>
            {aired ? 'Yayında' : now ? timeUntil(it.airingAt - now) : '—'}
          </span>
        </span>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={it.media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="h-20 w-14 shrink-0 rounded-xl object-cover transition duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" />
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block truncate font-semibold group-hover:text-ink">{pickTitle(it.media.title)}</span>
          <span className="mt-1 block truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {it.episode}. bölüm{it.media.episodes ? ` / ${it.media.episodes}` : ''} · {formatTr(it.media.format)}
          </span>
        </span>
        {it.media.averageScore ? <span className="hidden font-mono text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:block">{it.media.averageScore}</span> : null}
      </Link>
    </motion.li>
  )
}

export function ScheduleView({ items }: { items: ScheduleItem[] }) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(0)
  const [view, setView] = useState<'list' | 'grid'>('list')
  useEffect(() => {
    setNow(Date.now() / 1000)
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now() / 1000), 30000)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [])

  const days = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ScheduleItem[]>()
    for (const it of items) {
      const k = dayKey(it.airingAt)
      if (!map.has(k)) map.set(k, [])
      map.get(k)!.push(it)
    }
    return [...map.entries()].slice(0, 8)
  }, [items])

  const todayKey = dayKey(Date.now() / 1000)
  const [active, setActive] = useState(todayKey)
  const current = days.find(([k]) => k === active) ?? days[0]
  const next = now ? items.find((i) => i.airingAt > now) : null

  if (!days.length)
    return (
      <div className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border py-20 text-center">
        <p className="text-lg font-semibold">Takvim şu an yüklenemedi</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Birkaç saniye sonra yenilemeyi dene.</p>
      </div>
    )

  const list = current?.[1] ?? []
  const nowIndex = list.findIndex((i) => i.airingAt > now)

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      {next && <Spotlight item={next} now={now} />}

      <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:grid sm:grid-cols-4 sm:px-0 lg:grid-cols-8" role="tablist" aria-label="Günler">
        {days.map(([k, dayList]) => {
          const d = new Date(`${k}T12:00:00`)
          const isActive = k === current?.[0]
          return (
            <button
              key={k}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={isActive}
              onClick={() => setActive(k)}
              className={cn('relative isolate flex w-28 shrink-0 flex-col items-start gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border p-3 text-left transition sm:w-auto', isActive ? 'border-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border bg-card hover:border-primary/50')}
            >
              {isActive && <motion.span layoutId="day" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 34 }} />}
              <span className={cn('label-mono text-[9px]', isActive ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>{k === todayKey ? 'Bugün' : d.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { weekday: 'short' })}</span>
              <span className="text-3xl font-bold leading-none tabular-nums">{d.getDate()}</span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="flex -space-x-2">
                  {dayList.slice(0, 3).map((it) => (
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                    <img key={it.id} src={it.media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-5 rounded-full object-cover ring-2 ring-card" />
                  ))}
                </span>
                <span className={cn('ml-1 font-mono text-[10px]', isActive ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>{dayList.length}</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <Clock className="size-4" /> Türkiye saati · {list.length} bölüm
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-full bg-muted p-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Görünüm">
          {(
            [
              ['list', 'Zaman çizelgesi', List],
              ['grid', 'Gün dilimleri', LayoutGrid],
            ] as const
          ).map(([v, l, Icon]) => (
            <button key={v} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={view === v} onClick={() => setView(v)} className={cn('flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition', view === v ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
              <Icon className="size-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">{l}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {view === 'list' ? (
          <motion.ol key={`list-${current?.[0]}`} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {list.map((it, i) => (
              <Fragment key={it.id}>
                {current?.[0] === todayKey && i === nowIndex && nowIndex > 0 && (
                  <li className="flex items-center gap-3 py-1" aria-label="Şu an">
                    <span className="size-2.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-primary" />
                    <span className="label-mono text-[10px] text-ink">Şimdi · {timeOf(now)}</span>
                    <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-primary/50" />
                  </li>
                )}
                <Row it={it} now={now} index={i} />
              </Fragment>
            ))}
          </motion.ol>
        ) : (
          <motion.div key={`grid-${current?.[0]}`} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            {BUCKETS.map((b) => {
              const inBucket = list.filter((i) => bucketOf(i.airingAt) === b.id)
              return (
                <section key={b.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-4" aria-label={b.label}>
                  <header className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1">
                    <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-accent text-ink">
                      <b.icon className="size-4" />
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{b.label}</span>
                    <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{inBucket.length}</span>
                  </header>
                  {inBucket.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="px-1 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Bu dilimde yayın yok.</p>
                  ) : (
                    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                      {inBucket.map((it) => (
                        <li key={it.id}>
                          <Link href={`/anime/${it.media.id}`} className={cn('group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-2 transition hover:bg-muted', now && it.airingAt <= now && 'opacity-60')}>
                            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                            <img src={it.media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="h-14 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                              <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium group-hover:text-ink">{pickTitle(it.media.title)}</span>
                              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                {timeOf(it.airingAt)} · B{it.episode}
                              </span>

                          </Link>
                        </li>

  )

  ['', 'Tüm formatlar'],
  ['TV', 'TV'],
  ['MOVIE', 'Film'],
  ['ONA', 'ONA'],
  ['OVA', 'OVA'],
  ['SPECIAL', 'Özel'],
] as const
const STATUSES = [
  ['', 'Tüm durumlar'],
  ['RELEASING', 'Yayında'],
  ['FINISHED', 'Tamamlandı'],
  ['NOT_YET_RELEASED', 'Yakında'],
] as const
const SEASONS = [
  ['', 'Tüm sezonlar'],
  ['WINTER', 'Kış'],
  ['SPRING', 'İlkbahar'],
  ['SUMMER', 'Yaz'],
  ['FALL', 'Sonbahar'],
] as const

const selectCls = 'h-11 w-full min-w-0 truncate rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary sm:w-auto'

export function SearchFilters() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const params = useSearchParams()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [q, setQ] = useState(params.get('q') ?? '')
  const [group, setGroup] = useState(TROPE_GROUPS[0].id)
  const years = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => new Date().getFullYear() + 1 - i)

  const update = (patch: Record<string, string>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString())
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(patch)) {
      if (v) next.set(k, v)
      else next.delete(k)
    }
    next.delete('page')
    start(() => router.push(`${pathname}?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false }))
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if ((params.get('q') ?? '') !== q.trim()) update({ q: q.trim() })
    }, 450)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [q])

  const genre = params.get('genre') ?? ''
  const tags = (params.get('tag') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean)
  const active = ['q', 'genre', 'tag', 'year', 'season', 'format', 'status', 'sort'].some((k) => params.get(k))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-5 top-1/2 size-5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Anime adı ara…"
          aria-label="Anime adı"
          className="h-16 w-full rounded-full border border-border bg-card pl-14 pr-14 text-lg outline-none transition focus:border-primary focus:shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_18%,transparent)]"
        />
        {pending && <Loader2 className="absolute right-6 top-1/2 size-5 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-ink" />}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 items-center gap-2 sm:flex sm:flex-wrap">
        <select aria-label="Sıralama" className={selectCls} value={params.get('sort') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ sort: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="">Sırala: Varsayılan</option>
          {SORTS.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              Sırala: {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Format" className={selectCls} value={params.get('format') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ format: e.target.value })}>
          {FORMATS.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Durum" className={selectCls} value={params.get('status') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ status: e.target.value })}>
          {STATUSES.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Sezon" className={selectCls} value={params.get('season') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ season: e.target.value })}>
          {SEASONS.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Yıl" className={selectCls} value={params.get('year') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ year: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="">Tüm yıllar</option>
          {years.map((y) => (
            <option key={y} value={y}>
              {y}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {active && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQ('')
              start(() => router.push(pathname, { scroll: false }))
            }}
            className="flex h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-destructive"
          >
            <X className="size-4" /> Temizle
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="label-mono text-muted-foreground">Anime klişeleri · seçilenlerin hepsi</p>
          <div className="scrollbar-none flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-full bg-muted p-1" role="tablist" aria-label="Klişe grubu">
            {[...TROPE_GROUPS, { id: 'demo', label: 'Demografi', items: DEMOGRAPHICS }].map((g) => (
              <button
                key={g.id}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={group === g.id}
                onClick={() => setGroup(g.id)}
                className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition', group === g.id ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}
              >
                {g.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0">
          {[...TROPE_GROUPS, { id: 'demo', label: 'Demografi', items: DEMOGRAPHICS }]
            .find((g) => g.id === group)
            ?.items.map((t) => {
              const on = tags.includes(t.tag)
              return (
                <button
                  key={t.tag}
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={on}
                  onClick={() => update({ tag: (on ? tags.filter((x) => x !== t.tag) : [...tags, t.tag].slice(-3)).join(',') })}
                  className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', on ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink')}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </button>
              )
            })}
        </div>
        {tags.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3">
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Seçili:</span>
            {tags.map((t) => (
              <button key={t} type="button" onClick={() => update({ tag: tags.filter((x) => x !== t).join(',') })} className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-accent px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium">
                {TROPE_LABEL[t] ?? t} <X className="size-3" />
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0">
        {GENRE_LIST.map((g) => (
          <button
            key={g}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={genre === g}
            onClick={() => update({ genre: genre === g ? '' : g })}
            className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', genre === g ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink')}
          >
            {genreTr(g)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import type { SeriesSeason } from '@/lib/series'

const fmt = (d: string | null) => (d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : null)

/** Seasons as a reel of frames: season art, a giant outlined season numeral, air dates and episode count. */
export function SeasonReel({ seasons, fallback }: { seasons: SeriesSeason[]; fallback: string }) {
  if (!seasons.length) {
    return <p className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Sezon bilgisi bulunamadı.</p>
  }
  return (
    <div className="dark hx-filmstrip -mx-4 py-7 text-foreground sm:mx-0 sm:rounded-2xl">
      <div className="px-4 sm:px-6">
        <ScrollRow label="Sezonlar">
          {seasons.map((s) => {
            const dates = [fmt(s.premiere), fmt(s.end)].filter(Boolean)
            return (
              <article key={s.number} className="group relative flex w-[46vw] shrink-0 snap-start flex-col gap-3 sm:w-[200px]">
                <div className="relative aspect-[2/3] overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-muted ring-1 ring-foreground/10 transition duration-500 group-hover:-translate-y-1 group-hover:ring-primary/60">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={s.image || fallback || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className={s.image ? 'size-full object-cover' : 'size-full object-cover opacity-40 blur-sm'} />
                  <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim via-scrim/30 to-transparent" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="cine-numeral absolute -bottom-3 left-2 font-sans text-[7rem] font-black leading-none tracking-[-0.08em]" aria-hidden="true">
                    {s.number}
                  </span>
                  {s.episodes ? (
                    <span className="absolute right-2 top-2 rounded-full bg-scrim/75 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-on-scrim backdrop-blur">{s.episodes} bölüm</span>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">{s.number}. Sezon</h3>
                  <p className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-foreground/55">{dates.join(' – ') || 'Tarih bilinmiyor'}</p>
                </div>
              </article>
            )
          })}
        </ScrollRow>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useId, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { BadgeCheck, Check, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, MailCheck } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { confirmCurrentEmail, confirmEmailChange, linkPasswordLogin, removeAccount, sendVerificationCode, updateEmail, updateIdentity, updatePassword } from '@/app/actions/account'
import { CodeInput } from '@/components/auth/code-input'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type ActionResult = { ok: true; message?: string; step?: 'verify'; masked?: string; devCode?: string } | { ok: false; error: string }

export function useAction() {
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const run = (fn: () => Promise<ActionResult>, onOk?: (r: Extract<ActionResult, { ok: true }>) => void) => {
    setError(null)
    start(async () => {
      try {
        const r = await fn()
        if (r.ok) {
          if (r.message) toast.success(r.message)
          onOk?.(r)
        } else setError(r.error)
      } catch {
        setError('Bağlantı hatası. Tekrar dene.')
      }
    })
  }
  return { pending, error, run }
}

export function Field({
  label,
  hint,
  type = 'text',
  value,
  onChange,
  autoComplete,
  prefix,
  maxLength,
  required = true,
}: {
  label: string
  hint?: string
  type?: string
  value: string
  onChange: (v: string) => void
  autoComplete?: string
  prefix?: string
  maxLength?: number
  required?: boolean
}) {
  const id = useId()
  const [reveal, setReveal] = useState(false)
  const isPassword = type === 'password'
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <label htmlFor={id} className="text-sm font-medium">
        {label}
      </label>
      <div className="relative flex items-center">
        {prefix && <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 font-mono text-sm text-muted-foreground">{prefix}</span>}
        <input
          id={id}
          type={isPassword && reveal ? 'text' : type}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          maxLength={maxLength}
          required={required}
          aria-describedby={hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined}
          className={cn('h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3.5 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/15', prefix && 'pl-8', isPassword && 'pr-11')}
        />
        {isPassword && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setReveal((r) => !r)} aria-label={reveal ? 'Şifreyi gizle' : 'Şifreyi göster'} className="absolute right-1.5 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
            {reveal ? <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {hint && (
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function passwordStrength(pw: string) {
  let score = 0
  if (pw.length >= 8) score++
  if (pw.length >= 12) score++
  if (/[a-zçğıöşü]/.test(pw) && /[A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ]/.test(pw)) score++
  if (/[0-9]/.test(pw)) score++
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9çğıöşüÇĞİÖŞÜ]/.test(pw)) score++
  const level = Math.min(4, score)
  return { level, label: ['Çok zayıf', 'Zayıf', 'Orta', 'Güçlü', 'Çok güçlü'][level] }
}

function StrengthMeter({ value }: { value: string }) {
  if (!value) return null
  const { level, label } = passwordStrength(value)
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3" aria-live="polite">
      <div className="grid flex-1 grid-cols-4 gap-1">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => (
          <span key={n} className={cn('h-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors', n <= level ? (level <= 1 ? 'bg-destructive' : level === 2 ? 'bg-primary/60' : 'bg-primary') : 'bg-muted')} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <span className="w-20 text-right font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
    </div>
  )
}

function FormError({ error }: { error: string | null }) {
  if (!error) return null
  return (
    <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-destructive">
      {error}
    </p>
  )
}

function Submit({ pending, children, disabled, tone = 'primary' }: { pending: boolean; children: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; tone?: 'primary' | 'danger' }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending || disabled}
      className={cn(
        'flex h-11 w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-5 text-sm font-semibold transition disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
        tone === 'danger' ? 'bg-destructive text-background hover:brightness-110' : 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:brightness-110',
      )}
    >
      {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Check className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}

export function IdentityForm({ displayName, username }: { displayName: string; username: string }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [name, setName] = useState(displayName)
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState(username)
  const { pending, error, run } = useAction()
  const dirty = name.trim() !== displayName || handle.trim() !== username
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        run(() => updateIdentity({ displayName: name, username: handle }), () => router.refresh())
      }}
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Görünen ad" value={name} onChange={setName} maxLength={40} autoComplete="nickname" hint="Yorumlarda ve profilinde görünür." />
        <Field label="Kullanıcı adı" value={handle} onChange={(v) => setHandle(v.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, ''))} prefix="@" maxLength={20} autoComplete="username" hint="Harf, rakam, nokta ve alt çizgi. Profil adresin değişir." />
      </div>
      <FormError error={error} />
      <Submit pending={pending} disabled={!dirty}>
        Kaydet
      </Submit>
    </form>
  )
}

function VerifyStep({ masked, devCode, pending, error, onConfirm, onCancel }: { masked: string; devCode?: string; pending: boolean; error: string | null; onConfirm: (code: string) => void; onCancel: () => void }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('')
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        if (code.length === 6) onConfirm(code)
      }}
    >
      <p className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
        <MailCheck className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-ink" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{masked}</span> adresine 6 haneli bir kod gönderdik. Kod 10 dakika geçerli.
        </span>
      </p>
      {devCode && (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-primary/50 px-3.5 py-2 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Önizleme modu · kod: <span className="font-semibold tracking-[0.3em] text-ink">{devCode}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="max-w-sm">
        <CodeInput value={code} onChange={setCode} onComplete={onConfirm} disabled={pending} tone="light" />
      </div>
      <FormError error={error} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Submit pending={pending} disabled={code.length !== 6}>
          Doğrula
        </Submit>
        <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
          Vazgeç
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

export function VerifiedStatus({ verified }: { verified: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { pending, error, run } = useAction()
  const [pendingCode, setPendingCode] = useState<{ masked: string; devCode?: string } | null>(null)
  if (verified) {
    return (
      <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm">
        <BadgeCheck className="size-4 text-ink" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>
          E-postan <span className="font-semibold">doğrulanmış</span>. Profilinde Doğrulanmış rozeti görünüyor.
        </span>
      </p>
    )
  }
  if (pendingCode) {
    return (
      <VerifyStep
        {...pendingCode}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onCancel={() => setPendingCode(null)}
        onConfirm={(code) =>
          run(
            () => confirmCurrentEmail({ code }),
            () => {
              setPendingCode(null)
              router.refresh()
            },
          )
        }
      />
    )
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3.5 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">E-postan henüz doğrulanmadı. Doğrula, Doğrulanmış rozetini kazan.</p>
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={pending}
        onClick={() => run(() => sendVerificationCode(), (r) => r.step === 'verify' && setPendingCode({ masked: r.masked ?? '', devCode: r.devCode }))}
        className="flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-background transition hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <BadgeCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        Kod gönder
      </button>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive sm:basis-full">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function EmailForm({ current, verified = false }: { current: string; verified?: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [pendingCode, setPendingCode] = useState<{ masked: string; devCode?: string } | null>(null)
  const { pending, error, run } = useAction()

  if (pendingCode) {
    return (
      <VerifyStep
        {...pendingCode}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onCancel={() => setPendingCode(null)}
        onConfirm={(code) =>
          run(
            () => confirmEmailChange({ email, code }),
            () => {
              setPendingCode(null)
              setEmail('')
              setPassword('')
              router.refresh()
            },
          )
        }
      />
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <VerifiedStatus verified={verified} />
      <form
        className="flex flex-col gap-4"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          run(
            () => updateEmail({ email, password }),
            (r) => {
              if (r.step === 'verify') {
                setPendingCode({ masked: r.masked ?? email, devCode: r.devCode })
                return
              }
              setEmail('')
              setPassword('')
              router.refresh()
            },
          )
        }}
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Şu an: <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{current}</span>
        </p>
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Yeni e-posta" type="email" value={email} onChange={setEmail} autoComplete="email" />
          <Field label="Mevcut şifre" type="password" value={password} onChange={setPassword} autoComplete="current-password" hint="Değişikliği onaylamak için." />
        </div>
        <FormError error={error} />
        <Submit pending={pending} disabled={!email || !password}>
          Kod gönder ve değiştir
        </Submit>
      </form>
    </div>
  )
}

export function PasswordForm() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState('')
  const [next, setNext] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const { pending, error, run } = useAction()
  const mismatch = confirm.length > 0 && confirm !== next
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        if (next !== confirm) return
        run(
          () => updatePassword({ current, next }),
          () => {
            setCurrent('')
            setNext('')
            setConfirm('')
            router.refresh()
          },
        )
      }}
    >
      <Field label="Mevcut şifre" type="password" value={current} onChange={setCurrent} autoComplete="current-password" />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Yeni şifre" type="password" value={next} onChange={setNext} autoComplete="new-password" hint="En az 8 karakter, bir harf ve bir rakam." />
        <Field label="Yeni şifre (tekrar)" type="password" value={confirm} onChange={setConfirm} autoComplete="new-password" hint={mismatch ? 'Şifreler eşleşmiyor.' : undefined} />
      </div>
      <StrengthMeter value={next} />
      <FormError error={error} />
      <Submit pending={pending} disabled={!current || !next || mismatch}>
        Şifreyi değiştir
      </Submit>
    </form>
  )
}

export function LinkPasswordForm({ suggestedEmail }: { suggestedEmail?: string | null }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(suggestedEmail ?? '')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const { pending, error, run } = useAction()
  const mismatch = confirm.length > 0 && confirm !== password
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        if (password !== confirm) return
        run(() => linkPasswordLogin({ email, password }), () => router.refresh())
      }}
    >
      <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Sosyal hesabına erişimini kaybedersen diye yedek bir giriş yolu ekle. Bu e-posta ve şifreyle de hesabına girebilirsin.</p>
      <Field label="E-posta" type="email" value={email} onChange={setEmail} autoComplete="email" />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Şifre" type="password" value={password} onChange={setPassword} autoComplete="new-password" hint="En az 8 karakter, bir harf ve bir rakam." />
        <Field label="Şifre (tekrar)" type="password" value={confirm} onChange={setConfirm} autoComplete="new-password" hint={mismatch ? 'Şifreler eşleşmiyor.' : undefined} />
      </div>
      <StrengthMeter value={password} />
      <FormError error={error} />
      <Submit pending={pending} disabled={!email || !password || mismatch}>
        E-posta ile girişi ekle
      </Submit>
    </form>
  )
}

export function DeleteAccountForm({ username, needsPassword }: { username: string; needsPassword: boolean }) {
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const { pending, error, run } = useAction()
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        run(
          () => removeAccount({ confirm, password }),
          () => {
            window.location.href = '/'
          },
        )
      }}
    >
      <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
        Profilin, favorilerin ve kozmetiklerin kalıcı olarak silinir. Bu işlem geri alınamaz. Onaylamak için <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-foreground">{username}</span> yaz.
      </p>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Kullanıcı adı" value={confirm} onChange={setConfirm} autoComplete="off" />
        {needsPassword && <Field label="Şifre" type="password" value={password} onChange={setPassword} autoComplete="current-password" />}
      </div>
      <FormError error={error} />
      <Submit pending={pending} tone="danger" disabled={confirm.trim().toLowerCase() !== username.toLowerCase() || (needsPassword && !password)}>
        Hesabımı kalıcı olarak sil
      </Submit>
    </form>
  )
}

const PROVIDERS: Record<string, string> = { discord: 'Discord', google: 'Google', github: 'GitHub', email: 'E-posta' }

function mask(email?: string | null) {
  return email ? email.replace(/(.{2}).+(@.+)/, '$1•••$2') : '—'
}

function ago(ts?: number) {
  if (!ts) return null
  const diff = Date.now() - ts
  const m = Math.round(diff / 60_000)
  if (m < 1) return 'az önce'
  if (m < 60) return `${m} dk önce`
  const h = Math.round(m / 60)
  if (h < 24) return `${h} sa önce`
  const d = Math.round(h / 24)
  if (d < 30) return `${d} gün önce`
  return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
}

function Section({
  icon: Icon,
  title,

  onToggle,
  children,
  tone,
}: {
  icon: typeof UserRound
  title: string

  children: React.ReactNode
  tone?: 'danger'
}) {

        <span className={cn('grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl transition', tone === 'danger' ? 'bg-destructive/10 text-destructive' : open ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-foreground')}>
          <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">

function SecurityScore({ items }: { items: { label: string; done: boolean; hint: string }[] }) {
  const done = items.filter((i) => i.done).length
  const pct = Math.round((done / items.length) * 100)
  const r = 34
  const c = 2 * Math.PI * r
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
      <div className="relative grid size-28 shrink-0 place-items-center">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 80 80" className="absolute inset-0 -rotate-90" aria-hidden="true">
          <circle cx="40" cy="40" r={r} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="6" className="text-muted" />
          <motion.circle
            cx="40"
            cy="40"
            r={r}
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="6"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            className="text-primary"
            strokeDasharray={c}
            initial={{ strokeDashoffset: c }}
            animate={{ strokeDashoffset: c - (c * pct) / 100 }}
            transition={{ duration: 1.2, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
          />
        </svg>
        <span className="flex flex-col items-center">
          <span className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight">{pct}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">puan</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      <ul className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2.5" aria-label="Güvenlik kontrol listesi">
        {items.map((i) => (
          <li key={i.label} className="flex items-start gap-3 text-sm">
            <span className={cn('mt-0.5 grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full', i.done ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border border-dashed border-muted-foreground/50')}>
              {i.done && <ShieldCheck className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />}
            </span>
            <span>
              <span className={cn('block font-medium', !i.done && 'text-muted-foreground')}>{i.label}</span>
              {!i.done && <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{i.hint}</span>}
            </span>
            <span className="sr-only">{i.done ? 'tamamlandı' : 'eksik'}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

export function AccountPanel({ provider, email, passwordEmail, memberSince, username, displayName, logins, passwordChangedAt, revokedAt, emailVerified }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const toggle = (id: string) => setOpen((o) => (o === id ? null : id))
  const revoke = useAction()
  const hasPassword = Boolean(passwordEmail)
  const methods = [PROVIDERS[provider] ?? provider, ...(hasPassword && provider !== 'email' ? ['E-posta + şifre'] : [])]
  const freshPassword = passwordChangedAt ? Date.now() - passwordChangedAt < 180 * 86400_000 : provider === 'email' && Date.now() - memberSince < 180 * 86400_000

  const checklist = [
    { label: 'E-posta adresi tanımlı', done: Boolean(email || passwordEmail), hint: 'Hesabını kurtarabilmen için bir e-posta ekle.' },
