    { label: 'Birden fazla giriş yolu', done: methods.length > 1, hint: provider === 'email' ? 'Profil sayfasından bir sosyal hesap bağlayarak yedek yol oluşturabilirsin.' : 'Yedek bir giriş yöntemi kilitlenme riskini azaltır.' },
    { label: 'Şifre son 6 ayda yenilendi', done: hasPassword && freshPassword, hint: hasPassword ? 'Şifreni düzenli aralıklarla değiştir.' : 'Önce bir şifre belirle.' },
    { label: 'Oturumlar gözden geçirildi', done: Boolean(revokedAt && Date.now() - revokedAt < 90 * 86400_000), hint: 'Tanımadığın cihazları aşağıdan kapat.' },
  ]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card title="Güvenlik" accent="durumu">
        <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Eksik adımları tamamladıkça hesabın daha zor ele geçirilir.</p>
        <SecurityScore items={checklist} />
      </Card>

      <Card title="Hesap" accent="ayarları">
        <div className="mt-2">
          <Section icon={UserRound} title="Ad ve kullanıcı adı" summary={`${displayName} · @${username}`} open={open === 'identity'} onToggle={() => toggle('identity')}>
            <IdentityForm displayName={displayName} username={username} />
          </Section>

          <Section icon={Mail} title="E-posta" summary={hasPassword ? `${mask(passwordEmail)}${emailVerified ? ' · doğrulanmış' : ''}` : email ? `${mask(email)} · yalnızca iletişim` : 'Tanımlı değil'} open={open === 'email'} onToggle={() => toggle('email')}>
            {hasPassword ? <EmailForm current={mask(passwordEmail)} verified={Boolean(emailVerified)} /> : <LinkPasswordForm suggestedEmail={email} />}
          </Section>

          <Section
            icon={KeyRound}
            title="Şifre"
            summary={hasPassword ? (passwordChangedAt ? `Son değişiklik ${ago(passwordChangedAt)}` : 'Tanımlı') : 'Şifre yok — sosyal hesapla giriş'}
            open={open === 'password'}
            onToggle={() => toggle('password')}
          >
            {hasPassword ? <PasswordForm /> : <LinkPasswordForm suggestedEmail={email} />}
          </Section>

          <Section icon={AtSign} title="Giriş yöntemleri" summary={methods.join(' · ')} open={open === 'methods'} onToggle={() => toggle('methods')}>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <li className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                <span className="font-medium">{PROVIDERS[provider] ?? provider}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-ink">Bağlı · Ana yöntem</span>
              </li>
              {provider !== 'email' && (
                <li className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                  <span className="font-medium">E-posta + şifre</span>
                  {hasPassword ? (
                    <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-ink">Bağlı</span>
                  ) : (
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen('password')} className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground underline-offset-4 hover:text-foreground hover:underline">
                      Ekle
                    </button>
                  )}
                </li>
              )}
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Üyelik başlangıcı: {new Date(memberSince).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}
            </p>
          </Section>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Oturumlar ve" accent="cihazlar">
        <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Hesabına son giriş yapılan cihazlar. Tanımadığın bir giriş görürsen şifreni değiştir ve diğer oturumları kapat.</p>
        {logins.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz kayıtlı giriş yok. Bir sonraki girişinden itibaren burada listelenecek.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border">
            {logins.map((l, i) => (
              <li key={`${l.at}-${i}`} className="flex items-center gap-4 py-3">
                <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                  <MonitorSmartphone className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
                    {l.device}
                    {i === 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-primary/15 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-ink">Son giriş</span>}
                  </span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {l.ip} · {PROVIDERS[l.method] ?? l.method} · {ago(l.at)}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={revoke.pending}
          onClick={() => revoke.run(() => signOutEverywhere(), () => router.refresh())}
          className="mt-4 flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-destructive hover:text-destructive disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <ShieldAlert className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          Diğer tüm oturumları kapat
        </button>
        {revoke.error && (
          <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm text-destructive">
            {revoke.error}
          </p>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Veri ve" accent="deneyim">
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <a href="/api/account/export" className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary">
            <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Verilerimi indir (JSON)
          </a>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              try {
                sessionStorage.removeItem('sy-intro-seen')
                localStorage.removeItem('sy-intro')
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('intro-seen')
              } catch {}
              window.location.href = '/'
            }}
            className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary"
          >
            <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Açılışı tekrar oynat
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              try {
                localStorage.removeItem('sy-welcomed')
              } catch {}
              router.push('/hosgeldin')
            }}
            className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary"
          >
            <Sparkles className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Tanıtım turu
          </button>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Tehlikeli" accent="bölge">
        <div className="mt-2">
          <Section icon={Trash2} title="Hesabı sil" summary="Tüm verilerin kalıcı olarak silinir" open={open === 'delete'} onToggle={() => toggle('delete')} tone="danger">
            <DeleteAccountForm username={username} needsPassword={hasPassword} />
          </Section>
        </div>
        <form action="/api/auth/logout" method="post" className="mt-4">
          <button type="submit" className="flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-destructive/40 text-sm font-medium text-destructive transition hover:bg-destructive/10">
            <LogOut className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Çıkış yap
          </button>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Check, Clapperboard, Loader2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { setContentMode } from '@/app/actions/content-mode'
import type { ContentMode } from '@/lib/content-mode-shared'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const OPTIONS: { id: ContentMode; title: string; accent: string; body: string; points: string[]; image: string; icon: typeof Sparkles }[] = [
  {
    id: 'anime',
    title: 'Anime',
    accent: 'modu',
    body: 'Sytheris’in kalbi. AniList’ten canlı gelen katalog, sezonlar, karakterler ve seslendirmenler.',
    points: ['Türkiye Top 10 ve sezon listeleri', 'Bölüm izleme, kütüphane, takvim', 'Manga okuyucu ve karakter dosyaları'],
    image: '/modes/anime.webp',
    icon: Sparkles,
  },
  {
    id: 'film',
    title: 'Sinema',
    accent: 'modu',
    body: 'Anime olmayan, canlı çekim filmler. Ana sayfa ve menü bir sinema salonuna dönüşür.',
    points: ['Türkiye listelerinden haftanın filmleri', 'Resmî fragmanlar ve Türkçe özetler', 'Tür seansları: aksiyondan klasiklere'],
    image: '/modes/cinema.webp',
    icon: Clapperboard,
  },
]

export function ContentModePanel({ mode }: { mode: ContentMode }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(mode)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()

  const choose = (next: ContentMode) => {
    if (next === current || pending) return
    const prev = current
    setCurrent(next)
    start(async () => {
      const res = await setContentMode(next).catch(() => null)
      if (!res?.ok) {
        setCurrent(prev)
        toast.error('Mod değiştirilemedi, tekrar dene.')
        return
      }
      toast.success(next === 'film' ? 'Sinema modu açık — ana sayfa filmlerle yenilendi' : 'Anime moduna dönüldü')
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="İçerik modu" className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        {OPTIONS.map((o) => {
          const on = current === o.id
          return (
            <button
              key={o.id}
              type="button"
              role="radio"
              aria-checked={on}
              onClick={() => choose(o.id)}
              className={cn(
                'group relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[1.75rem] border text-left outline-none transition duration-500 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary',
                on ? 'border-primary shadow-[0_24px_60px_-30px_var(--primary)]' : 'border-border hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-foreground/30',
              )}
            >
              <span className="dark relative block h-44 overflow-hidden bg-scrim sm:h-52">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={o.image || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className={cn('absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover transition duration-1000 group-hover:scale-105', !on && 'grayscale-[0.6]')} />
                <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim via-scrim/30 to-transparent" />
                <span className="absolute left-5 top-5 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-scrim/60 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-on-scrim backdrop-blur">
                  <o.icon className="size-3.5" /> {o.id === 'anime' ? 'Varsayılan' : 'Yeni'}
                </span>
                <span className={cn('absolute right-5 top-5 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full border-2 transition', on ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-on-scrim/50 bg-scrim/40 text-transparent')}>
                  {pending && on ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="size-4" strokeWidth={3} />}
                </span>
                <span className="absolute bottom-4 left-5 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-on-scrim">
                  {o.title} <span className="font-serif font-normal italic">{o.accent}</span>
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-4 bg-card p-5">
                <span className="text-pretty text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{o.body}</span>
                <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                  {o.points.map((p) => (
                    <li key={p} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm">
                      <span className={cn('size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full', on ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-muted-foreground/50')} />
                      {p}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </span>
              {on && <motion.span layoutId="mode-ring" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-[1.75rem] ring-2 ring-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 32 }} />}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Tercih bu tarayıcıda saklanır. Listelerin, favorilerin ve yorumların iki modda da korunur; yalnızca keşfettiğin katalog değişir.</p>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { Check, Loader2, Lock, Pencil, Sparkles, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { deleteCustomTheme, saveCustomTheme } from '@/app/actions/themes'
import { CUSTOM_THEME_LIMIT, HEX_RE, customThemeVars, hexToOklch, oklchToHex, sanitizeThemeName, type CustomTheme } from '@/lib/custom-theme'
import type { Tier } from '@/lib/membership'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useTheme } from '@/components/providers/theme-provider'
import { Card } from './settings-panel'

const SWATCHES = [
  { name: 'Gece Mavisi', hex: '#3d5afe' },
  { name: 'Kan Ayı', hex: '#c62839' },
  { name: 'Yeşim', hex: '#14b38a' },

function Slider({ label, value, min, max, step, onChange, track, format }: { label: string; value: number; min: number; max: number; step: number; onChange: (v: number) => void; track: string; format: (v: number) => string }) {
  return (
    <label className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <span className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <span className="font-medium">{label}</span>
        <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{format(value)}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="relative flex h-6 items-center">
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-x-0 h-3 rounded-full ring-1 ring-foreground/10" style={{ background: track }} />
        <input type="range" min={min} max={max} step={step} value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))} className="sy-range relative w-full" aria-label={label} />
      </span>
    </label>
  )
}

function Preview({ hex, name }: { hex: string; name: string }) {
  const { dark } = useTheme()
  const base = customThemeVars(hex)
  const vars = {
    ...base,
    '--ink': dark ? base['--ink-dark'] : base['--ink-light'],
    '--accent': dark ? `oklch(0.26 calc(${base['--chroma']} * 0.2) ${base['--hue']})` : `oklch(0.94 calc(${base['--chroma']} * 0.12) ${base['--hue']})`,
  } as React.CSSProperties
  return (
    <div style={vars} className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-border bg-background p-5">
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -right-10 -top-10 size-40 rounded-full bg-primary/20 blur-3xl" />
      <div className="relative flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold tracking-tight">
          SYTHERIS
          <span className="block font-mono text-[8px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-ink">{name || 'Adsız tema'}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="size-3 rounded-full bg-primary shadow-[0_0_12px_var(--primary)]" />
      </div>
      <p className="relative mt-6 text-2xl font-semibold leading-tight tracking-tight">
        Bu akşam <span className="accent-serif">ne izliyoruz?</span>
      </p>
      <div className="relative mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <span className="rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground">Hemen izle</span>
        <span className="rounded-full border border-primary/50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-ink">Listeme ekle</span>
      </div>
      <div className="relative mt-5 flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
          <span className="block h-full w-2/3 rounded-full bg-primary" />
        </span>
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">12:40</span>

      <div className="relative mt-4 flex gap-1.5">
        {['Aksiyon', 'Fantastik', 'Dram'].map((g, i) => (

            {g}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function CustomThemeStudio({ tier, loggedIn, initialThemes }: { tier: Tier; loggedIn: boolean; initialThemes: CustomTheme[] }) {
  const { custom, applyCustom } = useTheme()
  const [themes, setThemes] = useState(initialThemes)
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const start = hexToOklch('#3d5afe')
  const [lch, setLch] = useState({ l: start.l, c: start.c, h: start.h })
  const [hexInput, setHexInput] = useState('#3d5afe')
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition()
  const unlocked = loggedIn && tier !== 'free'
  const hex = oklchToHex(lch.l, lch.c, lch.h)

  const setFromHex = (value: string) => {
    setHexInput(value)
    if (HEX_RE.test(value)) {
      const o = hexToOklch(value)
      setLch({ l: o.l, c: o.c, h: o.h })
    }
  }
  const setChannel = (patch: Partial<typeof lch>) => {
    const next = { ...lch, ...patch }
    setLch(next)
    setHexInput(oklchToHex(next.l, next.c, next.h))
  }

  function save(e: React.MouseEvent) {
    const origin = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }
    const finalName = sanitizeThemeName(name)
    if (finalName.length < 2) {
      toast.error('Temana en az 2 karakterlik bir isim ver.')
      return
    }
    startTransition(async () => {
      const r = await saveCustomTheme({ id: editing ?? undefined, name: finalName, hex })
      if (!r.ok) {
        toast.error(r.error)
        return
      }
      setThemes(r.themes)
      if (r.theme) applyCustom(r.theme, origin)
      setEditing(null)
      toast.success(`“${finalName}” uygulandı`, { description: 'Tüm sitede, bu ve diğer cihazlarında seninle.' })
    })
  }

  function remove(id: string) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const r = await deleteCustomTheme(id)
      if (r.ok) {
        setThemes(r.themes)
        toast.success('Tema silindi')
      } else toast.error(r.error)
    })
  }

  function edit(t: CustomTheme) {
    setEditing(t.id)
    setName(t.name)
    setFromHex(t.hex)
  }

  return (
    <Card title="Özel tema" accent="stüdyosu">
      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <p className="max-w-md text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Kendi rengini karıştır, adını koy. Butonlardan vurgulara kadar her şey senin renginle yeniden boyanır; kontrast otomatik ayarlanır.</p>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground">
          <Sparkles className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" /> Sytheris+
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_minmax(0,320px)]">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Tema adı</span>
            <input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={24}
              placeholder="ör. Gece Yarısı Neonu"
              className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3.5 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/15"
            />
          </label>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <label className="relative size-14 shrink-0 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden rounded-2xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10" style={{ background: hex }}>
              <span className="sr-only">Renk seçici</span>
              <input type="color" value={hex} onChange={(e) => setFromHex(e.target.value)} className="absolute inset-0 size-full cursor-pointer opacity-0" />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">Renk kodu</span>
              <input
                value={hexInput}
                onChange={(e) => setFromHex(e.target.value.startsWith('#') ? e.target.value : `#${e.target.value}`)}
                maxLength={7}
                spellCheck={false}
                aria-invalid={!HEX_RE.test(hexInput)}
                className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3.5 font-mono text-sm uppercase outline-none transition focus:border-primary aria-[invalid=true]:border-destructive"
              />
            </label>
          </div>

          <Slider label="Ton" value={Math.round(lch.h)} min={0} max={359} step={1} onChange={(h) => setChannel({ h })} format={(v) => `${v}°`} track="linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.7 0.18 0), oklch(0.7 0.18 60), oklch(0.7 0.18 120), oklch(0.7 0.18 180), oklch(0.7 0.18 240), oklch(0.7 0.18 300), oklch(0.7 0.18 359))" />
          <Slider label="Canlılık" value={Math.round(lch.c * 1000) / 1000} min={0.02} max={0.3} step={0.005} onChange={(c) => setChannel({ c })} format={(v) => `${Math.round((v / 0.3) * 100)}%`} track={`linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(${lch.l} 0 ${lch.h}), oklch(${lch.l} 0.3 ${lch.h}))`} />
          <Slider label="Parlaklık" value={Math.round(lch.l * 100) / 100} min={0.35} max={0.92} step={0.01} onChange={(l) => setChannel({ l })} format={(v) => `${Math.round(v * 100)}%`} track={`linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.35 ${lch.c} ${lch.h}), oklch(0.92 ${lch.c} ${lch.h}))`} />

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Hazır başlangıçlar</span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {SWATCHES.map((s) => (
                <button
                  key={s.hex}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setFromHex(s.hex)
                    if (!name) setName(s.name)
                  }}
                  title={s.name}
                  aria-label={`${s.name} rengiyle başla`}
                  className="size-8 rounded-full ring-2 ring-background transition hover:scale-110 focus-visible:ring-primary"
                  style={{ background: s.hex }}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Preview hex={hex} name={sanitizeThemeName(name)} />
          {unlocked ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={save}
              disabled={pending || !HEX_RE.test(hexInput)}
              className="flex h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full font-semibold transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
              style={{ background: hex, color: customThemeVars(hex)['--primary-foreground'] }}
            >
              {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Check className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
              {editing ? 'Güncelle ve uygula' : 'Kaydet ve uygula'}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <Link href={loggedIn ? '/abonelik' : '/giris'} className="flex h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground font-semibold text-background transition hover:opacity-90">
              <Lock className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              {loggedIn ? 'Sytheris+ ile kilidi aç' : 'Giriş yap ve kilidi aç'}
            </Link>
          )}
          {editing && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(null)} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
              Düzenlemeyi bırak, yeni tema oluştur
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {unlocked && (
        <div className="mt-8 border-t border-border pt-6">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Temaların</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              {themes.length} / {CUSTOM_THEME_LIMIT}
            </p>
          </div>
          {themes.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz bir tema kaydetmedin. Yukarıda rengini seç ve ilk temanı oluştur.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                {themes.map((t) => {
                  const active = custom?.id === t.id
                  return (
                    <motion.li key={t.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }} className={cn('group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-2 pr-2.5 transition', active ? 'border-primary bg-accent' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/20')}>
                      <button type="button" onClick={(e) => applyCustom(t, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY })} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-left" aria-pressed={active}>
                        <span className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl" style={{ background: t.hex }}>
                          {active && <Check className="size-4" style={{ color: customThemeVars(t.hex)['--primary-foreground'] }} aria-hidden="true" />}
                        </span>
                        <span className="min-w-0">
                          <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{t.name}</span>
                          <span className="block font-mono text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">{t.hex}</span>
                        </span>
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => edit(t)} aria-label={`${t.name} temasını düzenle`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
                        <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => remove(t.id)} aria-label={`${t.name} temasını sil`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                        <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </button>
                    </motion.li>
                  )
                })}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  )

export function Toggle({ checked, onChange, label, description }: { checked: boolean; onChange: (v: boolean) => void; label: string; description?: string }) {
  return (
    <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-6 py-4">
      <span>
        <span className="block font-medium">{label}</span>
        {description && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{description}</span>}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={checked}
        aria-label={label}
        onClick={() => onChange(!checked)}
        className={cn('relative h-7 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors duration-300', checked ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-muted-foreground/30')}
      >
        <span className={cn('absolute left-1 top-1 size-5 rounded-full bg-card shadow-[0_2px_6px_rgb(0_0_0/0.25)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.3,1.4,0.5,1)]', checked && 'translate-x-5')} />

  )
}

const LOCAL_KEYS = {
  playlist: ['sy-playlist', 'sy-volume'],
  progress: 'sy-pos-',
}

function DataCard() {
  const file = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [confirmWipe, setConfirmWipe] = useState(false)

  function exportPrefs() {
    const data = {
      app: 'sytheris',
      version: 1,
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      prefs: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sy-prefs') || '{}'),
      theme: localStorage.getItem('sy-theme'),
      mode: localStorage.getItem('sy-mode'),
      customTheme: localStorage.getItem('sy-custom-theme'),
      playlist: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sy-playlist') || '[]'),
    }
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const a = document.createElement('a')
    a.href = url
    a.download = 'sytheris-ayarlar.json'
    a.click()
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
    toast.success('Ayarların indirildi')
  }

  async function importPrefs(f: File) {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(await f.text())
      if (data?.app !== 'sytheris' || typeof data.prefs !== 'object') throw new Error()
      const allowed = Object.keys(DEFAULT_PREFS)
      const prefs = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data.prefs).filter(([k]) => allowed.includes(k))) as Partial<Prefs>
      setPrefs(prefs)
      if (typeof data.theme === 'string') localStorage.setItem('sy-theme', data.theme)
      if (data.mode === 'light' || data.mode === 'dark' || data.mode === 'system') localStorage.setItem('sy-mode', data.mode)
      if (typeof data.customTheme === 'string') localStorage.setItem('sy-custom-theme', data.customTheme)
      if (Array.isArray(data.playlist)) localStorage.setItem('sy-playlist', JSON.stringify(data.playlist.slice(0, 100)))
      toast.success('Ayarlar geri yüklendi', { description: 'Tema ve müzik listesi sayfa yenilenince uygulanır.' })
      window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 900)
    } catch {
      toast.error('Bu dosya bir Sytheris yedeği değil')
    }
  }

  function clearProgress() {
    let n = 0
    for (const k of Object.keys(localStorage)) {
      if (k.startsWith(LOCAL_KEYS.progress)) {
        localStorage.removeItem(k)
        n++
      }
    }
    toast.success(n ? `${n} bölümün izleme konumu silindi` : 'Silinecek izleme konumu yok')
  }

  function clearPlaylist() {
    LOCAL_KEYS.playlist.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k))
    toast.success('Müzik listen temizlendi', { description: 'Sayfa yenilenince boş başlar.' })
  }

  function wipe() {
    for (const k of Object.keys(localStorage)) if (k.startsWith('sy-')) localStorage.removeItem(k)
    try {
      sessionStorage.clear()
    } catch {}
    resetPrefs()
    toast.success('Bu cihazdaki tüm Sytheris verileri silindi')
    window.setTimeout(() => (window.location.href = '/'), 800)
  }

  const btn = 'flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary'

  return (
    <>
      <Card title="Yedekle ve" accent="taşı">
        <p className="mb-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Tema, oynatma tercihleri ve müzik listen bu cihazda saklanır. Bir dosyaya yedekleyip başka bir cihazda geri yükleyebilirsin.</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={exportPrefs} className={btn}>
            <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Ayarları dışa aktar
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => file.current?.click()} className={btn}>
            <Upload className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Yedekten geri yükle
          </button>
          <input
            ref={file}
            type="file"
            accept="application/json,.json"
            className="sr-only"
            tabIndex={-1}
            aria-hidden="true"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0]
              if (f) void importPrefs(f)
              e.target.value = ''
            }}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              resetPrefs()
              toast.success('Tercihler varsayılana döndü')
            }}
            className={btn}
          >
            <RotateCcw className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Tercihleri sıfırla
          </button>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Cihaz" accent="temizliği">
        <div className="divide-y divide-border">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4">
            <span>
              <span className="block font-medium">İzleme konumları</span>
              <span className="block text-sm text-muted-foreground">Yarıda bıraktığın bölümlerin kaldığı saniyeler.</span>
            </span>
            <button type="button" onClick={clearProgress} className={btn}>
              Temizle
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4">
            <span>
              <span className="block font-medium">Müzik listesi</span>
              <span className="block text-sm text-muted-foreground">Çalma sıran ve ses seviyesi.</span>
            </span>
            <button type="button" onClick={clearPlaylist} className={btn}>
              Temizle
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4">
            <span>
              <span className="block font-medium text-destructive">Her şeyi sil</span>
              <span className="block text-sm text-muted-foreground">Bu cihazdaki tüm Sytheris tercih ve verilerini kaldırır. Hesabın etkilenmez.</span>
            </span>
            {confirmWipe ? (
              <span className="flex gap-2">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmWipe(false)} className={btn}>
                  Vazgeç
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={wipe} className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-destructive px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-background transition hover:brightness-110">
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Evet, sil
                </button>
              </span>
            ) : (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmWipe(true)} className="flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-destructive/40 px-5 text-sm font-medium text-destructive transition hover:bg-destructive/10">
                <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Sil
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </>
  )
}

  hint: string
  icon: 'profile' | 'appearance' | 'access' | 'cosmetics' | 'playback' | 'ai' | 'account' | 'data' | 'content'
  /** Sidebar group heading this tab sits under. */
  group?: string
  /** Extra words the settings search should match (e.g. "şifre", "altyazı"). */
  keywords?: string
}

const ICONS: Record<SettingsTab['icon'], LucideIcon> = {
  profile: UserRound,
  appearance: Palette,
  access: Accessibility,
  cosmetics: Crown,
  playback: PlayCircle,
  ai: Bot,
  account: ShieldUser,
  data: HardDrive,
  content: Clapperboard,
}

const OUT = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

const fold = (s: string) => s.toLocaleLowerCase('tr').normalize('NFD').replace(/\p{Diacritic}/gu, '')

export function SettingsShell({
  tabs,
  panels,
  initial,
  identity,
}: {
  tabs: SettingsTab[]
  panels: Record<string, React.ReactNode>
  initial: string
  identity?: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(tabs.some((t) => t.id === initial) ? initial : tabs[0].id)
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const params = useSearchParams()
  const current = tabs.find((t) => t.id === active) ?? tabs[0]

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const q = fold(query.trim())
    if (!q) return tabs
    return tabs.filter((t) => fold(`${t.label} ${t.hint} ${t.keywords ?? ''}`).includes(q))
  }, [query, tabs])

  const go = (id: string) => {
    setActive(id)
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString())
    next.set('tab', id)
    router.replace(`${pathname}?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:gap-8">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-border pb-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-muted-foreground">
            Ayarlar <ChevronRight className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" /> <span className="text-ink">{current.label}</span>
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-balance text-4xl font-bold tracking-[-0.035em] sm:text-5xl">
            Senin <span className="accent-serif">düzenin.</span>
          </h1>
        </div>
        {identity}
      </header>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[260px_minmax(0,1fr)] lg:gap-10">
        <nav aria-label="Ayar bölümleri" className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 lg:sticky lg:top-24 lg:self-start">
          <label className="relative hidden lg:block">
            <span className="sr-only">Ayarlarda ara</span>
            <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ayarlarda ara…"
              className="h-11 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card pl-9 pr-3 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary"
            />
          </label>
          <ul className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex snap-x gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-1 lg:mx-0 lg:flex-col lg:gap-0.5 lg:overflow-visible lg:px-0 lg:pb-0">
            {visible.map((t, i) => {
              const Icon = ICONS[t.icon]
              const on = t.id === active
              const heading = t.group && t.group !== visible[i - 1]?.group ? t.group : null
              return (
                <li key={t.id} className="shrink-0 snap-start">
                  {heading && <p className={cn('label-mono hidden px-3 pb-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground lg:block', i > 0 && 'pt-5')}>{heading}</p>}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => go(t.id)}
                    aria-current={on ? 'page' : undefined}
                    className={cn(
                      'relative flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors lg:rounded-2xl lg:border-transparent lg:py-2.5',
                      on ? 'border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 text-foreground lg:bg-transparent' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground lg:hover:bg-muted/60',
                    )}
                  >
                    {on && <motion.span layoutId="settings-active" className="absolute inset-0 hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card shadow-[0_10px_30px_-18px_rgb(0_0_0/0.35)] lg:block" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 36 }} />}
                    <span className={cn('relative grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl transition-colors', on ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'lg:bg-muted')}>
                      <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </span>
                    <span className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                      <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-medium">{t.label}</span>
                      <span className="hidden truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:block">{t.hint}</span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              )
            })}
            {!visible.length && <li className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Eşleşen ayar yok.</li>}
          </ul>
        </nav>

        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div key={active} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: OUT }} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 pb-1">
              {(() => {
                const Icon = ICONS[current.icon]
                return (
                  <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-primary/12 text-ink ring-1 ring-primary/25">
                    <Icon className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </span>
                )
              })()}
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{current.label}</h2>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{current.hint}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {panels[active]}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export function AnnouncementBar({ text, tone }: { text: string; tone: 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' }) {
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(true)
  useEffect(() => {
    setHidden(sessionStorage.getItem('sy-ann') === text)
  }, [text])
  if (!text || hidden) return null
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'relative z-[51] flex items-center justify-center gap-3 px-10 py-2 text-center text-sm',
        tone === 'warning' ? 'bg-destructive text-on-scrim' : 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground',
      )}
      role="status"
    >
      <Megaphone className="size-4 shrink-0" />
      <span className="text-pretty">{text}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          sessionStorage.setItem('sy-ann', text)
          setHidden(true)
        }}
        aria-label="Duyuruyu kapat"
        className="absolute right-3 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-black/10"
      >
        <X className="size-4" />
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import useSWR from 'swr'
import { ArrowUpRight, CalendarDays, Compass, Loader2, Search, Shuffle, Star } from 'lucide-react'
import { Modal } from '@/components/ui-kit/modal'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { formatTr, pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json())

export function useDebounced<T>(value: T, ms = 250) {
  const [v, setV] = useState(value)
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setV(value), ms)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [value, ms])
  return v
}

const QUICK = [
  { href: '/ara?sort=TRENDING_DESC', label: 'Şu an trend olanlar', icon: Star },
  { href: '/takvim', label: 'Yayın takvimi', icon: CalendarDays },
  { href: '/rastgele', label: 'Rastgele anime çevir', icon: Shuffle },
  { href: '/ara', label: 'Tüm katalog', icon: Compass },
]

export function CommandPalette({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0)
  const dq = useDebounced(q.trim(), 220)
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR<{ results: MediaCard[] }>(dq.length > 1 ? `/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(dq)}` : null, fetcher, {
    keepPreviousData: true,
  })
  const results = dq.length > 1 ? (data?.results ?? []) : []

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) setQ('')
  }, [open])
  useEffect(() => setActive(0), [dq])

  const go = (href: string) => {
    onClose()
    router.push(href)
  }

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Anime ara" hideTitle side="top" showClose={false} className="sm:max-w-2xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-border px-5">
        <Search className="size-5 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input
          data-autofocus
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
              e.preventDefault()
              setActive((a) => Math.min(a + 1, Math.max(results.length - 1, 0)))
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
              e.preventDefault()
              setActive((a) => Math.max(a - 1, 0))
            } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return
              if (results[active]) go(`/anime/${results[active].id}`)
              else if (q.trim()) go(`/ara?q=${encodeURIComponent(q.trim())}`)
            }
          }}
          placeholder="Anime adı yaz… (ör. Frieren, Jujutsu Kaisen)"
          className="h-16 flex-1 bg-transparent text-lg outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
          aria-label="Anime ara"
        />
        {isLoading && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />}
        <kbd className="rounded-md border border-border bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">ESC</kbd>
      </div>
      <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto p-2">
        {results.length > 0 ? (
          <ul role="listbox" aria-label="Sonuçlar">
            {results.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={m.id} role="option" aria-selected={i === active}>
                <Link
                  href={`/anime/${m.id}`}
                  onClick={onClose}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
                  className={cn('flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl p-2.5 transition', i === active ? 'bg-accent' : 'hover:bg-muted')}
                >
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={m.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="h-16 w-11 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate font-medium">{pickTitle(m.title)}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {[m.seasonYear, formatTr(m.format), m.episodes ? `${m.episodes} bölüm` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  {m.averageScore ? <span className="font-mono text-sm text-ink">{m.averageScore}%</span> : null}
                  <ArrowUpRight className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : dq.length > 1 && !isLoading ? (
          <p className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {'"'}
            {dq}
            {'"'} için sonuç bulunamadı.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-2">
            <p className="label-mono px-2 pb-2 pt-1 text-muted-foreground">Hızlı erişim</p>
            {QUICK.map((l) => (
              <button
                key={l.href}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => go(l.href)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-3 text-left text-sm transition hover:bg-muted"
              >
                <l.icon className="size-4 text-ink" />
                {l.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

/* Animated mosaic of anime covers used behind the intro and the login screen. */
export function CoverWall({ covers, columns = 6 }: { covers: string[]; columns?: number }) {
  if (!covers.length) return <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-scrim" />
  const cols = Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, c) => {
    const list = covers.filter((_, i) => i % columns === c)
    const filled = list.length ? list : covers.slice(0, 4)
    return [...filled, ...filled]
  })
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex gap-3 overflow-hidden opacity-70 [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,transparent,black_15%,black_85%,transparent)]" aria-hidden="true">
      {cols.map((list, c) => (
        <div
          key={c}
          className={`min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3 ${c >= 4 ? 'hidden lg:flex' : c >= 3 ? 'hidden sm:flex' : 'flex'}`}
          style={{
            animation: `marquee ${50 + (c % 3) * 14}s linear infinite`,
            animationDirection: c % 2 ? 'reverse' : 'normal',
          }}
        >
          {list.map((src, i) => (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img key={i} src={src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="eager" decoding="async" className="aspect-[2/3] w-full rounded-xl object-cover" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * SYTHERIS — boot sequence.
 *   load    — a small device window floats tilted in the dark; the key art fills it as the counter runs to 100
 *   expand  — the window flattens, drops its bezel and grows past the edges of the screen
 *   exit    — the frame is wiped upward, revealing the site (first-time visitors land on the scroll prologue)
 * The load phase is CSS-driven (app/intro.css) so it plays from first paint; JS only schedules the hand-off,
 * reading the CSS animation's own clock so a slow hydration never leaves the counter frozen or cut short.
 * Keeps the `#sy-intro` id + `sy-intro-seen` session key so the boot script can hide it pre-paint.
 */

import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type Phase = 'play' | 'exit' | 'done'

/** Mirrors app/intro.css: exit starts at 3070ms and lasts 850ms; a skip wipes in 650ms. */
const EXIT_AT_MS = 3070
const TOTAL_MS = EXIT_AT_MS + 850
const SKIP_MS = 650

const COPY = {
  anime: {
    tagline: 'Anime keşif platformu',
    status: ['Evren hazırlanıyor', 'Kapaklar diziliyor', 'Işıklar kısılıyor', 'Perde açılıyor'],
  },
  film: {
    tagline: 'Film keşif platformu',
    status: ['Projektör ısınıyor', 'Makaralar takılıyor', 'Salon kararıyor', 'Seans başlıyor'],
  },
}

/** How far the CSS timeline has already run — hydration can land well after the intro started playing. */
function elapsed() {
  const el = document.getElementById('sy-intro')
  const anim = el?.getAnimations().find((a) => (a as CSSAnimation).animationName === 'intro-exit')
  const t = anim?.currentTime
  return typeof t === 'number' ? t : 0
}

export function Intro({ covers, keyart, enabled, mode = 'anime' }: { covers: string[]; keyart: string; enabled: boolean; mode?: 'anime' | 'film' }) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('play')
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const timers = useRef<number[]>([])

  const firstVisit = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      return !localStorage.getItem('sy-welcomed') && pathname === '/'
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }, [pathname])

  const done = useCallback(() => {
    timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout)
    timers.current = []
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem('sy-intro-seen', '1')
    } catch {}
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = ''
    document.documentElement.classList.add('intro-seen')
    setPhase('done')
  }, [])

  const finish = useCallback(() => {
    timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout)
    timers.current = []
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem('sy-intro-seen', '1')
    } catch {}
    if (firstVisit()) {
      router.push('/hosgeldin')
      return
    }
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = ''
    setPhase('exit')
    timers.current.push(window.setTimeout(done, SKIP_MS + 50))
  }, [done, firstVisit, router])

  useEffect(() => {
    // First-time visitors get the welcome film, which has its own opening slate — never two intros back to back.
    if (enabled && firstVisit()) {
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem('sy-intro-seen', '1')
      } catch {}
      router.replace('/hosgeldin')
      return
    }
    let skip = !enabled
    try {
      skip ||= Boolean(sessionStorage.getItem('sy-intro-seen')) || localStorage.getItem('sy-intro') === '0'
    } catch {}
    if (skip) {
      setPhase('done')
      return
    }
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches || document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion')
    if (reduce) {
      done()
      return
    }

    const t = elapsed()
    if (t < EXIT_AT_MS) document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    timers.current.push(window.setTimeout(() => (document.documentElement.style.overflow = ''), Math.max(0, EXIT_AT_MS - t)))
    timers.current.push(window.setTimeout(done, Math.max(0, TOTAL_MS + 50 - t)))

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'Enter') finish()
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => {
      timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = ''
    }
  }, [enabled, done, finish, firstVisit, router])

  if (phase === 'done') return null

  const copy = COPY[mode]
  const strip = covers.filter(Boolean).slice(0, 7)

  return (
    <div
      id="sy-intro"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Sytheris açılış animasyonu"
      data-phase={phase}
      className={cn('intro dark fixed inset-0 z-[200] overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-on-scrim', mode === 'film' && 'cine')}
    >
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(80%_60%_at_50%_0%,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--on-scrim)_9%,transparent),transparent_70%)]" />
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="grain absolute inset-0" />

      <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center [perspective:1400px]">
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="intro-glow pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-[64%] h-[30vh] w-[70vw] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-[50%] bg-[radial-gradient(closest-side,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_45%,transparent),transparent)] blur-3xl"
        />
        <div className="intro-stage">
          <div className="intro-window relative aspect-[16/10] w-[min(84vw,640px)] bg-on-scrim/[0.07] shadow-[0_60px_120px_-40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] ring-1 ring-on-scrim/15 backdrop-blur-md">
            <div className="relative size-full overflow-hidden rounded-[inherit] bg-scrim">
              <div className="intro-reveal absolute inset-0">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={keyart || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" fetchPriority="high" className={cn('size-full scale-110 object-cover', mode === 'film' ? 'object-[50%_20%]' : 'object-[50%_30%]')} />
              </div>
              <div className="intro-scan absolute inset-x-0 h-px bg-primary shadow-[0_0_18px_var(--primary)]" />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,transparent_50%,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--scrim)_80%,transparent))]" />
              <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 font-mono text-xs sm:left-4 sm:top-4 sm:text-sm">(SYTHERIS)</span>
              <span className="absolute right-3 top-3 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-on-scrim/60 sm:right-4 sm:top-4">
                {mode === 'film' ? '[ sinema ]' : '[ v.26 ]'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="intro-chrome pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
        <div className="absolute inset-x-5 top-[max(1.25rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))] flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.28em] text-on-scrim/60 sm:inset-x-10 sm:top-7">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-on-scrim/35">[</span>
            <span className="inline-block size-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-primary" />
            <span className="text-on-scrim/85">SYTHERIS</span>
            <span className="text-on-scrim/35">]</span>
          </span>
          <span className="hidden md:inline">{copy.tagline}</span>
          <span>TR · {new Date().getFullYear()}</span>
        </div>

        {strip.length > 0 && (

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const UNITS = [
  ['Gün', 86400],
  ['Saat', 3600],
  ['Dakika', 60],
  ['Saniye', 1],
] as const

function split(ms: number) {
  let s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000))
  return UNITS.map(([label, size]) => {
    const v = Math.floor(s / size)
    s -= v * size
    return [label, v] as const
  })
}

/** Live countdown to `target`; renders a dash grid until hydrated so server and client markup match. */
export function MaintenanceCountdown({ target }: { target: number }) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState<number | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    setNow(Date.now())
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [])

  const parts = now === null ? UNITS.map(([l]) => [l, null] as const) : split(target - now)

  return (
    <dl className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-6 sm:gap-12" aria-live="off">
      {parts.map(([label, value]) => (
        <div key={label} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <dd className="mist-numeral text-5xl sm:text-7xl">{value === null ? '--' : String(value).padStart(2, '0')}</dd>
          <dt className="text-xs tracking-wide text-[var(--mist-soft)]">{label}</dt>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  )
}

const d = (ms: number) => ({ '--d': `${ms}ms` }) as React.CSSProperties

/** Accepts an ISO date/time ("2026-12-01T18:00") as ETA; anything else is shown as plain text. */
function parseEta(eta?: string | null) {
  if (!eta) return null
  const t = Date.parse(eta)
  return Number.isFinite(t) && t > Date.now() ? t : null
}

export function MaintenanceScreen({ settings }: { settings: SiteSettings }) {

DOSYA: C:\Users\mumya\Desktop\SYTHERİS_SON\components\shell\scramble-text.tsx

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

const GLYPHS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPRSTUVYZ#%&*+=/<>'

export function ScrambleText({ text, className, duration = 650 }: { text: string; className?: string; duration?: number }) {
  const [out, setOut] = useState(text)
  const first = useRef(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false
      setOut(text)
      return
    }
    if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion')) {
      setOut(text)
      return
    }
    const start = performance.now()
    let raf = 0
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration)
      const revealed = Math.floor(p * text.length)
      setOut(
        text
          .split('')
          .map((c, i) => (c === ' ' ? ' ' : i < revealed ? c : GLYPHS[Math.floor(Math.random() * GLYPHS.length)]))
          .join(''),
      )
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
      else setOut(text)
    }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
  }, [text, duration])

  return (
    <span className={className} aria-label={text}>
      <span aria-hidden="true">{out}</span>
    </span>
  )
}

DOSYA: C:\Users\mumya\Desktop\SYTHERİS_SON\components\shell\secret-gate.tsx

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect } from 'react'

const PHRASE = 'sycore'

/**
 * Hidden entry to the control center. Not linked anywhere in the UI:
 * - Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Y
 * - typing "sycore" anywhere outside a text field
 * - holding the header logo for ~2.5 seconds (touch devices)
 */
export function SecretGate() {
  const router = useRouter()
  useEffect(() => {
    let buffer = ''
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'y') {
        e.preventDefault()
        router.push('/sy-core')
        return
      }
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement
      if (target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return
      if (e.key.length !== 1) return
      buffer = (buffer + e.key.toLowerCase()).slice(-PHRASE.length)
      if (buffer === PHRASE) {
        buffer = ''
        router.push('/sy-core')
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [router])
  return null
}

                  <Link href={l.href} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
                    {l.label}
                  </Link>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { LogIn, Search } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { HeaderUser } from '@/lib/viewer-types'
import type { ContentMode } from '@/lib/content-mode-shared'
import { CommandPalette } from './command-palette'
import { ProfilePanel } from './profile-panel'
import { MusicButton } from '@/components/music/music-button'

export const NAV: { href: string; label: string; plus?: boolean }[] = [
  { href: '/ara', label: 'Keşfet' },
  { href: '/manga', label: 'Manga' },
  { href: '/takvim', label: 'Takvim' },
  { href: '/atolye', label: 'Galeri', plus: true },
  { href: '/korku', label: 'Korku' },
]

export const FILM_NAV: { href: string; label: string; plus?: boolean }[] = [
  { href: '/sinema-ara', label: 'Ara' },
  { href: '/filmler', label: 'Filmler' },
  { href: '/diziler', label: 'Diziler' },
  { href: '/rastgele', label: 'Rastgele' },
  { href: '/atolye', label: 'Galeri', plus: true },
  { href: '/korku', label: 'Korku' },
]

export function isActive(pathname: string, href: string, search?: URLSearchParams | null) {
  const [path, query] = href.split('?')
  if (query) return pathname === path && (search?.toString() ?? '') === query
  if (path === '/filmler') return pathname === '/filmler' || pathname.startsWith('/film/')
  if (path === '/diziler') return pathname === '/diziler' || pathname.startsWith('/dizi/')
  return path === '/' ? pathname === '/' : pathname.startsWith(path)
}

export function SiteHeader({ user, mode = 'anime' }: { user: HeaderUser | null; mode?: ContentMode }) {
  const items = mode === 'film' ? FILM_NAV : NAV
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const router = useRouter()
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false)
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const lastY = useRef(0)
  const holdTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => {
      const y = window.scrollY
      const delta = y - lastY.current
      setScrolled(y > 24)
      if (y < 420) {
        setHidden(false)
        lastY.current = y
      } else if (Math.abs(delta) > 8) {
        setHidden(delta > 0)
        lastY.current = y
      }
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight
      setProgress(max > 0 ? Math.min(1, y / max) : 0)
    }
    onScroll()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement
      const typing = target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')
      if ((e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) || (e.key === '/' && !typing)) {
        e.preventDefault()
        setSearchOpen(true)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [])

  const startHold = () => {
    holdTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => router.push('/sy-core'), 2600)
  }
  const endHold = () => {
    if (holdTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(holdTimer.current)
  }

  return (
    <>
      <header
        className={cn(
          'sticky top-0 z-50 transition-transform duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)]',
          hidden && !searchOpen ? '-translate-y-[120%]' : 'translate-y-0',
        )}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            'mx-auto flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)]',
            scrolled
              ? 'mt-2 h-14 max-w-5xl rounded-full border border-border bg-popover/90 px-2 pl-5 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 shadow-[0_18px_50px_-20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)] sm:mt-3 [width:calc(100%-1.5rem)]'
              : 'h-16 w-full max-w-[1440px] border-b border-transparent bg-background/80 px-4 backdrop-blur-md sm:px-6 lg:px-10',
          )}
        >
          <Link
            href="/"
            className="group flex shrink-0 select-none flex-col leading-none"
            aria-label="SYTHERIS ana sayfa"
            onPointerDown={startHold}
            onPointerUp={endHold}
            onPointerLeave={endHold}
            onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
          >
            <span className="text-[19px] font-bold tracking-[-0.02em] transition-colors group-hover:text-ink">SYTHERIS</span>
          </Link>

          <nav className="mx-auto hidden items-center gap-0.5 md:flex" aria-label="Ana menü">
            {items.map((item) => {
              const active = isActive(pathname, item.href, searchParams)
              return (
                <Link
                  key={item.href}
                  href={item.href}
                  aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
                  className={cn('relative whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-3.5 py-2 text-[14px] font-medium transition-colors xl:px-4', active ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
                >
                  {active && <motion.span layoutId="nav-pill" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-full bg-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 34 }} />}
                  {item.label}
                  {item.plus ? (
                    <sup className={cn('ml-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold', active ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-ink')} aria-label="Sytheris+">
                      +
                    </sup>
                  ) : null}
                </Link>
              )
            })}
          </nav>

          <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 md:ml-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
              className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-card/60 px-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:border-primary/50 hover:text-foreground lg:w-48 lg:px-4"
              aria-label="Ara"
            >
              <Search className="size-4" />
              <span className="hidden lg:inline">Ara…</span>
              <kbd className="ml-auto hidden rounded-md border border-border bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] lg:inline">Ctrl K</kbd>
            </button>
            <MusicButton />
            {user ? (
              <ProfilePanel user={user} />
            ) : (
              <Link
                href="/giris"
                className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background transition hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"
              >
                <LogIn className="size-4" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Giriş yap</span>
                <span className="sr-only sm:hidden">Giriş yap</span>
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div
          className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-px origin-left bg-primary transition-opacity', scrolled ? 'opacity-0' : 'opacity-100')}
          style={{ transform: `scaleX(${progress})` }}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </header>
      <CommandPalette open={searchOpen} onClose={() => setSearchOpen(false)} />
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import { Check, Monitor, Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react'
import { THEMES, type ThemeMode } from '@/lib/themes'

const MODES: { id: ThemeMode; label: string; icon: typeof Sun }[] = [
  { id: 'light', label: 'Açık', icon: Sun },
  { id: 'dark', label: 'Koyu', icon: Moon },
  { id: 'system', label: 'Sistem', icon: Monitor },
]

export function ThemePanel({ onPick }: { onPick?: () => void }) {
  const { theme, mode, setTheme, setMode, custom } = useTheme()
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        {THEMES.map((t) => {
          const active = !custom && t.id === theme
          return (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={active}
              onClick={(e) => {
                setTheme(t.id, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY })
                onPick?.()
              }}
              className={cn(
                'group relative flex items-center gap-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border p-2.5 text-left transition',
                active ? 'border-primary bg-accent' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/20 hover:bg-muted',
              )}
            >
              <span className="relative grid size-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full ring-2 ring-background" style={{ background: t.swatch }}>
                {active && <Check className="size-3.5 text-on-scrim mix-blend-difference" />}
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0">
                <span className="block truncate text-[13px] font-medium">{t.name}</span>
                <span className="block font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground">{t.hex}</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 rounded-2xl bg-muted p-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Görünüm">
        {MODES.map((m) => {
          const Icon = m.icon
          const active = m.id === mode
          return (
            <button
              key={m.id}
              type="button"
              role="radio"
              aria-checked={active}
              onClick={(e) => setMode(m.id, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY })}
              className={cn(
                'flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl py-2 text-xs font-medium transition',
                active ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
              )}
            >
              <Icon className="size-3.5" />
              {m.label}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeftRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { hexToHsv, hsvToHex, isHex } from '@/lib/studio/engine'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const PALETTE = ['#111014', '#f5f1ea', '#e83f3f', '#f28c28', '#f6d04d', '#3fbf74', '#2aa6c9', '#3a5bd9', '#8a4fd8', '#e05aa8', '#8b5a3c', '#f2c9a5', '#7a8796', '#c9d1d9']

function useDrag(onMove: (x: number, y: number) => void) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const handle = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    onMove(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width)), Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height)))
  }
  return {
    ref,
    onPointerDown: (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
      e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
      handle(e)
    },
    onPointerMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
      if (e.buttons) handle(e)
    },
  }
}

export function ColorPicker({
  color,
  secondary,
  recent,
  onChange,
  onSwap,
}: {
  color: string
  secondary: string
  recent: string[]
  onChange: (hex: string) => void
  onSwap: () => void
}) {
  const [hsv, setHsv] = useState<[number, number, number]>(() => hexToHsv(color))
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(color)
  const lastEmitted = useRef(color)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (color === lastEmitted.current) return
    lastEmitted.current = color
    setHsv(hexToHsv(color))
    setDraft(color)
  }, [color])

  const emit = (next: [number, number, number]) => {
    setHsv(next)
    const hex = hsvToHex(next[0], next[1], next[2])
    lastEmitted.current = hex
    setDraft(hex)
    onChange(hex)
  }

  const sv = useDrag((x, y) => emit([hsv[0], x, 1 - y]))
  const hue = useDrag((x) => emit([x * 360, hsv[1], hsv[2]]))

  const onKeySV = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const d = e.shiftKey ? 0.1 : 0.02
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') emit([hsv[0], Math.min(1, hsv[1] + d), hsv[2]])
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') emit([hsv[0], Math.max(0, hsv[1] - d), hsv[2]])
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') emit([hsv[0], hsv[1], Math.min(1, hsv[2] + d)])
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') emit([hsv[0], hsv[1], Math.max(0, hsv[2] - d)])
    else return
    e.preventDefault()
  }
  const onKeyHue = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const d = e.shiftKey ? 15 : 3
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') emit([(hsv[0] + d) % 360, hsv[1], hsv[2]])
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') emit([(hsv[0] - d + 360) % 360, hsv[1], hsv[2]])
    else return
    e.preventDefault()
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div
        {...sv}
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label="Doygunluk ve parlaklık"
        aria-valuetext={`Doygunluk %${Math.round(hsv[1] * 100)}, parlaklık %${Math.round(hsv[2] * 100)}`}
        onKeyDown={onKeySV}
        className="relative h-36 w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none rounded-xl outline-none ring-offset-2 ring-offset-card focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary"
        style={{ background: `linear-gradient(to top, #000, transparent), linear-gradient(to right, #fff, ${hsvToHex(hsv[0], 1, 1)})` }}
      >
        <span
          className="pointer-events-none absolute size-4 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]"
          style={{ left: `${hsv[1] * 100}%`, top: `${(1 - hsv[2]) * 100}%`, background: color }}
        />
      </div>
      <div
        {...hue}
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label="Renk tonu"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={360}
        aria-valuenow={Math.round(hsv[0])}
        onKeyDown={onKeyHue}
        className="studio-hue relative h-3 w-full cursor-pointer touch-none rounded-full outline-none ring-offset-2 ring-offset-card focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary"
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 size-4 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]" style={{ left: `${(hsv[0] / 360) * 100}%`, background: hsvToHex(hsv[0], 1, 1) }} />
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="relative size-10 shrink-0">
          <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 size-6 rounded-md border border-border" style={{ background: secondary }} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="absolute left-0 top-0 size-7 rounded-md border-2 border-card shadow-sm" style={{ background: color }} aria-hidden="true" />
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={onSwap} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground" aria-label="Ana ve ikincil rengi değiştir (X)" title="Değiştir (X)">
          <ArrowLeftRight className="size-4" />
        </button>
        <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="studio-hex">
          Renk kodu
        </label>
        <input
          id="studio-hex"
          value={draft}
          spellCheck={false}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setDraft(e.target.value)
            const v = e.target.value.trim()
            if (isHex(v)) {
              const hex = (v.startsWith('#') ? v : `#${v}`).toLowerCase()
              lastEmitted.current = hex
              setHsv(hexToHsv(hex))
              onChange(hex)
            }
          }}
          className="h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-2.5 font-mono text-xs uppercase outline-none focus:border-primary"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">Palet</span>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5">
          {PALETTE.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onChange(c)}
              className={cn('aspect-square rounded-md border border-border transition hover:scale-110', c === color && 'ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-1 ring-offset-card')}
              style={{ background: c }}
              aria-label={`Renk ${c}`}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {recent.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">Son kullanılanlar</span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {recent.map((c) => (
              <button key={c} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(c)} className="size-6 rounded-full border border-border transition hover:scale-110" style={{ background: c }} aria-label={`Son renk ${c}`} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
