'use client'

import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'
import { motion, useReducedMotion, useTransform, type MotionValue } from 'motion/react'
import { useSectionProgress } from '@/lib/use-section-progress'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react'
import { CoverDrift } from '../intro/cover-drift'
import { SceneBoundary, canUseWebGL } from '@/components/three/scene-boundary'

const IntroScene = dynamic(() => import('../intro/intro-scene'), { ssr: false, loading: () => null })

function Beat({ p, range, children, className }: { p: MotionValue<number>; range: [number, number, number, number]; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const opening = range[0] >= range[1]
  const input = opening ? range.slice(1) : range
  const opacity = useTransform(p, input, opening ? [1, 1, 0] : [0, 1, 1, 0])
  const y = useTransform(p, input, opening ? [0, 0, -50] : [50, 0, 0, -50])
  const blur = useTransform(p, input, opening ? ['blur(0px)', 'blur(0px)', 'blur(8px)'] : ['blur(8px)', 'blur(0px)', 'blur(0px)', 'blur(8px)'])
  return (
    <motion.div style={{ opacity, y, filter: blur }} className={className}>
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}

/**
 * Chapter 01 — 開幕. Trending covers spiral around a tower in 3D; scrolling drives the camera down
 * the tower and finally through it, where the white Introduction chapter is waiting.
 */
export function ChapterOpen({ covers, onSkip }: { covers: string[]; onSkip: () => void }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  const reduced = Boolean(useReducedMotion())
  const scrollYProgress = useSectionProgress(ref, ['start start', 'end end'])
  const [active, setActive] = useState(true)
  const [compact, setCompact] = useState(false)
  const [webgl, setWebgl] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
  const pct = useTransform(scrollYProgress, (v) => String(Math.round(v * 100)).padStart(3, '0'))
  const bar = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [0, 1])
  const whiteout = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0.86, 1], [0, 1])

  useEffect(() => {
    setWebgl(canUseWebGL())
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setActive(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0 })
    io.observe(el)
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)')
    const sync = () => setCompact(mq.matches)
    sync()
    mq.addEventListener('change', sync)
    return () => {
      io.disconnect()
      mq.removeEventListener('change', sync)
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <section ref={ref} aria-label="Bölüm 01 — Açılış" className="relative h-[340vh] bg-scrim">
      <div data-intro-stage className="dark sticky top-0 h-dvh overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-on-scrim">
        <div className="absolute inset-0">
          {webgl === false && <CoverDrift covers={covers} progress={scrollYProgress} />}
          {webgl && (
            <SceneBoundary fallback={<CoverDrift covers={covers} progress={scrollYProgress} />}>
              <IntroScene covers={covers} progress={scrollYProgress} active={active} reduced={reduced} compact={compact} />
            </SceneBoundary>
          )}
        </div>
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(75%_75%_at_50%_50%,transparent_35%,var(--scrim)_100%)]" />
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="grain pointer-events-none absolute inset-0" />
        {/* The dive ends in white, which is where the Introduction chapter begins. */}
        <motion.div aria-hidden="true" style={{ opacity: whiteout }} className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-20 bg-on-scrim" />

        <header className="absolute inset-x-5 top-5 z-10 flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] sm:inset-x-10 sm:top-8">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="size-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-primary" aria-hidden="true" />
            Bölüm 01
          </span>
          <span className="hidden text-on-scrim/50 md:inline">Kaydırarak oynat</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={onSkip} className="rounded-full border border-on-scrim/25 px-4 py-2 text-on-scrim/80 outline-none transition hover:border-on-scrim hover:text-on-scrim focus-visible:border-primary">
            Geç <span className="sr-only">tanıtım filmini</span>
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10">
          <Beat p={scrollYProgress} range={[0, 0, 0.16, 0.26]} className="absolute inset-x-5 bottom-[16%] flex flex-col items-start gap-6 sm:inset-x-10 md:bottom-auto md:top-1/2 md:max-w-2xl md:-translate-y-1/2">
            <h1 lang="en" className="text-[clamp(64px,13vw,200px)] font-black uppercase leading-[0.8] tracking-[-0.06em]">
              Sytheris
            </h1>
            <p className="flex items-center gap-4 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-on-scrim/60">

              className="pointer-events-auto mt-2 flex h-12 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-on-scrim px-6 text-sm font-semibold text-scrim transition hover:opacity-90"
            >
              Kuleye in <ArrowDown className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

const KEYART = '/intro/keyart.webp'
/** Mirrors app/intro.css: the exit wipe starts at 2050ms and lasts 900ms; a skip wipes in 600ms. */
const EXIT_AT_MS = 2050
const TOTAL_MS = EXIT_AT_MS + 900
const SKIP_MS = 600
export const FILM_SEEN_KEY = 'sy-film-seen'

type Phase = 'play' | 'skip' | 'done'

/**
 * Opening slate of the welcome film: a counter runs to 100 inside a small tilted frame, then the frame is
 * wiped away upward. The whole timeline is CSS (app/intro.css), so it plays from first paint and leaves on
 * its own even if hydration is slow or a client error happens — the page can never get stuck behind it.
 * JS only unmounts it afterwards and handles Enter/Escape to skip.
 */
export function FilmBoot() {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('play')

  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0)
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(FILM_SEEN_KEY, '1')
    } catch {}

    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches || document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion')
    if (reduce || document.documentElement.classList.contains('film-seen')) {
      setPhase('done')
      return
    }

    const exit = ref.current?.getAnimations().find((a) => (a as CSSAnimation).animationName === 'film-boot-exit')
    const played = typeof exit?.currentTime === 'number' ? exit.currentTime : 0
    const timers = [window.setTimeout(() => setPhase('done'), Math.max(0, TOTAL_MS - played + 60))]

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Escape' && e.key !== 'Enter') return
      setPhase('skip')
      timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => setPhase('done'), SKIP_MS + 60))
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => {
      timers.forEach(clearTimeout)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    }
  }, [])

  if (phase === 'done') return null

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="status"
      aria-label="Sytheris yükleniyor"
      data-phase={phase}
      className="film-boot dark fixed inset-0 z-[200] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-on-scrim"
    >
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="grain absolute inset-0" />

      <p className="absolute left-6 top-6 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-on-scrim/50 sm:left-10 sm:top-8">
        <span lang="en">Sytheris</span> · Sayı 01
      </p>

      <div className="film-boot-frame relative aspect-[4/5] w-[min(56vw,300px)] overflow-hidden rounded-sm border-[6px] border-on-scrim/90 bg-scrim shadow-[0_40px_80px_-20px_rgb(0_0_0/0.8)]">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={KEYART} alt="" fetchPriority="high" className="film-boot-reveal absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
        <div className="film-boot-scan absolute inset-x-0 h-px bg-primary shadow-[0_0_18px_var(--primary)]" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim/70 to-transparent" />
      </div>

      <div className="absolute inset-x-6 bottom-6 flex items-end justify-between sm:inset-x-10 sm:bottom-8">
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="film-boot-counter text-[clamp(64px,12vw,160px)] font-black leading-[0.8] tracking-[-0.06em] tabular-nums" />
        <span className="mb-2 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-on-scrim/50">Enter · atla</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { motion, useTransform, type MotionValue } from 'motion/react'

const COLUMNS = 5

function Column({ covers, progress, index }: { covers: string[]; progress: MotionValue<number>; index: number }) {
  const direction = index % 2 ? 1 : -1
  const y = useTransform(progress, [0, 1], [`${direction * 4}%`, `${direction * -28}%`])
  const scale = useTransform(progress, [0, 0.85, 1], [1, 1.08, 1.5])
  return (
    <motion.ul style={{ y, scale }} className="flex flex-col gap-4 will-change-transform" aria-hidden="true">
      {covers.map((src, i) => (
        <li key={`${src}-${i}`} className="aspect-[2/3] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl ring-1 ring-on-scrim/10">
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading={i < 3 ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} decoding="async" className="size-full object-cover grayscale-[0.6] transition duration-500 hover:grayscale-0" />
        </li>
      ))}
    </motion.ul>
  )
}

/**
 * 2D stand-in for the 3D cover tower, used when WebGL is unavailable (blocked GPU, old devices,
 * battery saver) or the scene fails to start. Columns of covers drift against each other with scroll
 * and the last stretch zooms in, so the dive into the white Introduction chapter still reads.
 */
export function CoverDrift({ covers, progress }: { covers: string[]; progress: MotionValue<number> }) {
  const pool = covers.filter(Boolean)
  const columns = Array.from({ length: COLUMNS }, (_, c) => {
    const list = pool.filter((_, i) => i % COLUMNS === c)
    return list.length ? [...list, ...list].slice(0, 8) : []
  })

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden bg-scrim">
      <div className="absolute -inset-x-[10%] -top-[20%] grid h-[160%] grid-cols-3 gap-4 opacity-70 [transform:perspective(1200px)_rotateX(14deg)] md:grid-cols-5">
        {columns.map((list, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={i > 2 ? 'hidden md:block' : undefined}>
            <Column covers={list} progress={progress} index={i} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { Canvas, useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { Image, Sparkles } from '@react-three/drei'
import type { MotionValue } from 'motion/react'
import { Suspense, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { MathUtils, Vector3, type Color, type Group, type Mesh } from 'three'
import { cssVarColor, textureUrl } from '@/components/three/css-color'
import { QuietBoundary } from '@/components/three/quiet-boundary'

type ImageMesh = Mesh & { material: { grayscale: number; zoom: number; opacity: number } }

const STEP_ANGLE = (Math.PI * 2) / 7
const STEP_Y = 0.62
const CARD_W = 1.35
const CARD_H = CARD_W * 1.5

const lookTarget = new Vector3()
const worldPos = new Vector3()

function Cover({ url, index, radius, hoverable }: { url: string; index: number; radius: number; hoverable: boolean }) {
  const ref = useRef<ImageMesh>(null)
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false)
  const angle = index * STEP_ANGLE
  const y = -index * STEP_Y

  useFrame((state, dt) => {
    const mesh = ref.current
    if (!mesh) return
    mesh.getWorldPosition(worldPos)
    const dist = worldPos.distanceTo(state.camera.position)
    const color = hovered ? 1 : 1 - MathUtils.smoothstep(dist, radius * 2.4, radius * 4.2)
    mesh.material.grayscale = MathUtils.damp(mesh.material.grayscale, 1 - color, 6, dt)
    mesh.material.zoom = MathUtils.damp(mesh.material.zoom, hovered ? 1.12 : 1, 8, dt)
    const s = MathUtils.damp(mesh.scale.x, hovered ? CARD_W * 1.1 : CARD_W, 8, dt)
    mesh.scale.set(s, s * 1.5, 1)
  })

  return (
    <Image
      ref={ref as never}
      url={textureUrl(url)}
      transparent
      radius={0.08}
      grayscale={1}
      scale={[CARD_W, CARD_H]}
      position={[Math.sin(angle) * radius, y, Math.cos(angle) * radius]}
      rotation={[0, angle, 0]}
      side={2}
      onPointerOver={hoverable ? (e) => (e.stopPropagation(), setHovered(true)) : undefined}
      onPointerOut={hoverable ? () => setHovered(false) : undefined}
    />
  )
}

function Tower({ covers, progress, radius, reduced, shift }: { covers: string[]; progress: MotionValue<number>; radius: number; reduced: boolean; shift: boolean }) {
  const group = useRef<Group>(null)
  const height = (covers.length - 1) * STEP_Y

  useFrame((state, dt) => {
    const p = progress.get()
    const g = group.current
    if (!g) return
    const idle = reduced ? 0 : state.clock.elapsedTime * 0.06
    g.rotation.y = MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.y, p * Math.PI * 2.4 + idle, 4, dt)
    const side = shift ? radius * 0.8 : 0
    const shiftX = p < 0.42 ? MathUtils.lerp(side, -side, MathUtils.smoothstep(p, 0.2, 0.36)) : MathUtils.lerp(-side, 0, MathUtils.smoothstep(p, 0.55, 0.68))
    g.position.x = MathUtils.damp(g.position.x, shiftX, 4, dt)

    const cam = state.camera
    const dive = MathUtils.smoothstep(p, 0.72, 1)
    const targetY = MathUtils.lerp(1.2, -height * 0.78, MathUtils.smoothstep(p, 0, 0.85))
    const targetZ = MathUtils.lerp(radius * 3.7, radius * 1.65, MathUtils.smoothstep(p, 0, 0.7)) * (1 - dive) + 0.2 * dive
    const px = reduced ? 0 : state.pointer.x * 0.6
    const py = reduced ? 0 : state.pointer.y * 0.35
    cam.position.x = MathUtils.damp(cam.position.x, px, 3, dt)
    cam.position.y = MathUtils.damp(cam.position.y, targetY + py, 4, dt)
    cam.position.z = MathUtils.damp(cam.position.z, targetZ, 4, dt)
    lookTarget.set(0, cam.position.y - MathUtils.lerp(2.4, 0.4, dive), 0)
    cam.lookAt(lookTarget)
  })

  return (
    <group ref={group}>
      {covers.map((url, i) => (
        <QuietBoundary key={url + i}>
          <Suspense fallback={null}>
            <Cover url={url} index={i} radius={radius} hoverable={!reduced} />
          </Suspense>
        </QuietBoundary>
      ))}
    </group>
  )
}

function Atmosphere({ onReady }: { onReady: (c: { bg: Color; accent: Color }) => void }) {
  const { scene } = useThree()
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const host = document.querySelector('[data-intro-stage]') ?? document.documentElement
    const bg = cssVarColor('--scrim', '#0b0b0d', host)
    const accent = cssVarColor('--primary', '#4ade80', host)
    scene.background = bg
    onReady({ bg, accent })
  }, [scene, onReady])
  return null
}

export default function IntroScene({
  covers,
  progress,
  active,
  reduced,
  compact,
}: {
  covers: string[]
  progress: MotionValue<number>
  active: boolean
  reduced: boolean
  compact: boolean
}) {
  const [colors, setColors] = useState<{ bg: Color; accent: Color } | null>(null)
  const list = useMemo(() => covers.slice(0, compact ? 18 : 28), [covers, compact])
  const radius = compact ? 2.4 : 3.4

  return (
    <Canvas
      dpr={[1, 1.5]}
      frameloop={active ? 'always' : 'never'}
      gl={{ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance', alpha: false }}
      camera={{ fov: compact ? 55 : 42, near: 0.1, far: 60, position: [0, 1.2, radius * 3.7] }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <Atmosphere onReady={setColors} />
      {colors && <fog attach="fog" args={[colors.bg, radius * 1.4, radius * 5.5]} />}
      <Tower covers={list} progress={progress} radius={radius} reduced={reduced} shift={!compact} />
      {colors && !reduced && (
        <Sparkles count={compact ? 60 : 140} scale={[radius * 4, (list.length * STEP_Y) + 8, radius * 4]} position={[0, -(list.length * STEP_Y) / 2, 0]} size={2.2} speed={0.25} opacity={0.6} color={colors.accent} />
      )}
    </Canvas>
  )
}

import 'server-only'
import type { CharacterDetail, MediaCard, MediaDetail, StaffDetail } from './anilist-types'
import { currentSeason } from './format'

const ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co'

export async function anilist<T>(query: string, variables: Record<string, unknown> = {}, revalidate = 1800): Promise<T | null> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
        next: { revalidate },
      })
      if (res.status === 429 && attempt === 0) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200))
        continue
      }
      const json = await res.json()
      if (json.errors && !json.data) {
        console.error('[anilist]', json.errors?.[0]?.message)
        return null
      }
      return json.data as T
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[anilist] fetch failed', (e as Error).message)
      if (attempt === 0) continue
      return null
    }
  }
  return null
}

export const CARD = `
  id
  title { romaji english native userPreferred }
  coverImage { extraLarge large color }
  bannerImage
  format
  season
  seasonYear
  episodes
  duration
  averageScore
  popularity
  genres
  status
  trailer { id site }
  nextAiringEpisode { episode airingAt timeUntilAiring }
`

export async function getHomeData() {
  const { season, year } = currentSeason()
  const query = `
    query ($season: MediaSeason, $year: Int) {
      hero: Page(perPage: 6) { media(type: ANIME, sort: TRENDING_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} description(asHtml: false) } }
      top: Page(perPage: 10) { media(type: ANIME, sort: [TRENDING_DESC, POPULARITY_DESC], isAdult: false, status_in: [RELEASING, FINISHED]) { ${CARD} description(asHtml: false) } }
      seasonal: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, season: $season, seasonYear: $year, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      allTime: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, sort: SCORE_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      popular: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      upcoming: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, status: NOT_YET_RELEASED, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      pick: Page(perPage: 1, page: 2) { media(type: ANIME, sort: TRENDING_DESC, isAdult: false, format_in: [TV, ONA, MOVIE]) { ${CARD} description(asHtml: false) } }
    }`
  type R = Record<'hero' | 'top' | 'seasonal' | 'allTime' | 'popular' | 'upcoming' | 'pick', { media: MediaCard[] }>
  const data = await anilist<R>(query, { season, year }, 1800)
  return {
    season,
    year,
    hero: data?.hero.media ?? [],
    top: data?.top.media ?? [],
    seasonal: data?.seasonal.media ?? [],
    allTime: data?.allTime.media ?? [],
    popular: data?.popular.media ?? [],
    upcoming: data?.upcoming.media ?? [],
    pick: data?.pick.media?.[0] ?? null,
  }
}

export type FateFilters = {
  genres?: string[]
  tags?: string[]
  era?: { from: number; to: number } | null
  format?: string | null
  length?: 'short' | 'mid' | 'long' | null
  minScore?: number
}

export async function drawFatePool(f: FateFilters) {
  const query = `
    query ($page: Int, $genre_in: [String], $tag_in: [String], $format: MediaFormat, $sdg: FuzzyDateInt, $sdl: FuzzyDateInt, $epl: Int, $epg: Int, $score: Int) {
      Page(page: $page, perPage: 30) {
        media(type: ANIME, isAdult: false, genre_in: $genre_in, tag_in: $tag_in, format: $format, startDate_greater: $sdg, startDate_lesser: $sdl, episodes_lesser: $epl, episodes_greater: $epg, averageScore_greater: $score, sort: POPULARITY_DESC) {
          ${CARD} description(asHtml: false)
        }
      }
    }`
  const vars = {
    genre_in: f.genres?.length ? f.genres.slice(0, 3) : undefined,
    tag_in: f.tags?.length ? f.tags.slice(0, 3) : undefined,
    format: f.format || undefined,
    sdg: f.era?.from,
    sdl: f.era?.to,
    epl: f.length === 'short' ? 14 : f.length === 'mid' ? 31 : undefined,
    epg: f.length === 'mid' ? 13 : f.length === 'long' ? 30 : undefined,
    score: f.minScore ?? 55,
  }
  const filterCount = (vars.genre_in?.length ?? 0) + (vars.tag_in?.length ?? 0) + (vars.format ? 1 : 0) + (vars.sdg ? 1 : 0) + (f.length ? 1 : 0)
  const maxPage = filterCount === 0 ? 18 : filterCount === 1 ? 5 : 2
  const page = Math.floor(Math.random() * maxPage) + 1
  type R = { Page: { media: (MediaCard & { description?: string })[] } }
  let data = await anilist<R>(query, { ...vars, page }, 3600)
  if (!data?.Page.media.length && page > 1) data = await anilist<R>(query, { ...vars, page: 1 }, 3600)
  return data?.Page.media ?? []
}

export async function searchAnime(p: SearchParams) {
  const query = `
    query ($page: Int, $search: String, $genre: String, $tag_in: [String], $year: Int, $season: MediaSeason, $format: MediaFormat, $status: MediaStatus, $sort: [MediaSort]) {
      Page(page: $page, perPage: 24) {
        pageInfo { hasNextPage total currentPage }
        media(type: ANIME, isAdult: false, search: $search, genre: $genre, tag_in: $tag_in, seasonYear: $year, season: $season, format: $format, status: $status, sort: $sort) { ${CARD} }
      }
    }`
  const sort = p.sort || (p.q ? 'SEARCH_MATCH' : 'POPULARITY_DESC')
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { pageInfo: { hasNextPage: boolean; total: number; currentPage: number }; media: MediaCard[] } }>(
    query,
    {
      page: p.page || 1,
      search: p.q || undefined,
      genre: p.genre || undefined,
      tag_in: p.tag ? p.tag.split(',').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3) : undefined,
      year: p.year || undefined,
      season: p.season || undefined,
      format: p.format || undefined,
      status: p.status || undefined,
      sort: [sort],
    },
    900,
  )
  return data?.Page ?? { pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, total: 0, currentPage: 1 }, media: [] }
}

export type ScheduleItem = { id: number; episode: number; airingAt: number; media: MediaCard }

export async function getSchedule() {
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
  const start = now - (now % 86400) - 3 * 3600
  const end = start + 7 * 86400
  const query = `
    query ($start: Int, $end: Int, $page: Int) {
      Page(page: $page, perPage: 50) {
        pageInfo { hasNextPage }
        airingSchedules(airingAt_greater: $start, airingAt_lesser: $end, sort: TIME) { id episode airingAt media { ${CARD} isAdult } }
      }
    }`
  const all: ScheduleItem[] = []
  for (let page = 1; page <= 4; page++) {
    const data = await anilist<{ Page: { pageInfo: { hasNextPage: boolean }; airingSchedules: (ScheduleItem & { media: MediaCard & { isAdult?: boolean } })[] } }>(
      query,
      { start, end, page },
      1800,
    )
    if (!data) break
    all.push(...data.Page.airingSchedules.filter((s) => !s.media.isAdult))
    if (!data.Page.pageInfo.hasNextPage) break
  }
  return all
}

export async function getAnimeBatch(ids: number[]) {
  const unique = [...new Set(ids)].slice(0, 200)
  const chunks: number[][] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i += 50) chunks.push(unique.slice(i, i + 50))
  const results = await Promise.all(chunks.map((c) => getManyAnime(c)))
  return new Map(results.flat().map((m) => [m.id, m]))
}

import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'
import { kvDel, kvGet, kvSet } from './store'

/**
 * Çizim Atölyesi storage. Images live under their own keys so the gallery
 * listing only ships metadata; pixels are served by /api/art/[id].
 */

export type Artwork = {
  id: string
  uid: string
  title: string
  width: number
  height: number
  at: number
  likes: string[]
  hidden?: boolean
  /** Rough brush-time in seconds, shown as "x dk emek" */
  effort?: number
  layers?: number
}

type ArtPixels = { image: string; thumb: string }
type FeedRef = { id: string; uid: string; at: number }

export type DraftLayer = { id: string; name: string; visible: boolean; opacity: number; blend: string; data: string }
export type Draft = { w: number; h: number; layers: DraftLayer[]; at: number; title?: string }

export const ART_LIMITS = {
  imageBytes: 2_200_000,
  thumbBytes: 400_000,
  /** Keeps a full draft (base64) under the 8 MB server action body limit. */
  draftBytes: 5_400_000,
  perUser: 60,
  feed: 600,
  titleLen: 60,
}

const DATA_URL = /^data:image\/(?:webp|png|jpeg);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/

/** Accepts only base64 WebP / PNG / JPEG data URLs whose decoded size stays under `maxBytes`. */
export function isImageDataUrl(s: unknown, maxBytes: number): s is string {
  return typeof s === 'string' && s.length <= Math.ceil(maxBytes * 1.37) + 32 && DATA_URL.test(s)
}

export async function getArtwork(id: string) {
  return kvGet<Artwork>(`art:${id}`)
}

export async function getArtPixels(id: string) {
  return kvGet<ArtPixels>(`art-px:${id}`)
}

export async function listArtworks(limit = 120) {
  const feed = (await kvGet<FeedRef[]>('art-feed')) ?? []
  const items = await Promise.all(feed.slice(0, limit).map((r) => getArtwork(r.id)))
  return items.filter((a): a is Artwork => Boolean(a && !a.hidden))
}

export async function listUserArtworks(uid: string) {
  const ids = (await kvGet<string[]>(`art-user:${uid}`)) ?? []
  const items = await Promise.all(ids.map((id) => getArtwork(id)))
  return items.filter((a): a is Artwork => Boolean(a && !a.hidden))
}

export async function createArtwork(input: { uid: string; title: string; width: number; height: number; image: string; thumb: string; effort?: number; layers?: number }) {
  const id = randomBytes(7).toString('hex')
  const art: Artwork = {
    id,
    uid: input.uid,
    title: input.title,
    width: input.width,
    height: input.height,
    at: Date.now(),
    likes: [],
    effort: input.effort,
    layers: input.layers,
  }
  await kvSet(`art-px:${id}`, { image: input.image, thumb: input.thumb } satisfies ArtPixels)
  await kvSet(`art:${id}`, art)
  const feed = (await kvGet<FeedRef[]>('art-feed')) ?? []
  feed.unshift({ id, uid: input.uid, at: art.at })
  await kvSet('art-feed', feed.slice(0, ART_LIMITS.feed))
  const mine = (await kvGet<string[]>(`art-user:${input.uid}`)) ?? []
  mine.unshift(id)
  const overflow = mine.slice(ART_LIMITS.perUser)
  await kvSet(`art-user:${input.uid}`, mine.slice(0, ART_LIMITS.perUser))
  await Promise.all(overflow.map((old) => removeArtworkData(old)))
  return art
}

async function removeArtworkData(id: string) {
  await Promise.all([kvDel(`art:${id}`), kvDel(`art-px:${id}`)])
}

export async function deleteArtwork(id: string) {
  const art = await getArtwork(id)
  if (!art) return null
  await removeArtworkData(id)
  const feed = (await kvGet<FeedRef[]>('art-feed')) ?? []
  await kvSet(
    'art-feed',
    feed.filter((r) => r.id !== id),
  )
  const mine = (await kvGet<string[]>(`art-user:${art.uid}`)) ?? []
  await kvSet(
    `art-user:${art.uid}`,
    mine.filter((x) => x !== id),
  )
  return art
}

export async function toggleArtworkLike(id: string, uid: string) {
  const art = await getArtwork(id)
  if (!art || art.hidden) return null
  art.likes = art.likes.includes(uid) ? art.likes.filter((u) => u !== uid) : [...art.likes, uid]
  await kvSet(`art:${id}`, art)
  return art
}

export async function getDraft(uid: string) {
  return kvGet<Draft>(`art-draft:${uid}`)
}

export async function toCommentViews(comments: Comment[], viewerId: string | null): Promise<CommentView[]> {

import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'
import { kvGet, kvSet } from './store'
import type { Tier } from './membership'

/* ---------- Comments ---------- */
export type Comment = {
  id: string
  animeId: number
  animeTitle: string
  uid: string
  text: string
  spoiler: boolean
  likes: string[]
  at: number
  hidden?: boolean
  gif?: string | null
}

type FeedRef = { animeId: number; id: string; at: number }

export async function listComments(animeId: number) {
  return ((await kvGet<Comment[]>(`comments:${animeId}`)) ?? []).filter((c) => !c.hidden).sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at)
}

export async function addComment(input: Omit<Comment, 'id' | 'likes' | 'at'>) {
  const list = (await kvGet<Comment[]>(`comments:${input.animeId}`)) ?? []
  const c: Comment = { ...input, id: randomBytes(8).toString('hex'), likes: [], at: Date.now() }
  list.push(c)
  await kvSet(`comments:${input.animeId}`, list.slice(-500))
  const feed = (await kvGet<FeedRef[]>('comments-feed')) ?? []
  feed.unshift({ animeId: c.animeId, id: c.id, at: c.at })
  await kvSet('comments-feed', feed.slice(0, 300))
  const count = ((await kvGet<number>(`comment-count:${c.uid}`)) ?? 0) + 1
  await kvSet(`comment-count:${c.uid}`, count)
  return c
}

export async function getCommentCount(uid: string) {
  return (await kvGet<number>(`comment-count:${uid}`)) ?? 0
}

export async function toggleLike(animeId: number, id: string, uid: string) {
  const list = (await kvGet<Comment[]>(`comments:${animeId}`)) ?? []
  const c = list.find((x) => x.id === id)
  if (!c) return null
  c.likes = c.likes.includes(uid) ? c.likes.filter((u) => u !== uid) : [...c.likes, uid]
  await kvSet(`comments:${animeId}`, list)
  return c
}

export async function removeComment(animeId: number, id: string) {
  const list = (await kvGet<Comment[]>(`comments:${animeId}`)) ?? []
  const target = list.find((c) => c.id === id)
  await kvSet(
    `comments:${animeId}`,
    list.filter((c) => c.id !== id),
  )
  return target ?? null
}

export async function recentComments(limit = 60) {
  const feed = (await kvGet<FeedRef[]>('comments-feed')) ?? []
  const byAnime = new Map<number, Comment[]>()
  const out: Comment[] = []
  for (const ref of feed.slice(0, limit)) {
    if (!byAnime.has(ref.animeId)) byAnime.set(ref.animeId, (await kvGet<Comment[]>(`comments:${ref.animeId}`)) ?? [])
    const c = byAnime.get(ref.animeId)!.find((x) => x.id === ref.id)
    if (c) out.push(c)
  }
  return out
}

    note,

export async function consumeCode(code: string, uid: string) {
  const list = await listCodes()
  const c = list.find((x) => x.code === code.trim().toUpperCase())
  if (!c) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Kod bulunamadı.' }
  if (c.usedBy) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Bu kod daha önce kullanılmış.' }
  c.usedBy = uid
  c.usedAt = Date.now()
  await kvSet('premium-codes', list)
  return { ok: true as const, code: c }
}

  await kvSet(
    'premium-codes',
    list.filter((c) => c.code !== code),
  )
}

export type CustomTheme = { id: string; name: string; hex: string }

export const CUSTOM_THEME_KEY = 'sy-custom-theme'
export const CUSTOM_THEME_LIMIT = 8
export const HEX_RE = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i

export const CUSTOM_VAR_NAMES = ['--hue', '--chroma', '--primary', '--primary-foreground', '--ink-light', '--ink-dark'] as const

function srgbToLinear(c: number) {
  return c <= 0.04045 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4)
}

/** sRGB hex → OKLCH (L 0–1, C ~0–0.37, h degrees). */
export function hexToOklch(hex: string) {
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16)
  const r = srgbToLinear(((n >> 16) & 255) / 255)
  const g = srgbToLinear(((n >> 8) & 255) / 255)
  const b = srgbToLinear((n & 255) / 255)
  const l = Math.cbrt(0.4122214708 * r + 0.5363325363 * g + 0.0514459929 * b)
  const m = Math.cbrt(0.2119034982 * r + 0.6806995451 * g + 0.1073969566 * b)
  const s = Math.cbrt(0.0883024619 * r + 0.2817188376 * g + 0.6299787005 * b)
  const L = 0.2104542553 * l + 0.793617785 * m - 0.0040720468 * s
  const A = 1.9779984951 * l - 2.428592205 * m + 0.4505937099 * s
  const B = 0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.808675766 * s
  const C = Math.sqrt(A * A + B * B)
  let h = (Math.atan2(B, A) * 180) / Math.PI
  if (h < 0) h += 360
  return { l: L, c: C, h }
}

const r3 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 1000) / 1000

/** CSS variables that make a single brand colour drive the whole theme, with readable contrast. */
export function customThemeVars(hex: string): Record<(typeof CUSTOM_VAR_NAMES)[number], string> {
  const { l, c, h } = hexToOklch(hex)
  const hue = Math.round(h)
  const chroma = r3(Math.min(c, 0.24))
  const lightText = l < 0.68
  return {
    '--hue': String(hue),
    '--chroma': String(chroma),
    '--primary': hex,
    '--primary-foreground': lightText ? `oklch(0.985 0.01 ${hue})` : `oklch(0.2 ${r3(Math.min(c, 0.08))} ${hue})`,
    '--ink-light': `oklch(${r3(Math.min(l, 0.52))} ${r3(Math.min(c, 0.2))} ${hue})`,
    '--ink-dark': `oklch(${r3(Math.max(l, 0.8))} ${r3(Math.min(c, 0.17))} ${hue})`,
  }
}

export function sanitizeThemeName(name: string) {
  return name.replace(/[<>{}`]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 24)
}

function linearToSrgb(c: number) {
  return c <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * c : 1.055 * Math.pow(c, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055
}

function oklchToLinearRgb(l: number, c: number, h: number) {
  const hr = (h * Math.PI) / 180
  const a = c * Math.cos(hr)
  const b = c * Math.sin(hr)
  const l_ = Math.pow(l + 0.3963377774 * a + 0.2158037573 * b, 3)
  const m_ = Math.pow(l - 0.1055613458 * a - 0.0638541728 * b, 3)
  const s_ = Math.pow(l - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.291485548 * b, 3)
  return [
    4.0767416621 * l_ - 3.3077115913 * m_ + 0.2309699292 * s_,
    -1.2684380046 * l_ + 2.6097574011 * m_ - 0.3413193965 * s_,
    -0.0041960863 * l_ - 0.7034186147 * m_ + 1.707614701 * s_,
  ]
}

/** OKLCH → sRGB hex, pulling chroma in until the colour fits the sRGB gamut. */
export function oklchToHex(l: number, c: number, h: number) {
  let chroma = c
  let rgb = oklchToLinearRgb(l, chroma, h)
  for (let i = 0; i < 30 && rgb.some((v) => v < -0.0005 || v > 1.0005); i++) {
    chroma *= 0.94
    rgb = oklchToLinearRgb(l, chroma, h)
  }
  return (
    '#' +
    rgb
      .map((v) => Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, linearToSrgb(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v))))) * 255))
      .map((v) => v.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('')
  )
}

import 'server-only'
import jpeg from 'jpeg-js'
import { PNG } from 'pngjs'

/**
 * Turns plain-background character art (white or any flat colour) into a transparent cut-out,
 * so every character can stand in front of the showcase panel the way native PNG cut-outs do.
 *
 * The background colour is read from the image border, then flood-filled inwards from the edges:
 * only pixels connected to the border are removed, so white hair or clothing enclosed by line art survives.
 */

type Raster = { width: number; height: number; data: Uint8Array }

const MAX_PIXELS = 4_000_000
const TOLERANCE = 30
const FEATHER = 70

function decode(buf: Buffer, type: string): Raster | null {
  try {
    if (type.includes('png') || buf.subarray(1, 4).toString() === 'PNG') {
      const png = PNG.sync.read(buf)
      return { width: png.width, height: png.height, data: png.data }
    }
    const img = jpeg.decode(buf, { useTArray: true, formatAsRGBA: true, maxResolutionInMP: 40, maxMemoryUsageInMB: 512 })
    return { width: img.width, height: img.height, data: img.data }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function median(values: number[]) {
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)
  return sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)] ?? 255
}

/** Returns the background mask (1 = background), or null when the art has no clean, flat background. */
function backgroundMask({ width: w, height: h, data: d }: Raster) {
  const n = w * h
  if (n > MAX_PIXELS || w < 64 || h < 64) return null

  const border: number[] = []
  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) border.push(x, (h - 1) * w + x)
  for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) border.push(y * w, y * w + w - 1)

  const opaque = border.filter((i) => d[i * 4 + 3] > 16)
  const bg = [0, 1, 2].map((c) => median(opaque.map((i) => d[i * 4 + c])))
  const dist = (i: number) => Math.max(Math.abs(d[i * 4] - bg[0]), Math.abs(d[i * 4 + 1] - bg[1]), Math.abs(d[i * 4 + 2] - bg[2]))
  const isBg = (i: number) => d[i * 4 + 3] <= 16 || dist(i) < TOLERANCE

  const clean = border.filter(isBg).length / border.length
  if (clean < 0.7) return null

  const mask = new Uint8Array(n)
  const queue = new Int32Array(n)
  let head = 0
  let tail = 0
  for (const i of border) {
    if (!mask[i] && isBg(i)) {
      mask[i] = 1
      queue[tail++] = i
    }
  }
  while (head < tail) {
    const i = queue[head++]
    const x = i % w
    const next = [x > 0 ? i - 1 : -1, x < w - 1 ? i + 1 : -1, i - w, i + w]
    for (const j of next) {
      if (j >= 0 && j < n && !mask[j] && isBg(j)) {
        mask[j] = 1
        queue[tail++] = j
      }
    }
  }

  if (!dropSpeckles(mask, w, h)) return null

  let bgCount = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) bgCount += mask[i]
  const figure = 1 - bgCount / n
  if (figure < 0.06 || figure > 0.88) return null
  return { mask, bg, dist }
}

/**
 * Paper grain and JPEG noise leave tiny opaque islands floating around the figure after the flood fill.
 * Islands far smaller than the figure are folded into the background; if there are so many that the
 * background is clearly textured (not flat), the art is rejected so a cleaner candidate gets picked.
 */
function dropSpeckles(mask: Uint8Array, w: number, h: number) {
  const n = w * h
  const label = new Int32Array(n)
  const sizes: number[] = [0]
  const stack = new Int32Array(n)
  for (let start = 0; start < n; start++) {
    if (mask[start] || label[start]) continue
    const id = sizes.length
    let size = 0
    let top = 0
    stack[top++] = start
    label[start] = id
    while (top > 0) {
      const i = stack[--top]
      size++
      const x = i % w
      if (x > 0 && !mask[i - 1] && !label[i - 1]) (label[i - 1] = id), (stack[top++] = i - 1)
      if (x < w - 1 && !mask[i + 1] && !label[i + 1]) (label[i + 1] = id), (stack[top++] = i + 1)
      if (i >= w && !mask[i - w] && !label[i - w]) (label[i - w] = id), (stack[top++] = i - w)
      if (i < n - w && !mask[i + w] && !label[i + w]) (label[i + w] = id), (stack[top++] = i + w)
    }
    sizes.push(size)
  }
  const largest = Math.max(0, ...sizes)
  if (!largest) return false
  const keep = Math.max(300, largest * 0.02)
  let speckPixels = 0
  let speckCount = 0
  for (let id = 1; id < sizes.length; id++) {
    if (sizes[id] < keep) {
      speckPixels += sizes[id]
      speckCount++
    }
  }
  if (speckCount > 1500 || speckPixels > largest * 0.08) return false
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!mask[i] && sizes[label[i]] < keep) mask[i] = 1
  return true
}

/** Cheap check used while choosing artwork: can this image be cut out cleanly? */
export function canCutOut(buf: Buffer, type: string) {
  const img = decode(buf, type)
  return Boolean(img && backgroundMask(img))
}

/** Transparent, tightly-cropped PNG of the figure, or null when the background isn't flat enough. */
export function cutOut(buf: Buffer, type: string): Buffer | null {
  const img = decode(buf, type)
  if (!img) return null
  const found = backgroundMask(img)
  if (!found) return null

  const { width: w, height: h, data: src } = img
  const { mask, bg, dist } = found
  const out = Buffer.from(src)
  let minX = w
  let minY = h
  let maxX = -1
  let maxY = -1

  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const i = y * w + x
      const p = i * 4
      if (mask[i]) {
        out[p + 3] = 0
        continue
      }
      // Anti-aliased rim: fade pixels that border the background by how close they are to its colour,
      // and un-mix the background out of them so no white halo remains on a coloured panel.
      const rim = (x > 0 && mask[i - 1]) || (x < w - 1 && mask[i + 1]) || (y > 0 && mask[i - w]) || (y < h - 1 && mask[i + w])
      if (rim) {
        const a = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (dist(i) - TOLERANCE * 0.4) / FEATHER))
        if (a < 0.04) {
          out[p + 3] = 0
          continue
        }
        for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) out[p + c] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round((src[p + c] - bg[c] * (1 - a)) / a)))
        out[p + 3] = Math.round(src[p + 3] * a)
      }
      if (out[p + 3] > 0) {
        if (x < minX) minX = x
        if (x > maxX) maxX = x
        if (y < minY) minY = y
        if (y > maxY) maxY = y
      }
    }
  }
  if (maxX < 0) return null

  const pad = 4
  const left = Math.max(0, minX - pad)
  const top = Math.max(0, minY - pad)
  const cw = Math.min(w, maxX + pad + 1) - left
  const ch = Math.min(h, maxY + pad + 1) - top

  const png = new PNG({ width: cw, height: ch })
  for (let y = 0; y < ch; y++) {
    const from = ((top + y) * w + left) * 4
    out.copy(png.data, y * cw * 4, from, from + cw * 4)
  }
  return PNG.sync.write(png, { colorType: 6, deflateLevel: 6 })
}

}

type FeedEntry = {
  'im:name': { label: string }
  'im:image': { label: string }[]
  summary?: { label: string }
  'im:artist'?: { label: string }
  category?: { attributes: { label: string } }
  'im:releaseDate'?: { label: string }
  id: { attributes: { 'im:id': string } }
  link?: { attributes: { rel?: string; href: string; 'im:assetType'?: string } }[] | { attributes: { rel?: string; href: string } }
  rights?: { label: string }
}

function fromEntry(e: FeedEntry): Film | null {
  const genre = e.category?.attributes.label ?? ''
  if (EXCLUDED_GENRES.has(genre)) return null
  const art = e['im:image']?.at(-1)?.label
  if (!art) return null
  const links = Array.isArray(e.link) ? e.link : e.link ? [e.link] : []
  const trailer = links.find((l) => l.attributes.rel === 'enclosure')?.attributes.href ?? null
  const release = e['im:releaseDate']?.label ?? null
  return {
    id: e.id.attributes['im:id'],
    title: e['im:name'].label,
    director: e['im:artist']?.label ?? '',
    genre,
    genreTr: GENRE_TR[genre] ?? genre,
    year: release ? new Date(release).getFullYear() : null,
    release,
    summary: e.summary?.label ?? '',
    poster: sized(art, 400, 600),
    posterLg: sized(art, 1000, 1500),
    trailer,
    rights: e.rights?.label ?? null,
  }
}

async function feed(path: string): Promise<Film[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/tr/rss/topmovies/${path}/json`, { next: { revalidate: 21600 } })
    if (!res.ok) return []
    const json = (await res.json()) as { feed?: { entry?: FeedEntry[] | FeedEntry } }
    const raw = json.feed?.entry
    const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : raw ? [raw] : []
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    return list
      .map(fromEntry)
      .filter((f): f is Film => {
        if (!f || seen.has(f.id)) return false
        seen.add(f.id)
        return true
      })
  } catch {
    return []
  }
}

  const g = FILM_GENRES.find((x) => x.id === genre)
  return g ? feed(`limit=${limit}/genre=${g.itunes}`) : Promise.resolve([])
})

}

})

type LookupResult = {
  trackId: number
  trackName: string
  artistName: string
  primaryGenreName: string
  releaseDate?: string
  longDescription?: string
  shortDescription?: string
  previewUrl?: string
  artworkUrl100?: string
  trackTimeMillis?: number
  contentAdvisoryRating?: string
}

export const getFilm = cache(async (id: string): Promise<FilmDetail | null> => {
  if (!/^\d{3,14}$/.test(id)) return null
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=${id}&country=tr`, { next: { revalidate: 21600 } })
    if (!res.ok) return null
    const r = ((await res.json()) as { results?: LookupResult[] }).results?.[0]
    if (!r || !r.artworkUrl100) return null
    const summary = r.longDescription || r.shortDescription || ''
    const summaryTr = summary ? await translate(summary, 'tr').catch(() => null) : null
    return {
      id: String(r.trackId),
      title: r.trackName,
      director: r.artistName,
      genre: r.primaryGenreName,
      genreTr: GENRE_TR[r.primaryGenreName] ?? r.primaryGenreName,
      year: r.releaseDate ? new Date(r.releaseDate).getFullYear() : null,
      release: r.releaseDate ?? null,
      summary,
      summaryTr,
      poster: sized(r.artworkUrl100, 400, 600),
      posterLg: sized(r.artworkUrl100, 1000, 1500),
      trailer: r.previewUrl ?? null,
      rights: null,
      runtime: r.trackTimeMillis ? Math.round(r.trackTimeMillis / 60000) : null,
      rating: r.contentAdvisoryRating ?? null,
    }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
})

function fromLookup(r: LookupResult): Film | null {
  if (!r.artworkUrl100 || EXCLUDED_GENRES.has(r.primaryGenreName)) return null
  return {
    id: String(r.trackId),
    title: r.trackName,
    director: r.artistName,
    genre: r.primaryGenreName,
    genreTr: GENRE_TR[r.primaryGenreName] ?? r.primaryGenreName,
    year: r.releaseDate ? new Date(r.releaseDate).getFullYear() : null,
    release: r.releaseDate ?? null,
    summary: r.longDescription || r.shortDescription || '',
    poster: sized(r.artworkUrl100, 400, 600),
    posterLg: sized(r.artworkUrl100, 1000, 1500),
    trailer: r.previewUrl ?? null,
    rights: null,
  }
}

const fold = (s: string) =>
  s
    .toLocaleLowerCase('tr')
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/ı/g, 'i')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .trim()

async function itunesSearch(term: string): Promise<Film[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/search?term=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&media=movie&entity=movie&country=tr&limit=40`, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })
    if (!res.ok) return []
    const json = (await res.json()) as { results?: LookupResult[] }
    return (json.results ?? []).map(fromLookup).filter((f): f is Film => Boolean(f))
  } catch {
    return []
  }
}

/** Fallback when the iTunes search endpoint returns nothing: Wikidata films carrying an iTunes ID (P6398), resolved via the TR lookup. */
async function wikidataSearch(term: string): Promise<Film[]> {
  try {
    const headers = { 'User-Agent': 'SyraCinema/1.0 (cinema mode)', Accept: 'application/json' }
    const s = await fetch(`https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=${encodeURIComponent(`${term} haswbstatement:P6398`)}&srlimit=20&format=json`, { headers, next: { revalidate: 86400 } })
    const ids = (((await s.json()) as { query?: { search?: { title: string }[] } }).query?.search ?? []).map((x) => x.title).filter((t) => /^Q\d+$/.test(t))
    if (!ids.length) return []
    const query = `SELECT ?f ?it WHERE { VALUES ?f { ${ids.map((i) => `wd:${i}`).join(' ')} } ?f wdt:P6398 ?it . }`
    const sp = await fetch(`https://query.wikidata.org/sparql?format=json&query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { headers, next: { revalidate: 86400 } })
    const rows = (((await sp.json()) as { results?: { bindings?: { f: { value: string }; it: { value: string } }[] } }).results?.bindings ?? [])
    const order = new Map(ids.map((id, i) => [id, i]))
    const byFilm = new Map<string, string[]>()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const q = r.f.value.split('/').pop()!
      if (/^\d{3,14}$/.test(r.it.value)) byFilm.set(q, [...(byFilm.get(q) ?? []), r.it.value])
    }
    const itunesIds = [...byFilm.values()].flat().slice(0, 150)
    if (!itunesIds.length) return []
    const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=${itunesIds.join(',')}&country=tr`, { next: { revalidate: 21600 } })
    const found = new Map(((((await res.json()) as { results?: LookupResult[] }).results ?? [])).map((r) => [String(r.trackId), r]))
    const out: { film: Film; rank: number }[] = []
    for (const [q, its] of byFilm) {
      const hit = its.map((i) => found.get(i)).find(Boolean)
      const film = hit ? fromLookup(hit) : null
      if (film) out.push({ film, rank: order.get(q) ?? 99 })
    }
    return out.sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank).map((x) => x.film)
  } catch {
    return []
  }
}

/** Film search across the catalogue we already show, the iTunes TR store, and a Wikidata-backed fallback. */
export const searchFilms = cache(async (q: string): Promise<Film[]> => {
  const term = q.trim().slice(0, 80)
  if (term.length < 2) return []
  const needle = fold(term)
  const [home, store] = await Promise.all([getFilmHome(), itunesSearch(term)])
  const local = Object.values(home)
    .flat()
    .filter((f) => fold(f.title).includes(needle) || fold(f.director).includes(needle))
  const remote = store.length ? store : await wikidataSearch(term)
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  return [...local, ...remote].filter((f) => {
    if (seen.has(f.id)) return false
    seen.add(f.id)
    return true
  }).slice(0, 48)
})

/** Other films by the same director, matched against the iTunes artist credit. */
export const getFilmsByDirector = cache(async (director: string, excludeId: string): Promise<Film[]> => {
  const name = director.split(/,|&/)[0]?.trim()
  if (!name || name.length < 3) return []
  const needle = fold(name)
  const [home, store, wiki] = await Promise.all([getFilmHome(), itunesSearch(name), wikidataSearch(name)])
  const seen = new Set<string>([excludeId])
  return [...Object.values(home).flat(), ...store, ...wiki]
    .filter((f) => {
      if (seen.has(f.id) || !fold(f.director).includes(needle)) return false
      seen.add(f.id)
      return true
    })
    .sort((a, b) => (b.year ?? 0) - (a.year ?? 0))
    .slice(0, 18)
})

export function genreIdFor(genre: string): FilmGenreId | null {
  const map: Record<string, FilmGenreId> = {
    'Action & Adventure': 'aksiyon',
    'Sci-Fi & Fantasy': 'bilimkurgu',
    Thriller: 'gerilim',
    Drama: 'dram',
    Comedy: 'komedi',
    Horror: 'korku',
    Romance: 'romantik',
    'Kids & Family': 'aile',
    Documentary: 'belgesel',
    Western: 'western',
    Classics: 'klasik',
  }
  return map[genre] ?? null
}

  if (!min) return null
  const h = Math.floor(min / 60)
  const m = min % 60
  return h ? `${h} sa ${m} dk` : `${m} dk`
}

import type { MediaTitle } from './anilist-types'

export function pickTitle(t?: MediaTitle | null) {
  if (!t) return 'Bilinmeyen'
  return t.english || t.romaji || t.userPreferred || t.native || 'Bilinmeyen'
}

export function splitTitle(title: string) {
  const words = title.trim().split(/\s+/)
  if (words.length < 2) return { head: '', tail: title }
  const tail = words.pop() as string
  return { head: words.join(' '), tail }
}

export function stripHtml(html?: string | null) {
  if (!html) return ''
  return html
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
    .replace(/~!([\s\S]*?)!~/g, '$1')
    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^)]+)\)/g, '$1')
    .replace(/__(.*?)__/g, '$1')
    .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '$1')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#039;|&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&mdash;/g, '—')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim()
}

export function currentSeason(date = new Date()) {
  const m = date.getMonth()
  const year = date.getFullYear()
  if (m <= 2) return { season: 'WINTER', year }
  if (m <= 5) return { season: 'SPRING', year }
  if (m <= 8) return { season: 'SUMMER', year }
  return { season: 'FALL', year }
}

export function timeUntil(seconds: number) {
  const d = Math.floor(seconds / 86400)
  const h = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600)
  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
  if (d > 0) return `${d}g ${h}s`
  if (h > 0) return `${h}s ${m}dk`
  return `${m}dk`
}

export function fuzzyDate(d?: { year?: number | null; month?: number | null; day?: number | null } | null) {
  if (!d || !d.year) return null
  const months = ['Oca', 'Şub', 'Mar', 'Nis', 'May', 'Haz', 'Tem', 'Ağu', 'Eyl', 'Eki', 'Kas', 'Ara']
  return [d.day, d.month ? months[d.month - 1] : null, d.year].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
}

export function compact(n?: number | null) {
  if (n == null) return '—'
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('tr-TR', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n)
}

import 'server-only'
import { canCutOut } from '@/lib/cutout'

/**
 * Full-body character art.
 * AniList only ships square-ish portrait crops, so standing artwork is looked up on Safebooru
 * (general-rated only): first the character's tag is resolved from their name and series,
 * then the best-scored solo + full_body post is picked — transparent cut-outs first.
 */

const BASE = 'https://safebooru.org'
const WEEK = 604800
const UA = { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Sytheris/1.0; +https://sytheris.vercel.app)' }
const SAFE = 'rating:general -swimsuit -bikini -underwear -lingerie -nude -topless -topless_male -cosplay -comic -multiple_views -chibi'

/** `transparent` means the figure can stand on its own; `cutout` means the transparency is produced by our proxy. */
export type FullBody = { url: string; width: number; height: number; transparent: boolean; tag: string; cutout?: boolean; score?: number }

type Post = { file_url: string; sample_url?: string; width: number; height: number; score: number | null; tags: string }
type Suggestion = { label: string; value: string }

/** Romanisation-insensitive token: "Gojou" / "Gojo" / "Gojō" all become "gojo". */
function norm(s: string) {
  return s
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/ou/g, 'o')
    .replace(/uu/g, 'u')
    .replace(/oo/g, 'o')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
}

function tokens(s: string) {
  return s
    .split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}']+/u)
    .map(norm)
    .filter((t) => t.length > 1)
}

async function json<T>(url: string): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: UA, next: { revalidate: WEEK } })
    if (!res.ok) return null
    const text = (await res.text()).trim()
    return text ? (JSON.parse(text) as T) : null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

/** Resolves the Safebooru tag for a character, preferring the one qualified with their series. */
export async function resolveCharacterTag(name: string, series: string[]): Promise<string | null> {
  const nameTokens = tokens(name)
  if (!nameTokens.length) return null
  const seriesTokens = new Set(series.flatMap(tokens))
  const queries = [...new Set(name.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 1))].slice(0, 2)

  const suggestions = (await Promise.all(queries.map((q) => json<Suggestion[]>(`${BASE}/autocomplete.php?q=${encodeURIComponent(q.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, ''))}`)))).flatMap((s) => s ?? [])

  let best: { tag: string; score: number } | null = null
  const wanted = [...nameTokens].sort().join(' ')
  for (const s of suggestions) {
    const tag = s.value.replace(/&#039;/g, "'")
    const count = Number(/\((\d+)\)\s*$/.exec(s.label)?.[1] ?? 0)
    if (!count) continue
    const qualifier = /_\(([^)]+)\)$/.exec(tag)?.[1] ?? ''
    if (/cosplay/.test(qualifier)) continue
    const core = tokens(tag.replace(/_\([^)]*\)$/, ''))
    const exact = [...core].sort().join(' ') === wanted
    const qualifierTokens = tokens(qualifier)
    const seriesMatch = qualifierTokens.length > 0 && qualifierTokens.some((t) => seriesTokens.has(t))
    if (qualifierTokens.length > 0 && !seriesMatch) continue
    // "anya_(spy_x_family)" for "Anya Forger": a partial name is only trusted when the series qualifier confirms it.
    const partial = !exact && seriesMatch && core.length > 0 && core.every((t) => nameTokens.includes(t))
    if (!exact && !partial) continue
    const score = count * (seriesMatch ? 4 : 1) * (exact ? 2 : 1)
    if (!best || score > best.score) best = { tag, score }
  }
  return best?.tag ?? null
}

async function posts(tags: string) {
  const list = await json<Post[]>(`${BASE}/index.php?page=dapi&s=post&q=index&json=1&limit=40&tags=${encodeURIComponent(tags)}`)
  return (list ?? []).filter((p) => p.file_url && p.width > 0 && p.height > 0)
}

function toFullBody(p: Post, transparent: boolean, tag: string): FullBody {
  const usePng = transparent && /\.png$/i.test(p.file_url)
  return { url: usePng ? p.file_url : p.sample_url || p.file_url, width: p.width, height: p.height, transparent: usePng, tag, score: quality(p) }
}

/**
 * A standing full-body figure is naturally tall, so the tallest aspect ratios win; that filters out
 * chibi art, half-body crops and wide scenes far more reliably than the (often empty) score field.
 */
/** Effects, scenery and props that turn a clean standee into a busy action shot. */
const BUSY = ['fire', 'flame', 'flaming_sword', 'sparks', 'glowing_weapon', 'blood', 'injury', 'puddle', 'reflection', 'traditional_media', 'watercolor_(medium)', 'water', 'splashing', 'motion_lines', 'speed_lines', 'action', 'fighting_stance', 'attack', 'electricity', 'lightning', 'explosion', 'aura', 'smoke', 'magic_circle', 'petals', 'falling_petals', 'scenery', 'outdoors', 'sky', 'cloud', 'rock', 'midair', 'jumping', 'running', 'dynamic_pose', 'foreshortening']
/** Never usable as a single standee. */
const REJECT = ['dual_persona', 'multiple_persona', 'character_sheet', 'reference_sheet', 'multiple_views', 'comic', '2koma', '4koma', 'chibi', 'lineart', 'monochrome', 'greyscale', 'sketch', 'text_focus']

function busyness(p: Post) {
  const tags = new Set(p.tags.split(' '))
  return BUSY.reduce((s, t) => s + (tags.has(t) ? 1 : 0), 0)
}

function quality(p: Post) {
  const tags = new Set(p.tags.split(' '))
  const ratio = Math.min(p.height / p.width, 2.6)
  const busy = busyness(p)
  return (
    ratio +
    (p.height >= 1600 ? 0.5 : p.height >= 1100 ? 0.25 : 0) +
    (tags.has('official_art') ? 1.2 : 0) +
    (tags.has('standing') ? 0.6 : 0) +
    (tags.has('looking_at_viewer') ? 0.1 : 0) +
    (tags.has('white_background') || tags.has('simple_background') || tags.has('transparent_background') ? 0.35 : 0) +
    ((p.score ?? 0) > 0 ? 0.15 : 0) -
    busy * 0.45
  )
}

function usable(p: Post) {
  const tags = new Set(p.tags.split(' '))
  return !REJECT.some((t) => tags.has(t))
}

/** `strict` drops busy action shots entirely; only the very last fallback accepts them. */
function pickMany(list: Post[], transparent: boolean, tag: string, n: number, strict = true) {
  const ranked = list
    .filter((p) => p.height / p.width >= 1.15 && usable(p) && (!strict || busyness(p) < 2))
    .map((p) => ({ p, q: quality(p) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.q - a.q)
    .map((x) => x.p)
  if (strict) return ranked.slice(0, n).map((p) => toFullBody(p, transparent, tag))
  const fallback = list.filter(usable)
  return (ranked.length ? ranked : fallback.length ? fallback : list).slice(0, n).map((p) => toFullBody(p, transparent, tag))
}

async function download(url: string) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: UA, next: { revalidate: WEEK } })
    const type = res.headers.get('content-type') ?? ''
    if (!res.ok || !type.startsWith('image/')) return null
    return { buf: Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer()), type }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

/** Plain-background art whose background can be removed on our side (see lib/cutout). */
async function pickCutouts(list: Post[], tag: string, n: number): Promise<FullBody[]> {
  const candidates = pickMany(list, false, tag, Math.min(6, n + 3))
  const checks = await Promise.all(
    candidates.map(async (c): Promise<FullBody | null> => {
      const file = await download(c.url)
      return file && canCutOut(file.buf, file.type) ? { ...c, transparent: true, cutout: true } : null
    }),
  )
  return checks.filter((c): c is FullBody => c !== null).slice(0, n)
}

/** Standing poses first: action shots with effects flying everywhere make poor standees. */
const PLAIN_BACKGROUNDS = ['white_background standing', 'simple_background standing', 'white_background', 'simple_background']

/**
 * Up to `n` different standing artworks of a character, best first:
 * native transparent cut-outs, then plain-background art cut out on the server, then any full-body art.
 * Grids that resolve one image per card pass `cutouts: false` to skip the download-and-check step.
 */
export async function getFullBodies(name: string, series: string[], n = 2, { cutouts = true } = {}): Promise<FullBody[]> {
  const tag = await resolveCharacterTag(name, series)
  if (!tag) return []
  const found: FullBody[] = []
  const add = (items: FullBody[]) => items.forEach((f) => found.length < n && !found.some((x) => x.url === f.url) && found.push(f))

  add(pickMany(await posts(`${tag} solo full_body transparent_background standing ${SAFE} sort:score:desc`), true, tag, n))
  if (found.length < n) add(pickMany(await posts(`${tag} solo full_body transparent_background ${SAFE} sort:score:desc`), true, tag, n - found.length))

  if (cutouts) {
    for (const bg of PLAIN_BACKGROUNDS) {
      if (found.length >= n) break
      const list = await posts(`${tag} solo full_body ${bg} -transparent_background ${SAFE} sort:score:desc`)
      if (list.length) add(await pickCutouts(list, tag, n - found.length))
    }
  }

  if (found.length < n) add(pickMany(await posts(`${tag} solo full_body ${SAFE} sort:score:desc`), false, tag, n - found.length, false))
  // Cleanest standee leads, whichever stage it came from — that is what makes every page read like Frieren's.
  return found.sort((a, b) => (b.transparent ? 1 : 0) - (a.transparent ? 1 : 0) || (b.score ?? 0) - (a.score ?? 0))
}

/** Best standing artwork for a character, or null when nothing suitable exists. */
export async function getFullBody(name: string, series: string[], options?: { cutouts?: boolean }): Promise<FullBody | null> {
  return (await getFullBodies(name, series, 1, options))[0] ?? null
}

/** A handful of extra solo artworks of the character for the hero's gallery. */
export async function getCharacterGallery(tag: string, exclude?: string, limit = 4): Promise<string[]> {
  const list = await posts(`${tag} solo ${SAFE} sort:score:desc`)
  return list
    .filter(usable)
    .map((p) => p.sample_url || p.file_url)
    .filter((u) => u && u !== exclude)
    .slice(0, limit)
}

export function isSafebooruUrl(raw: string) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(raw)
    return u.protocol === 'https:' && (u.hostname === 'safebooru.org' || u.hostname.endsWith('.safebooru.org'))
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/** Same-origin URL for a Safebooru image (served through /api/fullbody/img), optionally with its background removed. */
export function proxied(url: string, cutout = false) {
  return `/api/fullbody/img?u=${encodeURIComponent(url)}${cutout ? '&cut=1' : ''}`
}

/** Same-origin URL for a resolved artwork. */
export function artSrc(f: FullBody) {
  return proxied(f.url, Boolean(f.cutout))
}

/**
 * Site-wide access gate. Runs in the proxy (Web Crypto only, no Node APIs) and in the gate action.
 * The signing secret is derived from the access key itself, so rotating SITE_ACCESS_KEY instantly
 * revokes every issued pass.
 */

export const GATE_COOKIE = 'sy_gate'
export const GATE_PATH = '/kapi'

/** Paths that must stay reachable without a pass: the gate itself, the hidden download page and PWA files. */
const OPEN_PREFIXES = ['/kapi', '/indir', '/api/indir', '/robots.txt', '/manifest.json', '/sw.js', '/icon', '/apple-icon', '/favicon', '/placeholder']

export function isOpenPath(pathname: string) {
  return OPEN_PREFIXES.some((p) => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`) || pathname.startsWith(`${p}.`) || pathname.startsWith(`${p}-`))
}

export function gateKey() {
  return process.env.SITE_ACCESS_KEY || process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || ''
}

export function gateEnabled() {
  return gateKey().length > 0
}

const encoder = new TextEncoder()

function toBase64Url(bytes: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array) {
  const arr = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes)
  let bin = ''
  for (const b of arr) bin += String.fromCharCode(b)
  return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '')
}

async function hmac(data: string) {
  const secret = `sy-gate-v1|${process.env.SESSION_SECRET ?? ''}|${gateKey()}`
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', encoder.encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign'])
  return toBase64Url(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, encoder.encode(data)))
}

function constantTimeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false
  let diff = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i)
  return diff === 0
}

export async function issueGateToken(ttlMs: number) {
  const nonce = toBase64Url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12)))
  const body = `${Date.now() + ttlMs}.${nonce}`
  return `${body}.${await hmac(body)}`
}

export async function verifyGateToken(token?: string | null) {
  if (!token) return false
  const parts = token.split('.')
  if (parts.length !== 3) return false
  const [exp, nonce, sig] = parts
  const expiry = Number(exp)
  if (!Number.isFinite(expiry) || Date.now() > expiry || !nonce) return false
  return constantTimeEqual(sig, await hmac(`${exp}.${nonce}`))
}

/** Hashes both sides first so comparison time never depends on the key length. */
export async function keyMatches(input: string) {
  const expected = gateKey()
  if (!expected || !input) return false
  const [a, b] = await Promise.all([
    crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', encoder.encode(input)),
    crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', encoder.encode(expected)),
  ])
  return constantTimeEqual(toBase64Url(a), toBase64Url(b))
}

/** Only allow same-site relative redirects after unlocking. */
export function safeNext(next: unknown) {
  const value = typeof next === 'string' ? next : ''
  if (!value.startsWith('/') || value.startsWith('//') || value.startsWith('/\\') || value.startsWith(GATE_PATH)) return '/'
  return value
}

export function horrorThumb(id: string, quality: 'hq' | 'max' = 'hq') {
  return `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${id}/${quality === 'max' ? 'maxresdefault' : 'hqdefault'}.jpg`
}

export function horrorRuntime(seconds: number) {
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  const s = seconds % 60
  return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
import { mkdir, readdir, readFile, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import path from 'node:path'

/*
 * GEÇİCİ REFERANS KUTUSU — işin bitince sil:
 *   app/kutu/   app/api/kutu/   components/inbox/   lib/inbox.ts   lib/pinterest.ts
 * Dosyalar yalnızca sunucunun geçici klasöründe (/tmp/sytheris-inbox) durur; repoya ya da ZIP'e girmez.
 */

export const INBOX_DIR = path.join(tmpdir(), 'sytheris-inbox')
export const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024
export const MAX_VIDEO_BYTES = 80 * 1024 * 1024
export const MAX_FILES = 150
export const DEFAULT_CATEGORY = 'Genel'

const EXT_BY_TYPE: Record<string, string> = {
  'image/png': 'png',
  'image/jpeg': 'jpg',
  'image/webp': 'webp',
  'image/gif': 'gif',
  'image/avif': 'avif',
  'video/mp4': 'mp4',
  'video/webm': 'webm',
  'video/quicktime': 'mov',
}

const TYPE_BY_EXT: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(EXT_BY_TYPE).map(([t, e]) => [e, t]))

const NAME_RE = /^[a-z0-9-]+\.(png|jpg|webp|gif|avif|mp4|webm|mov)$/

export type InboxKind = 'image' | 'video'

export type InboxItem = {
  name: string
  original: string
  size: number
  type: string
  kind: InboxKind
  category: string
  note: string
  source: string | null
  at: number
}

export function isInboxName(name: string) {
  return NAME_RE.test(name)
}

export function inboxType(name: string) {
  return TYPE_BY_EXT[name.split('.').pop() ?? ''] ?? 'application/octet-stream'
}

export function kindOf(type: string): InboxKind | null {
  if (!EXT_BY_TYPE[type]) return null
  return type.startsWith('video/') ? 'video' : 'image'
}

export function cleanCategory(raw: unknown) {
  const v = String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f<>]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 32)
  return v || DEFAULT_CATEGORY
}

function normalize(raw: Partial<InboxItem>): InboxItem | null {
  if (!raw.name || !isInboxName(raw.name)) return null
  const type = raw.type ?? inboxType(raw.name)
  return {
    name: raw.name,
    original: raw.original ?? raw.name,
    size: raw.size ?? 0,
    type,
    kind: raw.kind ?? kindOf(type) ?? 'image',
    category: cleanCategory(raw.category),
    note: raw.note ?? '',
    source: raw.source ?? null,
    at: raw.at ?? 0,
  }
}

async function readMeta(name: string) {
  try {
    return normalize(JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(INBOX_DIR, `${name}.json`), 'utf8')) as Partial<InboxItem>)
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export async function listInbox(): Promise<InboxItem[]> {
  await mkdir(INBOX_DIR, { recursive: true })
  const files = await readdir(INBOX_DIR)
  const items = await Promise.all(files.filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json')).map((f) => readMeta(f.slice(0, -5))))
  return items.filter((i): i is InboxItem => !!i).sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at)
}

/** Stores raw bytes with metadata. `type` must be one of the allowed MIME types. */
export async function saveBytes(bytes: Uint8Array, meta: { type: string; original: string; note?: string; category?: string; source?: string | null }): Promise<InboxItem> {
  const ext = EXT_BY_TYPE[meta.type]
  const kind = kindOf(meta.type)
  if (!ext || !kind) throw new Error(`${meta.original}: yalnızca PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF, MP4, WEBM veya MOV.`)
  const limit = kind === 'video' ? MAX_VIDEO_BYTES : MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
  if (bytes.byteLength > limit) throw new Error(`${meta.original}: ${Math.round(limit / 1024 / 1024)} MB sınırını aşıyor.`)

  await mkdir(INBOX_DIR, { recursive: true })
  const name = `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}.${ext}`
  const item: InboxItem = {
    name,
    original: meta.original.slice(0, 120),
    size: bytes.byteLength,
    type: meta.type,
    kind,
    category: cleanCategory(meta.category),
    note: (meta.note ?? '').slice(0, 600),
    source: meta.source ?? null,
    at: Date.now(),
  }
  await writeFile(path.join(INBOX_DIR, name), bytes)
  await writeFile(path.join(INBOX_DIR, `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(item))
  return item
}

export async function saveToInbox(file: File, note: string, category?: string): Promise<InboxItem> {
  const type = file.type === 'video/x-m4v' ? 'video/mp4' : file.type
  return saveBytes(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()), { type, original: file.name, note, category })
}

export async function updateInbox(name: string, patch: { category?: unknown; note?: unknown }) {
  const item = await readMeta(name)
  if (!item) return null
  const next: InboxItem = {
    ...item,
    category: patch.category !== undefined ? cleanCategory(patch.category) : item.category,
    note: patch.note !== undefined ? String(patch.note).slice(0, 600) : item.note,
  }
  await writeFile(path.join(INBOX_DIR, `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(next))
  return next
}

export async function renameCategory(from: string, to: string) {
  const items = await listInbox()
  const target = cleanCategory(to)
  await Promise.all(items.filter((i) => i.category === from).map((i) => updateInbox(i.name, { category: target })))
}

export async function inboxFilePath(name: string) {
  if (!isInboxName(name)) return null
  const file = path.join(INBOX_DIR, name)
  try {
    const s = await stat(file)
    return { file, size: s.size }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export async function removeFromInbox(name: string) {
  if (!isInboxName(name)) return false
  await rm(path.join(INBOX_DIR, name), { force: true })
  await rm(path.join(INBOX_DIR, `${name}.json`), { force: true })
  return true
}

export async function clearInbox(category?: string) {
  if (!category) {
    await rm(INBOX_DIR, { recursive: true, force: true })
    return
  }
  const items = await listInbox()
  await Promise.all(items.filter((i) => i.category === category).map((i) => removeFromInbox(i.name)))
}

import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'
import { kvGet, kvSet } from './store'
import type { LibraryList, ListStatus } from './library-types'

export type { LibraryList, ListStatus } from './library-types'

const SYSTEM: { status: ListStatus; name: string; hue: number; description: string }[] = [
  { status: 'watching', name: 'İzliyorum', hue: 155, description: 'Şu an devam ettiğin seriler.' },
  { status: 'planning', name: 'İzleyeceğim', hue: 255, description: 'Sıradaki maceraların.' },
  { status: 'completed', name: 'Tamamladım', hue: 80, description: 'Bitirip kalbine gömdüklerin.' },
  { status: 'paused', name: 'Ara verdim', hue: 45, description: 'Bir gün döneceğin seriler.' },
  { status: 'dropped', name: 'Bıraktım', hue: 25, description: 'Yolların ayrıldığı seriler.' },
]

function seed(): LibraryList[] {
  const now = Date.now()
  return SYSTEM.map((s) => ({ id: s.status, name: s.name, description: s.description, hue: s.hue, system: s.status, items: [], isPublic: true, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }))
}

export async function getLists(uid: string): Promise<LibraryList[]> {
  const stored = await kvGet<LibraryList[]>(`lists:${uid}`)
  if (!stored || !stored.length) return seed()
  const missing = seed().filter((s) => !stored.some((l) => l.id === s.id))
  return [...stored.filter((l) => l.system), ...missing, ...stored.filter((l) => !l.system)].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.system && b.system) return SYSTEM.findIndex((s) => s.status === a.system) - SYSTEM.findIndex((s) => s.status === b.system)
    if (a.system) return -1
    if (b.system) return 1
    return a.createdAt - b.createdAt
  })
}

export async function saveLists(uid: string, lists: LibraryList[]) {
  await kvSet(`lists:${uid}`, lists)
}

export function newCustomList(name: string, description: string, hue: number): LibraryList {
  const now = Date.now()
  return { id: randomBytes(6).toString('hex'), name, description, hue, items: [], isPublic: true, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }
}

export function libraryStats(lists: LibraryList[]) {
  const unique = new Set<number>()
  for (const l of lists) for (const i of l.items) unique.add(i.id)
  const by = (s: ListStatus) => lists.find((l) => l.system === s)?.items.length ?? 0
  return {
    total: unique.size,
    watching: by('watching'),
    planning: by('planning'),
    completed: by('completed'),
    custom: lists.filter((l) => !l.system).length,
  }
}

export function statusOf(lists: LibraryList[], animeId: number): ListStatus | null {
  return lists.find((l) => l.system && l.items.some((i) => i.id === animeId))?.system ?? null
}

import 'server-only'

/**
 * Transactional e-mail through Resend's HTTP API (no SDK needed).
 *   RESEND_API_KEY   required to actually deliver mail
 *   MAIL_FROM        optional sender, e.g. "Sytheris <no-reply@alanadin.com>" (domain must be verified in Resend)
 */

export function mailConfigured() {
  return Boolean(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY)
}

export async function sendMail(to: string, subject: string, html: string, text: string) {
  const key = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY
  if (!key) return { ok: false as const, error: 'E-posta servisi yapılandırılmamış.' }
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ from: process.env.MAIL_FROM || 'Sytheris <onboarding@resend.dev>', to: [to], subject, html, text }),
    })
    if (!res.ok) {
      const body = await res.text().catch(() => '')
      console.error('[mailer] resend', res.status, body.slice(0, 300))
      return { ok: false as const, error: 'Doğrulama e-postası gönderilemedi. Birazdan tekrar dene.' }
    }
    return { ok: true as const }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[mailer] failed', (e as Error).message)
    return { ok: false as const, error: 'E-posta servisine ulaşılamadı.' }
  }
}

const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c]!)

export function codeEmail(code: string, purpose: 'login' | 'register' | 'email-change') {
  const lead = { login: 'Hesabına giriş yapmak için', register: 'Sytheris hesabını oluşturmak için', 'email-change': 'Yeni e-posta adresini doğrulamak için' }[purpose]
  const subject = `${code} — Sytheris doğrulama kodun`
  const text = `${lead} bu kodu gir: ${code}\n\nKod 10 dakika geçerlidir. Bu isteği sen yapmadıysan bu e-postayı yok sayabilirsin.`
  const digits = code
    .split('')
    .map((d) => `<td style="width:44px;height:56px;border:1px solid #2a2f2c;border-radius:10px;font:600 28px/56px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:#f2f5f3;text-align:center;background:#141816">${esc(d)}</td>`)
    .join('<td style="width:8px"></td>')
  const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="tr"><body style="margin:0;background:#0b0d0c;padding:32px 16px;font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;color:#f2f5f3">
  <table role="presentation" width="100%" style="max-width:480px;margin:0 auto"><tr><td>
    <p style="margin:0 0 28px;font:700 18px/1 sans-serif;letter-spacing:-0.02em">SYTHERIS</p>
    <h1 style="margin:0 0 12px;font:600 26px/1.2 sans-serif;letter-spacing:-0.02em">Doğrulama kodun</h1>
    <p style="margin:0 0 28px;font:400 15px/1.6 sans-serif;color:#a7b0ab">${esc(lead)} aşağıdaki kodu gir. Kod 10 dakika geçerli.</p>
    <table role="presentation" style="border-collapse:separate;margin:0 0 28px"><tr>${digits}</tr></table>
    <p style="margin:0;font:400 13px/1.6 sans-serif;color:#6f7873">Bu isteği sen yapmadıysan bu e-postayı yok sayabilirsin; hesabında hiçbir değişiklik olmaz.</p>
  </td></tr></table></body></html>`
  return { subject, html, text }
}

import 'server-only'

/**
 * Manga catalog backed by the public MangaDex API (https://api.mangadex.org/docs).
 * No key needed. Every image goes through /api/manga/img so covers and pages load
 * on any origin, and only MangaDex hosts are ever proxied.
 */

const API = 'https://api.mangadex.org'
const HEADERS = { 'User-Agent': 'Sytheris/1.0 (+anime catalog)', Accept: 'application/json' }
const RATINGS = ['safe', 'suggestive']
export const READ_LANGS = ['tr', 'en'] as const
export type ReadLang = (typeof READ_LANGS)[number]

export type MangaStatus = 'ongoing' | 'completed' | 'hiatus' | 'cancelled'

export type MangaCard = {
  id: string
  title: string
  altTitle: string | null
  cover: string | null
  coverHi: string | null
  status: MangaStatus | null
  year: number | null
  demographic: string | null
  tags: string[]
  hasTurkish: boolean
  lastChapter: string | null
}

export type MangaDetail = MangaCard & {
  description: string
  authors: string[]
  artists: string[]
  originalLanguage: string
  anilistId: number | null
  languages: string[]
  rating: number | null
  follows: number | null
}

export type ChapterItem = {
  id: string
  chapter: string | null
  volume: string | null
  title: string | null
  lang: string
  pages: number
  group: string | null
  publishedAt: string
}

type Rel = { id: string; type: string; attributes?: Record<string, unknown> }
type RawManga = {
  id: string
  attributes: {
    title: Record<string, string>
    altTitles: Record<string, string>[]
    description: Record<string, string>
    status: MangaStatus | null
    year: number | null
    publicationDemographic: string | null
    lastChapter: string | null
    originalLanguage: string
    availableTranslatedLanguages: (string | null)[]
    links: Record<string, string> | null
    tags: { attributes: { name: Record<string, string>; group: string } }[]
  }
  relationships: Rel[]
}
