import 'server-only'
import { Pool } from 'pg'
import { promises as fs } from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

type Row = { key: string; value: unknown }

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __syStore?: Map<string, unknown>; __syStoreReady?: Promise<void>; __syTable?: Promise<void> }

const FILE = path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || '/tmp', 'sytheris-store.json')

export function storeBackend(): 'postgres' | 'memory' {
  return process.env.DATABASE_URL ? 'postgres' : 'memory'
}

const gp = globalThis as unknown as { __syPool?: Pool }

/**
 * Created on first use and reused across hot reloads. `allowExitOnIdle` lets build workers and scripts exit
 * instead of hanging on idle connections — one of the reasons `pnpm build` could appear to never finish.
 */
function db() {
  gp.__syPool ??= new Pool({
    connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    ssl: /localhost|127\.0\.0\.1/.test(process.env.DATABASE_URL ?? '') ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false },
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    allowExitOnIdle: true,
  })
  return gp.__syPool
}

async function ensureTable() {
  if (!g.__syTable) {
    g.__syTable = (async () => {
      await db().query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sytheris_kv (
          key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, 
          value JSONB NOT NULL, 
          updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
        )
      `)
    })().catch((e) => {
      g.__syTable = undefined
      throw e
    })
  }
  return g.__syTable
}

async function memory() {
  if (!g.__syStore) {
    g.__syStore = new Map()
    g.__syStoreReady = fs
      .readFile(FILE, 'utf8')
      .then((raw) => {
        const obj = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) g.__syStore!.set(k, v)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }
  await g.__syStoreReady
  return g.__syStore
}

let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
function scheduleFlush(map: Map<string, unknown>) {
  if (flushTimer) clearTimeout(flushTimer)
  flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    fs.writeFile(FILE, JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(map))).catch(() => {})
  }, 150)
}

export async function kvGet<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    const res = await db().query('SELECT value FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key = $1', [key])
    return res.rows[0]?.value ?? null
  }
  const m = await memory()
  return (m.get(key) as T) ?? null
}

export async function kvSet<T>(key: string, value: T) {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    await db().query(
      `INSERT INTO sytheris_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, now())
       ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()`,
      [key, JSON.stringify(value)]
    )
    return
  }
  const m = await memory()
  m.set(key, value)
  scheduleFlush(m)
}

export async function kvDel(key: string) {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    await db().query('DELETE FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key = $1', [key])
    return
  }
  const m = await memory()
  m.delete(key)
  scheduleFlush(m)
}

export async function kvList<T>(prefix: string, limit = 500): Promise<{ key: string; value: T }[]> {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    const like = prefix.replace(/[%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`) + '%'
    const res = await db().query(
      'SELECT key, value FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key LIKE $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT $2',
      [like, limit]
    )
    return res.rows as { key: string; value: T }[]
  }
  const m = await memory()
  const out: { key: string; value: T }[] = []
  for (const [key, value] of m) if (key.startsWith(prefix)) out.push({ key, value: value as T })
  return out.reverse().slice(0, limit)
}

export async function storeHealth() {
  const started = Date.now()
  try {
    if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
      await ensureTable()
      await db().query('SELECT 1')
    } else {
      await memory()
    }
    return { ok: true, ms: Date.now() - started }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, ms: Date.now() - started, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

import 'server-only'
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
import { safeFetch } from '@/lib/safe-url'

const UA =
  'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'

const REFERERS: Record<string, string> = {
  animepahe: 'https://animepahe.ru',
  kwik: 'https://kwik.cx',
  hianime: 'https://hianime.to',
  zoro: 'https://hianime.to',
  gogoanime: 'https://gogoanime3.co',
  animekai: 'https://animekai.to',
  anify: 'https://anify.tv',
}

const EXT_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
  ts: 'video/mp2t',
  m4s: 'video/iso.segment',
  mp4: 'video/mp4',
  m4v: 'video/mp4',
  webm: 'video/webm',
  aac: 'audio/aac',
  m4a: 'audio/mp4',
  vtt: 'text/vtt',
}

function decodeTarget(sp: URLSearchParams): string {
  const plain = sp.get('url')
  if (plain) return plain
  const b64 = sp.get('u')
  if (!b64) return ''
  try {
    return Buffer.from(b64, 'base64url').toString('utf8')
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

function pickReferer(target: string, given: string | null): string {
  if (given && /^https?:\/\/[^\s/]+/.test(given) && given.length < 300) {
    try {
      return new URL(given).toString()
    } catch {}
  }
  try {
    const host = new URL(target).hostname
    for (const [needle, ref] of Object.entries(REFERERS)) {
      if (host.includes(needle)) return ref
    }
    return new URL(target).origin
  } catch {
    return 'https://animepahe.ru'
  }
}

function wrap(url: string, ref: string): string {
  return `/api/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&referer=${encodeURIComponent(ref)}`
}

function rewritePlaylist(text: string, base: string, ref: string): string {
  const abs = (u: string): string => {
    try {
      return new URL(u, base).toString()
    } catch {
      return u
    }
  }

  return text
    .split('\n')
    .map((line) => {
      const t = line.trim()
      if (!t) return line
      if (t.startsWith('#')) {
        return line.replace(/URI="([^"]+)"/g, (_m, u: string) => `URI="${wrap(abs(u), ref)}"`)
      }
      return wrap(abs(t), ref)
    })
    .join('\n')
}

function typeFor(target: string, upstream: string | null): string {
  const fromUpstream = (upstream ?? '').split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase()
  if (fromUpstream && !fromUpstream.startsWith('text/plain') && fromUpstream !== 'application/octet-stream') {
    return fromUpstream
  }
  const ext = (target.split('?')[0].split('#')[0].split('.').pop() ?? '').toLowerCase()
  return EXT_TYPES[ext] ?? (fromUpstream || 'application/octet-stream')
}

export async function handle(req: Request, method: 'GET' | 'HEAD'): Promise<Response> {
  // HLS fetches many small segments, so the budget is generous; it only stops bulk abuse of the relay.
  const wait = rateLimit('stream-proxy', clientIp(req.headers), 1500, 60_000)
  if (wait) return tooMany(wait)

  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url)
  const target = decodeTarget(searchParams).trim()

  if (target.length > 4096 || !/^https?:\/\//i.test(target)) {
    return new Response('Geçersiz ya da eksik url parametresi.', { status: 400 })
  }

  let parsed: URL
  try {
    parsed = new URL(target)
  } catch {
    return new Response('Çözümlenemeyen url.', { status: 400 })
  }
  const ref = pickReferer(target, searchParams.get('referer') ?? searchParams.get('r'))

  const forward: Record<string, string> = {
    'User-Agent': UA,
    Accept: '*/*',
    'Accept-Language': 'tr,en;q=0.9',
    Referer: ref,
    Origin: new URL(ref).origin,
  }
  const range = req.headers.get('range')
  if (range) forward.Range = range
  const ifRange = req.headers.get('if-range')
  if (ifRange) forward['If-Range'] = ifRange

  let upstream: Response
  try {
    const res = await safeFetch(target, {
      method,
      headers: forward,
      cache: 'no-store',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(45_000),
    })
    if (!res) return new Response('Bu adres proxy üzerinden okunamaz.', { status: 400 })
    upstream = res
  } catch {
    return new Response('Kaynağa ulaşılamadı.', { status: 502 })
  }

  if (!upstream.ok && upstream.status !== 206) {
    return new Response(`Kaynak ${upstream.status} döndü.`, {
      status: upstream.status,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' },
    })
  }

  const contentType = upstream.headers.get('content-type') ?? ''
  const isPlaylist =
    contentType.includes('mpegurl') ||
    /\.m3u8(\?|#|$)/i.test(target) ||
    (parsed.pathname.endsWith('/') && contentType.includes('text'))

  if (isPlaylist) {
    const text = await upstream.text()
    if (!text.includes('#EXTM3U')) {
      return new Response(text, {
        status: upstream.status,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': contentType || 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' },
      })
    }
    return new Response(rewritePlaylist(text, target, ref), {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl',
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=5, stale-while-revalidate=30',
      },
    })
  }

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Content-Type': typeFor(target, contentType),
    'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes',
    'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400, immutable',
  }
  const contentRange = upstream.headers.get('content-range')
  if (contentRange) headers['Content-Range'] = contentRange
  const etag = upstream.headers.get('etag')
  if (etag) headers.ETag = etag

  if (method === 'HEAD' || !upstream.body) {
    const len = upstream.headers.get('content-length')
    if (len && !contentRange) headers['Content-Length'] = len
    return new Response(null, { status: upstream.status, headers })
  }

  // Gövde olduğu gibi akıtılır; metne çevrilmez.
  return new Response(upstream.body, { status: upstream.status, headers })
}

function assTime(t: string) {
  const [h, m, s] = t.trim().split(':')
  const [sec, cs = '0'] = s.split('.')
  return `${h.padStart(2, '0')}:${m.padStart(2, '0')}:${sec.padStart(2, '0')}.${cs.padEnd(3, '0').slice(0, 3)}`
}

function assToVtt(input: string) {
  const lines = input.split(/\r?\n/)
  let format: string[] = []
  const cues: string[] = []
  let inEvents = false
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (/^\[events\]/i.test(line.trim())) {
      inEvents = true
      continue
    }
    if (/^\[.*\]$/.test(line.trim())) {
      inEvents = false
      continue
    }
    if (!inEvents) continue
    if (line.startsWith('Format:')) format = line.slice(7).split(',').map((f) => f.trim().toLowerCase())
    if (line.startsWith('Dialogue:')) {
      const parts = line.slice(9).split(',')
      const textIndex = format.indexOf('text')
      const start = parts[format.indexOf('start')]
      const end = parts[format.indexOf('end')]
      if (!start || !end || textIndex < 0) continue
      const text = parts
        .slice(textIndex)
        .join(',')
        .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
        .replace(/\\N/gi, '\n')
        .trim()
      if (text) cues.push(`${assTime(start)} --> ${assTime(end)}\n${text}`)
    }
  }
  return `WEBVTT\n\n${cues.join('\n\n')}\n`
}

export function toVtt(input: string) {
  const text = input.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim()
  if (text.startsWith('WEBVTT')) return text + '\n'
  if (/^\[script info\]/i.test(text) || text.includes('Dialogue:')) return assToVtt(text)
  const body = text
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2')
    .replace(/(\d{1,2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2')
  return `WEBVTT\n\n${body}\n`
}

  ['mystery', ['Mystery', 'Psychological', 'Thriller']],
  ['romance', ['Romance', 'Mahou Shoujo']],
  ['comedy', ['Comedy', 'Slice of Life']],
  ['fantasy', ['Fantasy', 'Adventure']],
  ['supernatural', ['Supernatural']],
  ['action', ['Action']],
]

const COMBOS: [TitleStyle, string[]][] = [
  ['shounen', ['Action', 'Comedy']],
  ['brush', ['Action', 'Supernatural']],
]

const TAG_HINTS: [TitleStyle, string[]][] = [
  ['brush', ['Samurai', 'Demons', 'Curses', 'Swordplay', 'Ninja', 'Yokai']],
  ['scifi', ['Cyberpunk', 'Space', 'Virtual World', 'Super Robot', 'Real Robot']],
  ['horror', ['Gore', 'Vampire', 'Zombie']],
  ['fantasy', ['Isekai', 'Magic', 'Dragons', 'Kingdom Management', 'Mythology']],
  ['comedy', ['Iyashikei', 'Parody', 'Cute Girls Doing Cute Things']],
]

export function titleStyleFor(genres: string[] = [], tags: string[] = []): TitleStyle {
  const topTags = tags.slice(0, 5)
  for (const [style, hints] of TAG_HINTS) if (topTags.some((t) => hints.includes(t))) return style
  for (const [style, list] of COMBOS) if (list.every((g) => genres.includes(g)) && !genres.includes('Horror')) return style
  for (const [style, list] of ORDER) if (genres.some((g) => list.includes(g))) return style
  return 'classic'
}

import 'server-only'

export const SYNOPSIS_LANGS = [
  { id: 'tr', label: 'Türkçe', short: 'TR' },
  { id: 'en', label: 'English', short: 'EN' },
  { id: 'ja', label: '日本語', short: 'JA' },
  { id: 'de', label: 'Deutsch', short: 'DE' },
  { id: 'fr', label: 'Français', short: 'FR' },
  { id: 'es', label: 'Español', short: 'ES' },
  { id: 'ru', label: 'Русский', short: 'RU' },
  { id: 'ar', label: 'العربية', short: 'AR' },
  { id: 'ko', label: '한국어', short: 'KO' },
  { id: 'az', label: 'Azərbaycanca', short: 'AZ' },
] as const

export type SynopsisLang = (typeof SYNOPSIS_LANGS)[number]['id']

export function isSynopsisLang(v: string): v is SynopsisLang {
  return SYNOPSIS_LANGS.some((l) => l.id === v)
}

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __syTr?: Map<string, string> }
const memo = (g.__syTr ??= new Map())

function chunks(text: string, size = 1500) {
  const out: string[] = []
  let buf = ''
  for (const part of text.split(/(\n+)/)) {
    if ((buf + part).length > size && buf) {
      out.push(buf)
      buf = ''
    }
    buf += part
  }
  if (buf) out.push(buf)
  return out
}

async function google(text: string, to: string) {
  const url = `https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl=auto&tl=${to}&dt=t&q=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`
  const res = await fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 }, headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0' } })
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`google ${res.status}`)
  const json = (await res.json()) as [[string, string][]]
  return json[0].map((s) => s[0]).join('')
}

async function myMemory(text: string, to: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get?q=${encodeURIComponent(text.slice(0, 480))}&langpair=en|${to}`, {
    next: { revalidate: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 },
  })
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`mymemory ${res.status}`)
  const json = (await res.json()) as { responseData?: { translatedText?: string } }
  if (!json.responseData?.translatedText) throw new Error('mymemory empty')
  return json.responseData.translatedText
}

/** Translates plain text with keyless public endpoints; returns null when every provider fails. */
export async function translate(text: string, to: SynopsisLang): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!text.trim()) return ''
  const key = `${to}:${text.length}:${text.slice(0, 64)}`
  const hit = memo.get(key)
  if (hit) return hit
  try {
    const parts = await Promise.all(chunks(text).map((c) => google(c, to)))
    const result = parts.join('')
    memo.set(key, result)
    return result
  } catch {
    try {
      const result = await myMemory(text, to)
      memo.set(key, result)
      return result
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }
}

'use client'

import { useScroll, useTransform, type MotionValue } from 'motion/react'
import type { RefObject } from 'react'

type Offset = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof useScroll>[0]>['offset']

/**
 * Scroll progress of a section, 0 → 1.
 *
 * Motion 14 hands `useTransform(scrollYProgress, [...], [...])` straight to a native ViewTimeline animation
 * when the value drives opacity/filter/transform. For tall sticky sections that timeline's range is computed
 * wrong, so layers meant to fade in at the end (the welcome film's white-out) sat fully opaque from the start
 * and covered the whole intro. Passing the value through a function transform keeps it on the JS path,
 * which is exact and still runs every frame.
 */
export function useSectionProgress(target: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, offset: Offset): MotionValue<number> {
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({ target, offset })
  return useTransform(scrollYProgress, (v) => v)
}

import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes, scrypt as _scrypt, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'
import { promisify } from 'util'

import { getSession } from './session'
import { activeTier, sortBadges, type BadgeId, type BannerOverlay, type BannerPreset, type CommentColor, type FrameId, type NameStyle, type Nameplate, type Premium, type ProfileEffect, type Role } from './membership'

const scrypt = promisify(_scrypt) as (pw: string, salt: string, len: number) => Promise<Buffer>

export type Provider = 'discord' | 'google' | 'github' | 'email'

export type ProfileLink = { type: string; url: string }
export type ProfileSong = { title: string; artist: string; url: string; cover?: string | null } | null
export type LoginEvent = { at: number; device: string; ip: string; method: Provider }
export type Security = { logins: LoginEvent[]; passwordChangedAt?: number; emailChangedAt?: number; revokedAt?: number }

export type User = {
  id: string
  username: string
  displayName: string
  email?: string | null
  avatar?: string | null
  provider: Provider
  providerId: string
  createdAt: number

  location: string
  background?: string | null
  backgroundDim: number
  accent: string
  links: ProfileLink[]
  song: ProfileSong
  favorites: number[]
  views: number
  effects: { tilt: boolean; typewriter: boolean; glow: boolean }
  banned?: boolean
  banReason?: string | null
  role?: Role
  premium?: Premium
  badges?: BadgeId[]
  frame?: FrameId
  bannerPreset?: BannerPreset
  bannerOverlay?: BannerOverlay
  profileEffect?: ProfileEffect
  nameStyle?: NameStyle
  commentColor?: CommentColor
  nameplate?: Nameplate

  /** Bumping this invalidates every session cookie issued before. */
  sessionVersion?: number
  /** E-mail that can be used with a password, also for OAuth accounts that linked one. */

  customThemes?: { id: string; name: string; hex: string }[]
}

export type PublicUser = Omit<User, 'email' | 'providerId' | 'loginEmail' | 'security' | 'sessionVersion'>

export function toPublic(u: User): PublicUser {
  const { email: _e, providerId: _p, loginEmail: _l, security: _s, sessionVersion: _v, ...rest } = u
  return rest
}

/** Badges a user displays: manually awarded ones plus the automatic ones they currently qualify for. */
export function computeBadges(
  u: Pick<User, 'badges' | 'role' | 'premium'> & Partial<Pick<User, 'favorites' | 'createdAt' | 'song' | 'emailVerified'>>,
  extra: { libraryCount?: number; customLists?: number; comments?: number } = {},
): BadgeId[] {
  const set = new Set<BadgeId>(u.badges ?? [])
  if (u.role === 'moderator' || u.role === 'admin') set.add('moderator')
  if (u.emailVerified) set.add('verified')
  const tier = activeTier(u.premium)
  if (tier === 'plus') set.add('plus')
  if (tier === 'ultra') set.add('ultra')
  if ((extra.libraryCount ?? 0) >= 50) set.add('otaku')
  if ((extra.customLists ?? 0) >= 5) set.add('collector')
  if ((extra.comments ?? 0) >= 10) set.add('critic')
  if ((extra.comments ?? 0) >= 1) set.add('firstStep')
  if ((extra.libraryCount ?? 0) >= 100) set.add('marathon')
  if ((u.favorites?.length ?? 0) >= 10) set.add('curator')
  if (u.createdAt && Date.now() - u.createdAt >= 365 * 86400_000) set.add('veteran')
  if (u.song) set.add('bard')
  return sortBadges([...set])
}

function slugify(s: string) {
  return (
    s
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFKD')
      .replace(/[ıİ]/g, 'i')
      .replace(/[şŞ]/g, 's')
      .replace(/[ğĞ]/g, 'g')
      .replace(/[üÜ]/g, 'u')
      .replace(/[öÖ]/g, 'o')
      .replace(/[çÇ]/g, 'c')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9_.]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 20) || 'kullanici'
  )
}

export const RESERVED = new Set(['admin', 'api', 'giris', 'profil', 'sytheris', 'root', 'moderator', 'support'])

export async function uniqueUsername(base: string) {
  let name = slugify(base)
  if (RESERVED.has(name)) name = `${name}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 999)}`
  let candidate = name
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const taken = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${candidate}`)
    if (!taken) return candidate
    candidate = `${name}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 9999)}`
  }
  return `${name}${randomBytes(3).toString('hex')}`
}

function newUser(p: { provider: Provider; providerId: string; name: string; username: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }): User {
  return {
    id: randomBytes(12).toString('hex'),
    username: p.username,
    displayName: p.name.slice(0, 40),
    email: p.email ?? null,
    avatar: p.avatar ?? null,
    provider: p.provider,
    providerId: p.providerId,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    bio: 'Sytheris üzerinde anime keşfediyorum.',
    location: '',
    background: null,
    backgroundDim: 55,
    accent: 'green',
    links: [],
    song: null,
    favorites: [],
    views: 0,
    effects: { tilt: true, typewriter: true, glow: true },
    role: 'user',
    premium: null,
    badges: [],
    frame: 'none',
    bannerPreset: 'none',
  }
}

async function stampEarly(u: User) {
  const n = ((await kvGet<number>('user-count')) ?? 0) + 1
  await kvSet('user-count', n)
  if (n <= 1000) u.badges = [...(u.badges ?? []), 'early']
}

export async function getUser(id: string) {
  return kvGet<User>(`user:${id}`)
}

export async function saveUser(u: User) {
  await kvSet(`user:${u.id}`, u)
}

export async function getUserByUsername(username: string) {
  const id = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${username.toLowerCase()}`)
  return id ? getUser(id) : null
}

export async function getCurrentUser() {
  try {
    const session = await getSession()
    if (!session) return null
    const u = await getUser(session.uid)
    if (!u || u.banned) return null
    if ((session.sv ?? 0) !== (u.sessionVersion ?? 0)) return null
    return u
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export async function upsertOAuthUser(p: { provider: Exclude<Provider, 'email'>; providerId: string; name: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }) {
  const linkKey = `oauth:${p.provider}:${p.providerId}`
  const existingId = await kvGet<string>(linkKey)
  if (existingId) {
    const u = await getUser(existingId)
    if (u) {
      u.avatar = u.avatar && !u.avatar.includes('cdn.discordapp') && !u.avatar.includes('googleusercontent') && !u.avatar.includes('githubusercontent') ? u.avatar : (p.avatar ?? u.avatar)
      await saveUser(u)
      return u
    }
  }
  const username = await uniqueUsername(p.name)
  const u = newUser({ ...p, username })
  await kvSet(`uname:${username}`, u.id)
  await kvSet(linkKey, u.id)
  await stampEarly(u)
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function hashPassword(password: string) {
  return hash(password)
}

async function hash(password: string) {
  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex')
  const key = await scrypt(password, salt, 64)
  return `${salt}:${key.toString('hex')}`
}

async function check(password: string, stored: string) {
  const [salt, key] = stored.split(':')
  if (!salt || !key) return false
  const derived = await scrypt(password, salt, 64)
  const a = Buffer.from(key, 'hex')
  return a.length === derived.length && timingSafeEqual(a, derived)
}

export async function emailTaken(email: string) {
  return Boolean(await kvGet(`email:${email.trim().toLowerCase()}`))
}

/** `password` may be a plain password or, for code-verified sign-ups, an already computed `{ hash }`. */
export async function registerEmail(email: string, password: string | { hash: string }, name: string, verified = false) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (await kvGet(`email:${normalized}`)) throw new Error('Bu e-posta ile zaten bir hesap var.')
  const username = await uniqueUsername(name || normalized.split('@')[0])
  const u = newUser({ provider: 'email', providerId: normalized, name: name || username, username, email: normalized })
  if (verified) {
    u.emailVerified = true
    u.emailVerifiedAt = Date.now()
  }
  await kvSet(`email:${normalized}`, { id: u.id, hash: typeof password === 'string' ? await hash(password) : password.hash })
  await kvSet(`uname:${username}`, u.id)
  await stampEarly(u)
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function loginEmail(email: string, password: string) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  const rec = await kvGet<{ id: string; hash: string }>(`email:${normalized}`)
  if (!rec || !(await check(password, rec.hash))) throw new Error('E-posta veya şifre hatalı.')
  const u = await getUser(rec.id)
  if (!u) throw new Error('Hesap bulunamadı.')
  if (u.banned) throw new Error('Bu hesap askıya alınmış.')
  return u
}

export async function changeUsername(u: User, next: string) {
  const name = slugify(next)
  if (name.length < 3) throw new Error('Kullanıcı adı en az 3 karakter olmalı.')
  if (RESERVED.has(name)) throw new Error('Bu kullanıcı adı ayrılmış.')
  if (name === u.username) return u
  const taken = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${name}`)
  if (taken && taken !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu kullanıcı adı alınmış.')
  await kvSet(`uname:${name}`, u.id)
  const { kvDel } = await import('./store')
  await kvDel(`uname:${u.username}`)
  u.username = name
  return u
}

export async function listUsers() {
  const rows = await kvList<User>('user:', 500)
  return rows.map((r) => r.value).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

// ---------- Account security ----------

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

export function passwordEmailOf(u: User) {
  return u.loginEmail ?? (u.provider === 'email' ? u.providerId : null)
}

export function describeDevice(ua: string) {
  const browser = /Edg\//.test(ua) ? 'Edge' : /OPR\//.test(ua) ? 'Opera' : /Firefox\//.test(ua) ? 'Firefox' : /Chrome\//.test(ua) ? 'Chrome' : /Safari\//.test(ua) ? 'Safari' : 'Tarayıcı'
  const os = /iPhone|iPad/.test(ua) ? 'iOS' : /Android/.test(ua) ? 'Android' : /Windows/.test(ua) ? 'Windows' : /Mac OS X/.test(ua) ? 'macOS' : /Linux/.test(ua) ? 'Linux' : 'Bilinmeyen cihaz'
  return `${browser} · ${os}`
}

function maskIp(ip: string) {
  if (!ip || ip === 'local') return 'Yerel ağ'
  if (ip.includes(':')) return `${ip.split(':').slice(0, 3).join(':')}:••••`
  const parts = ip.split('.')
  return parts.length === 4 ? `${parts[0]}.${parts[1]}.•••.•••` : ip
}

export async function recordLogin(u: User, request: Request, method: Provider) {
  const ua = request.headers.get('user-agent') ?? ''
  const ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || 'local'
  const security: Security = u.security ?? { logins: [] }
  security.logins = [{ at: Date.now(), device: describeDevice(ua), ip: maskIp(ip), method }, ...(security.logins ?? [])].slice(0, 8)
  u.security = security
  u.lastSeen = Date.now()
  await saveUser(u)
}

async function requirePassword(u: User, password: string) {
  const email = passwordEmailOf(u)
  if (!email) throw new Error('Bu hesapta şifre tanımlı değil.')
  const rec = await kvGet<{ id: string; hash: string }>(`email:${email}`)
  if (!rec || rec.id !== u.id || !(await check(password, rec.hash))) throw new Error('Mevcut şifre hatalı.')
  return rec
}

export function validatePassword(pw: string) {
  if (pw.length < 8) return 'Şifre en az 8 karakter olmalı.'
  if (pw.length > 128) return 'Şifre en fazla 128 karakter olabilir.'
  if (!/[a-zçğıöşü]/i.test(pw) || !/[0-9]/.test(pw)) return 'Şifre en az bir harf ve bir rakam içermeli.'
  return null
}

export async function changePassword(u: User, current: string, next: string) {
  const err = validatePassword(next)
  if (err) throw new Error(err)
  if (current === next) throw new Error('Yeni şifre mevcut şifreden farklı olmalı.')
  await requirePassword(u, current)
  const email = passwordEmailOf(u)!
  await kvSet(`email:${email}`, { id: u.id, hash: await hash(next) })
  u.security = { ...(u.security ?? { logins: [] }), passwordChangedAt: Date.now() }
  u.sessionVersion = (u.sessionVersion ?? 0) + 1
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

/** Validates an e-mail change (format, availability, current password) without applying it. */
export async function prepareEmailChange(u: User, nextEmail: string, password: string) {
  const normalized = nextEmail.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!EMAIL_RE.test(normalized) || normalized.length > 120) throw new Error('Geçerli bir e-posta gir.')
  const current = passwordEmailOf(u)
  if (current === normalized) throw new Error('Bu zaten hesabının e-postası.')
  const taken = await kvGet<{ id: string }>(`email:${normalized}`)
  if (taken && taken.id !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu e-posta başka bir hesapta kullanılıyor.')
  await requirePassword(u, password)
  return normalized
}

/** Applies an e-mail change that was already validated and proven with a code sent to the new address. */
export async function commitEmailChange(u: User, normalized: string) {
  const current = passwordEmailOf(u)
  if (current === normalized) return u
  const taken = await kvGet<{ id: string }>(`email:${normalized}`)
  if (taken && taken.id !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu e-posta başka bir hesapta kullanılıyor.')
  const rec = current ? await kvGet<{ id: string; hash: string }>(`email:${current}`) : null
  if (!rec || rec.id !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu hesapta şifre tanımlı değil.')
  await kvSet(`email:${normalized}`, rec)
  if (current) await kvDel(`email:${current}`)
  if (u.provider === 'email') u.providerId = normalized
  else u.loginEmail = normalized
  u.email = normalized
  u.emailVerified = true
  u.emailVerifiedAt = Date.now()
  u.security = { ...(u.security ?? { logins: [] }), emailChangedAt: Date.now() }
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function changeLoginEmail(u: User, nextEmail: string, password: string) {
  const normalized = nextEmail.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!EMAIL_RE.test(normalized) || normalized.length > 120) throw new Error('Geçerli bir e-posta gir.')
  const current = passwordEmailOf(u)
  if (current === normalized) throw new Error('Bu zaten hesabının e-postası.')
  const taken = await kvGet<{ id: string }>(`email:${normalized}`)
  if (taken && taken.id !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu e-posta başka bir hesapta kullanılıyor.')
  const rec = await requirePassword(u, password)
  await kvSet(`email:${normalized}`, rec)
  if (current) await kvDel(`email:${current}`)
  if (u.provider === 'email') u.providerId = normalized
  else u.loginEmail = normalized
  u.email = normalized
  u.security = { ...(u.security ?? { logins: [] }), emailChangedAt: Date.now() }
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function addPasswordLogin(u: User, email: string, password: string) {
  if (passwordEmailOf(u)) throw new Error('Bu hesapta zaten e-posta ile giriş var.')
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!EMAIL_RE.test(normalized) || normalized.length > 120) throw new Error('Geçerli bir e-posta gir.')
  const err = validatePassword(password)
  if (err) throw new Error(err)
  if (await kvGet(`email:${normalized}`)) throw new Error('Bu e-posta başka bir hesapta kullanılıyor.')
  await kvSet(`email:${normalized}`, { id: u.id, hash: await hash(password) })
  u.loginEmail = normalized
  u.email = u.email ?? normalized
  u.security = { ...(u.security ?? { logins: [] }), passwordChangedAt: Date.now() }
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function revokeSessions(u: User) {
  u.sessionVersion = (u.sessionVersion ?? 0) + 1
  u.security = { ...(u.security ?? { logins: [] }), revokedAt: Date.now() }
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function deleteAccount(u: User) {
  const email = passwordEmailOf(u)
  await Promise.all([
    kvDel(`user:${u.id}`),
    kvDel(`uname:${u.username}`),
    email ? kvDel(`email:${email}`) : Promise.resolve(),
    u.provider !== 'email' ? kvDel(`oauth:${u.provider}:${u.providerId}`) : Promise.resolve(),
  ])
}

import 'server-only'
import { createHmac, randomInt, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'
import { kvDel, kvGet, kvSet } from './store'
import { secret } from './session'
import { codeEmail, mailConfigured, sendMail } from './mailer'

/**
 * Six-digit e-mail verification codes. Only an HMAC of the code is stored, it expires after
 * 10 minutes, allows 5 attempts, and a new code can be requested once a minute.
 */

export type CodePurpose = 'login' | 'register' | 'email-change'
type Stored<P> = { hash: string; exp: number; tries: number; sentAt: number; payload: P }

const TTL = 10 * 60_000
const RESEND_AFTER = 60_000
const MAX_TRIES = 5

const keyOf = (purpose: CodePurpose, email: string) => `vcode:${purpose}:${email.trim().toLowerCase()}`
const digest = (code: string, email: string) => createHmac('sha256', `${secret()}|vcode`).update(`${email}|${code}`).digest('hex')

export function maskEmail(email: string) {
  const [name, domain] = email.split('@')
  if (!domain) return email
  return `${name.slice(0, 2)}${'•'.repeat(Math.max(1, name.length - 2))}@${domain}`
}

/**
 * Creates and e-mails a code. Without a mail provider the code is returned as `devCode` outside production
 * so the flow stays testable in previews; in production `skipped` tells the caller to fall back gracefully.
 */
export async function issueCode<P>(purpose: CodePurpose, email: string, payload: P) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!mailConfigured() && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') return { ok: true as const, skipped: true as const, masked: maskEmail(normalized) }
  const key = keyOf(purpose, normalized)
  const existing = await kvGet<Stored<P>>(key)
  if (existing && Date.now() - existing.sentAt < RESEND_AFTER) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: `Yeni kod için ${Math.ceil((RESEND_AFTER - (Date.now() - existing.sentAt)) / 1000)} saniye bekle.` }
  }
  const code = String(randomInt(0, 1_000_000)).padStart(6, '0')
  await kvSet<Stored<P>>(key, { hash: digest(code, normalized), exp: Date.now() + TTL, tries: 0, sentAt: Date.now(), payload })

  if (!mailConfigured()) return { ok: true as const, devCode: code, masked: maskEmail(normalized) }
  const mail = codeEmail(code, purpose)
  const sent = await sendMail(normalized, mail.subject, mail.html, mail.text)
  if (!sent.ok) {
    await kvDel(key)
    return { ok: false as const, error: sent.error }
  }
  return { ok: true as const, masked: maskEmail(normalized) }
}

/** Returns the payload stored with the code when it matches; the code is single-use. */
export async function consumeCode<P>(purpose: CodePurpose, email: string, code: string) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  const key = keyOf(purpose, normalized)
  const stored = await kvGet<Stored<P>>(key)
  if (!stored || Date.now() > stored.exp) {
    if (stored) await kvDel(key)
    return { ok: false as const, error: 'Kodun süresi doldu. Yeni bir kod iste.' }
  }
  if (stored.tries >= MAX_TRIES) {
    await kvDel(key)
    return { ok: false as const, error: 'Çok fazla hatalı deneme. Yeni bir kod iste.' }
  }
  const clean = code.replace(/\D/g, '')
  const a = Buffer.from(digest(clean, normalized), 'hex')
  const b = Buffer.from(stored.hash, 'hex')
  if (clean.length !== 6 || a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
    await kvSet<Stored<P>>(key, { ...stored, tries: stored.tries + 1 })
    const left = MAX_TRIES - stored.tries - 1
    return { ok: false as const, error: left > 0 ? `Kod hatalı. ${left} deneme hakkın kaldı.` : 'Kod hatalı. Yeni bir kod iste.' }
  }
  await kvDel(key)
  return { ok: true as const, payload: stored.payload }
}

/** Lets the "Kodu tekrar gönder" button re-send for the same pending request. */
export async function reissueCode<P>(purpose: CodePurpose, email: string) {
  const stored = await kvGet<Stored<P>>(keyOf(purpose, email))
  if (!stored) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Bekleyen bir doğrulama yok. Baştan başla.' }
  if (Date.now() - stored.sentAt < RESEND_AFTER) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: `Yeni kod için ${Math.ceil((RESEND_AFTER - (Date.now() - stored.sentAt)) / 1000)} saniye bekle.` }
  }
  await kvDel(keyOf(purpose, email))
  return issueCode<P>(purpose, email, stored.payload)
}

import 'server-only'
import { cache } from 'react'
import { getCommentCount } from './community'
import { getLists, libraryStats } from './library'
import { activeTier, resolveBannerOverlay, resolveFrame, resolveNameplate } from './membership'
import { computeBadges, getCurrentUser } from './users'
import type { HeaderUser } from './viewer-types'

export const getViewer = cache(async () => {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) return null
  const [lists, comments] = await Promise.all([getLists(user.id).catch(() => []), getCommentCount(user.id).catch(() => 0)])
  const stats = libraryStats(lists)
  const header: HeaderUser = {
    username: user.username,
    displayName: user.displayName,
    avatar: user.avatar,
    background: user.background,
    bannerPreset: user.bannerPreset ?? 'none',
    bannerOverlay: resolveBannerOverlay(user),
    profileEffect: user.profileEffect ?? 'none',
    nameStyle: user.nameStyle ?? 'default',
    commentColor: user.commentColor ?? 'default',
    nameplate: resolveNameplate(user.nameplate),
    frame: resolveFrame(user.frame),
    tier: activeTier(user.premium),
    premiumUntil: user.premium?.until ?? null,
    role: user.role ?? 'user',
    badges: computeBadges(user, { libraryCount: stats.total, customLists: stats.custom, comments }),
    memberSince: user.createdAt,
    bio: user.bio,
    stats: {
      favorites: user.favorites.length,
      library: stats.total,
      watching: stats.watching,
      completed: stats.completed,
      planning: stats.planning,
      lists: lists.length,
      comments,
    },
  }
  return { user, lists, header }
})

/**
 * Çizim Atölyesi — pixel engine. Pure canvas helpers with no React,
 * so the editor component only orchestrates state.
 */

export type ToolId = 'brush' | 'pencil' | 'airbrush' | 'ink' | 'marker' | 'eraser' | 'fill' | 'picker' | 'line' | 'rect' | 'ellipse' | 'pan'

export type BlendMode = 'source-over' | 'multiply' | 'screen' | 'overlay' | 'darken' | 'lighten' | 'color-dodge' | 'color-burn' | 'soft-light' | 'hard-light' | 'difference'

export const BLEND_MODES: { id: BlendMode; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'source-over', label: 'Normal' },
  { id: 'multiply', label: 'Çarp' },
  { id: 'screen', label: 'Ekran' },
  { id: 'overlay', label: 'Kaplama' },
  { id: 'soft-light', label: 'Yumuşak ışık' },
  { id: 'hard-light', label: 'Sert ışık' },
  { id: 'darken', label: 'Koyulaştır' },
  { id: 'lighten', label: 'Açıklaştır' },
  { id: 'color-dodge', label: 'Renk soldur' },
  { id: 'color-burn', label: 'Renk yak' },
  { id: 'difference', label: 'Fark' },
]

export type BrushPreset = {
  /** 0 → feathered, 1 → crisp edge */
  hardness: number
  /** Distance between dabs as a fraction of the brush diameter */
  spacing: number
  /** Per-dab alpha; accumulates within a stroke, capped by the stroke opacity */
  flow: number
  /** How strongly pen pressure scales size (0 = ignore) */
  pressureSize: number
  /** How strongly pen pressure scales flow */
  pressureFlow: number
  /** Taper the start of a stroke (ink pens) */
  taper?: boolean
  /** Flat chisel tip for markers */
  chisel?: boolean
}

export const PRESETS: Record<Extract<ToolId, 'brush' | 'pencil' | 'airbrush' | 'ink' | 'marker' | 'eraser'>, BrushPreset> = {
  brush: { hardness: 0.65, spacing: 0.08, flow: 0.9, pressureSize: 0.75, pressureFlow: 0.3 },
  pencil: { hardness: 1, spacing: 0.05, flow: 1, pressureSize: 0.25, pressureFlow: 0.6 },
  airbrush: { hardness: 0, spacing: 0.04, flow: 0.06, pressureSize: 0.2, pressureFlow: 0.9 },
  ink: { hardness: 0.95, spacing: 0.04, flow: 1, pressureSize: 1, pressureFlow: 0, taper: true },
  marker: { hardness: 0.85, spacing: 0.06, flow: 0.5, pressureSize: 0.1, pressureFlow: 0.2, chisel: true },
  eraser: { hardness: 0.8, spacing: 0.06, flow: 1, pressureSize: 0.6, pressureFlow: 0.2 },
}

export function createCanvas(w: number, h: number) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas')
  c.width = w
  c.height = h
  return c
}

export function ctx2d(c: HTMLCanvasElement) {
  return c.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: false })!
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Colour */

export function hexToRgb(hex: string): [number, number, number] {
  const h = hex.replace('#', '')
  const full = h.length === 3 ? h.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('') : h.padEnd(6, '0').slice(0, 6)
  const n = parseInt(full, 16)
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]
}

export function rgbToHex(r: number, g: number, b: number) {
  return `#${[r, g, b].map((v) => Math.round(Math.min(255, Math.max(0, v))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`
}

export function hsvToHex(h: number, s: number, v: number) {
  const f = (n: number) => {
    const k = (n + h / 60) % 6
    return v - v * s * Math.max(0, Math.min(k, 4 - k, 1))
  }
  return rgbToHex(f(5) * 255, f(3) * 255, f(1) * 255)
}

export function hexToHsv(hex: string): [number, number, number] {
  const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(hex).map((v) => v / 255)
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b)
  const min = Math.min(r, g, b)
  const d = max - min
  let h = 0
  if (d) {
    if (max === r) h = ((g - b) / d) % 6
    else if (max === g) h = (b - r) / d + 2
    else h = (r - g) / d + 4
    h *= 60
    if (h < 0) h += 360
  }
  return [h, max ? d / max : 0, max]
}

export function isHex(s: string) {
  return /^#?[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(s.trim())
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Dabs */

const dabCache = new Map<string, HTMLCanvasElement>()

/** A pre-rendered round (or chisel) brush tip. Cached per size/hardness/colour. */
function dabFor(diameter: number, hardness: number, color: string, chisel: boolean) {
  const size = Math.max(1, Math.round(diameter))
  const key = `${size}|${hardness.toFixed(2)}|${color}|${chisel ? 1 : 0}`
  const hit = dabCache.get(key)
  if (hit) return hit
  if (dabCache.size > 160) dabCache.clear()
  const pad = 2
  const c = createCanvas(size + pad * 2, size + pad * 2)
  const g = ctx2d(c)
  const r = size / 2
  const cx = r + pad
  const [R, G, B] = hexToRgb(color)
  if (chisel) {
    g.translate(cx, cx)
    g.rotate(-Math.PI / 5)
    g.fillStyle = `rgb(${R},${G},${B})`
    g.fillRect(-r, -r * 0.32, size, r * 0.64)
  } else if (hardness >= 0.98 || size <= 2) {
    g.fillStyle = `rgb(${R},${G},${B})`
    g.beginPath()
    g.arc(cx, cx, r, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    g.fill()
  } else {
    const grad = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cx, 0, cx, cx, r)
    grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${R},${G},${B},1)`)
    grad.addColorStop(Math.max(0.01, hardness * 0.98), `rgba(${R},${G},${B},1)`)
    grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${R},${G},${B},0)`)
    g.fillStyle = grad
    g.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height)
  }
  dabCache.set(key, c)
  return c
}

export type StrokePoint = { x: number; y: number; p: number }

export type StrokeState = {
  last: StrokePoint | null
  carry: number
  travelled: number
  bbox: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number }
}

export function newStroke(): StrokeState {
  return { last: null, carry: 0, travelled: 0, bbox: { x0: Infinity, y0: Infinity, x1: -Infinity, y1: -Infinity } }
}

/**
 * Stamps dabs between the previous and current point onto `target`.
 * `mirrorW` mirrors every dab across the vertical centre line (symmetry mode).
 */
export function strokeTo(
  target: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  s: StrokeState,
  pt: StrokePoint,
  opts: { size: number; color: string; preset: BrushPreset; mirrorW?: number | null },
) {
  const { size, color, preset } = opts
  const from = s.last ?? pt
  const dx = pt.x - from.x
  const dy = pt.y - from.y
  const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy)
  const step = Math.max(0.5, size * preset.spacing)
  const stamp = (x: number, y: number, p: number) => {
    let scale = 1 - preset.pressureSize + preset.pressureSize * p
    if (preset.taper) scale *= Math.min(1, 0.25 + s.travelled / (size * 6))
    const d = Math.max(1, size * scale)
    const tip = dabFor(d, preset.hardness, color, Boolean(preset.chisel))
    target.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, preset.flow * (1 - preset.pressureFlow + preset.pressureFlow * p))
    const half = tip.width / 2
    target.drawImage(tip, x - half, y - half)
    if (opts.mirrorW) target.drawImage(tip, opts.mirrorW - x - half, y - half)
    const b = s.bbox
    const xs = opts.mirrorW ? [x, opts.mirrorW - x] : [x]
    for (const xx of xs) {
      b.x0 = Math.min(b.x0, xx - half)
      b.x1 = Math.max(b.x1, xx + half)
    }
    b.y0 = Math.min(b.y0, y - half)
    b.y1 = Math.max(b.y1, y + half)
  }

  if (!s.last) {
    stamp(pt.x, pt.y, pt.p)
    s.last = pt
    return
  }
  let t = s.carry
  while (t <= dist) {
    const k = dist ? t / dist : 0
    s.travelled += step
    stamp(from.x + dx * k, from.y + dy * k, from.p + (pt.p - from.p) * k)
    t += step
  }
  s.carry = t - dist
  s.last = pt
  target.globalAlpha = 1
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Shapes */

export function drawShape(
  g: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  tool: 'line' | 'rect' | 'ellipse',
  a: { x: number; y: number },
  b: { x: number; y: number },
  opts: { size: number; color: string; fill: boolean; mirrorW?: number | null },
) {
  const paint = (ax: number, bx: number) => {
    g.beginPath()
    if (tool === 'line') {
      g.moveTo(ax, a.y)
      g.lineTo(bx, b.y)
    } else if (tool === 'rect') {
      g.rect(Math.min(ax, bx), Math.min(a.y, b.y), Math.abs(bx - ax), Math.abs(b.y - a.y))
    } else {
      g.ellipse((ax + bx) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2, Math.abs(bx - ax) / 2, Math.abs(b.y - a.y) / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    }
    if (opts.fill && tool !== 'line') {
      g.fillStyle = opts.color
      g.fill()
    } else {
      g.strokeStyle = opts.color
      g.lineWidth = opts.size
      g.lineCap = 'round'
      g.lineJoin = 'round'
      g.stroke()
    }
  }
  paint(a.x, b.x)
  if (opts.mirrorW) paint(opts.mirrorW - a.x, opts.mirrorW - b.x)
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Flood fill */

/** Scanline flood fill on one layer. Returns false when the target already matches. */
export function floodFill(layer: HTMLCanvasElement, sx: number, sy: number, hex: string, tolerance: number, alpha: number) {
  const w = layer.width
  const h = layer.height
  const x0 = Math.floor(sx)
  const y0 = Math.floor(sy)
  if (x0 < 0 || y0 < 0 || x0 >= w || y0 >= h) return false
  const g = layer.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true })!
  const img = g.getImageData(0, 0, w, h)
  const d = img.data
  const i0 = (y0 * w + x0) * 4
  const tr = d[i0]
  const tg = d[i0 + 1]
  const tb = d[i0 + 2]
  const ta = d[i0 + 3]
  const [fr, fg, fb] = hexToRgb(hex)
  const fa = Math.round(alpha * 255)
  if (tr === fr && tg === fg && tb === fb && ta === fa) return false
  const tol = tolerance * tolerance * 4
  const match = (i: number) => {
    const r = d[i] - tr
    const gg = d[i + 1] - tg
    const b = d[i + 2] - tb
    const a = d[i + 3] - ta
    return r * r + gg * gg + b * b + a * a <= tol
  }
  const seen = new Uint8Array(w * h)
  const stack: number[] = [x0, y0]
  while (stack.length) {
    const y = stack.pop()!
    let x = stack.pop()!
    while (x >= 0 && !seen[y * w + x] && match((y * w + x) * 4)) x--
    x++
    let up = false
    let down = false
    while (x < w && !seen[y * w + x] && match((y * w + x) * 4)) {
      const p = y * w + x
      seen[p] = 1
      const i = p * 4
      d[i] = fr
      d[i + 1] = fg
      d[i + 2] = fb
      d[i + 3] = fa
      if (y > 0) {
        const m = !seen[p - w] && match((p - w) * 4)
        if (m && !up) stack.push(x, y - 1)
        up = m
      }
      if (y < h - 1) {
        const m = !seen[p + w] && match((p + w) * 4)
        if (m && !down) stack.push(x, y + 1)
        down = m
      }
      x++
    }
  }
  // Grow the fill by one pixel so anti-aliased line art leaves no halo.
  const grown = new Uint8ClampedArray(d)
  for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
    for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++) {
      const p = y * w + x
      if (seen[p]) continue
      if (seen[p - 1] || seen[p + 1] || seen[p - w] || seen[p + w]) {
        const i = p * 4
        if (d[i + 3] < 250) {
          grown[i] = fr
          grown[i + 1] = fg
          grown[i + 2] = fb
          grown[i + 3] = Math.max(d[i + 3], fa)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  img.data.set(grown)
  g.putImageData(img, 0, 0)
  return true
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Export */

export function canvasToDataUrl(c: HTMLCanvasElement, type: 'image/webp' | 'image/png', quality = 0.9) {
  const url = c.toDataURL(type, quality)
  // Safari can't encode WebP and silently returns PNG; that's fine, the server accepts both.
  return url
}

export function scaledCopy(src: HTMLCanvasElement, maxSide: number, background?: string) {
  const k = Math.min(1, maxSide / Math.max(src.width, src.height))
  const c = createCanvas(Math.max(1, Math.round(src.width * k)), Math.max(1, Math.round(src.height * k)))
  const g = ctx2d(c)
  if (background) {
    g.fillStyle = background
    g.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height)
  }
  g.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'
  g.drawImage(src, 0, 0, c.width, c.height)
  return c
}

export function loadImage(src: string) {
  return new Promise<HTMLImageElement>((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image()
    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'
    img.onload = () => resolve(img)
    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Görsel yüklenemedi'))
    img.src = src
  })
}
